Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司使用缔约另一方机场、设备、技术服务及航行设施时，应按照缔约另一方主管当局制定的公平合理费率支付费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rates Shall not be higher than those normally paid by other airlines for similar services .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于其他航空公司为同类服务通常支付的费用标准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10 [ 1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have fair and equal opportunity to carry on the agreed services traffic embarked in the territory of one Contracting party and disembarked in the territory of the other Contracting Party or vice versa and shall regard as being of supplementary character traffic embarked or disembarked in the territory of the other Contracting Party to and from point on route .
Translation: 第十条 一、缔约各方指定空运企业在经营协议航班时，应享有公平均等的机会，以承运在一方领土内上客而在另一方领土内下客的协议航班业务，或反之。对于在另一方领土内上下客而往返于航线各点的业务，应视为具有补充性质。

Query_Text_en: The designated airline of each Contracting Party in providing capacity for the carriage of traffic embarked in the territory of the other Contracting Party and disembarked at point on the specified routes or vice versa shall take into consideration the primary interest of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party in such traffic so as not affect unduly that interest of the latter airline .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司在为对方缔约方领土内始发、经规定航线至某点终止或反向运输的旅客提供运力时，应充分考虑对方指定航空公司在此类运输中的主要利益，以免不当损害该航空公司的权益。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the requirements of the public for such services .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司提供的协议航班服务，应与公众对此类服务的需求保持密切关联。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall have as its primary objective the provision of capacity adequate to meet the demands to carry passengers , baggages , cargo and mail embarked or disembarked in the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 三、各缔约方应以确保其指定航空公司有足够运力满足在本方领土内上下旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输需求为首要目标。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] traffic demands of the area through which the airline passes , after taking account of local and regional services .
Translation: 并综合考虑地方及区域航线服务后，评估该航线途经区域的航空运输需求。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The capacity to be provided at the outset shall be agreed between both Contracting Parties before the agreed services are inaugurated .
Translation: [5]双方缔约机构应在协议航线开航前，就初期提供的运力达成一致。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , the capacity to be provided shall be discussed from time to time between the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties and any changes in capacity agreed upon shall be confirmed by an Exchange of Notes .
Translation: 此后，缔约双方航空当局应不时商定拟提供的运力，任何达成一致的运力调整均须通过换文予以确认。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 11 [ 1 ] The tariffs on the agreed services operated by the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors including costs of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of service and the tariffs of other airlines for the whole or part of the same routes .
Translation: 第十一条 一、缔约各方指定航空公司在协议航班上采用的运价，应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑所有相关因素，包括经营成本、合理利润、航班特点以及其他航空公司在整个航线或航段上的运价。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Such tariffs shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting parties .
Translation: 上述运价应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定。

Query_Text_en: The tariffs so agreed shall , preceding their coming into effect , be submitted for the approval of their respective Aeronautical Authorities .
Translation: 双方商定的运价在生效前，应提交各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] If the designated airlines of both Contracting parties can not agree on the tariffs , or if the Aeronautical Authorities of either Contracting Party do not approve the tariffs submitted to them in accordance with provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] [ a ] of this Article , the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach appropriate tariffs .
Translation: 如缔约双方指定航空公司无法就运价达成一致，或任一方航空当局未按本条第二款第（一）项规定批准所提交的运价，缔约双方航空当局应努力商定适当运价。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] If the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties can not agree on the tariffs in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph [ 2 ] [ b ] of the Article , the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 如缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款第二项规定就运价达成一致，则应根据本协定第十五条规定解决争议。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Pending determination of new tariffs in accordance with the provisions of this Article , the tariffs already in force shall prevail .
Translation: [ d ] 在根据本条规定确定新关税前，现行关税继续有效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 12The excess of receipt over expenditure derived from the transportation of international traffic by the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be permitted to be transferred , at the official rate , by the other Contracting Party in accordance with its foreign exchange regulations .
Translation:
第十二条
缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输业务所得收入超过支出时，缔约另一方应按照其外汇管理规定，允许该航空公司按官方汇率将超额部分汇出。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13 [ 1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to establish and operate branch offices with staff of its own at the point [ s ] of the specified routes provided for in the Annex to the present Agreement as well as to appoint any general sales agent and ground handling agent in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十三条 一、缔约各方指定空运企业有权在本协定附件规定的航线地点设立和经营自派工作人员的分支机构，并可在缔约另一方领土内指定任何销售总代理和地面服务代理。

Query_Text_en: Such right shall be granted to or enjoyed by the designated airline of either Contracting Party on reciprocal basis .
Translation: 缔约任何一方指定空运企业的此项权利，应在对等基础上给予或享有。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such offices shall be the nationals of either Contracting Party . The number of staff of such offices other than those locally employed shall be agreed upon through consultation between the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 此类办事处的工作人员应为缔约任何一方的国民。除当地雇用的员工外，此类办事处的工作人员人数应由缔约双方主管部门协商确定。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such offices shall observe the laws and regulations of the State where such offices are located .
Translation: 该等办事处的工作人员应遵守办事处所在国的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party shall , in accordance with its internal laws and regulations , extend assistance and facilities to the representative offices of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and take those necessary measures for ensuring the availability of fuel supply as well as the safety of aircraft , spare parts , regular equipment and other properties of the said designated airline to be used on the agreed services in the territory of the first Contracting Party , similar to those taken for its own designated airline .
Translation: [ 2 ] 缔约各方应根据其国内法律法规，向另一缔约方指定航空企业的代表机构提供协助与便利，并采取必要措施确保该指定航空企业在缔约一方领土内经营协议航班所需的燃油供应及航空器、零部件、常规设备和其他财产的安全，其待遇应与为本国指定航空企业所采取的同类措施相当。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 14The Aeronautical Authorities of each Contracting Party shall supply to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party at their request such periodic or other statements of statistics as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided on the agreed services by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十四条  
缔约任何一方的航空当局应对方航空当局要求，应提供合理的定期或其他统计数据报表，以便审查该缔约一方指定航空公司在协议航班上提供的运力。

Query_Text_en: Such statements shall include all information required to determine the amount of traffic carried by the airline on the agreed services .
Translation: 此类报表须包含确定该航空公司在协议航班上所承运业务量所需的全部信息。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15 [ 1 ] In a spirit of close cooperation , the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties shall , as required , consult each other at any time with a view to ensuring the implementation of the provisions of the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十五条 第一款 缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神，根据需要随时就本协定各项规定的实施进行协商。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If any dispute arises between the Contracting parties relating to the interpretation or application of the present Agreement , the Contracting Parties shall settle it by negotiation between themselves in a spirit of friendly co - operation and mutual understanding .
Translation: [ 2 ] 缔约双方如因本协议之解释或适用发生争议，应以友好合作与相互谅解之精神，通过双方协商予以解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify any provision of the present Agreement it shall request consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十六条  
如缔约任何一方认为有必要修改本协定条款，应向缔约另一方提出磋商请求。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation , which may be conducted between the Aeronautical Authorities , shall begin within a period of sixty days as from the date of the request .
Translation: 此类磋商可由双方航空当局进行，并应自收到请求之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Any modifications se agreed shall come into force when confirmed by an exchange of Diplomatic Notes ,
Translation: 双方同意的任何修改应在外交换文确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 1 7After the date of signature , the present Agreement shall enter into force on the day of the exchange of Diplomatic Notes .
Translation: 第一条 本协定自签署之日起生效，并于外交照会交换之日正式实施。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation:
第十八条  
缔约任何一方可随时通知另一方终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party unless by an agreement between the contracting Parties the notice under reference is withdrawn before the expiry of this period .
Translation: 本协定应于缔约另一方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非缔约双方在该期限届满前达成协议撤销该通知。

Query_Text_en: Done in Beijing on this Twenty-sixth day of June l980 , in duplicate in the Chinese , Thai and English languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九八〇年六月二十六日订于北京，一式三份，每份均用中文、泰文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: In case of divergent interpretations of the Chinese and Thai texts , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如中泰文本解释出现歧义，以英文本为准。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 PERSONS COVERED This Agreement shall apply to persons who are residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation: 第一条 适用对象 本协定适用于缔约国一方或双方居民。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约国一方或其地方当局对所得征收的各种税收，不论其征收方式如何。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income all taxes imposed on total income , or on elements of income , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property and taxes on the total amounts of wages or salaries paid by enterprises .
Translation: 凡对全部所得或单项所得课征的税收，包括对转让动产或不动产取得的收益征收的税收，以及对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收，均应视为所得税。

Query_Text_en: [ hereinafter referred to as `` Netherlands tax '' ] .
Translation: [以下简称“荷兰税收”]。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Agreement shall apply also to any identical or substantially similar taxes that are imposed after the date of signature of the Agreement in addition to , or in place of , the existing taxes .
Translation: 本协定亦适用于协定签署之日后征收的、替代现行税种或与之性质相同或实质相似的任何税收。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other of any significant changes that have been made in their taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约双方主管当局应将各自税法所作的重大变动通知对方。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] any legal person , partnership or association deriving its status as such from the laws in force in a Contracting State .
Translation: [二]根据缔约方法律成立的法人、合伙企业或协会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of the Agreement at any time by a Contracting State , any term not defined therein shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning that it has at that time under the law of that State for the purposes of the taxes to which the Agreement applies , any meaning under the applicable tax laws of that State prevailing over a meaning given to the term under other laws of that State .
Translation: 二、在缔约国一方适用本协定时，对未经协定定义的术语，除上下文另有要求外，应具有该缔约国适用于本协定所涉税种的法律所规定的含义，且该缔约国税法对术语的界定效力优先于其国内其他法律所作的定义。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of incorporation , place of effective management or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State or local authority thereof .
Translation: 一、在本协定中，"缔约国一方居民"一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、管理机构所在地、总机构所在地或者其他类似性质的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，也包括该缔约国或其地方当局。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` permanent establishment '' means a fixed-4-place of business through which the business of an enterprise is wholly or partly carried on .
Translation: 1. 就本协定而言，"常设机构"一语是指企业进行全部或部分营业的固定营业场所。

Query_Text_en: f ] a mine , an oil or gas well , a quarry or any other place of extraction of natural resources .
Translation: f ] 矿井、油井或气井、采石场及任何其他自然资源开采场所。

Query_Text_en: b ] the furnishing of services , including consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel engaged by the enterprise for such purpose , but only if activities of that nature continue [ for the same or a connected project ] within a Contracting State for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any twelve month period .
Translation: b）企业通过雇员或为上述目的聘用的其他人员提供服务（包括咨询服务），但仅以该性质的活动在任何十二个月中连续或累计超过183天在缔约国一方为同一项目或相关联项目开展为限。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person - other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies - is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and has , and habitually exercises , in that Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that-5-Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力以该企业的名义签订合同（除第六款所指的独立代理人外），则该企业应认为在该缔约国一方设有常设机构。但该人的活动仅限于第四款所提及的活动，且该等活动若通过固定营业场所进行，根据该款规定该固定营业场所不会构成常设机构时，则不在此限。

Query_Text_en: However , when the activities of such an agent are devoted wholly or almost wholly on behalf of that enterprise , and conditions are made or imposed between that enterprise and the agent in their commercial and financial relations which differ from those which would have been made between independent enterprises , he will not be considered an agent of an independent status within the meaning of this paragraph .
Translation: 然而，当该代理人的活动全部或几乎全部代表该企业，且该企业与代理人在商业和财务关系中设定的条件不同于独立企业之间本应达成的条件时，该代理人将不被视为本款所指的独立地位代理人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In determining the profits of a permanent establishment , there shall be allowed as deductions expenses which are incurred for the purposes of the permanent establishment , including executive and general administrative expenses so incurred , whether in the State in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere .
Translation: 在确定常设机构的利润时，应扣除为该常设机构目的而发生的各项费用，包括行政管理和一般管理费用，不论其发生于常设机构所在国或其他任何地方。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In so far as it has been customary in a Contracting State to determine the profits to be attributed to a permanent establishment on the basis of an apportionment of the total profits of the enterprise to its various parts , nothing in paragraph 2 shall preclude that Contracting State from determining the profits to be taxed by such an apportionment as may be customary ;
Translation: 四、若缔约国一方一贯采用将企业总利润按比例分摊给各分支机构的方法来确定常设机构的应税利润，则第二款之规定不妨碍该缔约国继续采用此种惯用的分摊方法核定应纳税利润。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State C and taxes accordingly - profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润（该利润本应归属于首先提及的缔约国一方企业，若双方企业间的交易条件符合独立企业间正常交易原则）计入本国企业利润并征税时，该另一缔约国应对这部分利润所征税款作出相应调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed :
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可在支付股息公司居民所属的缔约国征税，并依据该国法律执行；但若股息受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不应超过以下限额：

Query_Text_en: b ] 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases .
Translation: b）其他情况下，股息总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement settle the mode of application of these limitations .
Translation: 缔约双方主管当局应通过协商确定上述限制的实施方式。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State if the beneficial owner of the dividends is the Government of that other Contracting State , any of its institutions or any other entity the capital of which is wholly owned directly or indirectly by that other Contracting State .
Translation: 三、虽有第二款之规定，但作为缔约国一方居民的公司向缔约国另一方居民支付的股息，若该股息的受益所有人为该缔约国另一方的政府、其任何机构或由该缔约国另一方直接或间接全资拥有的其他实体，则该项股息应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article means income from shares or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 四、本条"股息"一语是指从股份或者非债权关系分享利润的权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司是其居民的缔约国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如股息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司为其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，则不适用第一款及第二款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The provisions of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the shares or other rights in respect of which the dividends are paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 七、如股分或其它权利的产生或转让的主要目的或主要目的之一，在于利用本条规定以谋取利益，则本条不适用于因该股分或其它权利而支付的股息。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 perceng of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 二、然而，此项利息也可在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to , or on loans guaranteed or insured by , the Government or a local authority , the Central Bank , or any financial institution wholly owned by the other Contracting State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、虽有第二款规定，发生于缔约国一方并由缔约国另一方政府、地方当局、中央银行或其全资金融机构支付或担保（保险）贷款所产生的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国免予征税。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] any other institution as may be agreed from time to time between the competent authorities of the Contracting States .
Translation: [三] 缔约国双方主管当局随时协商确定的其他机构。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The term `` interest '' as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 第五条  本条所称"利息"一语，系指从各种债权所取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如利息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且据以支付利息的债权与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，则第一款及第二款的规定不予适用。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is a resident of that State .
Translation: 七、利息应认为发生于缔约国一方，当支付人是该缔约国居民时。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the interest , having regard to the debt-claim for which it is paid , exceeds the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 八、由于支付人与受益所有人之间存在特殊关系，或由于他们双方与第三方存在特殊关系，就支付利息的债权而言，所支付的利息数额超出支付人与受益所有人在无上述关系情况下所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后一数额。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The provisions of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 九、若利息支付所涉债务的创设或转让相关方，其主要目的或目的之一是通过此类创设或转让行为利用本条条款，则本条各项规定概不适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed :
Translation: 二、然而，此项特许权使用费也可在发生该项所得的缔约国，按照该国法律征税。但如果特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过：

Query_Text_en: b ] in the case of royalties referred to in sub-paragraph b ] of paragraph 3 , 10 percent of the adjusted amount of the royalties .
Translation: 对于第3款第2项所述的特许权使用费，调整后金额的10%。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this sub-paragraph `` the adjusted amount '' means 60 percent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 就本款而言，"调整后金额"指特许权使用费总额的60%。

Query_Text_en: and b ] payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment .
Translation: b）作为使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备而收取的任何形式的报酬款项。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is a resident of that Contracting State .
Translation: 五、特许权使用费应视为发生于缔约国一方，当支付人为该缔约国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment-11-or a fixed base in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 然而，当特许权使用费的支付者（无论其是否为缔约国居民）在缔约国一方设有常设机构或固定基地，且支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或固定基地相关联，并由其负担此项费用时，则应认为该特许权使用费发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在国。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The provisions of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the rights in respect of which the royalties are paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 七、如果特许权使用费收款人与权利创设或转让相关方的主要目的或主要目的之一，是通过此类创设或转让行为利用本条优惠，则本条规定不予适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such a fixed base , maybe taxed in that other State .
Translation: 二、缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方常设机构营业财产中的动产，或缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务所用固定基地的动产转让所得（包括转让该常设机构[单独或连同整个企业]或该固定基地所获收益），可在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic , or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 三、转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或转让附属于经营上述船舶或飞机的动产所取得的收益，应仅在企业实际管理机构所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares deriving more than 50 percent of their value directly or indirectly from immovable property situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民转让其直接或间接持有价值50%以上源自缔约国另一方不动产的股份所取得的收益，可在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State if the recipient of the gain , at any time during the twelve month period preceding such alienation , had a participation , directly or indirectly , of at least 25 perceng in the capital of that company .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民转让缔约国另一方居民公司股份所取得的收益，若该收益取得者在转让行为发生前的十二个月内曾直接或间接持有该公司至少25%的资本，则该项收益可在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: or b ] held by the Government of a Contracting State , any of its institutions or any other entity the capital of which is wholly owned by that Contracting State , provided that such institution or entity is a resident of that Contracting State .
Translation: 由缔约国政府、其任何机构或该缔约国全资拥有的任何其他实体持有的债券，但该机构或实体须为该缔约国的居民。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Gains from the alienation of any property , other than that referred to in paragraphs 1 to 5 , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 七、转让第一款至第五款所述以外的任何财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: orb ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve month period commencing or end in gin the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: 若其在缔约国另一方停留的时间，在有关财政年度内任何起止的十二个月期间累计达到或超过183天；

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 16 , 18 and 19 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 在遵循第十六条、第十八条及第十九条规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。但受雇于缔约国另一方的情形除外。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 三、虽有本条上述规定，缔约国一方居民因受雇于从事国际运输的船舶或飞机上工作而取得的报酬，可在该企业实际管理机构所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 DIRECTORS ' FEES 1 . Directors ' fees and other remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation:
第十六条 董事费条款

一、缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purpose of the provisions of paragraph 1 , the term `` member of the board of directors '' includes any person who is charged with the general management of the company and any person who is charged with the supervision thereof .
Translation: 二、就第一款规定而言，"董事会成员"一词包括负责公司全面管理的任何人员及负责公司监督的任何人员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or a sportsman in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or sportsman himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 , 14 and 15 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or sportsman are exercised .
Translation: 二、表演家或运动员从事个人活动取得的所得，若非归属表演家或运动员本人，而是归属于其他人员，则虽有第七条、第十四条及第十五条之规定，该项所得仍可在该表演家或运动员从事活动的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from activities exercised in the other Contracting State , if the visit to that other State is wholly or mainly supported by public funds of the first-mentioned State or local authorities thereof , or takes place under a cultural agreement between the Governments of the Contracting States .
Translation: 三、缔约国一方居民因由该缔约国或其地方当局公共资金全部或主要资助的访问，或根据缔约国双方政府间文化协定进行的访问，在缔约国另一方从事活动取得的所得，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。

Query_Text_en: In such a case , the income shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the entertainer or sportsman is a resident .
Translation: 在此情况下，该所得应仅在演艺人员或运动员为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 19 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 在遵守第十九条第二款规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因退休金及其他类似报酬所得，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , pensions and other similar remuneration , whether or not periodic in nature , insofar as the contributions or payments associated with the pension or other similar remuneration , or the entitlements received from them , have qualified for tax relief in the other Contracting State , may also be taxed in that State .
Translation: 二、然而，养老金及其他类似报酬（无论是否定期支付），只要与该养老金或类似报酬相关的缴款或款项，或由此产生的权益已在另一缔约国享受税收减免，则该另一缔约国亦可对其征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 , pensions paid and other similar payments made by the Government of a Contracting State or local authority thereof under the social security system of that State , whether or not periodic in nature , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 三、虽有第一款规定，缔约国一方政府或其地方当局按该国社会保障制度支付的养老金和其他类似款项，不论其是否具有定期支付性质，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration paid by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or authority , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 一、缔约国一方政府或其地方当局支付给向其提供服务的个人的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 二、a）虽有第一款规定，缔约国一方或其地方当局支付或从其建立的基金中支付给向其政府或地方当局提供服务的个人的退休金或其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: b ] However , such pensions and other similar remuneration shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State if the individual is a resident of , and a national of , that State .
Translation: 然而，此类养老金及其他类似报酬仅在该个人为缔约国另一方居民且为该国国民时，可在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages , pensions and other similar remuneration in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府或其地方当局经营业务提供服务取得的工资、薪金、养老金和其他类似报酬。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 STUDENTS Payments which a student who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education receives for the purpose of his maintenance or education shall not be taxed in that State , provided that such payments arise from sources outside that State .
Translation:
第二十条 学生  
作为或曾是缔约国另一方居民的学生，仅为接受教育目的而停留在首先提及的缔约国一方，其从该缔约国一方境外取得的用于维持生活或接受教育的款项，应在该缔约国一方免税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , items of income of a resident of a Contracting State not dealt with in the foregoing Articles of this Agreement and arising in the other Contracting State may also be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 三、虽有第一款及第二款之规定，本协定前述条款未作规定的缔约国一方居民的各项所得，凡发生于缔约国另一方者，亦可在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from the Netherlands , the amount of tax on that income payable in the Netherlands in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 当中国居民从荷兰取得所得时，依照本协定规定就该所得在荷兰缴纳的税额，可以在该居民的中国税收中抵免。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from the Netherlands is dividend paid by a company which is a resident of the Netherlands to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 20 percent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid in the Netherlands by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 二、在荷兰取得的所得为荷兰居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，且中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%时，该项抵免应考虑支付股息公司就该项所得缴纳的荷兰税收。

Query_Text_en: b ] However , where a resident of the Netherlands derives items of income which according to paragraphs 1 , 3 and 4 of Article 6 , paragraph 1 of Article 7 , paragraphs 1and 3 of Article 8 , paragraph 5 of Article 10 , paragraph 6 of Article 11 , paragraph 4 of Article 12 , paragraphs 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 and 5 of Article 13 , paragraph 1 of Article 14 , paragraphs 1 and 3 of Article 15 , paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 18 , sub-paragraph a ] of paragraph 1 and sub-paragraph a ] of paragraph 2 of Article 19 and paragraph 2 of Article21 of this Agreement may be taxed or shall be taxable only in China and are included in the basis referred to in sub-paragraph a ] of paragraph 2 of this Article , the Netherlands shall exempt such items of income by allowing a reduction of its tax .
Translation: 然而，若荷兰居民取得的所得项目根据本协定第六条第一、三、四款、第七条第一款、第八条第一、三款、第十条第五款、第十一条第六款、第十二条第四款、第十三条第一、二、三、四、五款、第十四条第一款、第十五条第一、三款、第十八条第二、三款、第十九条第一款a项及第二款a项以及第二十一条第二款之规定，可在中国征税或应仅在中国征税，且该所得已计入本条第二款a项所述税基，荷兰应通过准予税收抵免的方式对该类所得予以免税。

Query_Text_en: This reduction shall be computed in conformity with the provisions of the Netherlands law for the avoidance of double taxation .
Translation: 此项减免应依照荷兰避免双重征税法律规定计算。

Query_Text_en: c ] Further , the Netherlands shall allow a reduction from the Netherlands tax so computed for the items of income which according to paragraph 2 of Article 10 , paragraph 2 of Article 11 , paragraph 2 of Article 12 , paragraph 1 of Article 16 , paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 17 and paragraph 3 of Article 21 of this Agreement may be taxed or shall be taxable only in China to the extent that these items are included in the basis referred to in sub-paragraph a ] of paragraph 2 of this Article .
Translation: 此外，对于本协定第十条第二款、第十一条第二款、第十二条第二款、第十六条第一款、第十七条第一及第二款以及第二十一条第三款所述可在中国征税或应仅在中国征税的各项所得，荷兰应允许从按上述a项计算的荷兰税收中予以抵免，但抵免额不得超过上述各项所得在计算荷兰税收时所适用的税基部分。

Query_Text_en: The amount of this reduction shall be equal to the tax paid in China on these items of income , but shall , in case the provisions of the Netherlands law for the avoidance of double taxation provide so , not exceed the amount of the reduction which would be allowed if the items of income so included were the sole items of income which are exempt from the Netherlands tax under the provisions of the Netherlands law for the avoidance of double taxation .
Translation: 该项抵免额应等于对这些所得项目在中国缴纳的税额，但根据荷兰关于避免双重征税的法律规定，不得超过抵免前就这些所得项目计算的荷兰税收数额（假设这些所得项目是适用荷兰避免双重征税法律规定的唯一免税所得）。

Query_Text_en: This paragraph shall not restrict allowance now or hereafter accorded by the provisions of the Netherlands law for the avoidance of double taxation , but only as far as the calculation of the amount of the reduction of the Netherlands tax is concerned with respect to the aggregation of income from more than one country and the carry-forward of the tax paid in China on the said items of income to subsequent years .
Translation: 本条款不妨碍荷兰现行或未来关于避免双重征税的法律规定所允许的税收减免，但仅适用于以下情形：在计算荷兰税收减免额时涉及多国收入汇总，以及将中国针对上述收入项目已征税款结转至后续年度处理的情形。

Query_Text_en: d ] Notwithstanding the provisions of sub-paragraph b ] of paragraph 2 of this Article , the Netherlands shall allow a reduction from the Netherlands tax for the tax paid in China on items of income which according to paragraph 1 of Article 7 , paragraph 5 of Article 10 , paragraph 6 of Article 11 , paragraph 4 of Article 12 , paragraph 4 of Article 13 and paragraph 2 of Article 21 of this Agreement may be taxed or shall be taxable only in China to the extent that these items are included in the basis referred to in sub-paragraph a ] of paragraph 2 of this Article , insofar as the Netherlands under the provisions of the Netherlands law for the avoidance of double taxation allows a reduction from the Netherlands tax of the tax levied in another country on such items of income .
Translation: 虽有本条第2款第2项之规定，荷兰应允许从荷兰税收中抵免就本协定第七条第一款、第十条第五款、第十一条第六款、第十二条第四款、第十三条第四款以及第二十一条第二款规定可在中国征税或应仅在中国征税的各项所得所缴纳的中国税收，但以上各项所得须已根据本条第2款第1项规定计入荷兰税基，且抵免额不得超过荷兰法律关于避免双重征税的规定中对上述所得项在另一国所征税款给予抵免的限额。

Query_Text_en: For the computation of this reduction the provisions of sub-paragraph c ] of paragraph 2 of this Article shall apply accordingly .
Translation: 在计算此项减让时，应适用本条第二款第c项的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 MISCELLANEOUS RULE Nothing in this Agreement shall prejudice the right of each Contracting State to apply its domestic laws and measures concerning the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance , whether or not described as such , insofar as they do not give rise to taxation contrary to this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十三条 其他规定  
本协定不妨碍各缔约国适用其国内关于防止逃税与避税（无论是否如此表述）的法律和措施，只要此类适用不导致与本协定相抵触的征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith , which is other or more burden some than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of that other State in the same circumstances , in particular with respect to residence , are or may be subjected .
Translation: 一缔约国国民在另一缔约国所负担的税收或有关条件，不应与该另一缔约国国民在相同情况下（特别是关于居民身份）所负担或可能负担的税收或有关条件不同或比其更重。

Query_Text_en: This-17-provision shall , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 1 , also apply to persons who are not residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation: 虽有第一条之规定，本第十七条规定亦适用于非缔约国一方或双方居民之人士。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except where the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 9 , paragraph 8 of Article 11 , or paragraph 6 of Article 12 apply , interest , royalties and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、除适用第九条第一款、第十一条第八款或第十二条第六款规定的情形外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应如同支付给该缔约国一方居民一样，在相同条件下准予扣除。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Enterprises of a Contracting State , the capital of which is wholly or partly owned or controlled , directly or indirectly , by one or more residents of the other Contracting State , shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of the first-mentioned State are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业，其资本全部或部分、直接或间接由缔约国另一方一个或多个居民拥有或控制，该企业在首先提及的缔约国一方所负担的税收或相关要求，不应比该缔约国一方同类企业所负担或可能负担的税收或相关要求更为苛刻。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , he may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States , present this case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident or , if his case comes under paragraph 1 of Article 24 , to that of the Contracting State of which he is a national .
Translation: 一、当一个人认为缔约国一方或双方的措施导致或将导致对其不符合本协定规定的征税时，可以不考虑各缔约国国内法的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局；或者如果其案情属于第二十四条第一款规定的情形，可以提交本人为其国民的缔约国主管当局。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income and on capital imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or of its local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约国一方或其地方当局对所得和财产征收的各种税收，不论其征收方式如何。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income and on capital all taxes imposed on total income , on total capital , or on elements of income , or of capital , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , as well as taxes on capital appreciation .
Translation: 凡对全部所得、全部资本或某项所得、某项资本课征的税收，包括对转让动产或不动产取得的收益课征的税收，以及对资本增值课征的税收，均应视为对所得和资本征收的税收。

Query_Text_en: [ V ] Royalties and taxes on results relating to activities of exploration , research , exploitation and transport of hydrocarbons by way of pipelines .
Translation: [五] 通过管道开展碳氢化合物勘探、研究、开采及运输活动所产生收益的专利使用费与税款。

Query_Text_en: [ II ] the Income Tax for enterprises with foreign investment and foreign enterprises .
Translation: [二]外商投资企业和外国企业所得税

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term resident of a Contracting State means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of head office , place of management or any other criterion of a similar nature .
Translation: 1. 本协定中，"缔约国一方居民"一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、总机构所在地、管理机构所在地，或者其他类似性质的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] if he is a national of both States or of neither of them the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the question by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如该个人为缔约国双方国民或非任何一方国民，应由缔约国双方主管当局通过协商解决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 , a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then it shall be deemed to be a resident only of the State in which its place of effective management is situated .
Translation: 三、由于第一款之规定，除个人以外之人为缔约国双方之居民时，应仅视为其实际管理机构所在国之居民。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term permanent establishment means a fixed place of business through which the business of the enterprise is wholly or partly carried on .
Translation: 1. 就本协定而言，"常设机构"一语是指企业进行全部或部分营业的固定营业场所。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] a mine , an oil or gas well , a quarry or any other place of extraction of natural resources .
Translation: 矿井、油井或气井、采石场及其他自然资源开采场所

Query_Text_en: 3 . A building site or construction or installation project constitutes a permanent establishment only if it lasts more than six months .
Translation: 建筑工地或建筑安装工程仅当持续超过六个月时，方可构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the maintenance of a fixed place of business solely for any combination of activities mentioned in subparagraphs [ a ] to [ e ] , provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from this combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character .
Translation: 仅以从事（a）至（e）项所述活动的组合为目的而设立的固定营业场所，只要该固定营业场所因这种组合而产生的总体活动具有准备性或辅助性特征。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person - other than an agent of independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies - is acting on behalf of an enterprise and has , and habitually exercises , in a Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款的独立代理人外）代表某企业在一缔约国开展活动，拥有并经常行使以该企业名义签订合同的授权时，就该人为企业从事的任何活动而言，应认为该企业在该缔约国设有常设机构，除非此人的活动仅限于第四款所述性质——若这些活动通过固定营业场所进行，按照该款规定也不会使该固定营业场所构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 6 . An enterprise shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in a Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 六、企业仅通过经纪人、一般佣金代理人或任何其他独立地位代理人在缔约国一方开展业务，且该等人员在正常业务范围内行事的，不应仅凭此认定该企业在缔约国一方构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: ships , aircraft shall not be regarded as immovable property .
Translation: 船舶、航空器不应视为不动产。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall also apply to income derived from the direct use , letting , or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 第一款规定亦适用于直接使用、出租或以任何其他形式使用不动产所取得的收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 3 shall also apply to the income from immovable property of an enterprise and to income from immovable property used for the performance of independent professional services .
Translation: 第一及第三款之规定亦适用于企业不动产所得及用于独立专业劳务之不动产所得。

Query_Text_en: However , no such deduction shall be allowed in respect of amounts , if any , paid [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission , for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way interest on moneys lent to the permanent establishment .
Translation: 但常设机构支付给企业总机构或该企业其他办事处的特许权使用费、服务费或其他类似款项（因使用专利权或其他权利而支付的款项除外），以及为提供特定服务或管理而支付的佣金，或因借款给该常设机构而支付的利息（银行企业除外），均不得作任何扣除（偿还实际发生的费用除外）。

Query_Text_en: Likewise , no account shall be taken , in the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , for amounts charged [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] , by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices .
Translation: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，该机构向企业总机构或其它办事处收取的特许权使用费、服务费或类似款项（用于专利或其它权利的使用），以及为特定服务或管理支付的佣金，或（银行企业除外）向企业总机构或其它办事处提供贷款所获利息等费用[实际费用报销除外]，均不得予以扣除。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 , shall also apply to profits from the participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 三、第一款规定亦适用于参与联营、合营或国际经营机构所获利润。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，且双方企业在商业或财务关系中设定的条件不同于独立企业之间本应达成的条件，则若非因这些条件本应归属于其中一方企业的利润，可计入该企业利润并相应征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State - and taxes accordingly - profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润——在两个企业之间的交易条件等同于独立企业间交易条件时，这部分利润本应归属于首先提及的缔约国一方企业——计入该缔约国一方企业的利润内并予以征税时，该缔约国另一方应对这部分利润所征税款作出适当调整。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Dividends paid by a company which is resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 一、缔约国一方居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息，可以在该另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases .
Translation: [ b ] 在所有其他情况下，股息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term dividends as used in this Article means , income from shares , not being debt-claims , participation in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 三、本条所称“股息”，是指从股份或者非债权关系分享利润的权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司是其居民的缔约国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident , through a permanent establishment situated therein or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如股息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司为其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，则不适用第一款及第二款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State , that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company except in so far as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or in so far as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax on the company 's undistributed profits , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in such other State .
Translation: 五、作为缔约国一方居民的公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得时，该另一方不得对该公司支付的股息征收任何税收，除非该股息支付给该另一方的居民，或者支付股息的股权与该另一方设立的常设机构或固定基地有实际联系。即使所支付的股息或未分配利润全部或部分来源于该另一方的利润或所得，该另一方也不得对公司的未分配利润征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 7 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 然而，此类利息也可在发生利息的缔约国依照该国法律征税。但如果利息受益所有人是另一缔约国居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的7%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and derived by the Government of the other Contracting State , a local authority and the Central Bank thereof or any financial institutions wholly owned by the Government of that other State , or by any other resident of that other State with respect to debt-claims financed by the Government of that other State , a local authority and the Central Bank thereof or any financial institutions wholly owned by the Government of that other State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、虽有第二款规定，发生于缔约国一方并由缔约国另一方政府、地方当局及其中央银行或完全为其政府所有的金融机构取得，或由该缔约国另一方其他居民取得但债权资金系由该另一方政府、地方当局及其中央银行或完全为其政府所有的金融机构所提供者，所生利息应在首先提及的缔约国免税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term interest as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 本条所称"利息"一语，指从各种债权所取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State , a local authority thereof or a resident of that State .
Translation: 六、利息应认为发生于缔约国一方，当支付人是该缔约国政府、其行政区或地方当局，或该缔约国居民时。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the interest , having regard to the debt-claim for which it is paid , exceeds the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last mentioned amount .
Translation: 7. 如因支付人与受益所有人之间存在特殊关系，或由于双方与第三方存在特殊关系，致使所支付的利息数额超出无此类关系时双方可能商定的金额（就该债权而言），则本条规定仅适用于该合理金额部分。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term royalties as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work , including cinematograph films , or films or tapes used for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or models , plan , secret formula or process , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称"特许权使用费"，是指为使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学作品（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带）的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或程序，或者有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在特许权使用费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且据以支付特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，则不适用第一款和第二款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is that State , a local authority thereof or a resident of that State .
Translation: 五、特许权使用费应认为发生于缔约国一方，如果支付人是该缔约国、其地方当局或该国居民。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships , aircraft or containers operated in international traffic or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships , aircraft or containers , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 三、转让从事国际运输的船舶、飞机或集装箱，或与经营上述船舶、飞机或集装箱有关的动产取得的收益，应仅在该企业实际管理机构所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs 1 , 2 , 3 and 4 shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 五、转让第一款、第二款、第三款及第四款所述财产以外的任何财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] if he has a fixed base regularly available to him in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing his activities ;
Translation: [甲] 若该人士在另一缔约国设有固定基地，且该基地可定期用于开展其业务活动；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] if his stay in the other State is for a period or periods aggregating 183 days or more in any twelve-month period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: [ b ] 如果他在该另一国停留的时间,在有关财政年度中开始或结束的任何十二个月期间合计达到或超过一百八十三天;

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term professional services includes especially independent scientific , literary , artistic , educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians , lawyers , engineers , architects , surgeons , dentists and accountants .
Translation: 2. 专业服务特别包括独立的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、外科医生、牙医和会计师的独立执业活动。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: 该报酬并非由雇主在另一国设立的常设机构或固定基地负担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在从事国际运输的船舶或飞机上受雇而取得的报酬，可在企业实际管理机构所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 14 and 15 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as a sportsperson , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 虽有第十四条和第十五条的规定，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，或作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事其个人活动取得的所得，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to the income from activities performed in a Contracting State by entertainers or sportspersons if the visit to that State is substantially supported by public funds of one or both of the Contracting States or local authorities thereof or the activity is exercised within the framework of cultural or sports cooperation agreement between the Contracting States .
Translation: 第一、二款规定不适用于表演家或运动员在缔约国一方从事活动取得的收入，若其访问该国的活动主要由缔约国一方或双方或其地方政府的公共资金资助，或该活动是在缔约国双方文化或体育合作协定框架下开展的。

Query_Text_en: In such a case , the income shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the entertainer or the sportsperson is a resident .
Translation: 在此情况下，该所得应仅在演艺人员或运动员为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 19 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 在遵守第十九条第二款规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因以前受雇而获得的养老金及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Remuneration , other than a pension , paid by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方或其地方当局向个人支付的、因向该缔约国或地方当局提供服务而取得的报酬（养老金除外），应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . [ a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 二、[甲] 缔约国一方或其地方当局向为该国或该地方当局提供服务的个人支付的、或从其建立的基金中支付的任何养老金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to remuneration and pensions in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第十五条、第十六条、第十七条及第十八条的规定，应适用于缔约国或其地方当局从事经营活动所支付的服务报酬及退休金。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A student , apprentice or business trainee who is present in a Contracting State solely for the purpose of his education or training and who is , or immediately before being so present was , a resident of the other Contracting State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State on payments received from outside that first-mentioned State for the purposes of his maintenance , education or training .
Translation: 一、学生、学徒或企业实习生，若仅为接受教育或培训目的而停留于一缔约国，且在抵达前或停留期间为另一缔约国居民，其从该缔约国境外取得的用于维持生活、接受教育或培训的款项，应在首先提及的缔约国免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In respect of grants , scholarships and remuneration from employment not covered by paragraph 1 , a student , apprentice or business trainee envisaged in paragraph 1 shall , in addition , be entitled during such education or training to the same exemptions , relief or reduction in respect of taxes available to residents of the State which he is visiting .
Translation: 二、关于第一条规定未涵盖的补助金、奖学金及受雇所得报酬，第一条所述学生、学徒或企业受训人员在接受教育或培训期间，还应享受与所在国居民同等的税收豁免、减免或优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not apply to income , other than income from immovable property as defined in paragraph 2 of Article 6 , if the beneficial owner of such income , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 二、第一款规定不适用于不动产所得以外的其他所得。如果此类所得的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，通过在缔约国另一方设立的常设机构进行营业，或者通过设在缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付该所得的权属或财产与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系，则不适用第一款规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Capital represented by immovable property referred to in Article 6 , owned by a resident of a Contracting State and situated in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 第六条所述不动产所代表的资本，如为缔约国一方居民所有且坐落于缔约国另一方，可在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Capital represented by movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or by movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , may also be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 二、缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方常设机构营业财产构成中的动产所代表的资本，或缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方为从事独立个人劳务而使用的固定基地附属动产所代表的资本，也可在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Capital represented by ships , aircraft and containers operated in international traffic and by movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships , aircraft and containers , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the enterprise owning such property is a resident .
Translation: 三、以从事国际运输的船舶、飞机及集装箱为代表的资本，以及与上述船舶、飞机及集装箱运营相关的动产，应仅在拥有该财产的企业为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Such deduction shall not , however , exceed that part of the tax on income or on capital , as computed before the deduction is given , which is attributable to the income or capital , as the case may be , which may be taxed in Algeria .
Translation: 然而，此项扣除额不得超过阿尔及利亚可征税收入或资本（视情况而定）在扣除前所计算所得税或资本税中对应的部分。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] where a resident of China derives income from or owns capital in Algeria , the amount of tax on that income or capital payable in Algeria in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 在中国居民从阿尔及利亚取得所得或拥有资本的情况下，根据本协定规定应在阿尔及利亚缴纳的该项所得或资本税收，可抵免该居民在中国应缴纳的税收。

Query_Text_en: The amount of the credit , however , shall not exceed the amount of the Chinese tax on that income or capital computed in accordance with the taxation laws and regulations of China ;
Translation: 然而，抵免额不得超过按照中国税法计算的该所得或资本项下中国税收的金额。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] where the income derived from Algeria is a dividend paid by a company which is a resident of Algeria to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 10 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Algeria by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: [ b ] 在源自阿尔及利亚的收入为阿尔及利亚居民公司向中国居民公司支付的股息，且该中国居民公司持有支付股息公司股份比例不低于10%的情况下，税收抵免应考虑支付股息公司就其所得向阿尔及利亚缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith , which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of that other State in the same circumstances , in particular with respect to residence , are or may be subjected .
Translation: 一缔约国国民在另一缔约国所负担的税收或相关义务，不应比该另一缔约国国民在相同情况下（特别是在居住方面）所负担或可能负担的税收或相关义务更重或更繁琐。

Query_Text_en: This provisions shall , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 1 , also apply to persons who are not residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation: 本条规定应适用于非缔约国一方或双方居民的个人，第一条之规定概不适用。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall not be construed as obliging a Contracting State to grant to residents of the other Contracting State any personnel allowances , reliefs and reduction for taxation purposes on account of civil status or family responsibilities which it grants to its own residents .
Translation: 本条款不得解释为，缔约国一方有义务在税收上给予缔约国另一方居民因其婚姻状况或家庭责任而向其本国居民提供的任何个人津贴、减免和优惠。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except where the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 9 , paragraph 7 of Article 11 , or paragraph 6 of Article 12 , apply , interest , royalties and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、除适用第九条第一款、第十一条第七款或第十二条第六款的规定外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应如同支付给首先提及的缔约国居民一样，在相同条件下准予扣除。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , any debts of an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable capital of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been contracted to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 同样，在确定缔约国一方企业的应税资本时，该企业欠缔约国另一方居民的债务，应与其欠首先提及的缔约国居民的债务在同等条件下予以扣除。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws concerning taxes of every kind and description imposed on behalf of the Contracting States , insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约双方主管当局应交换为实施本协定或缔约双方关于各种税种的国内法规定所需的信息，但以根据该税法征税不违反本协定为限。

Query_Text_en: Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] concerned with the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to , the taxes referred to in the first sentence . Such persons or authorities shall use the information only for such purposes .
Translation: 缔约国一方收到的任何信息，均应按照该国国内法获取信息的相同方式予以保密，且仅可向与首句所述税种的评税或征收、执行或起诉、或上诉裁决相关的人员或机关（包括法院和行政部门）披露。此类人员或机关仅能将信息用于上述目的。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] to supply information which would disclose any trade , business , industrial , commercial or professional secret or trade process , or information , the disclosure of which would be contrary to public policy [ ordre public ] .
Translation: [ c ] 提供的信息如涉及任何贸易、商业、工业、商业或专业秘密或工艺流程，或其披露有违公共政策[公共秩序]，则不予提供。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each of the Contracting States shall notify the other completion of the procedure required by its law for the bringing into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 1. 各缔约国应将本国为使本协定生效所需法律程序履行完毕的情况通知对方。

Query_Text_en: The Agreement shall enter into force on the date of the latter of these notifications .
Translation: 本协定自后一份通知收到之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] with regard to other taxes , in respect of the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following the date upon which the Agreement enters into forces .
Translation: [b] 关于其他税种，自本协定生效之日后次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely but either of the Contracting States may terminate the Agreement through diplomatic channels by giving to the other Contracting State a written notice of termination no later than 30 June of any calendar year starting five years after the year in which the Agreement enters into force .
Translation: 1. 本协定长期有效，但任一缔约方可自协定生效之日起满五年后，通过外交途径在任何公历年6月30日之前向另一缔约方发出书面终止通知，终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] with regard to other taxes , in respect of the taxable years beginning after the end of the calendar year in which such notice is given .
Translation: [b] 对于其他税种，自发出通知之公历年结束后开始的纳税年度起适用。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , duly authorized thereto , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 兹证明，下列签署人经正式授权，已签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: DONE in duplicate at Beijing this sixth day of November , 2006 , in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 二〇〇六年十一月六日于北京签订，一式两份，每份均以中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: In case of divergence in interpretation , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如遇解释分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] the term `` Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December 1944 , including any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 [ a ] thereof , so far as those Annexes and amendments have been adopted by both Parties .
Translation: 本公约所称"公约"，系指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第九十条通过的附件及根据第九十条和第九十四条[a]款对附件或公约所作之修正，但以缔约双方均已接受的附件和修正为限。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] the term `` aeronautical authorities '' means , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , or any person or agency authorized to perform any function presently exercised by the said Administration and in the case of the People 's Democratic Republic of Algeria , the Ministry responsible for Civil Aviation or any person or agency authorized to perform any function presently exercised by the said Ministry .
Translation: "航空当局"一词，就中华人民共和国而言，系指中国民用航空总局或其授权行使该机构现有职能的任何个人或机构；就阿尔及利亚民主人民共和国而言，系指负责民用航空事务的部或其授权行使该部门现有职能的任何个人或机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] the term `` Agreement '' means this Agreement and its Annex as well as any amendment to this Agreement and\/or its Annex made in accordance with Article [ 19 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: [3] 本协议所指"协议"系指本协议及其附件，以及根据本协议第[19]条规定对本协议和/或其附件所作的任何修订。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] the term `` designated airline '' means an airline which has been designated and authorized in accordance with Article [ 3 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: [5]“指定航空公司”指根据本协定第三条指定并获得许可的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] the term `` agreed services '' means scheduled international air services on the route [ s ] specified in the Annex to this Agreement for the transport of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: [ 8 ] "协议航班"指本协定附件所列航线上定期往返的国际航空运输服务，用于运送旅客、行李、货物及邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] the term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one State .
Translation: "国际航空服务"指飞越一个以上国家领土上空空域的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 10 ] the term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo or mail .
Translation: "非交通目的经停"指除上下旅客、装卸行李、货物或邮件以外的任何着陆行为。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in relation to an agreed service , the capacity of the aircraft used on such service multiplied by the frequency operated by such aircraft over a given period on a route or section of a route .
Translation: [b] 就协议航班而言，指特定航线上或航段内，在规定期间内运营的该机型载运力与飞行班次之乘积。

Query_Text_en: [ 12 ] the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary service , but excluding prices and conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation: "运价"指运输旅客、行李和货物所需支付的费用及其适用条件，包括代理及其他辅助服务的价格与条件，但不含邮件运输的价格与条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 13 ] the term `` Route Schedule '' means the Route Schedule annexed to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with the provisions of Article [ 19 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: [ 13 ] "航线表"一词指本协议所附的航线表，或根据本协议第[ 19 ]条规定修订后的航线表。

Query_Text_en: [ 14 ] the term `` specified route '' means the route specified in the Route Schedule .
Translation: “指定航线”指航线时刻表中列明的航线。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement to enable the designated airline of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services on the route specified in the Annex .
Translation: 缔约一方给予缔约另一方本协定规定的权利，以使缔约另一方指定航空公司得以开通和经营附件所列航线的国际航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The right of the designated airline of one Contracting Party to take on board and discharge at point [ s ] in the territory of the other Contracting Party international traffic to or from a third country shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内地点上下前往或来自第三国的国际运输业务的权利，应由双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Nothing in this Article shall be deemed to confer on the designated airlines of one Contracting Party the privilege of embarking , in the territory of the other Contracting Party , passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried for remuneration or hire and destined for another point in the territory of that Contracting Party .
Translation: 本条款任何内容均不得视为授予缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内装载以有偿或租赁方式运输、且目的地为该缔约另一方领土内其他地点的乘客、行李、货物及邮件的特权。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline designated by the first Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to meet the conditions and the obligations prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air services by such authorities .
Translation: 另一方缔约国的航空当局可要求指定航空公司证明其具备资质，能够满足该当局通常合理适用于国际航空运输服务的法律法规所规定的条件和义务。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraphs [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] of this Article , grant to the airline so designated the appropriate operating authorization without unreasonable delay .
Translation: [4] 缔约另一方收到上述指定通知后，在不违反本条第[2]款和第[3]款规定的前提下，应毫不迟延地给予该指定航空公司适当的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The designated airline of one Contracting Party may commence , when it has acquired operating authorization , operation of the agreed services in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Agreement from the date prescribed in such authorization .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司获得运营许可后，可自该许可规定之日起，依照本协定相关条款开始协议航班的运营。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] where the said designated airline otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under this Agreement .
Translation: [ c ] 当上述指定航空公司未能依照本协定规定之条件运营时。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Unless immediate revocation , suspension of rights or imposition of conditions prescribed in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article is essential to prevent further infringement of laws and regulations by the said designated airline , such rights shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: [ 2 ] 除非立即撤销、暂停权利或施加本条第一款规定的条件对于防止该指定航空公司进一步违反法律法规确属必要，否则此类权利的行使须经与另一缔约方协商后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the admission to , departure from or operation and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the international operation shall be applicable to the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , while entering , departing from or operating and navigating in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约一方关于从事国际运营的航空器入境、离境及在其境内运行和航行的法律法规，应适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器在进入、离开或在缔约一方境内运行和航行时。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to admission to , stay in or departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail , such as laws and regulations relating to entry , clearance , immigration , passports , customs and quarantine , shall be applicable to the passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail carried by the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party while entering , staying in and departing from the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方关于旅客、机组、行李、货物或邮件入境、停留或离境的法律法规，如涉及入境、通关、移民、护照、海关及检疫等规定，应适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司所载运的旅客、机组、行李、货物或邮件在进入、停留及离开该缔约一方领土时。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Other relevant laws and regulations relating to aircraft and provisions in respect of civil aviation of one Contracting Party shall be applicable to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party while operating the agreed services in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方关于航空器及其他民航相关法律法规的规定，应适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司在缔约一方领土内经营协议航班时的运营活动。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] There shall be a fair and equal opportunity for the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties to operate the agreed services on the specified route .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司经营规定航线的协议航班时，应享有公平与平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In operating the agreed services the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the whole or part of the same route .
Translation: 在经营协议航班时，缔约各方指定航空公司应顾及另一方指定航空公司的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在同一航线或部分航段上提供的整体服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The agreed services supplied by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall provide at a reasonable load factor capacity adequate to meet the traffic requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司提供的协议航班服务，应以合理载运率提供充足运力，满足双方领土间旅客、行李、货物及邮件的运输需求。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 满足联程航班运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Capacity , frequency , type of aircraft and flight schedule shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: [ 1 ] 运力、班次、机型及航班时刻表应由缔约双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each designated airline shall have the right to engage in the sale of air transportation in the territory of the other Contracting Party directly and , at its discretion , through licensed agents .
Translation: 二、各指定航空公司有权在缔约另一方领土内直接或自行选择通过持照代理机构销售航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: Each designated airline shall have the right to use for this purpose its own transportation documents .
Translation: 各指定航空公司有权为此使用其自有运输凭证。
