Translation: 二〇〇七年一月十五日在北京签订，一式两份，分别用中文、塔吉克文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The designated airline [ s ] of either Party may omit on any or all flights , any point on the specified routes and may serve them in any order , provided the agreed service begin and terminate in the territory of the Party designating the airline .
Translation: 一、缔约任何一方指定航空公司在其任何或所有航班上，可自行决定跳过规定航线中的任一航点或所有航点，亦可调整经停顺序，但该协议航班之始发地与终到地均须位于指定该航空公司的缔约方领土范围内。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The exercise of fifth freedom traffic rights by the designated airline [ s ] of both Contracting Parties on the above routes shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the two Parties .
Translation: 2. 缔约双方指定航空公司行使上述航线上第五航权的具体安排，应由双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] The term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo or mail .
Translation: "非交通目的停靠"指除上下乘客、装卸行李货物或邮件以外的任何着陆行为。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services on the route specified in the Annex to this Agreement [ herein - after referred to as `` the specified route '' ] .
Translation: 第二十一条  缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件（以下称为"规定航线"）中所规定的航线上建立和经营定期航班的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of the present Agreement , aircraft of the designated airline of each Contracting arty can fly across the territory of the other Contracting Party without landing or make stops in the said territory for non-traffic purposes along the air route prescribed by the civil aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation: 二、在不违反本协定规定的前提下，缔约一方指定航空公司的飞机，经缔约另一方民航当局批准后，可沿该当局规定的航线飞越缔约另一方领土而不降停，或在上述领土内作非运输业务性经停。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Subject to the provisions of the present Agreement , the aircraft of the airline designated by each Contracting Party , in operating the agreed services on the specified route , shall have the right to make stops at point of the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for taking on or putting down passengers , baggage , cargo and mail coming from or destined for the territory of the first Contracting Party and those for the intermediate point between the territories of both Contracting Parties and those for specified points beyond the territories of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 三、在不违反本协定规定的前提下，缔约各方指定航空公司在经营协议航线的协议航班时，有权在对方领土内规定航线上的地点经停，以便上下来自或前往指定该航空公司的缔约一方领土的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，以及来自或前往缔约双方领土间中途地点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，和来自或前往缔约双方领土以外规定地点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The aircraft of the designated airline of each Contracting Party , while flying in the territory of the other Contracting Party , shall comply with the regulations governing the air route and air corridor at the boundary line prescribed by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司的飞机在飞越另一缔约方领土时，应遵守该缔约方制定的关于边界线航路和空中走廊的管理规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party at least sixty days in advance of the inauguration of the agreed services by its designated airline on the specified route .
Translation: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业应在商定航线开航前至少六十天将开航日期通知缔约另一方。

Query_Text_en: 6 . In case where the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operate an additional or charter flight on the specified route , the civil aeronautical authorities of the first Contracting Party shall submit request to the civil aeronautical authorities of the other contracting Party , and the flight shall be operated only after approval is obtained .
Translation: 六、如缔约一方指定航空公司欲在协议航线上经营加班或包机飞行，应事先向缔约另一方民航当局提出申请，获得批准后方可执行。

Query_Text_en: The request shall be submitted seventy-two hours prior to the departure of the aircraft for the flight .
Translation: 该申请须于航班起飞前72小时提交。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3 1 . The Government of the People 's Republic of China designates `` Department of International Affairs of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China '' as its airline and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines designates `` Philippine Airlines '' as its airline to operate their respective agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第三条 一、中华人民共和国政府指定"中国民用航空总局国际司"为其航空公司，菲律宾共和国政府指定"菲律宾航空公司"为其航空公司，在规定的航线上经营各自的协议航班。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The substantial ownership and effective control of the airline designated by each Contracting Party must be vested in such Contracting Party .
Translation: 二、各缔约方指定的航空公司，其大部分所有权和有效控制权应归属于该缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to suspend the exercise of the rights specified in Article 2 of the present Agreement by the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , in case of failure by that airline to comply with the laws and regulations of the first Contracting Party , or of failure to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement and its Annex .
Translation: 三、如指定航空公司未能遵守缔约一方法律法规，或未按本协定及其附件规定条件运营，缔约另一方有权暂停该航空公司行使本协定第二条所列权利。

Query_Text_en: However , under normal circumstances , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 但在通常情况下，此项权利须经与缔约另一方协商后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 4 1 . Matters relating to frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , conditions of carriage , sales representation and ground handling in each other 's territory in the operation of the specified routes shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第四条 一、缔约双方指定空运企业在经营协议航线时，有关班次、机型、班期时刻、运载条件、销售代理及地面服务事宜，应由双方空运企业协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Frequency , type of aircraft and schedule so agreed shall be subject to the approval of their respective civil aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 双方商定的航班班次、机型及班期时刻表应经各自民航当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have as their primary objective the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo , and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 2. 缔约双方指定航空公司提供的服务，应以运输由指定该航空公司的缔约方领土始发或前往该缔约方领土的旅客、行李、货物和邮件为主要目的。

Query_Text_en: Provision for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail both taken up and put down at points on the specified routes in the territory of a third country shall be made in accordance with the primary objective .
Translation: 在第三国领土指定航线上起降的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输安排，应遵循首要目标予以规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In operating the agreed services , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interest of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides , on the whole or part of the same route .
Translation: 三、在经营协议航班时，缔约各方指定航空公司应顾及另一方指定航空公司的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或部分相同航线上提供的整体服务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5 1 . The tariffs [ meaning the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage , and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply ] to be charged for the agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of service and the tariffs of other airlines for operation of scheduled air services on same or similar route or sectors .
Translation: 第五条 一、协议航班运价[指运输旅客、行李和货物的价格及适用条件]应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑所有相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润、服务特性以及其他航空公司在相同或类似航线或航段上经营定期航班业务的运价。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs applicable to the agreed services between the territories of both Contracting Parties shall be agreed upon between their designated airlines and shall be subject to the approval of their respective civil aeronautical authorities at least sixty [ 60 ] days in advance of its introduction . In special cases , this period can be reduced with the agreement of such authorities .
Translation: 二、缔约双方领土间协议航线的适用运价，应由双方指定航空公司商定，并至少提前六十（60）天报各自民航主管部门批准。特殊情况下，经双方民航主管部门同意，可缩短该期限。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If the designated airlines can not agree on a tariff or the civil aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party refuses to give approval to any tariff agreed upon between the designated airlines , the civil aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall try to agree upon an appropriate tariff between themselves .
Translation: 三、如指定航空公司未能就运价达成一致，或任一缔约方民航当局拒绝批准指定航空公司商定的任何运价，则缔约双方民航当局应尽力协商确定适当运价。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The tariffs established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force until new tariffs have been established .
Translation: 依据本条规定制定的关税税率应持续有效，直至新税率颁布实施。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory the airport and alternate airport [ s ] to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 第六条 一、缔约一方应在本国领土内指定机场和备降机场，供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线时使用，并在其境内为协议航班提供所需的通信、导航、气象及其他附属服务。

Query_Text_en: The detailed arrangements shall be agreed upon between the civil aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 具体安排应由缔约双方民航当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports and technical facilities of the other Contracting Party at the reasonable rates specified by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 一方指定航空公司使用另一方机场及技术设施时，应按另一方规定的合理费率支付费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rate shall not be higher than those normally paid by airlines of other countries .
Translation: 该费率不得高于其他国家航空公司通常支付的费率。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 1 . Aircraft operated on the specified route by the designated airline of either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverage , tobaccos , etc. ] retained on board the aircraft shall be exempted from any customs duties , inspection fees and other charges by the other Contracting Party on arriving in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第七条 一、缔约一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的航空器，以及留置在航空器上的正常设备、零备件、燃油、润滑油、机上供应品（包括食品、饮料、烟草等），在进出缔约另一方领土时，应豁免缔约另一方征收的任何关税、检验费及其他费用。

Query_Text_en: However , such articles shall not be unloaded without approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party and , if unloaded , the unloaded part shall be kept in bond by such authorities .
Translation: 但此类物品未经缔约另一方海关当局批准不得卸下；如获准卸下，卸下部分应由该海关当局监管。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores for consumption replenished to or taken on board the aircraft in the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party for operation of the specified route shall be exempted from customs duties , inspection fees and other charges .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司为执行规定航线而在缔约另一方领土内补充或装载的燃油、润滑油、航空器材等机上供应品，应免除关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Spare parts and regular airborne equipment , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverage , tobaccos , etc. ] introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance and repair of aircraft operated on the specified route by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party shall also be exempted from customs duties , inspection fees and other charges . However , such articles shall be unloaded only with approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party and shall be kept in bond .
Translation: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业为维护和修理其经营指定航线所使用的航空器而运入缔约另一方领土的零备件、常用机载设备、燃料、润滑油及机上供应品（包括食品、饮料、烟草等），亦应免除关税、检验费和其他税费。但上述物品须经缔约另一方海关当局批准后方可卸下，并应置于海关监管之下。

Query_Text_en: They shall not be sold or used for other purposes in the territory of the other Contracting Party , and shall be subject to storage charges as per the regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 该等物品不得在缔约另一方境内出售或挪作他用，并须按缔约另一方的规定缴纳仓储费用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its Crew and passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第八条  
缔约任何一方关于从事国际航班飞行的航空器进出其国境、在其境内停留及航行的法律法规，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境及在其境内停留的法律法规，在缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器及其所载机组、旅客、行李、货物和邮件处于该缔约一方国境内时，应同样适用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9 1 . For the operation of the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party has the right to set up its office of representative at the point of call on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第九条 一、为经营规定航线，缔约各方指定空运企业有权在对方缔约方领土内的规定航线上的经停地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such office of representative shall be citizens of the People 's Republic of China or the Republic of the Philippines , and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and subject to the approval of the proper authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该代表处工作人员应为中华人民共和国或菲律宾共和国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并经双方主管部门批准。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such office must observe the applicable laws and regulations of the country where such office is located .
Translation: 该办事处工作人员须遵守办事处所在国的适用法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall extend assistance and facilities to the office of representative of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and ensure the safety of the office and its staff as well as the safety of the aircraft , stores and other properties used on agreed services in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 二、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定航空公司的代表机构提供协助与便利，并确保该代表机构及其工作人员的安全，以及在其领土内经营协议航班所使用的航空器、储备物资和其他财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10Either Contracting Party undertakes to grant to the other Party free transfer in United States dollars at the rate of exchange in the official market at the time of remittance of the excess of receipts over expenditures achieved in its territory , in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , mail shipments and freight by the designated airline of the other Party .
Translation:
第十条  
缔约任何一方应准许缔约另一方在其领土内指定的空运企业，就经营旅客、行李、邮件和货物运输所得收支盈余，按汇款时官方市场汇率以美元自由汇出。

Query_Text_en: Wherever the payments system between the Contracting Parties governed by a special agreement , the said agreement shall apply .
Translation: 缔约双方支付体系如受专项协定管辖，则适用该专项协定。

Query_Text_en: i. general declaration .
Translation: 一、总声明

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificates mentioned above [ a - - e ] of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 各缔约方应承认另一方上述[a至e项]有效证书。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying on the specified route shall be citizens of its respective country .
Translation: 二、缔约任何一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的机组人员应为该国公民。

Query_Text_en: h. communicate in writing to the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation: h. 以书面形式将调查结果通报给第一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13Both Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation of the present Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support .
Translation:
第十三条  
缔约双方应本着密切合作、相互支持的精神，确保本协议的正确实施。

Query_Text_en: If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement , the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties or their competent authorities shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding .
Translation: 如对本协定之解释或实施产生任何分歧，缔约双方指定航空公司或其主管当局应本着友好合作与相互理解之精神，通过直接协商予以解决。

Query_Text_en: If agreement can not be reached , the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如未能达成协议，缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 14If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provision of this Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party and such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of receipt of the suggestion by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十四条  
缔约任何一方如认为有必要修改或修正本协定及其附件的任何条款，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。此项协商应于另一方收到建议之日起六十日内开始。

Query_Text_en: Any modification or amendments to this Agreement or its Annex shall come into force when they have been confirmed through exchange of notes between the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本协定及其附件的任何修改或修订，经缔约双方以换文确认后即告生效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15The present Agreement shall come into force on the day it is signed .
Translation:
第十五条  
本协定自签署之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party , if it desires to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 缔约任何一方可随时通知另一方终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of notice , unless it is withdrawn by the first Contracting Party with agreement by the latter , in which case the present Agreement shall remain in force .
Translation: 本协定自收到通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非先缔约方经后者同意撤回通知，在此情况下本协定继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Signed at Beijing on this 8th day of July , 1979 , in duplicate , in the Chinese , Pilipino and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七九年七月八日订于北京，一式两份，每份均以中文、菲律宾文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: the income tax ; [ hereinafter referred to as `` Ugandan tax '' ] .
Translation: 所得税（以下简称“乌干达税”）。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of incorporation , place of management , or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State and any local authority thereof .
Translation: 1. 就本协定而言，"缔约国一方居民"一词是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、注册地、管理机构所在地或其他类似性质的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的任何个人或实体，也包括该缔约国及其地方当局。

Query_Text_en: g ] a mine , an oil or gas well , a quarry or any other place of extraction of natural resources .
Translation: 矿井、油井或气井、采石场及任何其他自然资源开采场所。

Query_Text_en: and b ] the furnishing of services , including consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel , where activities of that nature continue [ for the same or a connected project ] within the country for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any twelve month period .
Translation: 二）企业通过雇员或其他人员在该国为同一项目或相关联项目提供的服务（包括咨询服务），若此类活动在任何十二个月中累计超过一百八十三天。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person -- other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies -- is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , has and habitually exercises an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力以该企业的名义签订合同（除第六款所指的独立代理人外），则该企业应认为在该缔约国一方设有常设机构。但此人的活动仅限于第四款所提及者，若通过固定营业场所进行这些活动，按照该款规定并不会使该固定营业场所构成常设机构时，则不在此限。

Query_Text_en: 6 . For the purposes of the preceding paragraphs , the profits to be attributed to the permanent establishment shall be determined by the same method year by year unless there is good and sufficient reason tote contrary .
Translation: 就前款而言，除非确有充分理由需要采用不同方法，否则常设机构每年利润的确定应采用相同方法。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶或飞机经营国际运输业务所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a ] an enterprise of a Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , orb ] the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , maybe included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 一、当缔约国一方企业直接或间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，或者同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本时，若两个企业在商业或财务关系中设定的条件与独立企业之间本应设定的条件存在差异，则因这些条件而未归属于其中一方企业的利润（若无此类条件本应归属于该企业），可计入该企业的利润并据以征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 7 . 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可在支付股息公司为其居民的缔约国征税，按照该国法律执行。但如果股息受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不应超过股息总额的7.5%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article means income from shares , or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 本条款所称"股息"，是指从股份或非债权性质的其它利润分享权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润公司居民国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其它公司权利取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 然而，此类利息也可在发生利息的缔约国依照该国法律征税。但如果利息受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and derived by the Government of the other Contracting State , a local authority or the Central Bank thereof or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of that other State , or by any other resident of that other State with respect to debt-claims insured or guaranteed or indirectly financed by the Government of that other State , a local authority or the Central Bank thereof or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of that other State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State .
Translation: 三、虽有第二款之规定，发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方政府、地方当局或其中央银行、或完全为其政府所有的金融机构取得，或由该缔约国另一方其他居民取得但其债权是由该另一方政府、地方当局或其中央银行、或完全为其政府所有的金融机构所保险、担保或间接融资的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the excess part of the payments shall remain taxable according to the laws of each Contracting State , due regard being had tote other provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 在此情况下，支付款项的超出部分仍应根据各缔约国的法律规定征税，同时应适当考虑本协定其他条款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 然而，此类特许权使用费也可在来源地缔约国征税，并依据该国法律执行；但若特许权使用费受益所有人是另一缔约国居民，则所征税款不得超过特许权使用费总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称"特许权使用费"，是指为使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学作品（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带）的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，或者为使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备，或有关工业、商业或科学经验的情报所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or affixed base in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 然而，当特许权使用费的支付方（无论其是否为缔约国居民）在某一缔约国设有常设机构或固定基地，且支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或固定基地相关联，同时该特许权使用费由该常设机构或固定基地负担时，则应认为该特许权使用费发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft shall be taxable only in that Contracting State .
Translation: 三、缔约国一方企业因转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或附属于该船舶或飞机的动产而取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的任何财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve month period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: b）如果他在该缔约国另一方停留的时间，在有关财政年度开始或结束的任何十二个月期间内累计达到或超过183天；

Query_Text_en: and c ] The remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or affixed base which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: 该报酬并非由雇主在另一国设立的常设机构或固定基地所负担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State , may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 三、虽有本条前述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营从事国际运输的船舶或飞机上受雇而取得的报酬，可在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 DIRECTORS ' FEES Directors ' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation:
第十六条 董事费  
缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可在该另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , income derived by entertainers or sportsmen who are residents of a Contracting State from the activities exercised in the other Contracting State under a plan of cultural exchange between the Governments of both Contracting States shall be exempt from tax in that other State .
Translation: 三、虽有本条上述规定，作为缔约国一方居民的表演家或运动员，在缔约国另一方按照两国政府文化交流计划开展活动取得的收入，在该缔约国另一方应予免税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 19 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State inconsideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 在遵守第十九条第二款规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因以往受雇而获得的养老金及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Remuneration , other than a pension , paid by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or a local authority thereof , in the discharge of functions of a governmental nature , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 一、缔约国一方政府或其地方当局对履行政府职能性质的服务支付给个人的报酬（退休金除外），应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds to which contributions are made by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered tote Government of that State or a local authority thereof shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 二、a）任何由缔约国一方政府或其地方当局支付，或从其建立基金中支付的养老金（该基金的资金来源包含该政府或地方当局的缴款），若该养老金系因个人向该缔约国政府或其地方当局提供服务而发放，则该项养老金应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Remuneration which an individual who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State , a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned state for the primary purpose of teaching , giving lectures or conducting research at a university , college , school or educational institution or scientific research institution recognized by the Government of the first-mentioned State derives for the purpose of such teaching , lectures or research shall not be taxed in the first-mentioned State for a period of two years from the date of his first arrival in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 一、作为缔约国另一方居民或此前曾是该国居民的个人，以为缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或该国政府认可的教育机构或科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究为主要目的而停留在该缔约国一方，其因教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，自其首次抵达该缔约国一方之日起两年内，应免予在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply only to income from lecturing , teaching or research derived by any individual if such activity is in public interest and undertaken pursuant to a technical cooperation agreement between the Contracting States .
Translation: 二、本条第一款规定仅适用于个人因从事符合公共利益的教学、讲学或研究活动而取得的收入，且该活动须依据缔约国双方签订的技术合作协议开展。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In respect of grants , scholarships and remuneration from employment not covered by paragraph 1 , a student , business apprentice or trainee described in paragraph 1 shall , in addition , be entitled during such education or training to the same exemptions , reliefs or reductions in respect of taxes available to residents of the State which he is visiting .
Translation: 对于未列入第一款的补助金、奖学金及受雇报酬，第一款所述学生、企业学徒或实习生在进行教育或培训期间，除享有该条款待遇外，还应获得与其到访国居民相同的税收豁免、减免或优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from Uganda , the amount of tax on that income payable in Uganda in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 在中国居民从乌干达取得所得的情况下，根据本协定规定在乌干达缴纳的该项所得税收，可在中国对该居民征收的税收中抵免。

Query_Text_en: The amount of the credit , however , shall not exceed the amount of the Chinese taxon that income computed in accordance with the taxation laws and regulations of China .
Translation: 然而，抵免额不得超过按照中国税收法规计算的该项所得应缴纳的中国税收数额。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from Uganda is dividend paid by accompany which is a resident of Uganda to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 20 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Uganda by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 若源自乌干达的收入系乌干达居民公司向中国居民公司支付的股息，且该中国公司持有支付股息公司不少于20%的股份，则税收抵免应考虑支付股息公司就其所得向乌干达缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: In Uganda , where a resident of Uganda derives income which , in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be taxed in China , Uganda shall allow as a deduction from the tax on the income of that resident an amount equal to the Chinese tax paid .
Translation: 在乌干达，当乌干达居民取得依照本协定规定可在中国征税的所得时，乌干达应允许从对该居民的该项所得征收的税额中扣除相当于在中国缴纳的税款金额。

Query_Text_en: Such deduction shall not , however , exceed that part of the income tax as computed before the deduction is given , which is attributable , as the case may be , to the income which may be taxed in China .
Translation: 然而，此项扣除额不得超过在未扣除前按中国税法规定应归属于可在中国征税的所得税部分。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except where the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 9 , paragraph 7of Article 11 , or paragraph 6 of Article 12 , apply , interest , royalties and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、除适用第九条第一款、第十一条第七款或第十二条第六款规定的情形外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应如同支付给首先提及的缔约国居民一样，在相同条件下准予扣除。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as tote interpretation or application of the Agreement .
Translation: 3. 缔约双方主管当局应尽力通过协商解决本协定解释或执行过程中产生的任何困难或疑问。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the purpose of reaching an agreement in the sense of paragraphs 2 and 3 . When it seems advisable for reaching agreement , representatives of the competent authorities of the Contracting States may meet together for an oral exchange of opinions .
Translation: 缔约双方主管当局可直接联系，以达成第二款和第三款所指的协议。为促成协议之目的，双方主管当局代表可通过会晤进行口头意见交换。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is foreseeably relevant for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or to the administration or enforcement of the domestic laws concerning taxes of every kind and description imposed on behalf of the Contracting States , or of their local authorities , in so far as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约双方主管当局应交换可预见的与执行本协定规定或实施缔约双方或其地方当局征收的各类税收国内法律相关且必要的信息，前提是该税收征管不违反本协定。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 DIPLOMATIC AGENTS AND CONSULAR OFFICERSNothing in this Agreement shall affect the fiscal privileges of diplomatic agents or consular officers under the general rules of international law or under the provisions of special agreements .
Translation:
第二十七条 外交代表和领事官员  
本协定任何规定不影响外交代表或领事官员依照国际法一般规则或特别协定条款所享有的财政特权。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 ENTRY INTO FORCEBoth Contracting States shall notify each other through diplomatic channels that they have completed the internal legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十八条 生效  
缔约双方应通过外交渠道相互通知已完成本协定生效所需的国内法律程序。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day upon the receipt of the latter notification .
Translation: 本协定自收到后一份通知之日起第三十日生效。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall be applicable in respect of income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force .
Translation: 本协定适用于本协定生效之次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 TERMINATIONThis Agreement shall continue in effect indefinitely but either of the Contracting States may , on or before the thirtieth day of June in any calendar year beginning after the expiration of a period of five years from the date of its entry into force , give written notice of termination tote other Contracting State through diplomatic channels .
Translation:
第二十九条 终止  
本协定长期有效，但任一缔约方可在协定生效五年期满后，于任何公历年度六月三十日或之前，通过外交途径向另一缔约方书面通知终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: In such event this Agreement shall cease to have effect as respects income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following that in which the notice of termination is given .
Translation: 在此情形下，本协定应自终止通知发出之次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度所得起停止生效。

Query_Text_en: Done at  on the day of  ,  , in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于____年____月____日在____签订，一式两份，中英文两种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: No deduction shall be allowed in respect of amounts , if any , paid [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , by way of commission , for specific services performed or for management , or except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the permanent establishment .
Translation: 常设机构支付给企业总机构或该企业其他办事处的特许权使用费、服务费、管理费（偿还代垫实际费用除外），以及因借款给该常设机构而支付的利息（银行企业除外），均不得作任何扣除。

Query_Text_en: Likewise , no account shall be taken , in the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , of amounts charged [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] , by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or similar payments in return for the use of patent or other rights , or by way of commission for the specific services or for management , or except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices .
Translation: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，也不应考虑该常设机构向企业总机构或其它办事处收取的特许权使用费、手续费或类似款项（除非属于实际开支的偿还），作为使用专利权或其它权利的报酬；或作为提供特定服务、管理服务的佣金；或除银行企业外，作为向企业总机构或其它办事处提供贷款所获利息。

Query_Text_en: and [ vi ] any institution wholly owned by the Government of China as may be agreed upon from time to time between the competent authorities of the Contracting States .
Translation: 以及[六] 经缔约国双方主管机关随时协商确定的、由中国政府全资拥有的任何机构。

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] any institution wholly owned by the Government of Uganda as may be agreed upon from time to time between the competent authorities of the Contracting States .
Translation: 以及乌干达政府全资拥有的、由缔约双方主管机关随时商定的任何机构。

Query_Text_en: It is agreed that only 70 per cent of the gross amount of royalties paid for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment is liable to tax in the Contracting State in which they arise .
Translation: 双方同意，对于因使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备而支付的特许权使用费总额，仅70%可在该费用产生的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , being duly authorized thereto , have signed this Protocol .
Translation: 兹经正式授权，下列签署人签署本议定书，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income all taxes imposed on total income , or on elements of income , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , taxes on the total amounts of wages or salaries paid by enterprises , as well as taxes on capital appreciation .
Translation: 凡是对全部所得或单项所得课征的税收，包括对转让动产或不动产取得的收益征收的税收，对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收，以及对资本增值征收的税收，均应视为所得税。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the enterprise income tax .
Translation: [ ii ] 企业所得税

Query_Text_en: the income tax .
Translation: 所得税

Query_Text_en: and j ] the term `` business '' includes the performance of professional services and of other activities of an independent character .
Translation: "业务"一词包括专业服务及具有独立性质的其他活动的履行。

Query_Text_en: f ] a mine , an oil or gas well , a quarry or any other place of extraction or exploitation of natural resources .
Translation: 矿井、油井或气井、采石场以及任何其他自然资源开采或开发场所。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person -- other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies -- is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and has , and habitually exercises , in that Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力以该企业的名义签订合同，除适用于第六款的独立代理人外，该企业应认为在该缔约国一方设有常设机构。但该人的活动仅限于第四款所提及的活动，且该等活动若通过固定营业场所进行，根据该款规定并不会使该固定营业场所构成常设机构时，则不在此限。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 3 shall also apply to the income from immovable property of an enterprise .
Translation: 第一及第三款之规定亦适用于企业不动产所得。

Query_Text_en: and b ] profits from the use , maintenance or rental of containers [ including trailers and related equipment for the transport of containers ] used for the transport of goods or merchandise , where such rental or such use , maintenance or rental , as the case may be , is incidental to the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic .
Translation: 以及 b ] 使用、维护或租赁用于货物运输的集装箱（包括运输集装箱的拖车及相关设备）所获利润，但此类租赁或使用、维护、租赁（视情况而定）须附属于国际运输中的船舶或飞机运营。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment .
Translation: 如股息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在支付股息公司为其居民的缔约国另一方通过设在该国的常设机构从事营业，且据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构有实际联系，则第一、二款规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: In such case the provisions of Article 7 shall apply .
Translation: 在此情况下，应适用第七条之规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State , that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company , except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax on the company 's undistributed profits , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in such other State .
Translation: 五、当缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得时，该另一方不得对该公司支付的股息征收任何税收（除非该股息支付给该另一方的居民，或支付股息的股权与该另一方设立的常设机构有实际联系），也不得对该公司的未分配利润征税，即使所支付的股息或未分配利润全部或部分来源于该另一方的利润或所得。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to , or on loans guaranteed or insured by , the Government or a local authority , the Central Bank or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 三、虽有第二款规定，发生于缔约国一方并由缔约国另一方政府、地方当局、政府全资拥有的中央银行或任何金融机构支付或担保（保险）贷款所产生的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment .
Translation: 如利息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方通过设在该国的常设机构进行营业，且据以支付利息的债权与该常设机构有实际联系，则第一、二款规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the interest , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred , and such interest is borne by such permanent establishment , then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment is situated .
Translation: 然而，当利息支付人（无论其是否为缔约国居民）在缔约国设有常设机构，且所支付利息的债务与该常设机构相关联，并由该常设机构负担此项利息时，此项利息应视为发生于该常设机构所在国。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称"特许权使用费"，是指为使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学作品（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带）的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，或者为有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment .
Translation: 如特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在特许权发生地缔约国另一方通过设在该国的常设机构从事经营活动，且支付特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构有实际联系，则第一、二款规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment is situated .
Translation: 然而，当特许权使用费的支付方（无论其是否为缔约国居民）在缔约国一方设有常设机构，且支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构相关联，并由该常设机构负担此项费用时，则应认为该特许权使用费发生于该常设机构所在国。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 二、缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方常设机构营业财产组成部分的动产处置收益，包括该常设机构[单独或连同整个企业]转让所产生的此类收益，可在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 15 , 17 , and 18 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 在遵循第十五条、第十七条及第十八条规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。但受雇于缔约国另一方的情形除外。

Query_Text_en: c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: 该报酬并非由雇主在另一国设立的常设机构负担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State , may be taxed in that Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 三、虽有本条前述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税，但以该项报酬由该缔约国企业支付为限。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 and 14 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as a sportsman , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 虽有第七条和第十四条的规定，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，或作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事其个人活动取得的所得，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or a sportsman in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or sportsman himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 and 14 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or sportsman are exercised .
Translation: 二、表演家或运动员从事个人活动取得的所得，若非归属其本人而归属其他方，虽有第七条和第十四条规定，该所得仍可在表演家或运动员从事活动的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from activities exercised in the other Contracting State as envisaged in paragraphs 1 and 2 , shall be exempt from tax in that other State if the visit to that other State is supported wholly or mainly by public funds of the first-mentioned Contracting State or a local authority thereof , or takes place under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Governments of the Contracting States .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因本协定第一条及第二条所述活动从缔约国另一方取得的所得，若该居民在缔约国另一方的访问费用全部或主要由首先提及的缔约国或其地方当局公共资金承担，或依据缔约国双方政府间文化协定或安排进行，则该项所得应在缔约国另一方免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 18 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 在遵守第十八条第二款规定的前提下，缔约国一方居民因以前受雇而获得的养老金及其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 一、除退休金外，缔约国一方或其地方当局向因向该缔约国或地方当局提供服务而取得工资、薪金和其他类似报酬的个人支付的款项，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Pensions and other similar remuneration paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 二、甲项：缔约国一方或其地方当局向因向该缔约国或地方当局提供服务而取得养老金或其他类似报酬的个人支付的款项，或从由其建立的基金中支付的此类款项，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 14 , 15 , 16 , and 17 shall apply to salaries , wages , pensions , and other similar remuneration in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第十四条、第十五条、第十六条及第十七条规定，应适用于缔约国或其地方当局经营业务所支付之薪金、工资、养老金及其他类似报酬。

Query_Text_en: A student , or business apprentice who is present in a Contracting State solely for the purpose of the student 's or business apprentice 's education or training and who is , or immediately before being so present was , a resident of the other Contracting State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State on payments received from outside that first-mentioned State for the purposes of the student 's or business apprentice 's maintenance , education or training .
Translation: 学生或企业学徒若仅为接受教育或培训目的而停留于缔约国一方，且其属于或在入境前属于缔约国另一方居民，则该学生或企业学徒为维持生活、接受教育或培训目的从缔约国一方境外取得的款项，应在该缔约国一方免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not apply to income , other than income from immovable property as defined in paragraph 2 of Article 6 , if the recipient of such income , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein and the right or property in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment .
Translation: 二、第一款规定不适用于不动产所得以外的其他所得。若该项所得的受益人是缔约国一方居民，通过在缔约国另一方设立的常设机构从事经营活动，且与支付该所得的权益或财产与该常设机构存在实际关联，则不适用第一款规定。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from Zambia , the amount of tax on that income payable in Zambia in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 在中国居民从赞比亚取得所得的情况下，根据本协定规定在赞比亚就该所得缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from Zambia is dividend paid by a company which is a resident of Zambia to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 10 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Zambia by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 若源自赞比亚的收入为赞比亚居民公司向中国居民公司支付的股息，且该中国公司持有支付股息公司不少于10%的股份，则税收抵免应考虑支付股息公司就其所得向赞比亚缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: In Zambia , where a resident of Zambia derives income from China which may be taxed in China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , the amount of the tax payable in respect of that income shall be allowed as a credit against Zambian tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 在赞比亚，当赞比亚居民从中国取得所得且该所得根据本协定规定可在中国征税时，赞比亚对该居民征收的税额中应允许抵免就该所得缴纳的中国税收。

Query_Text_en: The amount of credit , however , shall not exceed that part of Zambian tax which is appropriate to that income .
Translation: 然而，信贷额度不得超过赞比亚税收中与该收入相对应的部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , he may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States , present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident or , if his case comes under paragraph 1 of Article 22 , to that of the Contracting State of which he is a national .
Translation: 如有人认为缔约国一方或双方的措施导致或将导致对其征税不符合本协定规定，可不考虑各缔约国国内法的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局；或者如果其案情属第二十二条第一款所述，可提交本人为其国民的缔约国主管当局。

Query_Text_en: Done at  on the  day of  ,  , in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于____年____月____日在____签订，一式两份，以中文和英文书就，两种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China and , in the case of Syria , the Directorate General of Civil Aviation of the Ministry of Defense , or in both eases , any authorities or body authorized to perform the functions presently exercised by the said Authorities .
Translation: “航空当局”一词，在中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局，在叙利亚方面指国防部民航总局；就双方而言，亦指任何获授权行使上述当局现时职能的机构或团体。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The term `` designated airline '' means an airline which has been designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article 3 of the present Agreement .
Translation: "指定航空公司"指根据本协定第三条之规定获得指定与授权的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The term `` air service '' means any scheduled air service performed by aircraft for the public transport of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: “航空服务”指由航空器执飞、定期为公众运输旅客、行李、货物及邮件的航空业务。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes the air space over the territory of more than one State .
Translation: "国际航空服务"指飞越一个以上国家领土上空空间的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The term `` airline '' means any air transport enterprise operating international air services .
Translation: “航空公司”指经营国际航空运输业务的任何航空运输企业。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] The term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means technical stop for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: "非交通目的经停"指除上下旅客、装卸行李货物及邮件外，因技术原因进行的任何停留。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the routes specified in the Annex to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified routes '' ] for carriage of international passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: 第二条 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件（以下简称"规定航线"）所列航线上经营定期国际航班（以下简称"协议航班"）的权利，以载运国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] to make stops at the point [ s ] on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of putting down and taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: 在缔约另一方领土内指定航线的地点经停，以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall not have the right to take up at one point in the territory of the other Contracting Party traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail destined for another point in the same territory .
Translation: 3. 缔约任何一方指定航空公司均无权在缔约另一方领土内某一点装载以该领土内另一点为目的地的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party sixty [ 60 ] days in advance of the date of the commencement of operation of the agreed services by its designated airline .
Translation: 四、缔约一方指定的航空公司应在商定航线开航前六十（60）天，将开航日期通知缔约另一方。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate , by a diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party , one airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to the present Agreement .
Translation: 第三条 一、缔约任何一方有权通过外交照会通知缔约另一方，指定一家航空运输企业在协定附件规定的航线上经营协议航班。

Query_Text_en: or [ 3 ] where that airline otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement .
Translation: 或 [ 3 ] 该航空公司未按本协定规定条件运营的其他情形。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless immediate revocation , suspension or imposition of the conditions mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws and regulations , such right shah be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 二、除非为防止进一步违反法律法规确有必要立即撤销、中止许可或附加本条第一款所述条件，否则该项权利应在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: Article 5The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第五条  
缔约任何一方关于从事国际航班飞行的航空器进出其国境、在其境内停留及航行的法律法规，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境及在其境内停留的法律法规，适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器、机组，以及该航空器所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件在缔约一方境内的活动。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall supply the other Contracting Party information relevant to the above-mentioned laws and regulations in time .
Translation: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供与上述法律法规相关的信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 1 . Aircraft operated on the specified routes by the designated airline of either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores retained on board the aircraft shall be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from any customs duties , inspection fees and other duties and charges by the other Contracting Party on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第六条 一、缔约一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的航空器，以及留置在航空器上的正常设备、零备件、燃油、润滑油和机上供应品，在进出缔约另一方领土时，缔约另一方应在互惠基础上免除其关税、检验费和其他税费。

Query_Text_en: The above-mentioned articles may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only after approval has been obtained from the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 上述物品须经缔约另一方海关当局批准后，方可在缔约另一方境内卸下。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores replenished to or taken on board its aircraft by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with the latter 's regulations for the operation of the specified routes shall be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from customs duties , inspection fees and other duties and charges by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据对等原则，缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内依其规定为执飞指定航线补充或装载的燃油、润滑油、航空器材及其他机上供应品，缔约另一方应免除其关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Regular airborne equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants , aircraft stores introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party solely for use by the aircraft operated on the specified routes by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party shall also be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from customs duties , inspection fees and other duties and charges by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 三、缔约一方指定航空公司经营协议航线所使用的航空器正常设备、零备件、燃油、润滑油及机上供应品，如仅因使用需要而运入缔约另一方领土，在互惠基础上，缔约另一方应免除其关税、检验费及其他税捐和费用。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The articles unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party as mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article as well as the articles introduced into the said territory as mentioned in paragraph 3 of this Article shall be kept under supervision and control of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party subject to storage charges as per the regulations of the said customs authorities , and shall not be sold or used for other purposes in the above-mentioned territory until such time as they are re - exported or disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the said customs authorities .
Translation: 本条第1款所述在缔约另一方境内卸载的物品，以及第3款所述进入该缔约方境内的物品，均应由该缔约方海关当局监管，并按该海关规定缴纳仓储费用。在上述物品复运出境或根据该海关规定处置前，不得在该缔约方境内销售或挪作他用。

Query_Text_en: Article 7Each Contracting Party shall apply no more than very simplified control in respect of the passengers , baggage and cargo carried in direct transit across its territory by the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party engaged in the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第七条  
任一缔约方对另一缔约方指定航空公司在经营协议航班时，以直接过境方式载运于其领土内的乘客、行李及货物，应实施极为简化的监管措施。

Query_Text_en: The baggage and cargo in direct transit as mentioned above shall be exempted from customs duties and other simfiar duties and taxes .
Translation: 上述直接过境的行李和货物，应免征关税及其他类似税费。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airport and alternate airport to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 第八条 一、缔约一方应在本国境内指定供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线所使用的机场（包括备降机场），并向该空运企业提供其经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他附属服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airport [ s ] , equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司使用缔约另一方机场、设备及技术服务时，其收费标准应遵循缔约另一方主管部门制定的公平合理费率。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 1 . The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第九条 一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时，应享有公平均等的机会。

Query_Text_en: and [ 3 ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 以及[3]全程联运的运营要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 1 . The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit and the tariffs of other airlines .
Translation: 第十条 一、缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内至或自该领土运输所收取的运价，应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑所有相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润及其他航空公司的运价。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本条第一款所述运价应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The tariffs so agreed shall be submitted to the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval at least sixty days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 3. 双方商定的运价应至少在拟实施日期六十天前提交缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this period may be shortened subject to the agreement of the said Authorities .
Translation: 特殊情况下，经上述主管机关同意，该期限可予缩短。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If a tariff can not be agreed between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , or if the Aeronautical Authorities of one Contracting Party gives the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party notice of its disapproval of a tariff agreed in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariff through mutual consultation .
Translation: 四、如缔约双方指定航空公司未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议，或缔约一方航空当局对根据本条第二款协议运价提出异议并通知缔约另一方航空当局，则缔约双方航空当局应通过协商共同确定该运价。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph 4 of this Article , the difference of opinion shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就本条第三款提交的任何运价达成协议，或未能根据本条第四款确定任何运价，其分歧应依照本协定第十七条规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 11The revenue derived from the transportation of international traffic by the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempted from income tax and all other taxes and shall be permitted to be transferred by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十一条  
缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输业务所获得的收入，应免征所得税及其他一切税捐，并获准由缔约另一方汇出。

Query_Text_en: Article 12The Aeronautical Authorities of each Contracting Party shall supply to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistics relevant to the traffic to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party carried on the agreed services of the designated airline of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十二条  
缔约一方的航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，提供其指定航空公司在协议航班上承运的往来缔约另一方领土运输业务的相关统计数据。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office shall be citizens of the People 's Republic of China and of the Syrian Arab Republic and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该代表处工作人员应为中华人民共和国和阿拉伯叙利亚共和国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并须经双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 14The crew members of the designated airline of each Contracting Party , while flying the agreed services , shall be admitted by the other Contracting Party into its territory against production of valid passports without any requirement for a visa provided they stay at the airport for a period not exceeding twenty-four [ 24 ] hours and leave the said territory on the same aircraft .
Translation:
第十四条  
缔约一方指定航空公司的机组人员，在执行协议航班时，如持有效护照且在机场停留不超过二十四（24）小时并搭乘同一航空器离境，缔约另一方应准许其进入其领土，无需办理签证。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall annually submit to the other Contracting Party a list of names of the crew members referred to above , but may submit amendments thereto at any time .
Translation: 缔约各方应每年向另一方提交上述船员名单，并可在任何时候提交修改名单。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] general declaration .
Translation: [ 8 ] 总声明

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the above-mentioned valid certificates and licences issued by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 各缔约方应承认另一方签发的上述有效证书和执照。

Query_Text_en: Article 161 . In case where the aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party meets with an accident in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the other Contracting Party shall instruct its appropriate authorities to immediately inform the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party and provide necessary assistance to the crew and passengers on board the aircraft .
Translation: 第一百六十一条  如缔约一方指定空运企业的航空器在缔约另一方领土内发生事故，缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即通知缔约一方的航空当局，并对该航空器上的机组人员和乘客提供必要协助。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] communicate in writing to the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation: [6] 以书面形式将调查结果通报第一缔约方的航空主管部门。

Query_Text_en: The expenses incurred in connection with the above-mentioned investigation shall be borne by the Party in whose territory the accident has occurred .
Translation: 上述调查所涉费用应由事故发生地所在方承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 17Both Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation of the present Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support .
Translation:
第十七条  
缔约双方应本着密切合作与相互支持的精神，确保本协议的正确实施。

Query_Text_en: If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding . Failing to reach agreement , the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties shall settle it through consultation . If agreement still can not be reached , the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如对本协定之解释或实施发生任何分歧，缔约双方指定航空公司应本着友好合作与相互谅解之精神，通过直接协商予以解决。若协商未果，应由缔约双方航空当局通过磋商解决。如仍未能达成一致，则须通过外交途径由缔约双方共同解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 18If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provisions of the present Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party and such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十八条
缔约任何一方如认为有必要修改或修正本协定及其附件的任何条款，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。此项协商应于缔约另一方收到请求之日起六十（60）天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Any modification or amendment to the present Agreement or its Annex shall come into force when they have been confirmed through exchange of diplomatic notes between the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本协定及其附件的任何修改或修正，应经缔约双方以外交换文确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 19The Annex to the present Agreement and the notes exchanged in connection hereto shall be an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation:
第十九条  
本协定附件及与之相关的换文为本协定不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 20Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation:
第二十条
缔约任何一方可随时通知另一方终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party . If the above notice is withdrawn before the expiry of this period , the present Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协定应于另一缔约方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止。若上述通知于该期限届满前撤回，经另一缔约方同意，本协定应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 21The present Agreement shall come into force on a date to be laid down in an exchange of diplomatic notes , which shall state that the formalities required by the national legislation of each Contracting Party have been completed .
Translation:
第二十一条  
本协定自缔约双方通过外交照会相互通知已完成各自国内法律程序之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Done at Damascus on this tenth day of November , 1975 in duplicate in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七五年十一月十日订于大马士革，一式三份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Read `` Ministry of Transport '' instead of `` Ministry of Defense '' referred to in Article 1 [ 1 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: 本协定第一条第一款中所述“国防部”应理解为“交通运输部”。

Query_Text_en: The agreed services provided by the designated airline of either Contracting Party on the specified routes shall begin at a point in its territory .
Translation: 缔约任何一方指定航空公司在规定航线上提供的协议航班，应始自其领土内的一点。

Query_Text_en: II . Right of OmissionThe aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties operating the agreed services on the specified routes may omit calling at any intermediate point and point of extension .
Translation:
二、取消经停权
缔约双方指定航空公司在规定航线上经营协议航班时，可取消在任何中间点及延远点的经停。

Query_Text_en: III . Special , Charter and Additional Flights1 . In case the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operate special and charter flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party , the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party shall submit a request to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party which shall attend to clearance formalities from the appropriate authorities of its country and give reply to the former .
Translation:
三、专机、包机与加班飞行  
1. 缔约任何一方指定航空公司如欲在缔约另一方领土内经营专机或包机飞行，应首先向该缔约另一方航空当局提出申请。经申请方航空当局协调本国相关主管部门完成审批手续后，应向提出申请的缔约一方航空当局予以答复。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In case the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operate additional flight on the specified routes , it shall , under normal circumstance , submit a request to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party forty-eight hours before the departure of the aircraft in question , and the flight can be commenced only after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation: 二、如缔约任何一方指定航空公司欲在协议航线增加班次，正常情况下应于该航班起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，获准后方可开航。

Query_Text_en: AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PEOPLE 'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA AND THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNION OF BURMA ON THE QUESTION OF THE BOUNDARY BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIESThe Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the Union of Burma With a view to promoting an overall settlement of the Sino Burmese boundary question and to consolidating and further developing friendly relations between China and Burma Have agreed to conclude the present Agreement under the guidance of the Five Principles of peaceful coexistence and have agreed as follows :
Translation:
中华人民共和国政府和缅甸联邦政府关于两国边界问题的协定

中华人民共和国政府和缅甸联邦政府，为了全面解决中缅边界问题，巩固和发展两国友好关系，在和平共处五项原则指导下，决定缔结本协定，并达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Article 1The Contracting Parties agree to set up immediately a joint committee composed of an equal number of delegates from each side and charge it in accordance with the provisions of the present Agreement to discuss and work out solutions on the concrete questions regarding the Sino Burmese boundary enumerated in Article 2 of the present Agreement conduct surveys of the boundary and set up boundary markers and draft a Sino Burmese boundary treaty The joint committee shall hold regular meetings in the capitals of the two countries or at any other places in the two countries
Translation: 第一条 缔约双方同意立即成立由各方同等人数代表组成的联合委员会，根据本协定规定，负责讨论和解决本协定第二条所列中缅边界具体问题，进行勘界、树立界桩以及起草中缅边界条约。联合委员会应定期在两国首都或双方境内其他地点举行会议。

Query_Text_en: 1 With the exception of the area of Hpimaw Gawlum and Kangfang the entire undelimited boundary from the High Conical Peak to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary shall be delimited along the traditional customary line that is to say from the High Conical Peak northward along the watershed between the Taiping the Shweli the Nu Salween and the Tulung Taron Rivers on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other up to the place where it crosses the Tulung Taron River between Chingdam and Nhkumkang and then along the watershed between the Tulung Taron and the Tsayul Zayul Rivers on the one hand and all the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River except for the Tulung Taron River on the other up to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary
Translation: 除片马、古浪、岗房地区外，从高黎贡山至中缅边界西端终点之未定界，应沿传统习惯线划定。即：自高黎贡山起，向北沿太平江、瑞丽江、怒江（萨尔温江）、独龙江（塔龙江）等水系与恩梅开江之分水岭，至独龙江（塔龙江）在钦敦与恩康间穿越分水岭处；再沿独龙江（塔龙江）、察隅河等水系与伊洛瓦底江（除独龙江外）各上游支流之分水岭，直至中缅边界西端终点。

Query_Text_en: The joint committee shall send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to conduct surveys along the above mentioned watersheds so as to determine the specific alignment of this section of the boundary line and to set up boundary markers
Translation: 联合委员会应派出由双方等额人员组成的联合勘察队，沿上述分水岭进行实地勘察，以确定该段边界线的具体走向并设立界桩。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Burmese Government has agreed to return to China the area of Hpimaw Gawlum and Kangfang which belongs to China
Translation: 缅甸政府同意将属于中国的片马、古浪、岗房地区归还中国。

Query_Text_en: As to the extent of this area to be returned to China it is to be discussed and determined by the joint committee in accordance with the proposals put forward and marked on maps by the Governments of Burma and China on February 4 1957 and July 26 1957 respectively
Translation: 关于该地区归还中国的范围，应由联合委员会根据缅甸政府于1957年2月4日和中国政府于1957年7月26日分别提出并在地图上标注的方案进行讨论确定。

Query_Text_en: After determining theextent of this area to be returned to China the jointcommittee shall send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to conduct on the spot survey of the specific alignment of this section of the boundary line and to set up boundary markers
Translation: 联合委员会在确定该地区归还中国的范围后，应派出由双方对等人员组成的联合勘界小组，实地勘察该段边界线的具体走向，并树立界桩。

Query_Text_en: 3 In order to abrogate the perpetual lease by Burma of the Meng Mao triangular area Namwan Assigned Tract at the junction of the Namwan and the Shweli Rivers which belongs to China the Chinese Government has agreed to turn over this area to Burma to become part of the territory of the Union of Burma
Translation: 为废除缅甸对属于中国的南畹河与瑞丽江汇合处的勐卯三角地区（南畹指定区）的永租权，中国政府同意将该地区移交缅甸，作为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。

Query_Text_en: In exchange the Burmese Government has agreed to turn over to China to become part of Chinese territory the areas under the jurisdiction of the Panhung and Panlao tribes which are west of the boundary linefrom the junction of the Nam Ting and the Nampa Rivers to the No 1 marker on the southern delimited section of the boundary as defined in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941
Translation: 作为交换，缅甸政府同意将以下地区移交中国，并入中国领土：自南汀河与南帕河汇合处起，至1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文所划定边界南段第一号界桩止，界线以西的班洪、班老部落管辖区域。

Query_Text_en: AS to the extent of these areas to be turned over to China the Chinese and the Burmese Governments put forward proposals marked on maps on July 26 1957 and June 4 1959 respectively
Translation: 关于移交中国领土范围事宜，中缅两国政府分别于1957年7月26日及1959年6月4日在地图上标注并提出了相关方案。

Query_Text_en: The area where the proposals of the two Governments coincide will definitely be turned over to China
Translation: 两国政府方案重合区域必将移交中方

Query_Text_en: Where the proposals of the two Governments differ as to the area under the jurisdiction of the Panhung tribe the joint committee will send out a team composed of an equal number of persons from each side to ascertain on the spot as to whether it is under the jurisdiction of the Panhung tribe so as to determine whether it is to be turned over to China
Translation: 如两国政府就班洪部落管辖区域存在分歧，联合委员会应派遣由双方等额人员组成的小组实地核查，以确认该地区是否属班洪部落管辖，进而决定是否移交中国。

Query_Text_en: After the extent of the areas under the jurisdiction of the Panhung and Panlao tribes to be turned over to China has been thus determined the joint committee will send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to conduct on the spot survey of the specific alignment of this section of the boundary line and to set up boundary markers
Translation: 班洪、班老部落辖区移交中国的范围确定后，联合委员会应派出由双方对等人数组成的联合勘察队，实地勘察该段边界线的具体走向并树立界桩。

Query_Text_en: 4 Except for the adjustment provided for in paragraph 3 of this Article the section of the boundary from the junction of the Nam Ting and the Nampa Rivers to the No 1 marker on the southern delimited section of the boundary shall be delimited as defined in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941 The joint committee shall send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to carry out delimitation and demarcation along this section of the boundary line and set up boundary markers
Translation: 除本条第三款规定的调整外，自南汀河与南怕河汇合处至边界南段已定界第一号界桩的边界线，应按照1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文所确定界线进行标定。联合委员会应派出由双方同等人数组成的联合勘察队，沿此段边界线进行勘界和树立界桩。

Query_Text_en: Article 3The Contracting Parties agree that the joint committee after working out solutions for the existing issues concerning the Sino Burmese boundary as enumerated in Article 2 of the present Agreement shall be responsible for drafting a Sino Burmese boundary treaty which shall cover not only all the sections of the boundary as mentioned in Article 2 of the present Agreement but also the sections of the boundary which were already delimited in the past and need no adjustment
Translation:
第三条
