Query_Text_en: Article 3Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory airports and alternate airport [ s ] to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of air services , and provide the designated airline of the other Contracting Party with communications , navigational , lighting , meteorological and other auxiliary services as well as fuel , lubricants which are required for the safe operation of the air services on the specified route .
Translation:
第三条  
缔约一方应在本国境内指定机场和备降机场，供缔约另一方指定航空公司经营航空业务使用，并为该指定航空公司提供通信、导航、灯光、气象及其他辅助服务，以及特定航线上航空业务安全运行所需的燃料、润滑油。

Query_Text_en: The procedure of operation of the Aeronautical Fixed Tele-communication Service between the two Contracting Parties shall be agreed upon through consultation between the civil aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约双方民用航空当局应通过协商，就双方航空固定电信服务的操作程序达成一致。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 1 . The aircraft , passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail of the designated airline of either Contracting Party must comply with the effective laws , rules and regulations of the other Contracting Party in regard to traffic management , navigation , entry , exit , customs and quarantine , et cetera in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第四条 一、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机、旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件在缔约另一方领土内，必须遵守缔约另一方关于空中交通管理、航行、入境、出境、海关、检疫等现行有效的法律、规章和规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying the specified route shall bear the nationality and registration marks of the respective country and shall carry certificate of registration , certificate of airworthiness , journey logbook , aircraft radio station license , valid licenses for each member of the crew and name list of crew members , name list of passengers giving their places of embarkation and destination and manifest of cargo and mail .
Translation:
二、缔约任何一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的航空器应具有本国国籍标志和登记标志，并携带下列证件：
（一）登记证；
（二）适航证；
（三）航行记录簿；
（四）航空器无线电台执照；
（五）机组每一成员的有效执照；
（六）机组名单；
（七）注明起讫地点的旅客名单；
（八）货物、邮件舱单。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the validity of the above-mentioned valid documents of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方应承认另一方上述有效证件的效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 1 . The crew members of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties flying the specified routes shall be citizens of the respective countries .
Translation: 第五条 一、缔约双方指定空运企业飞行规定航线的机组人员，应为该缔约方本国国民。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party the right to set up its representative office at one point of call of its air services in the territory of the former .
Translation: 二、缔约一方应准许缔约另一方的指定航空公司在己方领土内某一航线经停地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The number of staff members of such representative office shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of the two Parties , and such staff members shall be citizens of the People 's Republic of China or the Republic of Iraq . The representative office may also employ the citizens of the country where it is situated .
Translation: 该代表处工作人员数量应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，且工作人员须为中华人民共和国或伊拉克共和国公民。代表处亦可聘用驻在国公民。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall , in its territory , extend assistance and facilities to the representative office of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and its staff members , ensure their security , and take measures to safeguard the aircraft , stores and other property of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 三、缔约一方应在其领土内，向缔约另一方指定航空运输企业的代表机构及其工作人员提供协助和便利，确保其安全，并采取措施保护缔约另一方指定航空运输企业的航空器、储备物资及其他财产。

Query_Text_en: Such articles of the other Contracting Party taken on board the aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party in the territory of the former shall comply with the laws and regulations of the former .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司的航空器在缔约另一方领土内装载的该缔约另一方物品，须遵守该缔约另一方的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The rate of charges imposed by one Contracting Party on the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the use of airports and other facilities in its territory shall not be higher than that imposed on the airlines of the other countries .
Translation: 缔约一方对缔约另一方指定航空公司在使用其境内机场及其他设施时所征收的费用，不得高于其对其他国家航空公司征收的费率。

Query_Text_en: Article 7Subject to the national laws and regulations of one Contracting Party and on reciprocal basis , the designated airline of such Contracting Party shall be responsible for effecting the transfer of the amount payable by it to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party to the bank account designated by the latter within sixty days after the receipt of invoices from the latter .
Translation:
第七条  
在遵守缔约一方国家法律法规并基于互惠原则的前提下，该缔约方指定航空公司在收到另一方指定航空公司开具的发票后，应负责将应付款项于六十日内汇至对方指定的银行账户。

Query_Text_en: Article 8When an aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party is in distress or meets with an accident in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the other Contracting Party shall undertake rescue operations , render assistance and rescue to the passengers and crew and do everything possible to protect the aircraft and the things on board , and at the same time give immediate notification to the former .
Translation:
第八条  
一缔约方指定航空公司的航空器在另一缔约方领土内遇险或发生事故时，该另一缔约方应实施救援行动，对乘客及机组人员提供救助与援救，并尽一切可能保护航空器及机上物品，同时立即将情况通知前一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: The latter shall undertake to conduct investigation into the accident and communicate the findings to the former , who may appoint its representatives to take part in the investigation .
Translation: 后者应负责对事故进行调查，并将调查结果通报前者；前者可指派代表参与调查。

Query_Text_en: Article 9Should any differences arise between the civil aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties over the interpretation or application of the present Agreement , consultations shall be conducted in the spirit of friendly cooperation for settlement . In case of failure to reach a common view , such differences shall be settled between the two Contracting Parties through diplomatic channels .
Translation:
第九条  
缔约双方民航当局如对本协定解释或实施发生分歧，应本着友好合作精神协商解决。如未能达成一致，该分歧应由缔约双方通过外交途径解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 10If either of the Contracting Parties considers it necessary to modify the present Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party , such consultations shall begin within sixty days from the date of receipt of such request by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十条  
缔约任何一方如认为有必要修改本协定或其附件，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。此项协商应于缔约另一方收到请求之日起六十日内开始。

Query_Text_en: Modifications agreed upon between both Contracting Parties will come into force when they have been confirmed by an exchange of notes .
Translation: 缔约双方商定的修改内容，自换文确认之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . In case one Contracting Party or the designated airline of such Contracting Party fails to comply with the provisions of the present Agreement , the other Contracting Party shall have the right to suspend or revoke the exercise of the rights specified in the present Agreement by the designated airline of the former .
Translation: 第十一条  一、如缔约一方或其指定空运企业未遵守本协定规定，缔约另一方有权暂停或撤销前者指定空运企业行使本协定规定的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Either Contracting Party may at any time give written notice to the other Contracting Party if it desires to terminate the present Agreement . The present Agreement shall terminate six months after the date of receipt of such notice given by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 缔约任何一方可随时书面通知另一方要求终止本协定。本协定自另一方收到该通知之日起六个月后终止。

Query_Text_en: Article 12The present Agreement shall come into force on the FIFTEENTH day of FEBRUARY , 1970 .
Translation:
第十二条  
本协定自一九七零年二月十五日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Signed in Peking this SEVENTH day of NOVEMBER , 1969 , in duplicate in the Chinese and Arabic languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九六九年十一月七日订于北京，一式两份，每份都用中文和阿拉伯文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: An English translation of this Agreement is attached hereto for reference in interpretation .
Translation: 本协议英文译本附后，仅供解释时参考。

Query_Text_en: From a point in China - points in third countries to be agreed upon between both Contracting Parties - Baghdad and Basrah in Iraq -- points in other third countries to be agreed upon between both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 自中国境内一点——经缔约双方商定的第三国地点——至伊拉克的巴格达和巴士拉——以及缔约双方商定的其他第三国地点。

Query_Text_en: From a point in Iraq - points in third countries to be agreed upon between both Contracting Parties - Canton and Shanghai in China - points in other third countries to be agreed upon between both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 自伊拉克境内某点（具体地点由缔约双方商定的第三国地点）——至中国广州和上海（具体地点由缔约双方商定的其他第三国地点）。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of either Contracting Party has no right to carry traffic between one point and another in the territory of the other Contracting Party , whatever the origin and ultimate destination of such traffic4 .
Translation: 三、缔约任何一方指定航空公司无权在缔约另一方领土内两点之间承运旅客与货物，无论此类运输的始发地与最终目的地为何。

Query_Text_en: The aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party shall perform stop at least at one point of call in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified route . However , it may overfly other points of call on the specified route without stop .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司的飞机在指定航线上飞行时，至少应在缔约另一方领土内一个经停点降落。但该飞机可不经停飞越指定航线上的其他经停点。

Query_Text_en: The Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Iraq , Being desirous , on the basis of the principles of mutual respect for territorial integrity and sovereignty , non-aggression , non-interference in each other 's internal affairs , equality and mutual benefit and peaceful co-existence , to develop cooperation between the two countries in the fields of cultural relations and affairs , so as to promote mutual understanding and friendly relations between the two peoples , have decided for these purposes to conclude the present Agreement .
Translation: 中华人民共和国政府与伊拉克共和国政府，基于相互尊重领土完整与主权、互不侵犯、互不干涉内政、平等互利及和平共处的原则，为发展两国在文化关系与事务领域的合作，增进两国人民之间的相互理解与友好关系，决定缔结本协定。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Both Contracting Parties shall encourage and support the exchange of visits and interchange of experiences of each other 's university professors , scholars , officials of governments cultural and educational departments and persons and students in the fields of literature , art , science , education , medicine , public health etc. , and youth organizations and promote contacts between the corresponding institutions relating to the aforesaid fields recommended by the governments of both parties .
Translation: 第一条 缔约双方应鼓励和支持互派大学教授、学者、政府文化教育部门官员及文学、艺术、科学、教育、医学、公共卫生等领域的专业人士与学生进行访问交流，分享经验；并促进双方政府推荐的上述领域相关机构之间的往来合作。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Both Contracting Parties shall exchange students and establish for that purpose specified numbers of scholarships .
Translation: 第二条 缔约双方应互派留学生，并为此提供专项奖学金名额。

Query_Text_en: Students of both Parties shall respect the system governing studies of the receiving country .
Translation: 双方留学生应遵守接受国的学习制度。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Each Contracting Party shall act in accordance with the system governing studies of the other 's country , with respect to diplomas and degrees of their students studying in the other Party 's country .
Translation: 第三条  缔约各方应根据本国规定，对在对方国家留学人员所获得的学历证书和学位予以承认。

Query_Text_en: In case one Party does not keep the system of degrees , it may meet the requests of the other Party by issuing certificates .
Translation: 如一方未实行学位制度，可通过颁发证书满足另一方要求。

Query_Text_en: Detailed methods of evaluating certificates or degrees shall be settled in the yearly operational plan .
Translation: 证书或学位评估的具体办法由年度实施方案确定。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Both Contracting Parties shall invite each other 's professors , scholars and scientists to give short-term lectures or to teach for longer periods in the other 's country .
Translation: 第四条 缔约双方应互邀对方教授、学者和科学家赴本国进行短期讲学或长期任教。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Both Contracting Parties shall study the establishment of academic chairs in their universities and cultural institutions for studying the language , literature and culture of each other 's country .
Translation: 第五条 缔约双方应研究在各自大学和文化机构中设立研究对方国家语言、文学及文化的学术讲席。

Query_Text_en: Methods concerning this shall be settled in the yearly operational plan .
Translation: 具体实施办法由年度经营计划予以明确。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Both Contracting Parties shall encourage the cooperation between their athletic institutions and shall arrange for visits and friendly matches of their sport teams or individual sportsmen .
Translation: 第六条 缔约双方应鼓励两国体育机构之间的合作，并安排双方运动队或运动员互访及进行友谊比赛。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Both Contracting Parties shall encourage and support cooperation in the fields of news broadcasting and television and the exchange of visits of journalists between the two countries , and shall send correspondents of official news agencies to be stationed permanently in each other 's country .
Translation: 第七条 缔约双方鼓励和支持两国在新闻广播和电视领域的合作以及新闻工作者的互访，并互派官方通讯社常驻记者。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Both Contracting Parties shall encourage the exchange of visits and performances by artists and art ensembles .
Translation: 第八条 缔约双方应鼓励艺术家和艺术团体的互访和演出交流。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Exchange of duplicated antiquities or their reproductions , encourage and support the visits of archeologists and holding of temporary exhibitions in each others country .
Translation: 交换重复文物或其复制品，鼓励并支持考古学家互访及在对方国家举办临时展览。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 For the implementation of the present Agreement , both Contracting Parties shall each appoint two delegates to form a standing committee , which shall , according to the principles laid down in the present Agreement , negotiate the yearly operational plan and supervise and inspect its implementation .
Translation: 第十条 为执行本协定，缔约双方应各自指派两名代表组成常设委员会。该委员会应根据本协定所定原则，商定年度执行计划，并监督和检查其执行情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 The Present Agreement shall come into force after approval by the Governments of both Contracting Parties and the exchange of notifications of approval .
Translation: 第十一条  本协定自双方政府批准并互换批准通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement may be amended by mutual consent .
Translation: 本协定可经双方同意予以修订。

Query_Text_en: If either of the Contracting Parties desires to terminate the present Agreement , a six-month advance notice in writing shall be given to the other .
Translation: 缔约任何一方如欲终止本协定，应提前六个月以书面形式通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement is concluded in Baghdad on April 4th , 1959 .
Translation: 本协定于1959年4月4日在巴格达签订。

Query_Text_en: Done induplicate in Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all three texts being equally valid .
Translation: 本协议以中文、阿拉伯文和英文三种语言各制作两份，三种文本具有同等法律效力。

Query_Text_en: In the event of discrepancy in interpretation , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如对文本解释存在歧义，应以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: b. notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations , who should disseminate the information without delay by all appropriate means of communication at his disposal .
Translation: b. 通知联合国秘书长，秘书长应通过其掌握的一切适当通讯手段立即传播该信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 2If , owing to accident , distress , emergency or unintended landing , the personnel of a spacecraft land in territory under the jurisdiction of a Contracting Party , it shall immediately take all possible steps to rescue them and render them all necessary assistance . It shall inform the launching authority and also the Secretary-General of the United Nations of the steps it is taking and of their progress .
Translation:
第二条  
如航天器人员因意外事故、遇险、紧急情况或非预定降落，降落在任一缔约国管辖区域内，该缔约国应立即采取一切可能措施予以营救，并提供一切必要协助。该缔约国应将其所采取的措施及进展情况通知发射当局及联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: If assistance by the launching authority would help to effect a prompt rescue or would contribute substantially to the effectiveness of search and rescue operations , the launching authority shall co-operate with the Contracting Party with a view to the effective conduct of search and rescue operations .
Translation: 若发射当局的协助有助于迅速实施救援或能显著提升搜救行动成效，则该当局应与缔约国开展合作，以确保搜救行动的有效开展。

Query_Text_en: Such operations shall be subject to the direction and control of the Contracting Party , which shall act in close and continuing consultation with the launching authority .
Translation: 此类行动应在发射国的指导和监督下进行，并与发射当局保持密切持续的协商。

Query_Text_en: Article 3If information is received or it is discovered that the personnel of a spacecraft have alighted on the high seas or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any State , those Contracting Parties which are in a position to do so shall , if necessary , extend assistance in search and rescue operations for such personnel to assure their speedy rescue .
Translation:
第三条  
如获悉或发现航天器人员已在公海或不属任何国家管辖的其他任何地方降落，各缔约国在必要时，应协助搜寻与营救该人员，确保其迅速获救。凡力所能及的缔约国，均应参与此类行动。

Query_Text_en: They shall inform the launching authority and the Secretary-General of the United Nations of the steps they are taking and of their progress .
Translation: 他们应将所采取的措施及进展情况通知发射国和联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article 4If , owing to accident , distress , emergency or unintended landing , the personnel of a spacecraft land in territory under the jurisdiction of a Contracting Party or have been found on the high seas or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any State , they shall be safely and promptly returned to representatives of the launching authority .
Translation:
第四条  
如因意外事故、遇险、紧急情况或非故意降落，航天器人员降落在某一缔约国管辖的领土上，或在公海或不属于任何国家管辖的任何其他地点被发现，应被安全并迅速送还发射当局的代表。

Query_Text_en: Article 51 . Each Contracting Party which receives information or discovers that a space object or its component parts has returned to Earth in territory under its jurisdiction or on the high seas or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any State , shall notify the launching authority and the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 第五十一条 任一缔约国若获悉或发现空间物体或其组成部分返回地球并落在其管辖的领土内、公海或不属任何国家管辖的其他任何地方，应通知发射当局和联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party having jurisdiction over the territory on which a space object or its component parts has been discovered shall , upon the request of the launching authority and with assistance from that authority if requested , take such steps as it finds practicable to recover the object or component parts .
Translation: 二、各缔约国若在其管辖领土上发现空间物体或其组成部分，应根据发射当局的请求，并在该当局提出协助要求时予以协助，采取其认为切实可行的措施，对该空间物体或其组成部分实施回收。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Upon request of the launching authority , objects launched into outer space or their component parts found beyond the territorial limits of the launching authority shall be returned to or held at the disposal of representatives of the launching authority , which shall , upon request , furnish identifying data prior to their return .
Translation: 三、应发射当局要求，在发射当局领土界限以外发现的外空发射物体或其组成部分应归还发射当局或交由该当局代表处置。发射当局在归还前经请求应提供识别数据。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Notwithstanding paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article , a Contracting Party which has reason to believe that a space object or its component parts discovered in territory under its jurisdiction , or recovered by it elsewhere , is of a hazardous or deleterious nature may so notify the launching authority , which shall immediately take effective steps , under the direction and control of the said Contracting party , to eliminate possible danger of harm .
Translation: 四、尽管有本条第二款和第三款的规定，若缔约国有理由认为在其管辖领土内发现或于其他地方寻获的空间物体或其组成部分具有危险或有害性质，可就此通知发射当局。发射当局应在该缔约国指导和监督下立即采取有效措施，消除可能造成损害的危险。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Expenses incurred in fulfilling obligations to recover and return a space object or its component parts under paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article shall be borne by the launching authority .
Translation: 根据本条第二款和第三款规定，为履行回收和归还空间物体或其组成部分义务所产生的费用，应由发射当局承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 6For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` launching authority '' shall refer to the State responsible for launching , or , where an international intergovernmental organization is responsible for launching , that organiz ation , provided that that organization declares its acceptance of the rights and obligations provided for in this Agreement and a majority of the States members of that organization are Contracting Parties to this Agreement and to the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space , including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies .
Translation:
第六条  
为本协定之目的，“发射国”一词应指负责发射的国家；若系国际政府间组织负责发射，则该组织为本协定所称之发射国，但该组织须声明接受本协定所规定之权利与义务，且该组织多数成员国为本协定及《关于各国探索和利用外层空间包括月球与其他天体活动所应遵守原则的条约》的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Article 71 . This Agreement shall be open to all States for signature .
Translation: 第七十一条  本协定对所有国家开放签署。

Query_Text_en: Any State which does not sign this Agreement before its entry into force in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to it at any time .
Translation: 本协定按本条第三款生效后未签署的任何国家，均可随时加入本协定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Agreement shall be subject to ratification by signatory States . Instruments of ratification and instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland , the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics and the United States of America , which are hereby designated the Depositary Governments .
Translation: 本协定须经签署国批准。批准书和加入书应交存于大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国、苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟及美利坚合众国政府，兹指定该三国政府为保管国政府。

Query_Text_en: 3 . This Agreement shall enter into force upon the deposit of instruments of ratification by five Governments including the Governments designated as Depositary Governments under this Agreement .
Translation: 本协定自包括本协定指定保管政府在内的五个政府交存批准书之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 4 . For States whose instruments of ratification or accession are deposited subsequent to the entry into force of this Agreement , it shall enter into force on the date of the deposit of their instruments of ratification or accession .
Translation: 对于在本协定生效后交存批准书或加入书的国家，本协定应自其交存批准书或加入书之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Depositary Governments shall promptly inform all signatory and acceding States of the date of each signature , the date of deposit of each instrument of ratification of and accession to this Agreement , the date of its entry into force and other notices .
Translation: 五、各保存国政府应将每一签署日期、每一批准书或加入书交存日期、本协定生效日期及其他通知事项，迅速告知所有签署国和加入国。

Query_Text_en: 6 . This Agreement shall be registered by the Depositary Governments pursuant to Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations .
Translation: 6. 本协定应由保管国政府依照《联合国宪章》第一百零二条规定予以登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Any State Party to the Agreement may propose amendments to this Agreement .
Translation:
第八条
本协定任何缔约国均可提出修正案。

Query_Text_en: Amendments shall enter into force for each State Party to the Agreement accepting the amendments upon their acceptance by a majority of the States Parties to the Agreement and thereafter for each remaining State Party to the Agreement on the date of acceptance by it .
Translation: 修正案应自过半数协定缔约国接受之日起对接受该修正案的缔约国生效，此后对余下每一缔约国自其接受之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 9Any State Party to the Agreement may give notice of its withdrawal from the Agreement one year after its entry into force by written notification to the Depositary Governments .
Translation:
第九条
本协定任何缔约国得于协定生效一年后，以书面通知保管国政府宣告退出本协定。

Query_Text_en: Such withdrawal shall take effect one year from the date of receipt of this notification .
Translation: 此项退出应自收到本通知之日起一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 10This Agreement , of which the English , Russian , French , Spanish and Chinese texts are equally authentic , shall be deposited in the archives of the Depositary Governments .
Translation:
第十条  
本协定以英文、俄文、法文、西班牙文和中文写成，各文本同等作准，应交存于各保存国政府档案库。

Query_Text_en: Duly certified copies of this Agreement shall be transmitted by the Depositary Governments to the Governments of the signatory and acceding States .
Translation: 本协定经核证无误的副本应由保管国政府分送各签署国及加入国政府。

Query_Text_en: In witness wehereof the undersigned , duly authorised , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 兹证明，下列签署人经正式授权，已签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done in triplicate , at the cities of London , Moscow and Washington , the twenty-second day of April , one thousand nine hundred and sixty-eight .
Translation: 本条约一式三份，于一九六八年四月二十二日在伦敦、莫斯科及华盛顿三地签署。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] `` Agreement '' means the present agreement , including its Annexes but excluding all titles of Articles , opened for signature by Governments at Washington on August 20 , 1971 , by which the international telecommunications satellite organization `` INTELSAT '' is established ;
Translation: [甲] "协定"系指1971年8月20日在华盛顿开放供各国政府签署的本协定，包括其附件但不包括各条款标题；根据该协定，成立了国际电信卫星组织"INTELSAT"。

Query_Text_en: and [ n ] `` Design '' and `` development '' include research directly related to the purposes of INTELSAT .
Translation: 且[n]项中“设计”与“开发”包括与国际通信卫星组织宗旨直接相关的研究工作。

Query_Text_en: Article II . [ ESTABLISHMENT OF INTELSAT ] [ a ] With full regard for the principles set forth in the Preamble to this Agreement , the Parties hereby establish the international telecommunications satellite organization `` INTELSAT '' , the main purpose of which is to continue and carry forward on a definitive basis the design , development , construction , establishment , operation and maintenance of the space segment of the global commercial telecommunications satellite system as established under the provisions of the Interim Agreement and the Special Agreement .
Translation: 第二条　[国际通信卫星组织的建立]　[一]　各缔约国在完全遵守本协定序言所阐明的各项原则的情况下，兹建立国际通信卫星组织“INTELSAT”，其主要宗旨是长久地继续并促进根据《临时协定》和《特别协定》的规定所建立起来的全球商业通信卫星系统空间段的设计、研制、建造、建立、经营和保养。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each State Party shall sign , or shall designate a telecom - munications entity , public or private , to sign , the Operating Agreement which shall be concluded in conformity with the provisions of this Agreement and which shall be opened for signature at the same time as this Agreement .
Translation: [b]各缔约国应签署，或指定一家公共或私营电信实体签署《运营协定》。该协定须符合本协定条款制定，并与本协定同时开放签署。

Query_Text_en: Relations between any telecommunications entity , acting as Signatory , and the Party which has designated it shall be governed by applicable domestic law .
Translation: 任何作为签字方的电信实体与其指定方之间的关系，均应受相关国内法律管辖。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Telecommunications administrations and entities may , subject to applicable domestic law , negotiate and enter directly into appropriate traffic agreements with respect to their use of channels of telecommunications provided pursuant to this Agreement and the Operating Agreement , as well as services to be furnished to the public , facilities , divisions of revenue and related business arrangements .
Translation: 各电信主管部门和实体可在适用国内法律允许范围内，就本协定及《业务协定》所提供电信信道的使用、向公众提供的服务、设施配置、收入分配及相关业务安排，直接协商并签订适当的通信协议。

Query_Text_en: Article III [ SCOPE OF INTELSAT ACTIVITIES ] [ a ] In continuing and carrying forward on a definitive basis activities concerning the space segment of the global commercial telecommunications satellite system referred to in paragraph [ a ] of Article II of this Agreement , INTELSAT shall have as its prime objective the provision , on a commercial basis , of the space segment required for international public telecommunications services of high quality and reliability to be available on a non-discriminatory basis to all areas of the world .
Translation:
第三条【国际通信卫星组织活动范围】
【甲款】在持续并确定性地推进本协定第二条甲款所述全球商业通信卫星系统空间段相关活动时，国际通信卫星组织应以商业运营为基础，将以下列为首要目标：为全球各地区无差别地提供高质量、高可靠性的国际公共通信服务所需空间段。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] Domestic public telecommunications services between areas which are not linked by any terrestrial wideband facilities and which are separated by natural barriers of such an exceptional nature that they impede the viable establishment of terrestrial wideband facilities between such areas , provided that the Meeting of Signatories , having regard to advice tendered by the Board of Governors , has given the appropriate approval in advance .
Translation: 以及[二]在以下地区之间提供的国内公众电信服务：这些地区之间未通过任何地面宽带设施连接，且被具有特殊性质的自然障碍所分隔，以致在这些地区之间无法经济可行地建立地面宽带设施；但须经签字国会议事先适当批准，并参考理事会提供的建议。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The INTELSAT space segment established to meet the prime objective shall also be made available for other domestic public telecommunications services on a non-discriminatory basis to the extent that the ability of INTELSAT to achieve its prime objective is not impaired .
Translation: 为满足首要目标而建立的国际通信卫星组织空间段，亦应在不影响该组织实现其首要目标的前提下，以非歧视方式向其他国内公共电信业务开放使用。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] The arrangements are otherwise acceptable from a technical and economic point of view .
Translation: 二、从技术和经济角度来看，其余安排均可接受。

Query_Text_en: provided that the efficient and economic operation of the INTELSAT space segment is not unfavorably affected in any way .
Translation: 只要国际通信卫星组织空间段的高效经济运行不受任何不利影响。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The utilization of the INTELSAT space segment for specialized telecommunications services pursuant to paragraph [ d ] of this Article , and the provision of satellites or associated facilities separate from the INTELSAT space segment pursuant to paragraph [ e ] of this Article , shall be covered by contracts entered into between INTELSAT and the applicants concerned .
Translation: 根据本条[d]款使用国际通信卫星组织空间段提供专用电信服务，以及根据本条[e]款提供独立于该组织空间段的卫星或附属设施，均须由国际通信卫星组织与相关申请方签订合同予以规范。

Query_Text_en: The utilization of INTELSAT space segment facilities for specialized telecommunications services pursuant to paragraph [ d ] of this Article , and the provision of satellites or associated facilities separate from the INTELSAT space segment for specialized telecommunications services pursuant to subparagraph [ e ] [ iii ] of this Article , shall be in accordance with appropriate authorizations , at the planning stage , of the Assembly of Parties pursuant to subparagraph [ c ] [ iv ] of Article VII of this Agreement .
Translation: 根据本条第[d]款使用国际通信卫星组织空间段设施提供专用电信服务，以及根据本条第[e]款第[iii]项提供独立于国际通信卫星组织空间段的卫星及相关设施以开展专用电信服务，均须依照本协定第七条[c]款第[iv]项之规定，在规划阶段获得缔约国大会的相应授权。

Query_Text_en: Wherethe utilization of INTELSAT space segment facilities for specialized telecommunications services would involve additional costs which result from required modifications to existing or planned INTELSAT space segment facilities , or where the provision of satellites or associated facilities separate from the INTELSAT space segment is sought for specialized telecommunications services as provided for in subparagraph [ e ] [ iii ] of this Article , authorization pursuant to subparagraph [ c ] [ iv ] of Article VII of this Agreement shall be sought from the Assembly of Parties as soon as the Board of Governors is in a position to advise the Assembly of Parties in detail regarding the estimated cost of the proposal , the benefits to be derived , the technical or other problems involved and the probable effects on present or foreseeable INTELSAT services .
Translation: 如因利用国际通信卫星组织空间段设施提供特种电信业务，需对现有或规划中的空间段设施进行改造而产生额外费用；或如本条第[e]款第[三]项所述，拟脱离国际通信卫星组织空间段单独配置卫星及相关设施以提供特种电信业务时，应依照本协定第七条[c]款第[四]项规定，在董事会能够就以下事项向缔约国大会提交详细评估意见后，立即提请大会审议批准：该提案的预估成本、预期收益、涉及的技术或其他问题，以及对国际通信卫星组织现有或可预见服务可能产生的影响。

Query_Text_en: Such authorization shall be obtained before the procurement process for the facility or facilities involved is initiated .
Translation: 相关设施采购程序启动前，须事先取得此项授权。

Query_Text_en: Before making such authorizations , the Assembly of Parties , in appropriate cases , shall consult or ensure that there has been consultation by INTELSAT with Specialized Agencies of the United Nations directly concerned with the provision of the specialized telecommunications services in question .
Translation: 在作出此类授权前，缔约国大会应视情况与国际电信联盟直接相关的联合国专门机构进行协商，或确保国际通信卫星组织已就相关专业电信服务的提供事宜与之进行过协商。

Query_Text_en: Article IV . [ JURIDICAL PERSONALITY ] [ a ] INTELSAT shall possess juridical personality .
Translation: 第四条　[法律人格]　[甲]　国际通信卫星组织具有法律人格。

Query_Text_en: and [ iv ] Be a party to legal proceedings .
Translation: 及[四] 参与法律诉讼程序。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each Party shall take such action as is necessary within its jurisdiction for the purpose of making effective in terms of its own law the provisions of this Article .
Translation: [ b ] 各方须在其管辖范围内采取必要措施，以确保本条规定的法律效力在其国内法体系中得以实现。

Query_Text_en: Article V. [ FINANCIAL PRINCIPLES ] [ a ] INTELSAT shall be the owner of the INTELSAT space segment and of all other property acquired by INTELSAT .
Translation: 第五条　【财务原则】　（一）国际通信卫星组织是国际通信卫星组织空间段及该组织所获一切其他财产的所有者。

Query_Text_en: The financial interest in INTELSAT of each Signatory shall be equal to the amount arrived at by the application of its investment share to the valuation effected pursuant to Article 7 of the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 各签字国在国际通信卫星组织中的财务权益，应等于其投资份额乘以《运营协定》第七条所定估值后所得的金额。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each Signatory shall have an investment share corresponding to its percentage of all utilization of the INTELSAT space segment by all Signatories as determined in accordance with the provisions of the Operating Agreement . However , no Signatory , even if its utilization of the INTELSAT space segment is nil , shall have an investment share less than the minimum established in the Operating Agreement .
Translation: [b]各签字国应拥有与其根据《运营协定》规定确定的、在所有签字国对国际通信卫星组织空间段使用总量中所占百分比相对应的投资份额。但任何签字国——即便其对国际通信卫星组织空间段的使用量为零——其投资份额均不得低于《运营协定》规定的最低限额。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Each Signatory shall contribute to the capital requirements of INTELSAT , and shall receive capital repayment and compensation for use of capital in accordance with the provisions of the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 各签署国应根据《运营协定》之规定，向国际通信卫星组织提供资本金要求，并据此获得资本偿还及资本使用补偿。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] All users of the INTELSAT space segment shall pay utilization charges determined in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the Operating Agreement .
Translation: [ d ] 所有使用国际通信卫星组织空间段的用户，均应按照本协定及《运营协定》的规定缴纳使用费。

Query_Text_en: The rates of space segment utilization charge for each type of utilization shall be the same for all applicants for space segment capacity for that type of utilization .
Translation: 各类空间段使用费率的收费标准，对所有申请该类型空间段容量的用户均一视同仁。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] The separate satellites and associated facilities referred to in paragraph [ e ] of Article III of this Agreement may be financed and owned by INTELSAT as part of the INTELSAT space segment upon the unanimous approval of all the Signatories . If such approval is withheld , they shall be separate from the INTELSAT space segment and shall be financed and owned by those requesting them .
Translation: 本协定第三条(e)款所述独立卫星及相关设施，经全体签字国一致批准后，可由国际通信卫星组织出资并作为其空间段组成部分持有。若未获批准，则此类卫星及设施应独立于国际通信卫星组织空间段，由申请方自行出资并持有。

Query_Text_en: In this case the financial terms and conditions set by INTELSAT shall be such as to cover fully the costs directly resulting from the design , development , construction and provision of such separate satellites and associated facilities as well as an adequate part of the general and administrative costs of INTELSAT .
Translation: 在此情况下，国际通信卫星组织制定的财务条款应能全额覆盖由此类独立卫星及相关设施的设计、开发、建造及提供所产生的直接成本，同时还应包含该组织一般性管理成本的合理分摊部分。

Query_Text_en: and [ iv ] An executive organ , responsible to the Board of Governors .
Translation: [四] 设执行机构，对理事会负责。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Except to the extent that this Agreement or the Operating Agreement specifically provides otherwise , no organ shall make determinations or otherwise act in such a way as to alter , nullify , delay or in any other manner interfere with the exercise of a power or the discharge of a responsibility or a function attributed to another organ by this Agreement or the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 除本协定或《经营协议》另有具体规定外，任何机构均不得作出决定或以其他方式采取行动，改变、取消、拖延或以任何其他方式干扰本协定或《经营协议》赋予另一机构的权力行使、责任履行或职能运作。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Subject to paragraph [ b ] of this Article , the Assembly of Parties , the Meeting of Signatories and the Board of Governors shall each take note of and give due and proper consideration to any resolution , recommendation or view made or expressed by another of these organs acting in the exercise of the responsibilities and functions attributed to it by this Agreement or the Operating Agreement .
Translation: [ c ] 在遵守本条[ b ]款的前提下，缔约方大会、签字国会议和董事会均应注意到并适当审议本协定或《运营协定》赋予其职责和职能的另一机构通过或表达的任何决议、建议或意见。

Query_Text_en: Article VII . [ ASSEMBLY OF PARTIES ] [ a ] The Assembly of Parties shall be composed of all the Parties and shall be the principal organ of INTELSAT .
Translation: 第七条　[缔约国大会]　[一]　缔约国大会由全体缔约国组成，是国际通信卫星组织的主要机构。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Assembly of Parties shall give consideration to those aspects of INTELSAT which are primarily of interest to the Parties as sovereign States .
Translation: [ b ] 缔约国大会应审议国际通信卫星组织中主要涉及各缔约国作为主权国家利益的事项。

Query_Text_en: It shall have the power to give consideration to general policy and long-term objectives of INTELSAT consistent with the principles , purposes and scope of activities of INTELSAT , as provided for in this Agreement .
Translation: 根据本协定规定，该机构有权审议符合国际通信卫星组织原则、宗旨及业务范围的总政策与长期目标。

Query_Text_en: In accordance with paragraphs [ b ] and [ c ] of Article VI of this Agreement , the Assembly of Parties shall give due and proper consideration to resolutions , recommendations and views addressed to it by the Meeting of Signatories or the Board of Governors .
Translation: 根据本协定第六条（乙）款和（丙）款之规定，缔约国大会应对签字国会议或董事会向其提交的决议、建议和意见予以充分适当的审议。

Query_Text_en: and [ xiv ] To exercise any other powers coming within the purview of the Assembly of Parties according to the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: [十四] 行使本协定规定范围内缔约方大会所拥有的其他一切权力。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The first ordinary meeting of the Assembly of Parties shall be convened by the Secretary General within one year following the date on which this Agreement enters into force .
Translation: [ d ] 缔约方大会首次常会应由秘书长在本协定生效之日起一年内召开。

Query_Text_en: Ordinary meetings shall thereafter be scheduled to be held every two years .
Translation: 此后，例行会议应每两年召开一次。

Query_Text_en: The Assembly of Parties , however , may decide otherwise from meeting to meeting .
Translation: 但缔约方大会可逐届会议作出不同决定。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] [ i ] In addition to the ordinary meetings provided for in paragraph [ d ] of this Article , the Assembly of Parties may meet in extraordinary meetings , which may be convened either upon request of the Board of Governors acting pursuant to the provisions of Article XIV or XVI of this Agreement , or upon the request of one or more Parties which receives the support of at least one-third of the Parties including the requesting Party or Parties .
Translation: 除本条第[d]款规定之例会外，缔约方大会还可应理事会依照本协定第十四条或第十六条规定采取行动时提出的要求，或经一个或多个缔约方提出且获得至少三分之一缔约方（含请求方）支持后，召开特别会议。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Requests for extraordinary meetings shall state the purpose of the meeting and shall be addressed in writing to the Secretary General or the Director General , who shall arrange for the meeting to be held as soon as possible and in accordance with the rules of procedure of the Assembly of Parties for convening such meetings .
Translation: [二] 特别会议请求须以书面形式提交秘书长或总干事，并阐明会议目的。秘书长或总干事应按照缔约方大会关于召开此类会议的议事规则，尽快安排会议召开。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] A quorum for any meeting of the Assembly of Parties shall consist of representatives of a majority of the Parties .
Translation: 缔约国大会任何会议的法定人数应由过半数缔约国的代表构成。

Query_Text_en: Each Party shall have one vote .
Translation: 各方均享有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: Decisions on matters of substance shall be taken by an affirmative vote cast by at least two-thirds of the Parties whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 实质性事项的决定须经至少三分之二出席并参加表决的缔约方代表投赞成票方可通过。

Query_Text_en: Decisions on procedural matters shall be taken by an affirmative vote cast by a simple majority of the Parties whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 程序性事项的决定应以出席并参加表决的缔约方简单多数赞成票通过。

Query_Text_en: Disputes whether a specific matter is procedural or substantive shall be decided by a vote cast by a simple majority of the Parties whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 对特定事项属于程序性或实质性问题的争议，应由出席会议并参加表决的缔约方以简单多数投票决定。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] The Assembly of Parties shall adopt its own rules of procedure , which shall include provision for the election of a Chairman and other officers .
Translation: 大会应制定其议事规则，其中应包括选举主席及其他官员的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] Each Party shall meet its own costs of representation at a meeting of the Assembly of Parties .
Translation: 各缔约方应自行承担其参加缔约方大会会议的代表费用。

Query_Text_en: Expenses of meetings of the Assembly of Parties shall be regarded as an administrative cost of INTELSAT for the purpose of Article 8 of the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 根据《运营协定》第八条规定，缔约国大会的会议开支应视为国际通信卫星组织的行政费用。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII . [ MEETING OF SIGNATORIES ] [ a ] The Meeting of Signatories shall be composed of all the Signatories .
Translation: 第八条　[签字国会议]　[一]　签字国会议由全体签字国组成。

Query_Text_en: In accordance with paragraphs [ b ] and [ c ] of Article VI of this Agreement , the Meeting of Signatories shall give due and proper consideration to resolutions , recommendations and views addressed to it by the Assembly of Parties or the Board of Governors .
Translation: 根据本协定第六条[b]款和[c]款规定，签字国会议应对缔约方大会或理事会向其提交的决议、建议及意见予以充分且适当的审议。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] To express its views and make recommendations on proposed amendments to this Agreement pursuant to Article XVII of this Agreement and to consider and take decisions , in accordance with Article 22 of the Operating Agreement and taking into account any views and recommendations received from the Assembly of Parties or the Board of Governors , on proposed amendments to the Operating Agreement which are consistent with this Agreement ;
Translation: [二] 根据本协定第十七条对本协定拟议修正案发表意见并提出建议；同时依照《业务协定》第二十二条，在考虑缔约国大会或董事会所提意见和建议的基础上，对符合本协定规定的《业务协定》拟议修正案进行审议并作出决定；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The first ordinary meeting of the Meeting of Signatories shall be convened by the Secretary General at the request of the Board of Governors within nine months after the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 签署方大会第一次常会应由总干事根据理事会请求，在本协定生效后九个月内召开。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter an ordinary meeting shall be held in every calendar year .
Translation: 此后每年应召开一次例行会议。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] [ i ] In addition to the ordinary meetings provided for in paragraph [ c ] of this Article , the Meeting of Signatories may hold extraordinary meetings , which may be convened either upon the request ofthe Board of Governors or upon the request of one or more Signatories which receives the support of at least one-third of the Signatories including the requesting Signatory or Signatories .
Translation: 除本条(c)款规定之例会外，签字国会议还可应理事会请求，或经一个或多个签字国提议且获得至少三分之一签字国（含提议国）支持后，召开特别会议。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Requests for extraordinary meetings shall state the purpose for which the meeting is required and shall be addressed in writing to the Secretary General or the Director General , who shall arrange for the meeting to be held as soon as possible and in accordance with the rules of procedure of the Meeting of Signatories for convening such meetings .
Translation: [ ii ] 特别会议请求须以书面形式提交秘书长或总干事，说明召开会议的目的。秘书长或总干事应按照《签署国会议议事规则》中关于召集此类会议的规定，尽快安排会议召开。

Query_Text_en: The agenda for an extraordinary meeting shall be restricted to the purpose or purposes for which the meeting was convened .
Translation: 特别会议的议程应仅限于召开该会议所针对的一项或多项事项。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] A quorum for any meeting of the Meeting of Signatories shall consist of representatives of a majority of the Signatories .
Translation: 签署国会议任何会议的法定人数应由过半数签署国代表构成。

Query_Text_en: Each Signatory shall have one vote .
Translation: 每一签署方应拥有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: Decisions on matters of substance shall be taken by an affirmative vote cast by at least two-thirds of the Signatories whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 实质性事项的决定须经至少三分之二出席会议并参加表决的签署方代表投赞成票方可通过。

Query_Text_en: Decisions on procedural matters shall be taken by an affirmative vote cast by a simple majority of the Signatories whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 程序性事项的决定应由出席并参加表决的签署方代表以简单多数赞成票通过。

Query_Text_en: Disputes whether a specific matter is procedural or substantive shall be decided by a vote cast by a simple majority of the Signatories whose representatives are present and voting .
Translation: 对特定事项属于程序性或实质性问题的争议，应由在场参加表决的签署方以简单多数投票决定。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The Meeting of Signatories shall adopt its own rules of procedure , which shall include provision for the election of a Chairman and other officers .
Translation: 签署方会议应自行制定议事规则，其中应包括选举主席及其他官员的条款。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] Each Signatory shall meet its own costs of representation at meetings of the Meeting of Signatories .
Translation: 各签署方应自行承担其出席签署方会议的代表费用。

Query_Text_en: Expenses of meetings of the Meeting of Signatories shall be regarded as an administrative cost of INTELSAT for the purpose of Article 8 of the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 根据《运营协定》第八条规定，签字国会议的开支应视为国际通信卫星组织的行政费用。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] One Governor representing any group of at least five Signatories not represented pursuant to subparagraph [ i ] or [ ii ] of this paragraph from any one of the regions defined by the Plenipotentiary Conference of the International Telecommunication Union , held at Montreux in 1965 , regardless of the total investment shares held by the Signatories comprising the group .
Translation: [三] 由1965年蒙特勒国际电信联盟全权代表大会所划定任一区域内、未依本款第[一]项或第[二]项规定获得代表的至少五个签字国组成的集团，可推选一名理事代表该集团，且该集团签字国合计持有的投资份额不影响其推选权。

Query_Text_en: However , the number of Governors under this category shall not exceed two for any region defined by the Union or five for all such regions .
Translation: 但按此类别委任的理事人数，对联盟所划定的任一地区不得超过两名，对所有此类地区总计不得超过五名。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] [ i ] During the period between the entry into force of this Agreement and the first meeting of the Meeting of Signatories , the minimum investment share that will entitle a Signatory or group of Signatories to be represented on the Board of Governors shall be equal to the investment share of the Signatory holding position thirteen in the list of the descending order of size of initial investment shares of all the Signatories .
Translation: [b][i]在本协定生效至签字国会议首次召开期间，任一签字国或签字国集团若要获得理事会代表权，其最低投资份额应等同于全体签字国按初始投资份额由大到小排序中位列第十三位的签字国所持份额。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Subsequent to the period mentioned in subparagraph [ i ] of this paragraph , the Meeting of Signatories shall determine annually the minimum investment share that will entitle a Signatory or group of Signatories to be represented on the Board of Governors .
Translation: [二] 在本款第[一]项所述期限之后，签字国会议应每年确定使某一签字国或签字国集团有权在理事会获得代表权的最低投资额。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the Meeting of Signatories shall be guided by the desirability of the number of Governors being approximately twenty , excluding anyselected pursuant to subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article .
Translation: 为此目的，签署国会议应遵循的原则是：理事人数以二十名左右为宜，但根据本条（a）款（iii）项选任的理事不在此限。

Query_Text_en: [ A ] If the Board of Governors , at the time the determination is made , is composed of twenty , twenty-one or twenty-two Governors , the Meeting of Signatories shall fix a minimum investment share equal to the investment share of the Signatory which , in the list in effect at that time , holds the same position held in the list in effect when the previous determination was made , by the Signatory selected on that occasion , [ B ] If the Board of Governors , at the time the determination is made , is composed of more than twenty-two Governors , the Meeting of Signatories shall fix a minimum investment share equal to the investment share of a Signatory which , in the list in effect at that time , holds a position above the one held in the list in effect when the previous determination was made , by the Signatory selected on that occasion , [ C ] If the Board of Governors , at the time the determination is made , is composed of less than twenty Governors , the Meeting of Signatories shall fix a minimum investment share equal to the investment share of a Signatory which , in the list in effect at that time , holds a position below the one held in the list in effect when the previous determination was made , by the Signatory selected on that occasion .
Translation:
[甲]若确定最低投资额时理事会由二十、二十一或二十二名理事组成，签字国会议应将最低投资额定为：按当时有效名单所列，与上次确定时被选签字国在彼时名单中所占序位相同之签字国的投资份额；  
[乙]若确定最低投资额时理事会由超过二十二名理事组成，签字国会议应将最低投资额定为：按当时有效名单所列，序位高于上次确定时被选签字国在彼时名单中所占序位之某一签字国的投资份额；  
[丙]若确定最低投资额时理事会由不足二十名理事组成，签字国会议应将最低投资额定为：按当时有效名单所列，序位低于上次确定时被选签字国在彼时名单中所占序位之某一签字国的投资份额。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] If , by applying the ranking method set forth in subparagraph [ iii ] [ B ] of this paragraph , the number of Governors would be less than twenty , or , by applying that set forth in subparagraph [ iii ] [ C ] of this paragraph , would be more than twenty-two , the Meeting of Signatories shall determine a minimum investment share that will better ensure that there will be twenty Governors .
Translation: 若依照本款第（三）项（B）目所列排名方法产生的理事人数少于20名，或按第（三）项（C）目方法产生的理事人数超过22名，签字国会议应确定一个最低投资份额，以确保理事人数达到20名。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] For the purpose of the provisions of subparagraphs [ iii ] and [ iv ] of this paragraph , the Governors selected in accordance with subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article shall not be taken into consideration .
Translation: 就本款第[三]项和第[四]项规定而言，依据本条[一]款第[三]项选出的理事不应列入考量范围。

Query_Text_en: [ vi ] For the purpose of the provisions of this paragraph , investment shares determined pursuant to subparagraph [ c ] [ ii ] of Article 6 of the Operating Agreement shall take effect from the first day of the ordinary meeting of the Meeting of Signatories following such determination .
Translation: 根据本款规定，依照《运营协定》第6条第[c]款第[ii]项确定的投资股份，应自签署国会议常会确定之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Whenever a Signatory or group of Signatories fulfills the requirements for representation pursuant to subparagraph [ a ] [ i ] , [ ii ] or [ iii ] of this Article , it shall be entitled to be represented on the Board of Governors .
Translation: 当某一签署方或签署方集团根据本条第[a]款第[i]、[ii]或[iii]项之规定达到代表资格要求时，即有权在理事会中获得代表席位。

Query_Text_en: In the case of any group of Signatories referred to in subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article , such entitlement shall become effective upon receipt by the executive organ of a written request from such group , provided , however , that the number of such groups represented on the Board of Governors has not , at the time of receipt of any such written request , reached the applicable limitations prescribed in subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article .
Translation: 对于本条第[a]款第[iii]项所述任何签约方集团而言，该等权利应于执行机构收到该集团书面请求时生效；但前提是，在收到任何此类书面请求时，理事会中此类集团代表数量尚未达到本条第[a]款第[iii]项规定的适用限额。

Query_Text_en: If at the time of receipt of any such written request representation on the Board of Governors pursuant to subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article has reached the applicable limitations prescribed therein , the group of Signatories may submit its request to the next ordinary meeting of the Meeting of Signatories for a determination pursuant to paragraph [ d ] of this Article .
Translation: 若在收到此类书面请求时，理事会代表权根据本条第[ a ]款第[ iii ]项已达到规定限额，该签字国集团可将其请求提交签字国大会下届常会，以便根据本条第[ d ]款作出决定。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Upon the request of any group or groups of Signatories referred to in subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article , the Meeting of Signatories shall annually determine which of these groups shall be or continue to berepresented on the Board of Governors .
Translation: 根据本条第[ a ]款第[ iii ]项所述任何签署方团体的请求，签署方会议应每年确定这些团体中哪些应成为或继续担任理事会成员。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , if such groups exceed two for any one region defined by the International Telecommunication Union , or five for all such regions , the Meeting ofSignatories shall first select the group which has the highest combined investment share from each such region from which there has been submitted a written request pursuant to paragraph [ c ] of this Article .
Translation: 为此目的，若此类集团在国际电信联盟界定的任一区域内超过两个，或在所有此类区域总计超过五个，签字国会议应首先从依据本条[c]款提交书面请求的各区域中，选出合计投资份额最高的集团。

Query_Text_en: If the number of groups so selected is less than five , the remaining groups which are to be represented shall be selected in decreasing order of the combined investment shares of each group , without exceeding the applicable limitations prescribed in subparagraph [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article .
Translation: 如按上述方式选出的集团不足五个，则剩余应获代表权的集团应按各集团合计投资份额由高至低的顺序选出，但不得超过本条第（a）款第（iii）项规定的限额。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] In order to ensure continuity within the Board of Governors , every Signatory or group of Signatories represented pursuant to subparagraph [ a ] [ i ] , [ ii ] or [ iii ] of this Article shall remain represented , either individually or as part of such group , until the next determination made in accordance with paragraph [ b ] or [ d ] of this Article , regardless of the changes that may occur in its or their investment shares as the result of any adjustment of investment shares .
Translation: 为确保理事会工作的连续性，凡根据本条第（a）款第（一）、（二）或（三）项规定获得代表权的任一签署方或签署方集团，无论其投资份额因任何调整而发生何种变化，均应继续保有单独或作为集团成员的代表权，直至依照本条第（b）款或第（d）款规定作出下一轮代表权确认为止。

Query_Text_en: However , representation as part of a group constituted pursuant to subparagraph [ a ] [ ii ] or [ iii ] of this Article shall cease if the withdrawal from the group of one or more Signatories would make the group ineligible to be represented on the Board of Governors pursuant to this Article .
Translation: 然而，若根据本条（a）款（ii）项或（iii）项组成的集团中有一个或多个签署方退出，导致该集团不再具备按本条规定的理事会上代表资格，则该集团的代表权即告终止。

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] Domestic public telecommunications services between areas which are not linked by any terrestrial wide-band facilities and which are separated by natural barriers of such an exceptional nature that they impede the viable establishment of terrestrial wide-band facilities between such areas , provided that the Meeting of Signatories has given in advance the appropriate approval required by subparagraph [ b ] [ ii ] of Article III of this Agreement .
Translation: 以及[三]在以下地区之间提供的国内公众电信服务：这些地区之间未通过任何地面宽带设施连接，且被具有特殊性质的自然障碍所分隔，以致在这些地区之间无法建立可行的地面宽带设施，但须事先获得本协定第三条第二款第二项所规定的签署方会议的必要批准。

Query_Text_en: and [ iv ] No Governor may cast more than forty per cent of the total voting participation of all Signatories and groups of Signatories represented on the Board of Governors .
Translation: [四]任何理事或理事集团在理事会中的投票参与权不得超过全体签约方投票参与权总数的百分之四十。

Query_Text_en: To the extent that the voting participation of any Governor exceeds forty per cent of such total voting participation , the excess shall be distributed equally to the other Governors on the Board of Governors .
Translation: 若某位理事的投票权占比超过上述总投票权的40%，超出部分应在理事会其他理事中平均分配。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] For the purposes of composition of the Board of Governors and calculation of the voting participation of Governors , the investment shares determined pursuant to subparagraph [ c ] [ ii ] of Article 6 of the Operating Agreement shall take effect from the first day of the ordinary meeting of the Meeting of Signatories following such determination .
Translation: 就理事会组成及理事表决权比例计算而言，根据《业务协定》第6条第[c]款第[ii]项确定的投资股份，应自确定后的签字国会议常会首日起生效。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Governors shall consist of either a majority of the Board of Governors , which majority shall have at least two-thirds of the total voting participation of all Signatories and groups of Signatories represented on the Board of Governors , or else the total number constituting the Board of Governors minus three , regardless of the amount of voting participation they represent .
Translation: [ i ] 理事会会议法定人数应为以下两者之一：要么是理事会过半数成员，且该过半数成员须持有理事会全体签约方及签约方集团代表总表决权的至少三分之二；要么是理事会全体成员数减三，不论其所代表表决权多少。

Query_Text_en: [ j ] The Board of Governors shall endeavor to take decisions unanimously .
Translation: 董事会应努力以协商一致方式作出决定。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] On all substantive questions , either by an affirmative vote cast by at least four Governors having at least two-thirds of the total voting participation of all Signatories and groups of Signatories represented on the Board of Governors taking into account the distribution of the excess referred to in subparagraph [ g ] [ iv ] of this Article , or else by an affirmative vote cast by at least the total number constituting the Board of Governors minus three , regardless of the amount of voting participation they represent ;
Translation: [ i ] 所有实质性问题的表决，须满足以下任一条件方为通过：一是获得至少四位理事的赞成票，且这些理事所代表的全体签约方及签约方集团投票权占比不低于三分之二（同时须考虑本条[g][iv]项所述超额部分的分配情况）；二是获得理事会全体理事数减三的赞成票数（此时可不考虑其所代表的投票权比例）。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] On all procedural questions , by an affirmative vote representing a simple majority of Governors present and voting , each having one vote .
Translation: [二]所有程序性问题均需经出席并参加表决的理事以简单多数票赞成通过，每位理事享有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ k ] Disputes whether a specific question is procedural or substantive shall be decided by the Chairman of the Board of Governors .
Translation: [ k ] 某一具体问题属于程序性还是实质性争议，应由理事会主席裁定。

Query_Text_en: The decision of the Chairman may be overruled by a two-thirds majority of the Governors present and voting , each having one vote .
Translation: 主席的决定可被出席并参与表决的理事以三分之二多数票否决，每位理事享有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ l ] The Board of Governors , if it deems appropriate , may create advisory committees to assist it in the performance of its responsibilities .
Translation: 董事会如认为适当，可设立咨询委员会以协助其履行职责。

Query_Text_en: [ m ] The Board of Governors shall adopt its own rules of procedure , which shall include the method of election of a Chairman and such other officers as may be required .
Translation: 理事会应制定其议事规则，其中应包括选举主席及其他必要官员的方式。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph [ j ] of this Article , such rules may provide for any method of voting in the election of officers which the Board of Governors deems appropriate .
Translation: 尽管有本条[ j ]款之规定，董事会仍可酌情采用其认为适当的任何选举方式推选官员。

Query_Text_en: [ n ] The first meeting of the Board of Governors shall be convened in accordance with paragraph 2 of the Annex to the Operating Agreement .
Translation: 董事会首次会议应依照《业务协定》附件第2款规定召开。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors shall meet as often as is necessary but at least four times a year .
Translation: 理事会应视需要召开会议，但每年至少举行四次会议。

Query_Text_en: FUNCTIONS ] [ a ] The Board of Governors shall have the responsibility for the design , development , construction , establishment , operation and maintenance of the INTELSAT space segment and , pursuant to this Agreement , the Operating Agreement and such determinations that in this respect may have been made by the Assembly of Parties pursuant to Article VII of this Agreement , for carrying out any other activities which are undertaken by INTELSAT .
Translation: 职能] [a] 董事会应负责设计、研制、建造、建立、运营和维护国际通信卫星组织空间段，并根据本协定、《业务协定》以及缔约国大会根据本协定第七条可能就此作出的决定，开展国际通信卫星组织承担的任何其他活动。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] Include in its reports to the Assembly of Parties and to the Meeting of Signatories information on actions or decisions taken with respect to such resolutions , recommendations and views , and its reasons for such actions or decisions .
Translation: 并在向缔约国大会和签字国会议提交的报告中，说明针对此类决议、建议和意见所采取的行动或作出的决定，并阐明相关行动或决定的理由。

Query_Text_en: Article XI . [ DIRECTOR GENERAL ] [ a ] The executive organ shall be headed by the Director General and shall have its organizational structure implemented not later than six years after the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 第十一条　[总干事]　执行机构由总干事领导，其组织结构应在本协定生效后六年内落实到位。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] [ i ] The Director General shall be the chief executive and the legal representative of INTELSAT and shall be directly responsible to the Board of Governors for the performance of all management functions .
Translation: 总干事应为国际通信卫星组织的行政首长和法定代表，直接向理事会负责履行所有管理职能。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The Director General shall act in accordance with the policies and directives of the Board of Governors .
Translation: [ii] 总干事应依照理事会的政策方针和指示行事。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] The Director General shall be appointed by the Board of Governors , subject to confirmation by the Assembly of Parties .
Translation: [ iii ] 总干事应由理事会任命，并经缔约方大会批准后生效。

Query_Text_en: The Director General may be removed from office for cause by the Board of Governors on its own authority .
Translation: 总干事可由理事会依职权因故免职。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] The paramount consideration in the appointment of the Director General and in the selection of other personnel of the executive organ shall be the necessity of ensuring the highest standards of integrity , competency and efficiency .
Translation: [四] 在任命总干事及遴选执行机关其他工作人员时，首要考虑因素必须是确保其具备最高标准的诚信、才干与效率。

Query_Text_en: The Director General and the personnel of the executive organ shall refrain from any action incompatible with their responsibilities to INTELSAT .
Translation: 总干事及执行机构工作人员不得采取任何违背其对国际通信卫星组织所负职责的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] [ i ] The permanent management arrangements shall be consistent with the basic aims and purposes of INTELSAT , its international character and its obligation to provide on a commercial basis telecommunications facilities of high quality and reliability .
Translation: 常设管理机构安排应符合国际通信卫星组织的基本宗旨和目标，保持其国际性质，并履行以商业化方式提供高质量、高可靠性电信设施的职责。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The Director General , on behalf of INTELSAT , shall contract out , to one or more competent entities , technical and operational functions to the maximum extent practicable with due regard to cost and consistent with competence , effectiveness and efficiency .
Translation: [ ii ] 总干事应代表国际通信卫星组织，在充分考虑成本效益并确保能力、效能与效率的前提下，最大限度地将技术及运营职能外包给一家或多家合格实体。

Query_Text_en: and in the case of the Republic of Zambia , the Minister of Communications and Transport or any person or agency authorized to perform the functions presently exercised by the Minister ;
Translation: 就赞比亚共和国而言，指通信和交通部长或任何获授权行使该部长现行职能的个人或机构；

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] the term `` Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December , 1944 , and includes any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention , and any amendment of the Annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 , insofar as such Annexes and amendments have become effective for both Parties ;
Translation: “公约”系指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第九十条通过的附件，以及根据第九十条和第九十四条对附件或公约的修正案，但以该等附件和修正案已对双方生效为限；

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] the term `` Agreement '' means this Agreement , its Annexes and any amendments to this Agreement and\/or its Annex made in accordance with Article 18 of this Agreement ;
Translation: [3]"本协议"一词系指本协议及其附件，以及根据本协议第18条规定对本协议和/或其附件所作的任何修订；

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] the term `` airline '' means any air transport enterprise offering or operating international air services ;
Translation: [4]“航空公司”指提供或经营国际航空运输业务的任何航空运输企业；

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] the term `` designated airline '' means an airline which has been designated and authorized in accordance with Article 3 of this Agreement ;
Translation: [ 5 ] "指定航空公司"指根据本协定第三条指定并获授权的航空公司；

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] the term `` air service '' means any scheduled air service performed by aircraft for the public transportation of passengers , baggage , cargo or mail ;
Translation: “航空服务”指由航空器为公众运输旅客、行李、货物或邮件而实施的定期航班服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] the term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one State ;
Translation: [7]“国际航空服务”指飞越一个以上国家领土上空空间的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] the term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo or mail ;
Translation: "非交通目的经停"指除上下旅客、装卸行李、货物或邮件以外的任何目的着陆。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] in relation to an aircraft , the payload of that aircraft available on a route or section of a route .
Translation: [甲]就航空器而言，指该航空器在某航线或某航段上可搭载的有效载荷。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in relation to an air service , the capacity of the aircraft used on such service multiplied by the frequency operated by such aircraft over a given period on a route or section of a route ;
Translation: [b] 就航空运输服务而言，指特定航线上或航段内，某机型在该航线运营的航班频次与单机运载量之乘积。

Query_Text_en: [ 10 ] the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary service , but excluding prices and conditions for the carriage of mail ;
Translation: [10]“运价”指旅客、行李和货物运输应支付的价格及其适用条件，包括代理及其他辅助服务的价格与条件，但不含邮件运输的价格与条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 11 ] the term `` Route Schedule '' means the Route Schedule annexed to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with the provisions of Article 18 of this Agreement .
Translation: [11]“航线表”一词指本协议所附的航线表，或根据本协议第18条规定修订的航线表。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement to enable the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services on the route specified in the Route Schedule [ hereinafter called the `` agreed services '' and `` the specified route '' respectively ] .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约一方给予缔约另一方本协定规定的权利，以使缔约另一方指定航空公司得以建立和经营航线表中所列航线的国际航班（以下分别称为"协议航班"和"规定航线"）。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] to make stops at the point [ s ] on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on board and discharging international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating in or destined for the first Contracting Party .
Translation: （c）在缔约另一方领土内指定航线上的地点作技术性经停，以便上下来自或前往缔约一方的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The rights of the designated airline of one Contracting Party to take on board and discharge at point [ s ] in the territory of the other Contracting Party international traffic to or from a third country shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内地点上下前往或来自第三国的国际运输业务的权利，应由双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party an airline or airlines to operate the agreed services on the specified route , and to withdraw or alter such designations .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约任何一方有权以书面形式向缔约另一方指定一家或多家空运企业，在规定的航线上经营协议航班，并有权撤销或更改上述指定。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline designated by the first Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfil the conditions and the obligations prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by them to the operation of international air services by the said authorities .
Translation: 另一方缔约国的航空当局可要求第一方缔约国指定的航空公司证明其具备资质，能够履行该当局通常且合理适用于国际航空运输服务的法律法规所规定的条件与义务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Unless immediate revocation , suspension of rights or imposition of the conditions mentioned in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws and regulations by the said designated airline [ s ] , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: [ 2 ] 除非立即撤销、暂停权利或实施本条第一款所述条件对防止该指定航空公司进一步违反法律法规确属必要，否则此类权利的行使须经与缔约另一方协商后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in the international operation shall be applicable to the aircraft of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party , while entering , within , and departing from the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方关于从事国际运营的航空器入境、停留和离境的法律法规，应适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器在进入、停留于和离开缔约一方领土时。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in or departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail , such as laws and regulations relating to entry , clearance , immigration , passports , customs and quarantine , shall be applicable to the passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail carried by the aircraft of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party while entering , staying in and departing from the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: [ 2 ] 缔约一方关于旅客、机组、行李、货物或邮件出入、停留或离开其领土的法律法规，如涉及入境、通关、移民、护照、海关及检疫等事项的规定，应适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司所载运的旅客、机组、行李、货物或邮件在进入、停留及离开该缔约一方领土时。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Passengers , baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit and not leaving the areas of the airport reserved for such purpose shall be subject to no more than a simplified control .
Translation: [ 3 ] 直接过境且不离开机场指定区域的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，仅需接受简化检查。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] There shall be fair and equal opportunity for the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties to operate the agreed services on the specified route .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司经营规定航线的协议航班时，应享有公平与平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In operating the agreed services the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services the latter provides on the whole or part of the same routes .
Translation: 在经营协议航班时，缔约各方指定航空公司应顾及另一方缔约方指定航空公司的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在全部或部分相同航线上提供的航班服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The agreed services provided by the designated airline [ s ] of the Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the requirements of the public for transportation on the specified routes and shall have as their primary objective the provision at a reasonable load factor of capacity adequate to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , cargo and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司提供的协议航班服务，应与规定航线的公众运输需求密切关联，并以合理载运率为首要目标，提供充足运力以满足缔约双方领土间当前及合理预期的旅客、货物和邮件运输需求。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Matters relating to sales agency and ground handling for the operation of the agreed services shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: [ 2 ] 关于协议航班运营的销售代理及地面服务事宜，应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并经两缔约方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party may , according to traffic requirements , apply for operation of extra flight on the specified route .
Translation: 缔约任何一方指定航空公司均可根据运输需求，申请在协议航线上经营加班飞行。

Query_Text_en: The application for such flight shall be submitted at least three days before its proposed operation to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , and the flight can be operated only after approval has been obtained from such authorities .
Translation: 此类飞行申请应于计划执行前至少三天提交缔约另一方航空主管部门，且须获得该部门批准后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The tariffs referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , in consultation when necessary and possible with other airlines operating over the same route or section .
Translation: 本条第一款所述运价应由缔约双方指定航空公司在必要时并尽可能与其他经营同一航线或航段的航空公司协商后共同议定。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties can not agree on any of these tariffs , the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall determine the tariffs through consultation .
Translation: 如缔约各方指定航空公司未能就上述任何运价达成一致，应由缔约双方航空当局通过协商予以确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the aeronautical authorities can not agree on the approval of any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article 19 of this Agreement .
Translation: [4]如航空当局未能就本条第二款提交的任何运价批准事宜或第三款规定的运价确定事宜达成一致，应将该事项提交缔约双方，依照本协定第十九条规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall designate regular airport [ s ] and alternate airport [ s ] in its territory to be used by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services , and shall provide that airline [ s ] with such communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary facilities and services as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约各方应在本国领土内指定供对方缔约方指定航空公司经营协议航班使用的常规机场和备降机场，并向该航空公司提供经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助设施与服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports [ including the technical equipment and other facilities and services ] , communications and navigational facilities and other auxiliary services of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司使用对方缔约方机场（包括技术设备及其他设施服务）、通信导航设施及其他辅助服务时，其收费标准应遵照对方缔约方主管当局制定的公平合理费率执行。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those applicable to any airline of other States engaged in international air services for the use of similar equipment , facilities and services .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于其他任何国家经营国际航空运输业务的航空公司使用同类设备、设施及服务所适用的费率标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of one Contracting Party , as well as their regular equipment , spare parts [ including engines ] , fuels , oil [ including hydraulic fluids , lubricants ] and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on arriving in the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约一方指定航空公司在国际航班上使用的航空器及其正常设备、零部件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑油）以及机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在进入缔约另一方领土时，应基于互惠原则免除所有关税、税款、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，但上述设备和物品须在航空器上保留至重新运输出境为止。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] spare parts [ including engines ] introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft engaged in operation of international services .
Translation: [ b ] 由另一缔约方指定航空公司带入该缔约方领土的零部件（包括发动机），用于维护或修理从事国际航班运营的航空器。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Printed ticket stock , air waybills and publicity materials introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司带入缔约另一方领土的印刷票证、航空货运单及宣传材料，在互惠基础上应免除一切关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the approval of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本条第[1]款和第[2]款所述设备及物品，经缔约另一方海关当局批准后，可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。

Query_Text_en: Such equipment and items shall be kept under the supervision or control of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party up to such time as they are re-exported , or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the Customs regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类设备及物品应在另一缔约方海关当局监管或控制下保存，直至其复运出口或根据该缔约方海关法规以其他方式处置完毕。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The exemption provided for in paragraph [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall also be available where a designated airline of one Contracting Party has contracted with another airline , which similarly enjoys such exemptions in the territory of the other Contracting Party , for the loan or transfer in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the equipment and items specified in paragraph [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article .
Translation: 本条第一、二款规定的豁免待遇，亦适用于缔约一方指定航空公司与另一家同样在缔约另一方领土内享有此类豁免的航空公司签订协议，在缔约另一方领土内借贷或转让本条第一、二款所列设备及物品的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all the customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on the basis of reciprocity with the exception of the charges corresponding to the services provided .
Translation: [ 6 ] 基于互惠原则，过境行李、货物及邮件应免除一切关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用，但对应所提供服务的费用除外。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The revenues and profit realized by the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party in connection with operation of the agreed services shall be exempt from all taxes .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内经营协议航班所获收入及利润，应免除一切税收。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The property of the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on the basis of reciprocity .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内的财产，应基于互惠原则免除一切税收。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Wages , salaries and other similar remuneration received by the employees of the representation of the designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party , who are nationals of the first Contracting Party , shall be exempt from all taxes on the basis of reciprocity by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司的代表机构所雇用的、具有该缔约一方国籍的雇员，其工资、薪金及其他类似报酬，基于互惠原则，应由缔约另一方免除一切税收。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] For the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have the right , on reciprocal basis , to set up representation at the point [ s ] of call on the specified route within the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: [ 1 ] 为经营指定航线上的协议航班，各缔约方指定航空公司有权在对等基础上，在另一缔约方领土内的指定航线经停地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The staff members of the representation of the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party ; the number of such staff shall be determined between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司在对方领土内的常驻机构工作人员应为任一缔约方国民；其人员数量由双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Such staff shall be subject to the laws and regulations in force of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类工作人员须遵守缔约另一方的现行法律法规。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The crew members of the designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party on the agreed services shall be nationals of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司在协议航班上的机组人员应为该缔约方国籍。

Query_Text_en: If a designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party desires to employ crew members of any other nationality on the agreed services , prior approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 如缔约任何一方指定航空公司拟在协议航班上雇佣其他国籍机组人员，须事先获得缔约另一方批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Certificates of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licences issued or rendered valid by either of the Contracting Parties shall , during the period of their validity , be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party , provided that the requirements under which such certificates or licences were issued or rendered valid are equal to or above the minimum standards which are established pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: [ 1 ] 缔约一方颁发或核准的适航证、合格证及执照，在其有效期内，缔约另一方应予承认有效。但颁发或核准此类证照的标准，须等同或高于根据《公约》制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party reserves the right , however , to refuse to recognize as valid , for the purpose of flights over its own territory , certificates of competency and licences granted to or rendered valid for its own nationals by the other Contracting Party or by any other State .
Translation: [ 2 ] 然而，各缔约方保留如下权利：对于为飞越本国领土之目的而向他方缔约方或任何其他国家国民颁发或确认有效的适航证书及执照，可拒绝承认其效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have on the reciprocal basis the right to remit to the Contracting Party designating the airline its revenue received in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司有权在对等基础上，将其在另一缔约方领土内获得的收入汇至指定该航空公司的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the conversion and remittance of the revenue received in its territory by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party , and assist the said airline [ s ] in attending to the relevant formalities .
Translation: 三、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业在其境内获得的收入提供兑换和汇出便利，并协助该空运企业办理相关手续。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Consistent with their rights and obligations under international law , the Parties reaffirm that their obligation to each other to protect the security of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference forms an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: [ 1 ] 根据国际法规定的权利和义务，缔约双方重申，相互保护民用航空安全免遭非法干扰的义务是本协定不可分割的组成部分。
