Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In the event that one or more Member States of such an organization is also Party to this Convention , the organization and such Member State or States shall decide on their responsibility for the performance of their obligations under this Convention . Such distribution of responsibility shall take effect following completion of the notification procedure described in subparagraph [ c ] . The organization and the Member States shall not be entitled to exercise rights under this Convention concurrently .
Translation: [2]若该组织的一个或多个成员国亦为本公约之缔约国，则该组织及其相关成员国应共同确定履行本公约义务之责任分配。此项责任分配需在完成[c]项所述通知程序后生效。该组织与成员国不得同时并行行使本公约赋予之权利。

Query_Text_en: In addition , regional economic integration organizations , in matters within their competence , shall exercise their rights to vote with a number of votes equal to the number of their Member States that are Parties to this Convention .
Translation: 此外，区域经济一体化组织在其职权范围内的事项上，应以等同于其作为本公约缔约方的成员国数量的票数行使表决权。

Query_Text_en: Such an organization shall not exercise its right to vote if any of its Member States exercises its right , and vice-versa ;
Translation: 若该组织任一成员国行使表决权，则该组织不得行使表决权，反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: B. in the event of any later modification of their respective responsibilities , the regional economic integration organization shall inform the depositary of any such proposed modification of their respective responsibilities ; the depositary shall in turn inform the Parties of such modification ;
Translation: B. 若区域经济一体化组织各自职责后续发生任何修改，该组织应将其职责拟议修改事项通知保存人；保存人应随即向各缔约方通报此类修改。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Member States of a regional economic integration organization which become Parties to this Convention shall be presumed to retain competence over all matters in respect of which transfers of competence to the organization have not been specifically declared or informed to the depositary ;
Translation: [4] 作为区域经济一体化组织成员国的本公约缔约方，若未向保存人特别声明或通报已将相关权限移交该组织，则推定其仍保留所有事项的管辖权限。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] `` Regional economic integration organization '' means an organization constituted by sovereign States , members of the United Nations or of any of its specialized agencies , to which those States have transferred competence in respect of matters governed by this Convention and which has been duly authorized , in accordance with its internal procedures , to become a Party to it .
Translation: [5]“区域经济一体化组织”指由联合国或其任何专门机构成员国的主权国家组成的组织，这些国家已将在本公约管辖事项上的权限移交该组织，且该组织已根据其内部程序正式获准成为本公约缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 加入书应提交联合国教科文组织总干事保存。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 C Point of contactUpon becoming Parties to this Convention , each Party shall designate a point of contact as referred to in Article 9 .
Translation:
第二十八条 第三款 联络点  
各缔约方在成为本公约缔约方时，应按照第九条规定指定一名联络点。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , but only with respect to those States or regional economic integration organizations that have deposited their respective instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval , or accession on or before that date .
Translation: 1. 本公约应自第三十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起三个月后生效，但仅对在该日或该日之前交存各自批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的国家或区域经济一体化组织具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: It shall enter into force with respect to any other Party three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 本公约自任何其他缔约方交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起三个月后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purposes of this Article , any instrument deposited by a regional economic integration organization shall not be counted as additional to those deposited by Member States of the organization .
Translation: 就本条而言，区域经济一体化组织交存的任何文书不应视为其成员国所交存文书的额外文件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . with regard to the provisions of the Convention , the implementation of which comes under the jurisdiction of individual constituent units such as States , counties , provinces , or cantons which are not obliged by the constitutional system of the federation to take legislative measures , the federal government shall inform , as necessary , the competent authorities of constituent units such ? as States , counties , provinces or cantons of the said provisions , with its recommendation for their adoption .
Translation: 2. 对于《公约》中属于各组成单位（如州、县、省或邦）管辖范围、且联邦宪法体制并未强制要求其采取立法措施的条款，联邦政府应视情况将相关条款通报这些州、县、省或邦的主管当局，并建议其予以采纳。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any Party to this Convention may denounce this Convention .
Translation: 1. 本公约任何缔约方均可退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The denunciation shall be notified by an instrument in writing deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 2. 退出应以书面文书形式通知，并递交联合国教科文组织总干事备案。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The denunciation shall take effect 12 months after the receipt of the instrument of denunciation .
Translation: 3. 退出声明应于收到退出文书12个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall in no way affect the financial obligations of the Party denouncing the Convention until the date on which the withdrawal takes effect .
Translation: 退出行为绝不影响该缔约方在退出生效之日前所承担的财政义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 C Depositary functionsThe Director-General of UNESCO , as the depositary of this Convention , shall inform the Member States of the Organization , the States not members of the Organization and regional economic integration organizations referred to in Article 27 , as well as the United Nations , of the deposit of all the instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession provided for in Articles 26 and 27 , and of the denunciations provided for in Article 31 .
Translation:
第三十二条丙款 保存人职能  
联合国教科文组织总干事作为本公约保存人，应将第二十六条和第二十七条所述的所有批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的交存情况，以及第三十一条规定的退出通知，通报本组织成员国、第二十七条提及的非成员国和区域经济一体化组织以及联合国。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A Party to this Convention may , by written communication addressed to the Director-General , propose amendments to this Convention .
Translation: 1. 本公约任何缔约方均可通过向总干事提交书面文书的方式，提出对本公约的修正案。

Query_Text_en: The Director-General shall circulate such communication to all Parties .
Translation: 总干事应将此类来文分送所有缔约方。

Query_Text_en: If , within six months from the date of dispatch of the communication , no less than one half of the Parties reply favourably to the request , the Director-General shall present such proposal to the next session of the Conference of Parties for discussion and possible adoption .
Translation: 若自函件发出之日起六个月内，不少于半数缔约方对该请求作出积极回应，总干事应将此项提案提交缔约方大会下届会议审议，以供讨论并可能通过。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of Parties present and voting .
Translation: 修正案应以出席并参加表决的缔约方三分之二多数通过。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Once adopted , amendments to this Convention shall be submitted to the Parties for ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 3. 本公约修正案一经通过，应提交各缔约方批准、接受、核准或加入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . For Parties which have ratified , accepted , approved or acceded to them , amendments to this Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the instruments referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article by two-thirds of the Parties .
Translation: 对于已批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的缔约方，公约修正案应自本条第3款所述文书经三分之二缔约方交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , for each Party that ratifies , accepts , approves or accedes to an amendment , the said amendment shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit by that Party of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 此后，对于批准、接受、核准或加入该修正案的每一缔约方，该修正案应于该缔约方交存其批准、接受、核准或加入文书之日后三个月生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The procedure set out in paragraphs 3 and 4 shall not apply to amendments to Article 23 concerning the number of Members of the Intergovernmental Committee .
Translation: 第五款 第三段和第四段所述程序不适用于对政府间委员会成员人数相关第二十三条的修订。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] a Party to the unamended Convention in relation to any Party not bound by the amendments .
Translation: 对于不受修正案约束的任何缔约方而言，该缔约方在未经修正的公约框架下仍为缔约一方。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 C Authoritative textsThis Convention has been drawn up in Arabic , Chinese , English , French , Russian and Spanish , all six texts being equally authoritative .
Translation:
第三十四条 作准文本  
本公约以阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文拟定，六种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 C RegistrationIn conformity with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations , this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation:
第三十五条丙 登记  
根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条规定，本公约应联合国教科文组织总干事之请求，在联合国秘书处登记备案。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 C Conciliation CommissionA Conciliation Commission shall be created upon the request of one of the Parties to the dispute .
Translation:
第一条 调解委员会  
争端当事国一方提出请求时，应设立调解委员会。

Query_Text_en: The Commission shall , unless the Parties otherwise agree , be composed of five members , two appointed by each Party concerned and a President chosen jointly by those members .
Translation: 除非当事方另有约定，委员会应由五名成员组成，其中当事方各委派两名，并由这些成员共同推选一名主席。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 C Members of the CommissionIn disputes between more than two Parties , Parties in the same interest shall appoint their members of the Commission jointly by agreement .
Translation:
第二条 C款 委员会成员  
在两个以上缔约方之间的争端中，具有共同利益的缔约方应通过协商一致方式联合委派其委员会成员。

Query_Text_en: Where two or more Parties have separate interests or there is a disagreement as to whether they are of the same interest , they shall appoint their members separately .
Translation: 两个或两个以上当事人有各自利益或对是否具有共同利益存在分歧的，应当分别推选代表人。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 C AppointmentsIf any appointments by the Parties are not made within two months of the date of the request to create a Conciliation Commission , the Director-General of UNESCO shall , if asked to do so by the Party that made the request , make those appointments within a further two-month period .
Translation:
第三条 调解委员会成员的任命  

若当事方在收到设立调解委员会的请求后两个月内未能完成成员任命，提出请求的一方有权提请联合国教科文组织总干事在随后两个月内完成相关任命。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 C President of the CommissionIf a President of the Conciliation Commission has not been chosen within two months of the last of the members of the Commission being appointed , the Director-General of UNESCO shall , if asked to do so by a Party , designate a President within a further two-month period .
Translation:
第四条第三款 调解委员会主席  
若调解委员会全体成员任命完成后的两个月内未能选出主席，应任一缔约方请求，联合国教科文组织总干事应在随后两个月内指定一名主席。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 C DecisionsThe Conciliation Commission shall take its decisions by majority vote of its members .
Translation:
第五条 调解委员会的决定  
调解委员会应以成员多数票通过方式作出决定。

Query_Text_en: It shall , unless the Parties to the dispute otherwise agree , determine its own procedure .
Translation: 除非争端各方另有协议，否则仲裁庭应自行确定其程序规则。

Query_Text_en: It shall render a proposal for resolution of the dispute , which the Parties shall consider in good faith .
Translation: 应提出争议解决建议，各方须本着诚信原则予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 C DisagreementA disagreement as to whether the Conciliation Commission has competence shall be decided by the Commission .
Translation:
第六条 C款 关于委员会权限的争议  
对于调解委员会是否具有管辖权的争议，应由该委员会作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works Paris Act of July 24,1971 , as amended on September 28,1979 of September 9,1886 , completed at PARIS on May 4,1896 , revised at BERLIN on November 13,1908 , completed at BERNE on March 20,1914 , revised at ROME on June 2,1928 , at BRUSSELS on June 26,1948 , at STOCKHOLM on July 14,1967 , and at PARIS on July 24,1971 , and amended on September 28,1979 The countries of the Union , being equally animated by the desire to protect , in as effective and uniform a manner as possible , the fights of authors in their literary and artistic works , recognizing the importance of the work of the Revision Conference held at Stockholm in 1967 , Have resolved to revise the Act adopted by the Stockholm Conference , while maintaining without change Articles 1 to 20 and 22 to 26 of that Act Consequently , the undersigned Plenipotentiaries , having presented their full powers , recognized as in good and due form , have agreed as follows :
Translation:
《保护文学和艺术作品伯尔尼公约》1971年7月24日巴黎文本（经1979年9月28日修订）  
本公约最初于1886年9月9日缔结，1896年5月4日在巴黎补充完备，1908年11月13日在柏林修订，1914年3月20日在伯尔尼补充完备，1928年6月2日在罗马修订，1948年6月26日在布鲁塞尔修订，1967年7月14日在斯德哥尔摩修订，1971年7月24日在巴黎修订，并于1979年9月28日通过修正案。  

本联盟各国出于以尽可能有效且统一的方式保护作者对其文学和艺术作品所享权利的共同愿望，认识到1967年斯德哥尔摩修订会议工作成果的重要意义，决定在保持该会议通过的文本第一条至第二十条及第二十二条至第二十六条不作变动的前提下，对斯德哥尔摩文本进行修订。  

为此，下列全权代表在交验全权证书并确认无误后，达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Article 1 The countries to which this Convention applies constitute a Union for the protection of the fights of authors in their literary and artistic works
Translation: 第一条 适用本公约的国家组成联盟，以保护作者对其文学和艺术作品所享之权利。

Query_Text_en: illustrations , maps , plans , sketches and three dimensional works relative to geography , topography , architecture or science
Translation: 与地理、地形、建筑或科学相关的图示、地图、平面图、草图及立体作品

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall , however , be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to prescribe that works in general or any specified categories of works shall not be protected unless they have been fixed in some material form
Translation: 然而，联盟各国可立法规定：一般作品或特定类别作品须以某种物质形式固定，否则不予保护。

Query_Text_en: 3 Translations , adaptations , arrangements of music and other alterations of a literary or artistic work shall be protected as original works without prejudice to the copyright in the original work
Translation: 对音乐作品的翻译、改编、编曲及其他文学或艺术作品的改动，应作为原创作品受到保护，且不影响原作品的著作权。

Query_Text_en: 4 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the protection to be granted to official texts of a legislative , administrative and legal nature , and to official translations of such texts
Translation: 联盟各国应通过立法确定对立法、行政及司法性质的官方文本及其正式译本所提供的保护。

Query_Text_en: 5 Collections of literary or artistic works such as encyclopaedias and anthologies which , by reason of the selection and arrangement of their contents , constitute intellectual creations shall be protected as such , without prejudice to the copyright in each of the works forming part of such collections
Translation: 因其内容选择与编排构成智力创作的文学或艺术作品合集，如百科全书和选集，应作为独立作品受到保护，且该保护不影响构成该合集的各作品本身的著作权。

Query_Text_en: 6 The works mentioned in this Article shall enjoy protection in all countries of the Union This protection shall operate for the benefit of the author and his successors in rifle
Translation: 本条款所述作品应在联盟所有成员国受到保护。此项保护应有利于作者及其权利继承人。

Query_Text_en: 7 Subject to the provisions of Article 7 4 of this Convention , it shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the extent of the application of their laws to works of applied art and industrial designs and models , as well as the conditions under which such works , designs and models shall be protected Works protected in the country of origin solely as designs and models shall be entitled in another country of the Union only to such special protection as is granted in that country to designs and models ;
Translation: 根据本公约第七条第4款之规定，联盟各成员国应通过国内立法确定其法律对实用艺术品、工业品外观设计和模型的适用范围，以及此类作品、设计和模型受保护的条件。在起源国仅作为外观设计和模型受保护的作品，在联盟其他成员国只能享受该国对设计和模型提供的特别保护。

Query_Text_en: however , if no such special protection is granted in that country , such works shall be protected as artistic works
Translation: 然而，若该国未对此类作品提供特殊保护，则应将其作为艺术作品予以保护。

Query_Text_en: 8 The protection of this Convention shall not apply to news of the day or to miscellaneous facts having the character of mere items of press information
Translation: 本公约之保护不适用于每日新闻或仅属报刊消息性质的杂项事实。

Query_Text_en: 1 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to exclude , wholly or in part , from the protection provided by the preceding Article political speeches and speeches delivered in the course of legal proceedings
Translation: 联盟各成员国可通过立法，全部或部分排除对前条所述政治演说及诉讼过程中发表言论的法律保护。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall also be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the conditions under which lectures , addresses and other works of the same nature which are delivered in public may be reproduced by the press , broadcast , communicated to the public by wire and made the subject of public communication as envisaged in Article 11bis 1 of this Convention , when such use is justified by the informatory purpose
Translation: 联盟各国立法还应规定，在何种条件下，为报道目的合理使用时，可通过报刊转载、广播、有线传播或本公约第十一条之二第一款规定的公开传播方式，复制公开宣讲的讲演、演说及其他同类性质作品。

Query_Text_en: 3 Nevertheless , the author shall enjoy the exclusive right of making a collection of his works mentioned in the preceding paragraphs
Translation: 然而，作者仍享有将其前款所述作品汇编成集的专有权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 Authors who are not nationals of one of the countries of the Union but who have their habitual residence in one of them shall , for the purposes of this Convention , be assimilated to nationals of that country
Translation: 非联盟成员国国民但在某成员国境内有惯常居所的作者，为本公约之目的，应视同该成员国国民。

Query_Text_en: 3 The expression `` published works '' means works published with the consent of their authors , whatever may be the means of manufacture of the copies , provided that the availability of such copies has been such as to satisfy the reasonable requirements of the public , having regard to the nature of the work The performance of a dramatic , dramatico musical , cinematographic or musical work , the public recitation of a literary work , the communication by wire or the broadcasting of literary or artistic works , the exhibition of a work of art and the construction of a work of architecture shall not constitute publication
Translation: 3 “已发表作品”系指经作者授权出版的作品，无论复制件以何种方式制作，只要根据作品性质，其复制件的发行能够满足公众合理需求。戏剧、戏剧音乐、电影或音乐作品的表演，文学作品的公开朗诵，有线传播或广播文学艺术作品，艺术作品的展览以及建筑作品的建造均不构成出版。

Query_Text_en: 4 A work shall be considered as having been published simultaneously in several countries if it has been published in two or more countries within thirty days of its first publication
Translation: 作品若在首次出版后三十日内在两个及以上国家出版，则视为在数国同时出版。

Query_Text_en: b authors of works of architecture erected in a country of the Union or of other artistic works incorporated in a building or other structure located in a country of the Union
Translation: 在联盟成员国境内建造的建筑作品作者，以及将其他艺术作品融入联盟成员国境内建筑物或其他构筑物的作者。

Query_Text_en: 1 Authors shall enjoy , in respect of works for which they are protected under this Convention , in countries of the Union other than the country of origin , the rights which their respective laws do now or may hereafter grant to their nationals , as well as the rights specially granted by this Convention
Translation: 作者就其在本联盟任一成员国受到本公约保护的著作，除作品起源国外，在该国享有其现行法律或今后可能赋予其国民的权利，以及本公约特别授予的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 The enjoyment and the exercise of these rights shall not be subject to any formality ;
Translation: 这些权利的享有和行使无需履行任何手续。

Query_Text_en: such enjoyment and such exercise shall be independent of the existence of protection in the country of origin of the work Consequently , apart from the provisions of this Convention , the extent of protection , as well as the means of redress afforded to the author to protect his rights , shall be governed exclusively by the laws of the country where protection is claimed
Translation: 此类作品的享有及行使权利，应独立于作品起源国的现行保护制度。因此，除本公约条款另有规定外，著作权的保护范围及作者为维护其权利所能获得的救济手段，应完全依照主张保护地国家的法律予以确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 Protection in the country of origin is governed by domestic law However , when the author is not a national of the country of origin of the work for which he is protected under this Convention , he shall enjoy in that country the same rights as national authors
Translation: 作品在起源国的保护由该国法律管辖。然而，当作者非作品起源国国民却依据本公约受保护时，该作者在起源国应享有与本国国民同等的权利。

Query_Text_en: i when these are cinematographic works the maker of which has his headquarters or his habitual residence in a country of the Union , the country of origin shall be that country , and
Translation: 若电影作品的制片人总部或惯常居所位于联盟成员国境内，则该作品的起源国应为该成员国。

Query_Text_en: ii when these are works of architecture erected in a country of the Union or other artistic works incorporated in a building or other structure located in a country of the Union , the country of origin shall be that country
Translation: 二、当上述作品为建筑作品且建于联盟成员国境内，或为其他艺术作品且构成位于联盟成员国境内建筑物或其他构筑物之一部分时，其起源国应为该成员国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Where any country outside the Union fails to protect in an adequate manner the works of authors who are nationals of one of the countries of the Union , the latter country may restrict the protection given to the works of authors who are , at the date of the first publication thereof , nationals of the other country and are not habitually resident in one of the countries of the Union If the country of fast publication avails itself of this right , the other countries of the Union shall not be required to grant to works thus subjected to special treatment a wider protection than that granted to them in the country of fast publication
Translation: 1. 若联盟以外之国家未能对联盟成员国国民之作品提供充分保护，则该成员国可限制对首次出版时身为该外国国民且非常住联盟成员国境内之作者作品的保护。若作品首次出版国行使此项权利，则联盟其他成员国无须对受此特殊待遇之作品提供比首次出版国所授予更广泛的保护。

Query_Text_en: 2 No restrictions introduced by virtue of the preceding paragraph shall affect the rights which an author may have acquired in respect of a work published in a country of the Union before such restrictions were put into force
Translation: 根据前款规定实施的任何限制措施，均不影响作者在联盟成员国于该限制生效前已出版作品所享有的权利。

Query_Text_en: 3 The countries of the Union which restrict the grant of copyright in accordance with this Article shall give notice thereof to the Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization hereinafter designated as `` the Director General '' by a written declaration specifying the countries in regard to which protection is restricted , and the restrictions to which fights of authors who are nationals of those countries are subjected The Director General shall immediately communicate this declaration to all the countries of the Union
Translation: 各联盟成员国若依据本条对版权授予实施限制，应以书面声明形式通知世界知识产权组织总干事（以下简称“总干事”），具体说明限制保护所涉国家名单及这些国家国民的作者权利所受限制情形。总干事须立即将此项声明转达联盟所有成员国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Independently of the author 's economic fights , and even after the transfer of the said fights , the author shall have the fight to claim authorship of the work and to object to any distortion , mutilation or other modification of , or other derogatory action in relation to , the said work , which would be prejudicial to his honor or reputation
Translation: 1. 无论作者是否已转让其经济权利，甚至在转让上述权利后，作者仍有权主张作品的署名权，并有权反对任何有损其荣誉或声誉的歪曲、篡改或其他修改行为，或对该作品的其他贬损性行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 The rights granted to the author in accordance with the preceding paragraph shall , after his death , be maintained , at least until the expiry of the economic fights , and shall be exercisable by the persons or institutions authorized by the legislation of the country where protection is claimed However , those countries whose legislation , at the moment of their ratification of or accession to this Act , does not provide for the protection after the death of the author of all the fights set out in the preceding paragraph may provide that some of these rights may , after his death , cease to be maintained
Translation: 根据前款规定授予作者的权利，应在其去世后至少保留至经济权利期满为止，并由要求保护国法律所授权的个人或机构行使。然而，在批准或加入本公约时，其国内立法未规定对作者去世后前款所列全部权利予以保护的国家，可规定其中部分权利在作者去世后不再予以保留。

Query_Text_en: 3 The means of redress for safeguarding the fights granted by this Article shall be governed by the legislation of the country where protection is claimed
Translation: 为保障本条所赋予权利而采取的救济手段，应依照主张保护所在国的法律规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 The term of protection granted by this Convention shall be the life of the author and fifty years after his death
Translation: 本公约授予的保护期限为作者终生及其死后五十年。

Query_Text_en: 2 However , in the case of cinematographic works , the countries of the Union may provide that the term of protection shall expire fifty years after the work has been made available to the public with the consent of the author , or , failing such an event within fifty years from the making of such a work , fifty years after the making
Translation: 然而，就电影作品而言，联盟各国可规定保护期于作品经作者同意公之于众后五十年届满；若作品在创作完成后五十年内未公之于众，则保护期自作品创作完成之日起五十年届满。

Query_Text_en: 3 In the case of anonymous or pseudonymous works , the term of protection granted by this Convention shall expire fifty years after the work has been lawfully made available to the public However , when the pseudonym adopted by the author leaves no doubt as to his identity , the term of protection shall be that provided in paragraph 1 If the author of an anonymous or pseudonymous work discloses his identity during the above mentioned period , the term of protection applicable shall be that provided in paragraph 1 The countries of the Union shall not be required to protect anonymous or pseudonymous works in respect of which it is reasonable to presume that their author has been dead for fifty years
Translation: 对于匿名或假名作品，本公约给予的保护期应自作品合法向公众公开发表之日起五十年届满。但如作者采用的假名足以确知其身份，保护期应适用第1款规定。若匿名或假名作者在上述期间表露其身份，适用保护期应为第1款所规定期限。各成员国对于有合理理由推定作者已去世五十年的匿名或假名作品，无义务予以保护。

Query_Text_en: however , this term shall last at least until the end of a period of twenty five years from the making of such a work
Translation: 然而，该期限自作品创作完成之日起不得少于二十五年。

Query_Text_en: 5 The term of protection subsequent to the death of the author and the terms provided by paragraphs 2 , 3 and 4 shall run from the date of death or of the event referred to in those paragraphs , but such terms shall always be deemed to begin on the first of January of the year following the death or such event
Translation: 作者去世后的保护期及第2款、第3款和第4款规定的保护期，应自作者死亡或所述事件发生之日起计算，但此类保护期均视为自死亡或事件发生次年的1月1日起算。

Query_Text_en: 6 The countries of the Union may grant a term of protection in excess of those provided by the preceding paragraphs
Translation: 联盟各成员国可给予比前述条款所规定更长的保护期限。

Query_Text_en: 7 Those countries of the Union bound by the Rome Act of this Convention which grant , in their national legislation in force at the time of signature of the present Act , shorter terms of protection than those provided for in the preceding paragraphs shall have the fight to maintain such terms when ratifying or acceding to the present Act
Translation: 本联盟中受本公约罗马文本约束的国家，若其在本文本签署时生效的国内立法所规定的保护期短于前述各款期限，则在批准或加入本文本时有权维持该较短保护期。

Query_Text_en: however , unless the legislation of that country otherwise provides , the term shall not exceed the term fixed in the country of origin of the work
Translation: 然而，除非该国的法律另有规定，否则该期限不得超过作品起源国所规定的期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 7bis The provisions of the preceding Article shall also apply in the case of a work of joint authorship , provided that the terms measured from the death of the author shall be calculated from the death of the last surviving author
Translation: 第七条之二 前条规定同样适用于合作作品，但以作者去世之日起计算的保护期应以最后去世的作者死亡时间为准。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy the exclusive right of making and of authorizing the translation of their works throughout the term of protection of their fights in the original works
Translation: 第八条 受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，在对原作享有权利的整个保护期内，享有翻译和授权翻译其作品的专有权。

Query_Text_en: 1 Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall have the exclusive right of authorizing the reproduction of these works , in any manner or form
Translation: 根据本公约受保护的文学和艺术作品作者，享有授权以任何方式或形式复制其作品的专有权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to permit the reproduction of such works in certain special cases , provided that such reproduction does not conflict with a normal exploitation of the work and does not unreasonably prejudice the legitimate interests of the author
Translation: 联盟各国可在特定特殊情形下立法允许此类作品的复制，但该复制不得与作品的正常利用相冲突，亦不得不合理地损害作者的合法利益。

Query_Text_en: 3 Any sound or visual recording shall be considered as a reproduction for the purposes of this Convention
Translation: 根据本公约之规定，任何录音或录像行为均视为复制。

Query_Text_en: 1 It shall be permissible to make quotations from a work which has already been lawfully made available to the public , provided that their making is compatible with fair practice , and their extent does not exceed that justified by the purpose , including quotations from newspaper articles and periodicals in the form of press summaries
Translation:
允许从已合法公开发表的作品中摘录引文，只要摘录行为符合合理使用惯例，且摘录范围未超出正当目的所需限度，包括以新闻摘要形式转载报刊文章和期刊内容。  

2 The Chinese government has always adhered to the principle of putting people first and serving the people wholeheartedly, continuously advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capabilities.  
中国政府始终坚持以人民为中心、全心全意为人民服务的根本宗旨，持续推进国家治理体系和治理能力现代化。  

3 In order to promote the healthy development of the digital economy, it is necessary to strengthen the construction of digital infrastructure, improve the regulatory system, and encourage innovation while preventing risks.  
为促进数字经济健康发展，需加强数字基础设施建设，完善监管体系，在鼓励创新的同时防范风险。  

4 The central bank emphasized the importance of implementing a prudent monetary policy to maintain liquidity reasonably ample and guide market interest rates to operate within a reasonable range.  
央行强调应实施稳健的货币政策，保持流动性合理充裕，引导市场利率在合理区间内运行。  

5 The free trade agreement will significantly reduce tariff barriers, expand market access for service industries, and create more favorable conditions for bilateral investment.  
该自由贸易协定将大幅削减关税壁垒，扩大服务业市场准入，为双边投资创造更有利条件。  

6 We must adhere to the path of green and low-carbon development, promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, and cultivate new drivers of economic growth.  
必须坚持绿色低碳发展道路，推动传统产业转型升级，培育经济增长新动能。  

7 The report points out that global economic growth is facing multiple challenges, including rising inflationary pressures, tightening financial conditions, and increased geopolitical uncertainties.  
报告指出，全球经济增长面临多重挑战，包括通胀压力上升、金融环境收紧及地缘政治不确定性加剧。  

8 The company strictly complies with international business ethics, resolutely opposes any form of commercial bribery, and has established a comprehensive compliance management system.  
该公司严格遵守国际商业道德，坚决反对任何形式的商业贿赂，并建立了完善的合规管理体系。  

9 The new tax incentives aim to support small and medium-sized enterprises in increasing R&D investment, enhancing innovation capabilities, and accelerating digital transformation.  
新出台的税收优惠政策旨在支持中小企业加大研发投入、提升创新能力并加快数字化转型。  

10 The international community should strengthen cooperation to jointly address climate change, protect biodiversity, and achieve sustainable development goals.  
国际社会应加强合作，共同应对气候变化、保护生物多样性，实现可持续发展目标。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union , and for special agreements existing or to be concluded between them , to permit the utilization , to the extent justified by the purpose , of literary or artistic works by way of illustration in publications , broadcasts or sound or visual recordings for teaching , provided such utilization is compatible with fair practice
Translation: 各联盟成员国应通过国内立法或现有及未来缔结的特别协议，在符合公平惯例的前提下，允许为教学目的在出版物、广播节目或音像制品中适当引用文学艺术作品作为解说例证，其使用程度须与教学目的相符。

Query_Text_en: 3 Where use is made of works in accordance with the preceding paragraphs of this Article , mention shall be made of the source , and of the name of the author if it appears thereon
Translation: 依照本条前款规定使用作品时，须注明出处及作者姓名（若作品已署名）。

Query_Text_en: 1 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to permit the reproduction by the press , the broadcasting or the communication to the public by wire of articles published in newspapers or periodicals on current economic , political or religious topics , and of broadcast works of the same character , in cases in which the reproduction , broadcasting or such communication thereof is not expressly reserved Nevertheless , the source must always be clearly indicated ;
Translation: 联盟各国立法可准许报刊转载、广播或以有线方式向公众传播报刊所载有关当前经济、政治或宗教问题的文章，以及性质相同的广播作品，但以未明确声明保留权利者为限；且在任何情况下，均应明确标明出处。

Query_Text_en: the legal consequences of a breach of this obligation shall be determined by the legislation of the country where protection is claimed
Translation: 违反此项义务的法律后果应依据请求保护国的法律予以确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall also be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the conditions under which , for the purpose of reporting current events by means of photography , cinematography , broadcasting or communication to the public by wire , literary or artistic works seen or heard in the course of the event may , to the extent justified by the informatory purpose , be reproduced and made available to the public
Translation: 联盟各国立法还应规定，在何种条件下，为报道时事新闻而通过摄影、电影、广播或有线传播向公众传播时，在事件过程中被看到或听到的文学或艺术作品，在符合新闻报道目的的合理范围内，可予以复制并向公众提供。

Query_Text_en: ii any communication to the public of the performance of their works
Translation: 二 向公众传播其作品的表演

Query_Text_en: 2 Authors of dramatic or dramatic musical works shall enjoy , during the full term of their rights in the original works , the same rights with respect to translations thereof
Translation: 戏剧作品或戏剧音乐作品的作者，在其原作权利保护期内，对作品的翻译享有同等权利。

Query_Text_en: iii the public communication by loudspeaker or any other analogous instrument transmitting , by signs , sounds or images , the broadcast of the work
Translation: 三、通过扬声器或其他任何类似工具，以符号、声音或图像形式公开传播作品广播的行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the conditions under which the rights mentioned in the preceding paragraph may be exercised , but these conditions shall apply only in the countries where they have been prescribed They shall not in any circumstances be prejudicial to the moral rights of the author , nor to his right to obtain equitable remuneration which , in the absence of agreement , shall be fixed by competent authority
Translation: 联盟各国应通过立法确定前款所述权利的行使条件，但此类条件仅适用于制定该条件的国家。在任何情况下，这些条件均不得损害作者的精神权利，也不得影响其获得公平报酬的权利；如无协议，报酬金额应由主管当局确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 In the absence of any contrary stipulation , permission granted in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article shall not imply permission to record , by means of instruments recording sounds or images , the work broadcast It shall , however , be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the regulations for ephemeral recordings made by a broadcasting organization by means of its own facilities and used for its own broadcasts The preservation of these recordings in official archives may , on the ground of their exceptional documentary character , be authorized by such legislation
Translation: 若无相反规定，依照本条第一款授予的许可并不包含使用录音或录像设备录制广播作品的权限。但联盟各成员国可自行立法，对广播组织利用自有设备制作并用于自身播出的临时性录制品制定相关规范。鉴于此类录制品具有特殊文献价值，成员国法律可批准将其保存于官方档案机构。

Query_Text_en: i the public recitation of their works , including such public recitation by any means or process ;
Translation: 公开朗诵其作品，包括以任何手段或方法公开朗诵；

Query_Text_en: ii any communication to the public of the recitation of their works
Translation: 二、以任何方式公开朗诵其作品

Query_Text_en: 2 Authors of literary works shall enjoy , during the full term of their rights in the original works , the same fights with respect to translations thereof
Translation: 文学作品的作者，在其原作品权利保护期内，对作品的翻译享有同等权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Authors of literary or artistic works shall enjoy the exclusive fight of authorizing adaptations , arrangements and other alterations of their works
Translation: 第十二条 文学或艺术作品的作者享有授权对其作品进行改编、编排及其他改动的专有权利。

Query_Text_en: but all such reservations and conditions shall apply only in the countries which have imposed them and shall not , in any circumstances , be prejudicial to the rights of these authors to obtain equitable remuneration which , in the absence of agreement , shall be fixed by competent authority
Translation: 但所有此类保留与条件仅适用于作出保留的国家，且在任何情况下均不得损害这些作者获得公平报酬的权利；如无协议，该报酬应由主管当局裁定。

Query_Text_en: 2 Recordings of musical works made in a country of the Union in accordance with Article 13 3 of the Conventions signed at Rome on June 2,1928 , and at Brussels on June 26,1948 , may be reproduced in that country without the permission of the author of the musical work until a date two years after that country becomes bound by this Act
Translation: 根据1928年6月2日罗马公约及1948年6月26日布鲁塞尔公约第13条第3款之规定，在联盟成员国制作的音乐作品录音制品，自该国受本公约约束之日起两年内，可不经音乐作品作者许可在该国境内进行复制。

Query_Text_en: 3 Recordings made in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article and imported without permission from the parties concerned into a country where they are treated as infringing recordings shall be liable to seizure
Translation: 根据本条第一和第二款制作、未经相关方许可进口至视其为侵权录音制品的国家时，该录音制品应予扣押。

Query_Text_en: ii the public performance and communication to the public by wire of the works thus adapted or reproduced
Translation: 二 通过有线方式公开传播或向公众传播经改编或复制的作品

Query_Text_en: 2 The adaptation into any other artistic form of a cinematographic production derived from literary or artistic works shall , without prejudice to the authorization of the author of the cinematographic production , remain subject to the authorization of the authors of the original works
Translation: 将源自文学或艺术作品的电影作品改编为其他任何艺术形式时，在不妨碍电影作品作者授权的情况下，仍须取得原作作者的授权。

Query_Text_en: 3 The provisions of Article 13 1 shall not apply
Translation: 第十三条第一款之规定不予适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 Without prejudice to the copyright in any work which may have been adapted or reproduced , a cinematographic work shall be protected as an original work The owner of copyright in a cinematographic work shall enjoy the same fights as the author of an original work , including the rights referred to in the preceding Article
Translation: 在不损害任何可能被改编或复制作品的版权前提下，电影作品应作为原创作品受到保护。电影作品的版权所有者享有与原创作品作者相同的权利，包括前条所述各项权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 a Ownership of copyright in a cinematographic work shall be a matter for legislation in the country where protection is claimed
Translation: 电影作品的著作权归属应依照主张保护国的法律予以确定

Query_Text_en: b However , in the countries of the Union which , by legislation , include among the owners of copyright in a cinematographic work authors who have brought contributions to the making of the work , such authors , if they have undertaken to bring such contributions , may not , in the absence of any contrary or special stipulation , object to the reproduction , distribution , public performance , communication to the public by wire , broadcasting or any other communication to the public , or to the subtitling or dubbing of texts , of the work
Translation: 然而，在本联盟成员国中，若其立法将电影作品创作贡献者列为著作权共有人，则此类作者在无相反或特殊约定的情况下，不得反对对该作品进行复制、发行、公开表演、有线传播、广播或其他公开传播行为，亦不得反对为作品添加字幕或配音文本。

Query_Text_en: c The question whether or not the form of the undertaking referred to above should , for the application of the preceding subparagraph b , be in a written agreement or a written act of the same effect shall be a matter for the legislation of the country where the maker of the cinematographic work has his headquarters or habitual residence However , it shall be a matter for the legislation of the country of the Union where protection is claimed to provide that the said undertaking shall be in a written agreement or a written act of the same effect The countries whose legislation so provides shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration , which will be immediately communicated by him to all the other countries of the Union
Translation: 关于前述b项之适用，上述承诺形式是否须以书面协议或具有同等效力的书面文件作出，应由电影作品制作者总部或惯常居所所在国之立法确定。但联盟成员国可要求该承诺须以书面协议或具有同等效力的书面文件形式作出，此要求应由主张保护国之立法规定。作出此类立法规定的国家应以书面声明形式通知总干事，总干事须立即将该声明转达联盟所有其他成员国。

Query_Text_en: d By `` contrary or special stipulation '' is meant any restrictive condition which is relevant to the aforesaid undertaking
Translation: 所谓"相反或特别规定"是指与上述承诺相关的任何限制性条件。

Query_Text_en: 3 Unless the national legislation provides to the contrary , the provisions of paragraph 2 b above shall not be applicable to authors of scenarios , dialogues and musical works created for the making of the cinematographic work , or to the principal director thereof However , those countries of the Union whose legislation does not contain rules providing for the application of the said paragraph 2 b to such director shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration , which will be immediately communicated by him to all the other countries of the Union
Translation: 除非本国法律另有规定，上述第二款第二项之规定不适用于为创作电影作品而撰写的剧本、对白及音乐作品的作者，亦不适用于电影作品的主要导演。但联盟成员国中，其法律未规定将上述第二款第二项适用于该导演者，应以书面声明方式通知总干事，总干事须立即将此项声明转达联盟所有其他成员国。

Query_Text_en: 1 The author , or after his death the persons or institutions authorized by national legislation , shall , with respect to original works of art and original manuscripts of writers and composers , enjoy the inalienable fight to an interest in any sale of the work subsequent to the first transfer by the author of the work
Translation: 对于艺术作品的原件和作家、作曲家的原稿，作者或在其死后由国家法律授权的人或机构，享有不可剥夺的权利，即在该作品首次转让后对任何再次出售享有收益权。

Query_Text_en: 2 The protection provided by the preceding paragraph may be claimed in a country of the Union only if legislation in the country to which the author belongs so permits , and to the extent permitted by the country where this protection is claimed
Translation: 前款所规定的保护，仅在作者所属国家的法律允许的范围内，且仅在主张保护的国家法律所允许的范围内，方可在联盟成员国主张。

Query_Text_en: 3 The procedure for collection and the amounts shall be matters for determination by national legislation
Translation: 征收程序及金额由各国立法确定。

Query_Text_en: 1 In order that the author of a literary or artistic work protected by this Convention shall , in the absence of proof to the contrary , be regarded as such , and consequently be entitled to institute infringement proceedings in the countries of the Union , it shall be sufficient for his name to appear on the work in the usual manner This paragraph shall be applicable even if this name is a pseudonym , where the pseudonym adopted by the author leaves no doubt as to his identity
Translation: 根据本公约受保护的文学或艺术作品作者，如无相反证明，应视为该作品之作者，并有权在联盟成员国提起侵权诉讼。只要作者姓名以通常方式出现在作品上即可满足此项要求。本款规定同样适用于作者使用笔名之情形，只要该笔名能明确无误地证实作者身份。

Query_Text_en: 2 The person or body corporate whose name appears on a cinematographic work in the usual manner shall , in the absence of proof to the contrary , be presumed to be the maker of the said work
Translation: 凡以通常方式在电影作品上署名的个人或法人团体，如无相反证明，应推定为该作品的制片人。

Query_Text_en: 3 In the case of anonymous and pseudonymous works , other than those referred to in paragraph 1 above , the publisher whose name appears on the work shall , in the absence of proof to the contrary , be deemed to represent the author , and in this capacity he shall be entitled to protect and enforce the author 's fights The provisions of this paragraph shall cease to apply when the author reveals his identity and establishes his claim to authorship of the work
Translation: 对于匿名及假名作品（上述第一款所述情形除外），若无相反证明，作品上所署名的出版者即视为作者代表，并有权以该身份维护及行使作者权利。当作者公开其身份并证实其为作品创作者时，本款规定即停止适用。

Query_Text_en: 4 a In the case of unpublished works where the identity of the author is unknown , but where there is every ground to presume that he is a national of a country of the Union , it shall be a matter for legislation in that country to designate the competent authority which shall represent the author and shall be entitled to protect and enforce his fights in the countries of the Union
Translation: 对于作者身份不明但确有充分理由推定其为联盟成员国国民的未发表作品，应由该国立法指定主管机关代表该作者，并有权在联盟各成员国境内维护和行使该作者的权利。

Query_Text_en: b Countries of the Union which make such designation under the terms of this provision shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration giving full information concerning the authority thus designated The Director General shall at once communicate this declaration to all other countries of the Union
Translation: 根据本条款作出这一指定的联盟成员国，应以书面声明形式通知总干事，详细说明被指定当局的全部信息。总干事应立即将该声明通报联盟所有其他成员国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Infringing copies of a work shall be liable to seizure in any country of the Union where the work enjoys legal protection
Translation: 作品的侵权复制品在联盟任何成员国境内均可予以扣押，只要该作品在该国受法律保护。

Query_Text_en: 2 The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall also apply to reproductions coming from a country where the work is not protected , or has ceased to be protected
Translation: 前款规定同样适用于作品来源国对该作品不予保护或保护期已届满的情况。

Query_Text_en: 3 The seizure shall take place in accordance with the legislation of each country
Translation: 扣押应依照各国法律执行

Query_Text_en: Article 17 The provisions of this Convention can not in any way affect the fight of the Government of each country of the Union to permit , to control , or to prohibit , by legislation or regulation , the circulation , presentation , or exhibition of any work or production in regard to which the competent authority may find it necessary to exercise that fight
Translation: 第十七条 本公约条款绝不妨碍联盟各成员国政府通过立法或监管，对任何作品或制品的传播、演出或展览进行许可、管控或禁止；各成员国主管当局认为有必要行使此项权利时，可采取相应措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall apply to all works which , at the moment of its coming into force , have not yet fallen into the public domain in the country of origin through the expiry of the term of protection
Translation: 1 本公约适用于所有作品，只要这些作品在公约生效时，在其起源国尚未因保护期限届满而进入公有领域。

Query_Text_en: 2 If , however , through the expiry of the term of protection which was previously granted , a work has fallen into the public domain of the country where protection is claimed , that work shall not be protected anew
Translation: 然而，若作品因原定保护期限届满而进入主张保护国之公有领域，则该作品不得重新获得保护。

Query_Text_en: 3 The application of this principle shall be subject to any provisions contained in special conventions to that effect existing or to be concluded between countries of the Union In the absence of such provisions , the respective countries shall determine , each in so far as it is concerned , the conditions of application of this principle
Translation: 本原则之适用须受联盟成员国间现行或将来缔结之专门公约相关条款约束。如无此类条款，各成员国应自行确定该原则在本国之适用条件。

Query_Text_en: 4 The preceding provisions shall also apply in the case of new accessions to the Union and to cases in which protection is extended by the application of Article 7 or by the abandonment of reservations
Translation: 上述规定同样适用于新加入本联盟的国家，以及根据第七条适用扩大保护范围或放弃保留条款的情形。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 The provisions of this Convention shall not preclude the making of a claim to the benefit of any greater protection which may be granted by legislation in a country of the Union
Translation: 第十九条 本公约之规定不妨碍联盟成员国法律可能授予的更广泛保护之权利主张。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 The Governments of the countries of the Union reserve the right to enter into special agreements among themselves , in so far as such agreements grant to authors more extensive rights than those granted by the Convention , or contain other provisions not contrary to this Convention The provisions of existing agreements which satisfy these conditions shall remain applicable
Translation: 第二十条　本联盟各成员国政府有权在彼此间签订专门协定，只要此类协定授予作者的权利比本公约所赋予的更广泛，或包含不违反本公约的其他条款。现行协定中符合上述条件的条款将继续适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 Special provisions regarding developing countries are included in the Appendix
Translation: 附录载有关于发展中国家的特别规定

Query_Text_en: 2 Subject to the provisions of Article 28 1 b , the Appendix forms an integral part of this Act
Translation: 根据第二十八条第一款第二项之规定，本附录构成本法不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 a The Union shall have an Assembly consisting of those countries of the Union which are bound by Articles 22 to 26
Translation: 1 a 本联盟应设立大会，由受第二十二条至第二十六条约束的本联盟成员国组成。

Query_Text_en: b The Government of each country shall be represented by one delegate , who may be assisted by alternate delegates , advisors , and experts
Translation: 各国政府应各派一名代表参会，并可配备副代表、顾问及专家协助工作。

Query_Text_en: c The expenses of each delegation shall be borne by the Government which has appointed it
Translation: 各代表团的开支应由指派该代表团的政府承担。

Query_Text_en: xiii subject to its acceptance , exercise such rights as are given to it in the Convention establishing the Organization
Translation: 十三、在表示接受后，可行使《本组织成立公约》所赋予的各项权利。

Query_Text_en: b With respect to matters which are of interest also to other Unions administered by the Organization , the Assembly shall make its decisions after having heard the advice of the Coordination Committee of the Organization
Translation: 对于本组织所辖其他联盟同样关切的事项，大会应在听取本组织协调委员会意见后作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 3 a Each country member of the Assembly shall have one vote
Translation: 3 a 大会各成员国均享有一票表决权

Query_Text_en: b One half of the countries members of the Assembly shall constitute a quorum
Translation: 大会成员国过半数出席即构成法定人数

Query_Text_en: c Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph b , if , in any session , the number of countries represented is less than one half but equal to or more than one third of the countries members of the Assembly , the Assembly may make decisions but , with the exception of decisions concerning its own procedure , all such decisions shall take effect only if the following conditions are fulfilled The International Bureau shall communicate the said decisions to the countries members of the Assembly which were not represented and shall invite them to express in writing their vote or abstention within a period of three months from the date of the communication If , at the expiration of this period , the number of countries having thus expressed their vote or abstention attains the number of countries which was lacking for attaining the quorum in the session itself , such decisions shall take effect provided that at the same time the required majority still obtains
Translation: (c) 尽管有(b)项规定，若大会任何一届会议出席国家数不足全体成员国半数但达到或超过三分之一时，大会仍可作出决议；但除关于其自身议事程序的决议外，所有此类决议须在下列条件满足后方可生效：国际局须将上述决议通报未出席大会的成员国，并邀请其自通报之日起三个月内以书面形式投票或弃权。若在此期限届满时，以书面形式投票或弃权的国家数达到本届会议达成法定人数所缺数额，且同时仍满足所需多数票条件，则此类决议即告生效。

Query_Text_en: d Subject to the provisions of Article 26 2 , the decisions of the Assembly shall require two thirds of the votes cast
Translation: 除第二十六条第二款规定的情形外，大会决议须经所投票数的三分之二多数通过。

Query_Text_en: e Abstentions shall not be considered as votes
Translation: 弃权票不计入表决票数。

Query_Text_en: f A delegate may represent , and vote in the name of , one country only
Translation: 一名代表仅可代表一个国家并以该国名义投票。

Query_Text_en: g Countries of the Union not members of the Assembly shall be admitted to its meetings as observers
Translation: 非大会成员国的本联盟成员国应获准作为观察员列席会议

Query_Text_en: 4 a The Assembly shall meet once in every second calendar year in ordinary session upon convocation by the Director General and , in the absence of exceptional circumstances , during the same period and at the same place as the General Assembly of the Organization
Translation: 大会应每两年召开一次常会，由总干事召集；除特殊情况外，应与本组织大会同期同地举行。

Query_Text_en: b The Assembly shall meet in extraordinary session upon convocation by the Director General , at the request of the Executive Committee or at the request of one fourth of the countries members of the Assembly
Translation: 大会应总干事召集、执行委员会提议或四分之一成员国要求，召开特别会议。

Query_Text_en: 5 The Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure
Translation: 大会应自行通过其议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 1 The Assembly shall have an Executive Committee
Translation: 大会应设执行委员会

Query_Text_en: 2 a The Executive Committee shall consist of countries elected by the Assembly from among countries members of the Assembly Furthermore , the country on whose territory the Organization has its headquarters shall , subject to the provisions of Article 25 7 b , have an ex officio seat on the Committee
Translation: 2 a 执行委员会应由大会从成员国中选举产生的国家组成。此外，根据第二十五条第七款b项的规定，组织总部所在国应自动获得该委员会席位。

Query_Text_en: b The Government of each country member of the Executive Committee shall be represented by one delegate , who may be assisted by alternate delegates , advisors , and experts
Translation: 执行委员会各成员国政府应各派一名代表，并可配备副代表、顾问及专家予以协助。

Query_Text_en: 3 The number of countries members of the Executive Committee shall correspond to one fourth of the number of countries members of the Assembly In establishing the number of seats to be filled , remainders after division by four shall be disregarded
Translation: 执行委员会成员国数目应相当于大会成员国的四分之一。在确定应选席位数时，除以四后的余数不计。

Query_Text_en: 4 In electing the members of the Executive Committee , the Assembly shall have due regard to an equitable geographical distribution and to the need for countries party to the Special Agreements which might be established in relation with the Union to be among the countries constituting the Executive Committee
Translation: 大会在选举执行委员会委员时，应适当考虑委员国地域分配的公平性，并确保与联盟可能建立特别协定关系的缔约国在执委会组成国家中占有适当席位。

Query_Text_en: 5 a Each member of the Executive Committee shall serve from the close of the session of the Assembly which elected it to the close of the next ordinary session of the Assembly
Translation: 5 a 执行委员会各成员任期自选举其的大会会议闭幕时起，至下届大会常会闭幕时止。

Query_Text_en: b Members of the Executive Committee may be re elected , but not more than two thirds of them
Translation: 执行委员会成员可连选连任，但连任人数不得超过总人数的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: c The Assembly shall establish the details of the rules governing the election and possible re election of the members of the Executive Committee
Translation: 大会应制定执行委员会成员选举及连任细则。

Query_Text_en: ii submit proposals to the Assembly respecting the draft program and biennial budget of the Union prepared by the Director General ;
Translation: 二、就总干事编制的本组织计划草案及双年度预算向大会提交提案；

Query_Text_en: vi perform such other functions as are allocated to it under this Convention
Translation: 六、履行本公约所规定的其他职能

Query_Text_en: b With respect to matters which are of interest also to other Unions administered by the Organization , the Executive Committee shall make its decisions after having heard the advice of the Coordination Committee of the Organization
Translation: 对于本组织管理的其他联盟同样关切的事项，执行委员会应在听取本组织协调委员会意见后作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 7 a The Executive Committee shall meet once a year in ordinary session upon convocation by the Director General , preferably during the same period and at the same place as the Coordination Committee of the Organization
Translation: 7 a 执行委员会每年应召开一次常会，由总干事召集，会议时间与地点宜尽量与组织协调委员会同期同地举行。

Query_Text_en: b The Executive Committee shall meet in extraordinary session upon convocation by the Director General , either on his own initiative , or at the request of its Chairman or one fourth of its members
Translation: 执行委员会应于总干事召集时举行特别会议，不论系总干事主动提议，抑或应委员会主席或四分之一成员请求而召开。

Query_Text_en: 8 a Each country member of the Executive Committee shall have one vote
Translation: 8 a 执行委员会各成员国均享有一票表决权

Query_Text_en: b One half of the members of the Executive Committee shall constitute a quorum
Translation: 执行委员会成员的半数即构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: c Decisions shall be made by a simple majority of the votes cast
Translation: 决议应以简单多数票通过

Query_Text_en: d Abstentions shall not be considered as votes
Translation: 弃权票不计入表决票数。

Query_Text_en: e A delegate may represent , and vote in the name of , one country only
Translation: 一名代表仅可代表一个国家并以该国名义投票。

Query_Text_en: 9 Countries of the Union not members of the Executive Committee shall be admitted to its meetings as observers
Translation: 联盟中非执行委员会成员的9个国家将以观察员身份列席会议

Query_Text_en: 10 The Executive Committee shall adopt its own rules of procedure
Translation: 执行委员会应自行制定议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 1 a The administrative tasks with respect to the Union shall be performed by the International Bureau , which is a continuation of the Bureau of the Union united with the Bureau of the Union established by the International Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
Translation: 1 a 本联盟的行政事务应由国际局执行，该局系原联盟事务局与《保护工业产权国际公约》所设联盟事务局合并后的延续机构。

Query_Text_en: b In particular , the International Bureau shall provide the secretariat of the various organs of the Union
Translation: 特别是，国际局应为本联盟各机构的秘书处提供支持。

Query_Text_en: c The Director General of the Organization shall be the chief executive of the Union and shall represent the Union
Translation: 本组织总干事应担任联盟最高行政长官，并代表联盟行使职权。

Query_Text_en: 2 The International Bureau shall assemble and publish information concerning the protection of copyright Each country of the Union shall promptly communicate to the International Bureau all new laws and official texts concerning the protection of copyright
Translation: 国际局应汇编并发布有关版权保护的信息。联盟各成员国须及时向国际局通报所有涉及版权保护的新法律及官方文件。

Query_Text_en: 3 The International Bureau shall publish a monthly periodical
Translation: 国际局应每月出版一期期刊

Query_Text_en: 4 The International Bureau shall , on request , furnish information to any country of the Union on matters concerning the protection of copyright
Translation: 国际局应依请求，向本联盟任何国家提供有关版权保护事宜的信息。

Query_Text_en: 5 The International Bureau shall conduct studies , and shall provide services , designed to facilitate the protection of copyright
Translation: 国际局应开展研究并提供服务，以促进版权保护工作的开展。

Query_Text_en: 6 The Director General and any staff member designated by him shall participate , without the right to vote , in all meetings of the Assembly , the Executive Committee and any other committee of experts or working group The Director General , or a staff member designated by him , shall be ex officio secretary of these bodies
Translation: 总干事及其指定的工作人员有权以无表决权身份参加大会、执行委员会及任何其他专家委员会或工作组的全部会议。总干事或其指定人员应依职权担任上述机构的当然秘书。

Query_Text_en: 7 a The International Bureau shall , in accordance with the directions of the Assembly and in cooperation with the Executive Committee , make the preparations for the conferences of revision of the provisions of the Convention other than Articles 22 to 26
Translation: 国际局应根据大会指示，并与执行委员会合作，为修订本公约第二十二至二十六条以外条款的会议进行筹备工作。

Query_Text_en: b The International Bureau may consult with intergovernmental and international non governmental organizations concerning preparations for conferences of revision
Translation: 国际局可就修订会议的筹备事宜与政府间组织及国际非政府组织进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: c The Director General and persons designated by him shall take part , without the right to vote , in the discussions at these conferences
Translation: 总干事及其指定人员可参加这些会议的讨论，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: 8 The International Bureau shall carry out any other tasks assigned to it
Translation: 8 国际局应执行其被指定的任何其他任务

Query_Text_en: 1 a The Union shall have a budget
Translation: 1 a 联盟应设立预算

Query_Text_en: b The budget of the Union shall include the income and expenses proper to the Union , its contribution to the budget of expenses common to the Unions , and , where applicable , the sum made available to the budget of the Conference of the Organization
Translation: 联盟预算应包括联盟本身的收支项目、联盟对共同支出预算的分摊款项，以及（如适用）拨付本组织大会预算的款项。

Query_Text_en: c Expenses not attributable exclusively to the Union but also to one or more other Unions administered by the Organization shall be considered as expenses common to the Unions The share of the Union in such common expenses shall be in proportion to the interest the Union has in them
Translation: 联盟开支中非专属本联盟、同时亦涉及本组织所辖其他一个或多个联盟的部分，应视为各联盟共同开支。本联盟分摊的共同开支份额，应按其所涉利益比例确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 The budget of the Union shall be established with due regard to the requirements of coordination with the budgets of the other Unions administered by the Organization
Translation: 联盟预算的制定应适当考虑与本组织管理的其他联盟预算协调配合的要求。

Query_Text_en: v rents , interests , and other miscellaneous income
Translation: 租金、利息及其他杂项收入

Query_Text_en: b Unless it has already done so , each country shall indicate , concurrently with depositing its instrument of ratification or accession , the class to which it wishes to belong Any country may change class If it chooses a lower class , the country must announce it to the Assembly at one of its ordinary sessions Any such change shall take effect at the beginning of the calendar year following the session
Translation: 各成员国若尚未作出选择，应在递交批准书或加入书时，同时声明其希望归属的类别。任何国家均可变更其所属类别。若选择降类，该国须在大会常会上予以宣布。此类变更应于该届常会结束后次年1月1日起生效。

Query_Text_en: c The annual contribution of each country shall be an amount in the same proportion to the total sum to be contributed to the annual budget of the Union by all countries as the number of its units is to the total of the units of all contributing countries
Translation: 各成员国每年对联盟年度预算的认缴额，应与其认缴单位数占全体认缴国单位总数的比例相同。

Query_Text_en: d Contributions shall become due on the first of January of each year
Translation: 会费应于每年1月1日缴纳。

Query_Text_en: e A country which is in arrears in the payment of its contributions shall have no vote in any of the organs of the Union of which it is a member if the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of the contributions due from it for the preceding two full years However , any organ of the Union may allow such a country to continue to exercise its vote in that organ if , and as long as , it is satisfied that the delay in payment is due to exceptional and unavoidable circumstances
Translation: 凡拖欠本组织会费之成员国，其拖欠数额如等于或超过此前两个完整年度应缴会费总额时，即丧失其在本组织所有机构中的表决权。但如相关机构认定拖欠系因特殊且不可抗力情况所致，可允许该国在该机构中继续行使表决权。

Query_Text_en: f If the budget is not adopted before the beginning of a new financial period , it shall be at the same level as the budget of the previous year , in accordance with the financial regulations
Translation: 若新财政周期开始前预算未获通过，则根据财政条例，预算金额应维持上一年度相同水平。

Query_Text_en: 5 The amount of the fees and charges due for services rendered by the International Bureau in relation to the Union shall be established , and shall be reported to the Assembly and the Executive Committee , by the Director General
Translation: 国际局局长应确定本联盟相关服务所产生的费用与收费金额，并向大会和执行委员会报告。

Query_Text_en: 6 a The Union shall have a working capital fund which shall be constituted by a single payment made by each country of the Union If the fund becomes insufficient , an increase shall be decided by the Assembly
Translation: 6 a 本联盟应设立一项周转基金，由联盟各成员国一次性缴款构成。若该基金出现不足，大会应决定增加其金额。

Query_Text_en: b The amount of the initial payment of each country to the said fund or of its participation in the increase thereof shall be a proportion of the contribution of that country for the year in which the fund is established or the increase decided
Translation: 各国向该基金的首次缴款或参与增资的金额，应按照该国在基金设立或增资决定当年的认缴比例计算。

Query_Text_en: c The proportion and the terms of payment shall be fixed by the Assembly on the proposal of the Director General and after it has heard the advice of the Coordination Committee of the Organization
Translation: 付款比例和条件应由大会根据总干事的提议，在听取本组织协调委员会的意见后予以确定。

Query_Text_en: 7 a In the headquarters agreement concluded with the country on the territory of which the Organization has its headquarters , it shall be provided that , whenever the working capital fund is insufficient , such country shall grant advances The amount of these advances and the conditions on which they are granted shall be the subject of separate agreements , in each case , between such country and the Organization As long as it remains under the obligation to grant advances , such country shall have an ex officio seat on the Executive Committee
Translation: 7 a 本组织与总部所在国签订的总部协定应规定：当周转资金不足时，该国应提供预付款。此类预付款的金额及发放条件，由该国与本组织在具体情况下另行签订专项协议予以确定。只要该国仍承担提供预付款的义务，其代表应依职权在执行委员会中拥有一个席位。

Query_Text_en: b The country referred to in subparagraph a and the Organization shall each have the right to denounce the obligation to grant advances , by written notification Denunciation shall take effect three years after the end of the year in which it has been notified
Translation: a项所述国家与本组织均有权以书面通知形式声明免除提供预付款之义务。此项声明应自通知发出当年年底起三年后生效。

Query_Text_en: 8 The auditing of the accounts shall be effected by one or more of the countries of the Union or by external auditors , as provided in the financial regulations They shall be designated , with their agreement , by the Assembly
Translation: 根据财务条例规定，账目审计应由本联盟一国或多国或外聘审计师执行。审计人员须经大会任命，且须征得其本人同意。

Query_Text_en: 1 Proposals for the amendment of Articles 22,23,24,25 , and the present Article , may be initiated by any country member of the Assembly , by the Executive Committee , or by the Director General Such proposals shall be communicated by the Director General to the member countries of the Assembly at least six months in advance of their consideration by the Assembly
Translation: 大会成员国、执行委员会或总干事均可提出对第二十二条、第二十三条、第二十四条、第二十五条及本条的修正案。此类修正案应由总干事在大会审议前至少六个月通报各成员国。

Query_Text_en: 2 Amendments to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall be adopted by the Assembly Adoption shall require three fourths of the votes cast , provided that any amendment of Article 22 , and of the present paragraph , shall require four fifths of the votes cast
Translation: 对第1款所述条款的修正案应由大会通过。通过修正案需获得所投票数的四分之三多数，但对第22条及本款的任何修正需获得所投票数的五分之四多数。

Query_Text_en: 3 Any amendment to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall enter into force one month after written notifications of acceptance , effected in accordance with their respective constitutional processes , have been received by the Director General from three fourths of the countries members of the Assembly at the time it adopted the amendment Any amendment to the said Articles thus accepted shall bind all the countries which are members of the Assembly at the time the amendment enters into force , or which become members thereof at a subsequent date , provided that any amendment increasing the financial obligations of countries of the Union shall bind only those countries which have notified their acceptance of such amendment
Translation: 对第一条所述条款的任何修正案，应于总干事收到在修正案通过时为大会成员国的四分之三国家根据其各自宪法程序以书面形式表示接受的通知书后一个月生效。经此方式接受的上述条款修正案，对修正案生效时为大会成员国的所有国家或此后成为大会成员国的国家具有约束力；但任何增加本联盟成员国财务负担的修正案，仅对已通知接受该修正案的国家产生约束力。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall be submitted to revision with a view to the introduction of amendments designed to improve the system of the Union
Translation: 本公约应提交修订，旨在引入旨在完善联盟体系的修正案。

Query_Text_en: 2 For this purpose , conferences shall be held successively in one of the countries of the Union among the delegates of the said countries
Translation: 为此目的，联盟各国代表应轮流在成员国境内召开会议。

Query_Text_en: 3 Subject to the provisions of Article 26 which apply to the amendment of Articles 22 to 26 , any revision of this Act , including the Appendix , shall require the unanimity of the votes cast
Translation: 在遵循适用于第二十二条至第二十六条修订的第二十六条规定的前提下，对本公约（包括附录）所作的任何修订，均需经全体投票一致通过。

Query_Text_en: 1 a Any country of the Union which has signed this Act may ratify it , and , if it has not signed it , may accede to it Instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Director General
Translation: 1 a 本联盟任何成员国若已签署本协定书，可予以批准；若尚未签署，亦可加入。批准书或加入书应递交总干事保存。

Query_Text_en: b Any country of the Union may declare in its instrument of ratification or accession that its ratification or accession shall not apply to Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix , provided that , if such country has previously made a declaration under Article VI 1 of the Appendix , then it may declare in the said instrument only that its ratification or accession shall not apply to Articles 1 to 20
Translation: 任何联盟成员国均可在其批准书或加入书中声明，其批准或加入不适用于第一条至第二十一条及附录。但如该国已根据附录第六条第一款作出声明，则可在上述文件中仅声明其批准或加入不适用于第一条至第二十条。

Query_Text_en: c Any country of the Union which , in accordance with subparagraph b , has excluded provisions therein referred to from the effects of its ratification or accession may at any later time declare that it extends the effects of its ratification or accession to those provisions Such declaration shall be deposited with the Director General
Translation: 根据第b款规定，联盟成员国若已在其批准书或加入书中排除相关条款的适用效力，可在后续任何时间声明将其批准或加入的效力延伸至这些条款。该声明应提交总干事备案。

Query_Text_en: ii France , Spain , the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland , and the United States of America , have become bound by the Universal Copyright Convention as revised at Paris on July 24,1971
Translation: 法国、西班牙、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国以及美利坚合众国均已加入1971年7月24日在巴黎修订的《世界版权公约》。

Query_Text_en: b The entry into force referred to in subparagraph a shall apply to those countries of the Union which , at least three months before the said entry into force , have deposited instruments of ratification or accession not containing a declaration under paragraph 1 b
Translation: a项所述生效日期的效力，应适用于至少在该生效日期前三个月交存批准书或加入书且未根据第1款b项作出声明的本联盟成员国。

Query_Text_en: c With respect to any country of the Union not covered by subparagraph b and which ratifies or accedes to this Act without making a declaration under paragraph 1 b , Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General has notified the deposit of the relevant instrument of ratification or accession , unless a subsequent date has been indicated in the instrument deposited In the latter case , Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix shall enter into force with respect to that country on the date thus indicated
Translation: 对于未适用第二项且批准或加入本议定书时未依据第一款第二项作出声明的任何联盟成员国，若总干事已通知其批准书或加入书的交存，则第一条至第二十一条及附录将于通知之日起三个月后对该国生效，除非交存文书中另行载明后续日期。在此情况下，第一条至第二十一条及附录将于该国指定的日期生效。

Query_Text_en: d The provisions of subparagraphs a to c do not affect the application of Article of the Appendix
Translation: 子项a至c的规定不影响附录第[编号]条的适用。

Query_Text_en: 3 With respect to any country of the Union which ratifies or accedes to this Act with or without a declaration made under paragraph 1 b , Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General has notified the deposit of the relevant instrument of ratification or accession , unless a subsequent date has been indicated in the instrument deposited In the latter case , Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force with respect to that country on the date thus indicated
Translation: 对于批准或加入本议定书的本联盟成员国，无论其是否根据第1款第2项作出声明，第二十二条至第三十八条应于总干事就相关批准书或加入书交存事宜发出通知之日起三个月后生效，除非交存文书中另行载明后续生效日期。在后一种情形下，第二十二条至第三十八条应自该文书载明之日起对该国生效。

Query_Text_en: BOUNDARY TREATY BETWEEN THE PEOPLE 'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA AND THE UNION OF BURMA
Translation: 中华人民共和国和缅甸联邦边界条约

Query_Text_en: Chou En lai Premier of the State Council for the Chairman of the People 's Republic of China andU Nu Prime Minister for the President of the Union of Burma Who having mutually examined their full powers and found them in good and due form have agreed upon the following :
Translation: 中华人民共和国国务院总理周恩来和缅甸联邦总统吴努相互校阅全权证书认为妥善后，议定如下：

Query_Text_en: and the People 's Republic of China agrees to delimit the section of the boundary from the junction of the Nam Hpa and the Nam Ting Rivers to the junction of the Nam Hka and the Nam Yung Rivers in accordance with the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941 with the exception of the adjustments provided for in Articles 2 and 3 of the present Treaty
Translation: 中华人民共和国同意自南帕河与南定河汇合处至南卡江与南永河汇合处之边界段，依照1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文规定进行划界，但本条约第二条及第三条所规定之调整部分除外。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 In view of the relations of equality and friendship between China and Burma the two Parties decide to abrogate the perpetual lease by Burma of the MengMao Triangular area Namwan Assigned Tract which belongs to China
Translation: 第二条 鉴于中缅两国间的平等友好关系，双方决定废除缅甸对中国所属孟卯三角地区（南畹指定区）的永租权。

Query_Text_en: Taking into account the practical needs of the Burmese side the Chinese side agrees to turn over this area measuring about 220 square kilometres 85 square miles and as indicated in the attached map to Burma to become part of the territory of the Union of Burma
Translation: 考虑到缅方的实际需求，中方同意将约220平方公里（85平方英里）的该地区，如附图所示，移交缅甸，作为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。

Query_Text_en: In exchange and having regard for the historical ties and the integrity of the tribes the Burmese side agrees to turn over to China to become part of Chinese territory the areas measuring about 189 square kilometres 73 square miles and as indicated in the attached map under the jurisdiction of the Panhung and Panlao tribes which belong to Burma according to the provision in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941
Translation: 鉴于历史联系与部落完整，缅方同意将根据1941年6月18日中英政府换文规定原属缅甸管辖的班洪、班老部落辖区（面积约189平方公里，合73平方英里，详见附图所示地域）移交中国，作为中国领土的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 For the convenience of administration by each side and having regard for the intratribal relationship and production and livelihood needs of the local inhabitants the two Parties agree to make fair and reasonable adjustments to a small section of the boundary line as defined in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941 by including in China Yawng Hok and Lungnai Villages and including in Burma Umhpa Pan Kung Pan Nawng and Pan Wai Villages so that these boundary line intersected villages will no longer be intersected by the boundary line
Translation: 第三条 为了便于双方行政管理，照顾当地居民的部落关系和生产、生活需要，双方同意对1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文规定的界线中的一小段，作一些公平合理的调整，把中国的羊柏寨、班孔寨和班弄寨划入缅甸，把缅甸的班歪寨、班外寨、班个寨划入中国，使这些骑线村寨不再被边界线所分割。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 The Chinese Government in line with its consistent policy of opposing foreign prerogatives and respecting the sovereignty of other countries renounces China 's right of participation in mining enterprises at Lufang of Burma as provided in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941
Translation: 第四条 中国政府一贯反对外国特权、尊重他国主权，现根据1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文规定，放弃对缅甸掸邦炉房地区矿产企业的参与权。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 The Contracting Parties agree that the section of the boundary from the High Conical Peak to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary with the exception of the area of Hpimaw Gawlum and Kangfang shall be fixed along the traditional customary line i e from the High Conical Peak northwards along the watershed between the Taping the Shweli and the Nu Rivers and the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other to a point on the south bank of the Tulung Taron River west of Western Chingdam Village thence across the Tulung Taron River and then further along the watershed between the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village and the Tsayul Zayul River on the one hand and all the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River excluding the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the other to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary
Translation: 第五条　缔约双方同意，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，从尖高山到中缅边界西端终点的全部未定界，按照传统习惯线定界，具体而言，即从尖高山起向北沿着恩梅开江（即伊洛瓦底江上游东侧最大支流）与萨尔温江（即怒江）之间的分水岭，以及恩梅开江支流独龙江上游与迪楚河（Tsayul Zayul River）之间的分水岭，直至中缅边界西端终点为止。具体走向为：从尖高山向北沿太平江、瑞丽江、怒江与独龙江上游西岸支流（不含西靖打村以西的独龙江上游河段）和恩梅开江的分水岭，至西靖打村以西独龙江南岸的一点；由此横跨独龙江，再沿西靖打村以西独龙江上游河段与迪楚河的分水岭，以及除西靖打村以西独龙江上游河段外伊洛瓦底江全部上游支流的分水岭，直至中缅边界西端终点。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 The Contracting Parties affirm that the two sections of the boundary from the High Conical Peak to the junction of the Nam Hpa and the Nam Ting Rivers and from the junction of the Nam Hka and the Nam Yung Rivers to the southeastern extremity of the SinoBurmese boundary at the junction of the Nam La and the Lanchang Mekong Rivers were already delimited in the past and require no change the boundary being as delineated in the maps attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 第六条 缔约双方确认，从高黎贡山（雪山）到南帕河与南定河汇合处以及从南卡江与南永河汇合处到南腊河与澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处的中缅边界南端止的两段边界，过去已经划定，无需更改，界线如本条约附图所示。

Query_Text_en: 1 From the High Conical Peak Mu Lang Pum Manang Pure the line runs northwards then southeastwards and then northeastwards along the watershed between the Taping River Ta Ying Chiang the Lung Chuan Chiang Shweli and the Nu Salween River on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Shuei Cheng Machyi Chet Pass Panwa Pass Tasamin Shan Hpare Yemawlaunggu Hkyet Pass and Chitsu Lagwi Pass to the source of the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho
Translation: 自高锥康峰穆朗普曼南普尔起，界线向北延伸，继而转向东南，再折向东北，沿分水岭而行。该分水岭一侧为太平江（大盈江）、龙川江（瑞丽江）及怒江（萨尔温江），另一侧为恩梅开江。界线途经水城、马赤垭口、潘瓦山口、塔萨明山、帕雷、耶茂隆古、克耶山口及吉祖拉圭山口，最终抵达楚依大河（楚依霍大河）源头。

Query_Text_en: 2 From the source of the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho the line runs northwestwards along the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho to its junction with its tributary flowing in from the north thence northwards along this tributary to a point on the watershed between the tributaries of the Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung River on the one hand and the Wang Ke Moku Kyaung River and its tributary the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho on the other thence westwards along this watershed passing through Ma Chu Lo Waddy height 2423 metres 7950 feet thence northwards till it crosses the Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung River west of Hpimaw Village ; thence northwards along the ridge passing through Luksang Bum and crossing the Gan Kang Hao River to reach the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River ; thence westwards along the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River to its junction with the Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka River ; thence northwards up the Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka River to its junction with the Ta Hpawte Hpawte Kyaung River
Translation: 界线自楚衣大河（楚衣塔河）源头起，沿楚衣大河（楚衣塔河）向西北行至其北侧支流汇合处，继而沿该支流向北延伸，直至分水岭上某点——该分水岭一侧为匹莫河（平央江）支流，另一侧为旺克莫古河及其支流楚衣大河（楚衣塔河）；由此沿分水岭西行，经马楚洛洼地（海拔2423米，即7950英尺），继续北行穿越匹莫村西侧的匹莫河（平央江）；复沿山脊北行，经卢康山并横跨甘康豪河，抵达乌忠瓦索河；继而沿乌忠瓦索河西行至其与小江（敖昌卡河）交汇处；再溯小江（敖昌卡河）北上，直至与大泡特河（泡特江）汇流点。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs north of Kangfang Village generally eastwards and then southeastwards along the watershed between the Hsiao Hpawte Hpawshi Kyaung River and the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River on the one hand and the Ta Hpawte Hpawte Kyaung River on the other to a point on the watershed between the Nu Salween and the Nmai Hka Rivers
Translation: 界线由此沿岗房村以北向东延伸，继而转向东南，沿小泡特泡西卡河与乌弄瓦索卡河同大泡特泡特卡河之间的分水岭前行，直至抵达怒江（萨尔温江）与恩梅开江分水岭上的一点。

Query_Text_en: 3 From the above mentioned point on the watershed between the Nu Salween and the Nmai Hka Rivers the line runs generally northwards along the watershed between the Nu Salween River and the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Kia Ngo Tu Sajyang Pass Sala Pass Ming Ke Nahke Pass Ni Chi Ku Gi Gi Thara Pass Kawchi Thara Pass Jongit L'ka and Maguchi Pass ; thence the line continues to run northwards and then generally westwards passing through Alang L'ka Mawa L'ka Pang Tang Shan Pumtang Razi Lonlang L'ka Hkora Razi to Tusehpong Razi
Translation: 自上述怒江（萨尔温江）与恩梅开江分水岭之点起，界线大体向北行，沿怒江（萨尔温江）与土龙塔隆河上游（位于西钦达姆村以西段）之分水岭，以及恩梅开江之分水岭，穿越基亚俄都萨江山口、沙拉山口、明克纳克山口、尼赤库吉吉塔拉山口、考赤塔拉山口、琼吉拉卡山口及马古奇山口；继而界线继续北行后大体西转，经阿朗拉卡山口、马瓦拉卡山口、庞当山、蓬唐拉兹山、隆朗拉卡山口、霍拉拉兹山，直至图塞蓬拉兹山。

Query_Text_en: 4 From Tusehpong Razi the line runs generally northwestwards along the ridge passing through height 2892 metres and height 2140 3 metres to a point on the south bank of the Tulung Taron River west of Western Chingdam Village Thence it crosses the Tulung Taron River to its junction with its tributary on its northern bank and thence northwestwards along the ridge to Kundam Razi Lungawng Hpong
Translation: 从图西朋拉齐起，界线大体向西北沿山脊而行，经过高程2892米和高程2140.3米处，至位于西金当村以西的图龙塔隆河南岸一点。随后界线横跨图龙塔隆河，至该河与其北岸支流交汇处，继而向西北沿山脊行至昆当拉齐隆岗蓬。

Query_Text_en: 5 From Kundam Razi Lungawng Hpong the line runs generally northwards and northwestwards along the watershed between the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the one hand and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River [ excluding the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village ] on the other passing through Thala Pass Sungya Amansan L'ka to Yulang Pass
Translation: 自昆冬拉子隆岗蓬起，界线大体向北及西北方向延伸，沿图龙塔隆河上游段（不含西钦丹村以上河段）与伊洛瓦底江支流上游（不含西钦丹村以上图龙塔隆河段）之间的分水岭，经塔拉山口、松亚阿曼桑勒卡，至尤朗山口。

Query_Text_en: 6 From Yulang Pass the line runs generally southwestwards along the watershed between the Tsayul Zayul River on the one hand and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River on the other passing through Gamlang L'ka to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary
Translation: 自玉朗山口起，界线大体向西南方向延伸，沿察隅河与伊洛瓦底江上游支流之间的分水岭，经甘朗拉卡至中缅边界西端终点。

Query_Text_en: 1 From the High Conical Peak the line runs generally southwestwards along the watershed between the upper tributaries of the Taping River the Mong Ka Hka and the upper tributaries of the Ta Pa Chiang Tabak Hka Rivers on the one hand and the lower tributaries of the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Ta Ya Kou Lunghkyen Hkyet and thence northwestwards to Hsiao Chueh Pass Tabak Hku Hkyet
Translation: 自高锥山起，界线大体向西南行，沿分水岭将塔宾河、蒙戛河等上游支流与南迈河下游支流分开，途经大哑口、隆肯隘，继而转向西北至小雀隘（塔巴克河隘）。

Query_Text_en: 2 From Hsiao Chueh Pass Tabak Hku Hkyet the line runs down the Ta Pa Chiang Tabak Hka the Mong Ka Hka and up the Shih Tzu Paknoi Hka River the upper stretch of which is known as the Hkatong Hka River to its source
Translation: 自小雀丫口起，界线顺大坝江、大坝卡河、勐戛卡河而上，至石茨柏诺依卡河源头（该河上游称卡同卡河）。

Query_Text_en: 3 From the source of the Shih Tzu Paknoi Hka River the line runs southwestwards and then westwards along the watershed between the Monglai Hka on the one hand and the Pajao Hka the Ma Li Ka River and the Nan Shan Namsang Hka River on the other to the source of the Laisa Stream
Translation: 自什秋帕克诺卡河源头起，界线沿分水岭向西南延伸，继而转向西行，一侧为蒙莱卡河，另一侧为帕交卡河、马利卡河及南杉南桑卡河，直至抵达莱萨溪源头。
