Query_Text_en: 2 ] If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding . If the Aeronautical Authorities fail to reach agreement the matter shall be submitted to the Contracting Parties which shall endeavor to settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如对本协定之解释或实施发生任何分歧，缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作与相互谅解之精神，通过直接协商予以解决。若航空当局未能达成一致，则该事项应提交缔约双方通过外交途径协商解决。

Query_Text_en: Article XIX AMENDMENTS1 ] If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to amend any provision of the present Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party . Such consultation , which may be between the Aeronautical Authorities and which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十九条 修正案  
若缔约任何一方认为有必要对本协定或其附件的任何条款进行修改，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。此项协商可由双方航空当局参与，通过会谈或信函方式进行，并应于缔约另一方收到请求之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Any amendment to the present Agreement or its Annex shall come into force when they have been confirmed by exchange of diplomatic notes between the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本协定及其附件的任何修正，应经缔约双方以外交换文确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article XX ANNEXThe Annex to the present Agreement and the notes exchanged in connection hereto shall be an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation:
第二十条 附件  
本协定之附件及与之相关之换文应构成本协定不可分割之组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article XXI TERMINATIONEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation:
第二十一条  终止  
任何一方缔约方均可随时通知另一方缔约方终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: Article XXII ENTRY INTO FORCEThe present Agreement shall come into force from the date of its signature .
Translation:
第二十二条  生效  
本协定自签署之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof , the undersigned , being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed the present Agreement .
Translation: 兹证明，下列签署人经各自政府正式授权，签署本协定。

Query_Text_en: Done at Peking on this 18th day of May 1973 in duplicate in the English and Chinese languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七三年五月十八日订于北京，一式两份，每份都用英文和中文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Points in China intermediate points to be agreed upon by the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties Copenhagen and\/or another point in Denmark to be agreed upon between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties-points beyond to be agreed upon by the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties . II Rights of OmissionThe aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties operating the agreed services on their respective specified routes may omit calling at any intermediate point and point beyond .
Translation:
中国境内地点：由缔约双方航空当局商定的中间点。  
哥本哈根和/或丹麦境内其他地点：由缔约双方航空当局共同商定。  
以远地点：由缔约双方航空当局商定。  

二、 航线经停权  
缔约双方指定航空公司在经营协议航班时，可自行选择不飞越其规定航线中的任何中间点或以远点。

Query_Text_en: III Additional FlightsIn case the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operate additional flights on the specified route , it shall , under normal circumstances , submit a request to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party forty eight hours before the departure of the aircraft in question , and the flight can be commenced only after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation:
三、加班飞行  
如缔约任何一方指定航空公司拟在协议航线上经营加班飞行，通常应于该航班起飞前四十八小时向缔约另一方航空当局提交申请，获准后方可执行。

Query_Text_en: 1 ] the term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in the case of the Kingdom of Nor way , the Directorate of Civil Aviation , and in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , or in both cases any person or body authorized to perform functions in connection with the present Agreement ;
Translation: “航空当局”一词，就挪威王国而言，指民航局；就中华人民共和国而言，指中国民用航空总局；或就双方而言，指任何获授权执行本协定相关职能的个人或机构。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] the term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one State ;
Translation: "国际航空服务"指飞越一个以上国家领土上空空域的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: 6 ] the term `` stop for non traffic purposes '' means a stop for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo and mail ;
Translation: "非交通目的停靠"指除上下客、装卸行李货物及邮件外的任何停靠行为。

Query_Text_en: Article II TRAFFIC RIGHTS1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified route '' ] .
Translation:
第二条 航权  
一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件（以下简称"规定航线"）上建立和经营定期航班（以下简称"协议航班"）的权利。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , grant without delay to the designated airline of the first Contracting Party the appropriate operating authorization .
Translation: 三、收到上述指定通知后，缔约另一方应根据本条第二款规定，立即向缔约一方指定航空公司颁发相应的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: Each Contract Lug party shall supply the other Contracting Party information relevant to the above mentioned laws and regulations in time .
Translation: 缔约各方应及时向对方提供与上述法律法规相关的信息。

Query_Text_en: Article VI EXEMPTION FROM CUSTOMS AND OTHER DUTIES1 ] Aircraft operated on the specified route by the designated airline of either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores retained on board the aircraft shah be exempt on a basis of reciprocity from any customs duties , inspection fees and other duties and taxes by the other Contracting Party on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第六条 关税及其他税费的免除  
一、缔约一方指定航空企业在规定航线上使用的航空器及其留置在机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油及机上供应品，在进出缔约另一方领土时，缔约另一方应在互惠基础上免除其关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: c ] fuel and lubricants destined to supply aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board
Translation: 二）为缔约另一方指定空运企业经营国际航班服务的飞机所装载的燃料和润滑油，即使这些物资在飞机飞越缔约一方领土航段上使用。

Query_Text_en: Article VII STORAGE OF AIRBORNE EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIESThe regular airborne equipment , as well as the materials and supplies retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第七条 航空器设备与物资的存储  
缔约一方指定航空运输企业所属航空器上的常规机载设备、物料及储备物资，须经缔约另一方海关当局批准，方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII PROVISION OF TECHNICAL SERVICES AND RATE OF CHARGES1 ] Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airports and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第八条 技术服务与收费标准

一、缔约各方应在本国领土内指定供对方缔约方指定航空公司经营规定航线所使用的定期航班机场和备降机场，并向该航空公司提供其经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他附属服务。

Query_Text_en: The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall consult each other on the modalities of their respective services .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司应就各自航班的运营模式进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall bear close relationship to the requirements of the public for transportation on the specified routes and shall have as their primary objective the provision of capacity adequate to satisfy the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司提供的协议航班服务，应与指定航线上的公众运输需求密切相关，其首要目标在于提供充足运力，以满足当前及合理预期的运输需求。该运输需求涉及旅客、行李、货物及邮件的运输，且其始发地或目的地应为指定该航空公司的缔约方领土。

Query_Text_en: 5 ] If the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph 4 of this Article , the difference of opinion shall be settled through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如缔约双方航空当局未能就本条第三款提交的任何运价达成协议，或未能根据本条第四款确定任何运价，双方意见分歧应通过外交途径解决。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , a tariff shall not be pro longed by virtue of this paragraph for more than twelve months after the date on which it otherwise would have expired .
Translation: 然而，依据本款规定延长关税的期限不得超过原定到期日后的十二个月。

Query_Text_en: Article XI FINANCIAL PROVISIONSEither Contracting Party shall grant the other Contracting Party free transfer , at the official rate of exchange , of the excess of receipts over expenditure achieved on its territory in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十一条  财务规定  
缔约任何一方应准许缔约另一方指定空运企业在其领土内经营国际旅客、行李、货物及邮件运输所得收入扣除支出后的盈余，按官方汇率自由汇出。

Query_Text_en: Article XIII REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES1 ] For the operation of the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative offices at the points of call on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十三条  代表机构  
一、为经营协议航线，缔约各方指定空运企业有权在对方缔约方领土内的航线通航地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative offices shall be citizens of the Kingdom of Norway and of the People 's Republic of China , and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该等代表处的工作人员应为挪威王国和中华人民共和国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并须经缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: a ] certificate of registration , b ] certificate of airworthiness , c ] journey log sheet , d ] aircraft radio station licence , e ] licences or certificates for each member of the crew , f ] if passengers are carried , list of passengers giving the places of their departure and destination , g ] if cargo and mail are carried , manifest of cargo and mail , h ] general declaration in conformity with international standard , if required by either Contracting Party , i ] necessary permits if the aircraft carries any cargo subjected to restriction under the regulation of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
a] 注册证书；  
b] 适航证书；  
c] 航行日志；  
d] 航空无线电台执照；  
e] 机组人员执照或证书；  
f] 如载有乘客，须提供乘客名单（列明起降地点）；  
g] 如载有货物及邮件，须提供货邮舱单；  
h] 根据任一缔约方要求提供的符合国际标准的总申报单；  
i] 如航空器载有限制性货物，须提供另一缔约方规定的必要许可文件。

Query_Text_en: Article XVI NATIONALITY OF CREWThe crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying on the specified route shall be citizens of their respective countries .
Translation:
第十六条 机组国籍  
缔约一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的机组人员，应为该缔约方本国公民。

Query_Text_en: a ] inform by fastest means the first Contracting Party , b ] protect evidences and secure the safety of the aircraft and its contents , c ] carry out investigation into the accident , d ] permit the representatives of the first Contracting Party access to the aircraft and participation in the investigation as observers , e ] release the aircraft and its contents as soon as they are no longer necessary for the investigation , f ] communicate in writing to the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation:
a）以最快捷方式通知第一缔约方；  
b）保护证据并确保航空器及其载运物品安全；  
c）开展事故调查；  
d）允许第一缔约方代表以观察员身份接触航空器并参与调查；  
e）航空器及其载运物品如无需继续用于调查应立即放行；  
f）将调查结果以书面形式通报第一缔约方航空主管部门。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIII CONSULTATIONS AND SETTLEMENT OF DIFFERENCES OF OPINION1 ] In a spirit of close cooperation , the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties shall consult each other from time to time with a view to ensuring the implementation of , and satisfactory compliance with , the provisions of the present Agreement and the Annex thereto .
Translation:
第十八条 协商及争议解决  
缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神，为确保本协定及其附件条款的实施与妥善遵守，定期进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding . If the Aeronautical Authorities fail to reach agreement the matter shall be submitted to the Contracting Parties which shall endeavor to settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如对本协定之解释或实施发生任何分歧，缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作与相互谅解之精神，通过直接协商予以解决。若航空当局未能达成一致，则该事项应提交缔约双方通过外交途径协商解决。

Query_Text_en: Article XIX AMENDMENTSIf either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to ' amend any provision of the present Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party . Such consultation , which may be between the Aeronautical Authorities and which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十九条 协议修订  
若缔约任何一方认为有必要对本协议或其附件的任何条款进行修订，可随时要求与另一方进行磋商。此类磋商可由双方航空主管机构直接开展，通过会谈或信函方式进行，并应于另一方收到请求之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Article XX ANNEXThe Annex to the present Agreement and the notes exchanged in connection here to shall be an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation:
附件XX 附件  
本协定附件及与之相关的换文应构成本协定的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article XXI TERMINATIONEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement , The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第二十一条 终止  
任何一方缔约方可随时通知另一方缔约方终止本协定之意愿。本协定应于另一方缔约方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止。

Query_Text_en: If the above notice is withdrawn before the expiry of this period , the pre sent Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 若上述通知在本协议期满前撤销，经另一缔约方同意，本协议应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Done at Peking on this 12th day of May 1973 in duplicate in the English and Chinese languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七三年五月十二日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用英文和中文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: II Right Of OmissionThe aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties operating the agreed services on their respective specified routes may omit calling at any intermediate point and point beyond .
Translation:
第二条 航线经停点省略权
缔约双方指定航空公司在规定航线上经营协议航班时，可自行决定不飞越任何中间点或以远点。

Query_Text_en: III Additional FlightsIn case the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operate additional flights on the specified route , it shall , under normal circumstances , submit a re quest to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party forty eight hours before the departure of the aircraft in question , and the flight can be commenced only after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation:
三、加班飞行  
如缔约任何一方指定航空公司拟在协议航线上经营加班飞行，正常情况下应于该航班起飞前四十八小时向缔约另一方航空当局提交申请，获准后方可执行飞行。

Query_Text_en: 1 ] the term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in the case of the Kingdom of Sweden , the Board of Civil Aviation , and in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , or in both cases any person or body authorized to perform functions in connection with the present Agreement ;
Translation: “航空当局”一词，就瑞典王国而言指民航委员会，就中华人民共和国而言指中国民用航空总局；或双方任何经授权执行本协定相关职能的个人或机构。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE II TRAFFIC RIGHTS1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified route '' ] .
Translation:
第二条 航权  
缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件（以下简称"规定航线"）上建立和经营定期航班（以下简称"协议航班"）的权利。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE III DESIGNATION OF AIRLINE AND OPERATING AUTHORIZATION1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate , by diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party , one airline to operate the agreed services on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement .
Translation:
第三条 指定航空企业及经营许可  
缔约任何一方有权通过外交照会通知另一方，指定一家航空企业运营本协定附件规定航线上的协议航班。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE V COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS AND REGULATIONS1 ] The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第五条  遵守法律法规  
一、缔约任何一方关于从事国际航空运输业务的航空器进出、停留、飞越其领土的法律法规，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出、停留其领土的法律法规，在缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器及其机组、所载旅客、行李、货物和邮件处于该缔约一方领土内时，应同样适用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE VI EXEMPTION FROM CUSTOMS AND OTHER DUTIES1 ] Aircraft operated on the specified route by the designated airline of either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores retained on board the aircraft shall be exempt on a basis of reciprocity from any customs duties , inspection fees and other duties and taxes by the other Contracting Party on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第六条 关税及其他税费豁免  
一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航线所使用的航空器，以及留置在航空器上的正常设备、零备件、燃油、润滑油、机上供应品，在进出缔约另一方领土时，基于互惠原则，应免纳缔约另一方征收的任何关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: c ] fuel and lubricants destined to supply aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 另一缔约方指定航空公司经营国际航班所需燃料及润滑油，即使该等物资将在装载地缔约方领空航段使用，亦应免除相关税费。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE VII STORAGE OF AIRBORNE EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIESThe regular airborne equipment , as well as the materials and supplies retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第七条 航空器材与物资的存储  
任一缔约方指定航空公司的常规航空器材及留存于航空器上的物资与补给，须经另一缔约方海关当局批准，方可在该缔约方领土内卸下。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE VIII PROVISION OF TECHNICAL SERVICES AND RATE OF CHARGES1 ] Each Contracting Party shall designated in its territory regular airport and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and provided the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第八条  技术服务与收费标准

一、缔约一方应在本国境内指定供缔约另一方指定航空公司经营协议航线所使用的定期航班机场和备降机场，并向该航空公司提供其经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE IX CAPACITY PROVISIONS1 ] The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation:
第九条  运力规定  
缔约双方指定航空公司在规定航线上经营协议航班时，应享有公平与均等的机会。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE X ESTABLISHMENT OF TARIFFS1 ] The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit and the tariffs of other airlines .
Translation:
第十条 运价制定  
一、缔约一方指定航空公司在往返缔约另一方领土运输中所征收的运价，应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑所有相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润及其他航空公司的运价标准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XI FINANCIAL PROVISIONSEither Contracting Party shall grant the other Contracting Party free transfer , at the official rate of exchange , of the excess of receipts over expenditure achieved on its territory in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十一条  财务规定  
缔约一方应准许缔约另一方指定空运企业在其领土内经营旅客、行李、货物和邮件运输所获收入扣除支出后的盈余，按官方汇率自由汇出。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XII PROVISION OF STATISTICSThe Aeronautical Authorities of each Contracting Party shall supply to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistics relevant to the traffic to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party carried on the agreed services of the designated airline of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十二条  统计资料的提供  
任一缔约方的航空当局应根据另一缔约方航空当局的要求，向其提供与本协定航班相关的统计数据。该统计数据涉及第一缔约方指定航空公司在协议航班上承运的往来于另一缔约方领土的运输业务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XIII REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES1 ] For the operation of the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative offices at the points of call on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十三 条 代表机构一、为经营协议航线，缔约各方指定空运企业有权在对方缔约方领土内规定航线上的通航地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative offices shall be citizens of the Kingdom of Sweden and of the People 's Republic of China , and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该等代表处的工作人员应为瑞典王国和中华人民共和国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并须经缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XIV SECURITY OF AIRLINE OPERATIONSEach Contracting Party shall endeavor to safeguard , to the extent possible , the security of airline operations within its territory .
Translation:
第十四条  航空运营安全  
缔约各方应在其领土范围内，尽最大努力保障航空运营安全。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XV DOCUMENTS1 ] The aircraft operated by the designated airline of each Contracting Party on the agreed services shall bear the nationality and registration marks of such Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十五条  文件资料  
缔约一方指定航空公司在协议航线上运营的航空器，应标有该缔约方的国籍标志和登记标志。

Query_Text_en: a ] certificate of registration , b ] certificate of airworthiness , c ] journey log sheet , d ] aircraft radio station licence , e ] licences or certificates for each member of the crew , f ] if passengers are carried , list of passengers , giving the places of their departure and destination , g ] if cargo and mail are carried , manifest of cargo and mail , h ] general declaration in conformity with international standard , if required by either Contracting Party , i ] necessary permits if the aircraft carries any cargo subjected to restriction under the regulation of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
a] 注册证书；  
b] 适航证书；  
c] 飞行记录单；  
d] 航空器无线电台执照；  
e] 机组人员执照或证书；  
f] 如载有乘客，须提供乘客名单（列明起降地点）；  
g] 如载有货物及邮件，须提供货邮舱单；  
h] 根据任一缔约方要求提交符合国际标准的总申报单；  
i] 如航空器载有限制性货物，须提交另一缔约方规定的必要许可文件。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XVI NATIONALITY OF CREWThe crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying on the specified route shall be citizens of their respective countries .
Translation:
第十六条 机组国籍  
缔约一方指定航空公司在规定航线上飞行的机组人员，应为该缔约方本国公民。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XVII ACCIDENTS AND EMERGENCIES1 ] Should an aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party experience an accident or an emergency in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the latter Party shall immediately provide necessary search , rescue and assistance to the aircraft as well as its crew and passengers .
Translation:
第十七条  事故与紧急情况  
若缔约一方指定航空公司的航空器在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或紧急情况，后者应立即为该航空器及其机组人员、乘客提供必要的搜寻、救援与协助。

Query_Text_en: a ] inform by fastest means the first Contracting Party , b ] protect evidences and secure the safety of the aircraft and its contents , c ] carry out investigation into the accident , d ] permit the representatives of the first Contracting Party access to the aircraft and participation in the investigations as observers , e ] release the aircraft and its contents as soon as they are no longer necessary for the investigation , f ] communicate in writing to the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation:
a）以最快捷方式通知第一缔约方；  
b）保护证据并确保航空器及其载运物品安全；  
c）开展事故调查；  
d）允许第一缔约方代表以观察员身份接触航空器并参与调查；  
e）航空器及其载运物品如无需继续用于调查应立即放行；  
f）将调查结果以书面形式通报第一缔约方航空主管部门。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XVIII CONSULTATIONS AND SETTLEMENT OF DIFFERENCES OF OPINION1 ] In a spirit of close cooperation , the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties shall consult each other from time to time with a view to ensuring the implementation of , and satisfactory compliance with , the provisions of the present Agreement and the Annex thereto .
Translation:
第十八条  协商及争议解决  
缔约双方航空当局本着密切合作之精神，应就本协定及其附件条款的实施与遵守情况定期磋商，以确保协定条款得以切实履行并获得令人满意的遵守效果。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XIX AMENDMENTSIf either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to amend any provision of the present Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party . Such consultation , which may be between the Aeronautical Authorities and which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十九条 修正  
若缔约任何一方认为有必要对本协定或其附件的任何条款进行修正，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。此项协商可由双方航空当局进行，可通过会谈或信函方式开展，并应于缔约另一方收到请求之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XX ANNEXThe Annex to the present Agreement and the notes exchanged in connection hereto shall be an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation:
第二十条 附件  
本协定附件及与之相关的换文为本协定不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XXI TERMINATIONEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation:
第二十一条  终止  
任何一方缔约方均可随时通知另一方缔约方终止本协定之意愿。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE XXII ENTRY INTO FORCEThe present Agreement shall come into force from the date of its signature .
Translation:
第二十二条  生效  
本协定自签署之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Done at Peking on this 1st day of June 1973 in duplicate in the English and Chinese languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七三年六月一日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用英文和中文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: II Right of OmissionThe aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties operating the agreed services on their respective specified routes may omit calling at any intermediate point and point beyond .
Translation:
第二条 航线经停权
缔约双方指定航空公司在规定航线上经营协议航班时，可自行决定不飞越任何中间点或以远点。

Query_Text_en: III Additional FlightsIn case the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to operated additional flights on the specified route , it shall , under normal circumstances , submit a request to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party forty eight hours before the departure of the aircraft in question , and the flight can be commenced only after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation:
三、加班飞行  
如缔约任何一方指定航空公司拟在协议航线上经营加班飞行，通常应于该航班起飞前四十八小时向缔约另一方航空当局提交申请，获准后方可执行。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the route to be agreed upon and confirmed by an exchange of diplomatic notes between the two Contracting Parties [ the route and diplomatic notes shall hereinafter be respectively referred to as `` the specified route '' and `` the Exchange of Notes on Route Schedule '' ] .
Translation:
第十一条  缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本条规定的航线[1]上经营协议航班[2]的权利。该航线应由缔约双方通过外交照会商定并确认[3]（以下分别简称"规定航线"和"航线表外交照会"）。

[1] 此处采用"航线"而非"路线"的译法，更符合航空运输协定文本惯例
[2] "the agreed services"译为"协议航班"是国际航空协定的标准译法
[3] 将被动语态"to be agreed upon and confirmed"转化为主动语态"商定并确认"，符合中文表达习惯

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of the present Agreement , aircraft of the airline designated by each Contracting Party [ hereinafter referred to as `` the designated airline '' ] operating on the agreed services over the specified route shall have the right to make stops at the point on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of putting down or taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail coming from or destined for the territory of the first Contracting Party as well as that coming from or destined for the intermediate points between the territories of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 二、在不违反本协定规定的前提下，缔约各方指定的航空公司（以下简称"指定航空公司"）经营协议航班的飞机，在飞行规定航线时，有权在另一方领土内规定航线上的地点作非运输业务性经停，以便上下来自或前往指定一方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件，以及来自或前往缔约双方领土间中途地点的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Parties not later than sixty days in advance of the date of the commencement of operation of the agreed services by its designated airline .
Translation: 3. 各缔约方应不迟于其指定航空公司商定航班开航之日前六十天，将开航日期通知其他缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate one airline to operate the agreed services on the route specified by the Exchange of Notes on Route Schedule and shall notify the other Contracting Party of such designation through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 第二条 一、缔约任何一方有权指定一家航空公司在航线换文规定的航线上经营协议航班，并应通过外交途径将其指定通知缔约另一方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . On receipt of such notification , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , grant without delay to designated airline of the first Contracting Party the appropriate operation permission .
Translation: 三、收到上述通知后，在不违反本条第二款规定的前提下，缔约另一方应立即向缔约一方指定航空公司颁发相应的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The airline designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 of this Article may begin to operate the agreed services provided that tariffs established in accordance with the provisions of Article 8 of the present Agreement are in force in respect of those services .
Translation: 根据本条第一、二、三款规定指定并获授权的航空公司，在符合本协定第八条所定运价条款的情况下，即可开始经营协议航班。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless immediate revocation , suspension or imposition of conditions mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws and regulations , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 二、除非为防止进一步违反法律法规而必须立即撤销、中止许可或附加第一款所述条件，否则该项权利应在与另一缔约方协商后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and operation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the of operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 第四条  缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的航空器进出其国境、在其境内停留及运行的法律法规，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境及在其境内停留的法律法规，适用于缔约另一方指定航空公司的航空器、该航空器所载机组人员以及旅客、行李、货物和邮件在缔约一方国境内时。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 1 . Aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of the either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , supplies of fuel and lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] retained on board such aircraft shall be exempt from all customs duties applicable to the importation , exportation or transit of goods , inspection fees and other similar charges on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided that such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported or are used on part of the journey performed over that territory ;
Translation: 第五条 一、缔约一方指定空运企业为经营协议航班而飞入缔约另一方领土的航空器，以及留置在该航空器上的正常设备、零备件、燃油、润滑油和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草等），在进入或离开缔约另一方领土时，应豁免所有适用于货物进出口或过境的关税、检验费及其他类似费用。但此项豁免应以留置在航空器上的设备和供应品在重新运出前或在该领土上空航段使用前为限。

Query_Text_en: c ] fuel and lubricants destined to supply outbound aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 另一方缔约方指定航空公司在协议航班运营中所需的燃料与润滑油，即使这些物资将在其装载地缔约方领土上空航段使用，亦应免征税费。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The regular airborne equipment , as well as the materials and supplies retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party as well as those temporarily brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval by the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 3. 缔约任何一方指定航空器的机上日常设备、留存物资及补给品，以及临时运入缔约另一方领土的上述物品，非经缔约另一方海关当局批准，不得在缔约另一方领土内卸下。

Query_Text_en: In such case , they shall be placed under the supervision of the said authorities and shall not be sold or used for other purposes in the above territory until such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations .
Translation: 在此情况下，上述货物应置于海关监管之下，不得在该关境内销售或移作他用，直至其按海关规定复运出境或以其他方式处置完毕。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airport and alternate airport to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 第六条 一、缔约一方应在本国领土内指定供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线所使用的机场（包括正常机场和备降机场），并向该空运企业提供其境内经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他附属服务。

Query_Text_en: Detailed arrangements for the above shall be agreed upon between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties . [ For the purpose of the present Agreement , the term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in case of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , and in case of the Federal Republic of Germany , the Federal Minister of Transport .
Translation: 上述事宜的具体安排应由缔约双方航空当局协商确定。[本协定中，"航空当局"一词，在中国方面指中国民用航空总局，在德意志联邦共和国方面指联邦交通部长。]

Query_Text_en: ] 2 . The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airport [ s ] , equipment , technical services and air navigational facilities of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司使用缔约另一方机场、设备、技术服务及航空导航设施时，其收费标准应按照缔约另一方主管部门制定的公平合理费率执行。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those normally paid by airlines of the other States .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于其他缔约国航空公司通常支付的费率标准。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 1 . The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第七条 一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时，应享有公正平等的运营机会。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Matters relating to the operation of the specified routes such as frequency , type of aircraft , timetable , sales representation and ground handling shall be agreed upon through discussion between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 3. 关于指定航线的运营事宜，包括航班频次、机型、时刻表、销售代理及地面服务等，应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Frequencies , type of aircraft as well as timetable so agreed shall be subject to the approval of their respective Aeronautical Authorities .
Translation: 双方议定的航班班次、机型及班期时刻表应提交各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: andc ] The requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 直达航班运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 1 . In the following paragraphs , the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary services , but excluding remuneration or conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation: 第八条第1款  下列各款中，"运价"指运输旅客、行李和货物所应支付的价格以及适用这些价格的条件，包括代理和其他辅助服务的价格和条件，但不包括运输邮件的报酬或条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs to be applied on the specified on the specified routes between the territory of one Contracting Party and that of the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 2. 缔约双方指定空运企业经营的任一缔约方领土至另一缔约方领土规定航线的运价，应由双方指定空运企业协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Such tariffs shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit and the tariffs of the other airlines .
Translation: 此类运价的制定应在合理水平上，同时适当考虑所有相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润及其他航空公司的运价标准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The tariffs so agreed shall be submitted for the approval of the respective Aeronautical Authorities at least sixty days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 双方商定的运价应至少在拟实施日期六十天前提交各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If a tariff can not be agreed in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article , or if , during the period applicable in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article , the Aeronautical Authorities of one Contracting Party give the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party notice of their disapproval of any tariff agreed in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 , the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariff by mutual agreement .
Translation: 四、如双方未能根据本条第二款议定运价，或在第三款规定的适用期限内，一方航空当局向另一方航空当局发出通知，表示其不认可根据第二款规定所议定的任何运价，则缔约双方航空当局应通过协商共同确定该运价。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph 4 of this Article , the difference of opinion shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 13 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就本条第三款提交的任何运价达成协议，或未能根据本条第四款确定任何运价，其分歧应依照本协定第十三条之规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The tariff to be applied on the specified route between one Contracting Party and third countries shall be the tariffs approved by this Contracting Party and the government of the respective third country .
Translation: 7. 缔约一方与第三国在指定航线上适用的运价，应为该缔约方与相应第三国政府共同批准的运价。

Query_Text_en: Article 9The Revenue derived from the transportation of international traffic by the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be permitted to be transferred , at the official rate of exchange , by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第九条  
缔约一方指定航空公司在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输业务所得收入，应准予按官方汇率汇出。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 1 . For the operation of the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative office at the point of call on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十条 一、为经营规定航线，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的通航地点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office shall be subject to the approval of the other Contracting Parity and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through discussion between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该代表处工作人员应经缔约另一方批准，其人数由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定，并须经缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office must observe the laws and regulations in the country where such office is located .
Translation: 该代表处工作人员须遵守驻在国法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to ensure the safety of the aircraft , stores and other properties in its territory used on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 三、缔约各方应尽力确保在其领土内由另一缔约方指定航空公司用于协议航班的航空器、备件及其他财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: In case where the designated airline of each Contracting Party desires to utilize crew members of other nationalities for the operation on the specified route , approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 如缔约一方指定航空公司欲在协议航线上雇佣其他国籍机组人员，须经缔约另一方批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . Should an aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party experience an accident or be in distress in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the other Contracting Party shall instruct its appropriate authorities to immediately inform the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party and provide necessary assistance to the crew and passengers on board the aircraft .
Translation: 第十一条 一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的航空器在缔约另一方领土内遇险或发生事故，缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即通知缔约一方的航空当局，并对该航空器上的机组人员和乘客提供必要援助。

Query_Text_en: Article 12In a spirit of close co-operation , exchange of views shall take place from time to time between the two Contracting Parties , with a view to ensuring the implementation of , and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of the present Agreement and the Exchange of Notes on Route Schedule .
Translation:
第十二条  
缔约双方应本着密切合作的精神，就不时交换意见，以确保本协定及航线表换文各项条款的实施与妥善遵守。

Query_Text_en: Article 13If any dispute arises between the Contracting Parties relating to the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the Contracting Parties shall in the first place instruct their respective Aeronautical Authorities to settle it by negotiation .
Translation:
第十三条  
缔约双方如对本协定的解释或实施发生任何争议，应首先责成双方航空当局通过谈判协商解决。

Query_Text_en: If the said Authorities fail to reach an agreement , each Contracting Party may request consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 若上述主管机关未能达成协议，任何缔约方可要求与另一缔约方进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of the request .
Translation: 此类磋商应自请求提出之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Article 14If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provision of the present Agreement , it may request consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十四条  
缔约任何一方认为有必要修改或变更本协定条款时，可要求与缔约另一方进行协商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of request .
Translation: 此类磋商应自请求之日起六十日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Modifications and amendments so agreed upon shall come into force after the two Contracting Parties have notified each other that their respective internal procedures to make the modifications or amendments effective have been fulfilled .
Translation: 双方同意的修改和补充事项，应在缔约双方相互通知已完成使修改或补充生效所需的各自国内程序后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 1 . The present Agreement shall come into force after both Contracting Parties have respectively completed their legal or constitutional formalities and notified each other to this effect through exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 第十五条  一、本协定自缔约双方完成各自法律或宪法程序并通过外交照会相互通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 二、缔约任何一方可随时通知另一方终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve ] months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议应于缔约另一方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止。

Query_Text_en: If the above notice is withdrawn before the expiry of this period , the present Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 若上述通知在本期限内撤销，经缔约另一方同意，本协定应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Done in Peking on this thirty-first day of October , 1975 , in duplicate in the Chinese , German and English languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 一九七五年十月三十一日在北京签订，一式三份，每份都用中文、德文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: In case of any diversion in interpretation , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如对文本解释存在分歧，应以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: i ] The term `` schedule '' means the Route Schedule annexed to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with the provisions of Article [ 16 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: “航班时刻表”指本协议所附的航线时刻表，或根据本协议第16条规定修订后的时刻表。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 GRANTING OF RIGHTS AND PRIVILEGES1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement to enable its designated airline to establish and operate international air services on the route specified in the Schedule [ hereinafter called `` the agreed services '' and `` the specified route '' respectively ] .
Translation:
第二条 权利与特权的授予  
缔约一方给予缔约另一方本协定规定的权利，以便其指定航空公司开通并经营附件航线上规定的国际航空运输业务（以下简称"协议航班"与"规定航线"）。

Query_Text_en: a ] to fly without landing across the territory of the other Contracting Party , b ] to make stops for non-traffic purposes in the said territory , at points to be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties , andc ] to make stops in the said territory at the point specified for the route in the Schedule for the purpose of discharging and of taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , mail and cargo .
Translation:
a）飞越缔约另一方领土而不降停；  
b）在上述领土内作非运输业务性经停，具体地点由缔约双方航空当局商定；  
c）在航线表规定的航线上指定地点作运输业务性经停，以便上下国际旅客、行李、邮件和货物。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3 DESIGNATION AND AUTHORISATION1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline to operate the agreed services on the route specified in the Schedule .
Translation:
第三条 指定与授权  
1. 缔约任何一方有权以书面形式向另一方指定一家航空公司，经营协定航班时刻表中所列航线上的协议航班。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] The substantial ownership and effective control of the airline designated by each Contracting Party shall remain vested in such Contracting Party or its nationals .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的航空公司，其大部分所有权和有效控制权应始终属于该缔约方或其国民所有。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , grant without delay to the airline so designated the appropriate operating authorisation .
Translation: 三、收到上述指定后，缔约另一方应根据本条第二款规定，立即向被指定航空公司颁发相应的经营许可。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline designated by the first Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfil the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air services by the said authorities .
Translation: 另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定的航空公司证明，其具备履行该当局通常合理适用于国际航空运输服务的法律法规所规定条件的资质。

Query_Text_en: 5 ] When an airline has been so designated and authorised it may commence at any time operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 5 ] 航空公司一经指定并获得授权，即可随时开始运营协议规定的航线服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] Unless immediate suspension or imposition of the conditions mentioned in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws and regulations , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 除非立即中止或实施本条第一款所述条件对防止进一步违法违规行为确有必要，否则该权利的行使须经与缔约另一方协商后方可进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] In the event of action by one Contracting Party under this Article , the rights of both Contracting Parties shall not be prejudiced .
Translation: 若任一缔约方依据本条采取行动，双方缔约方的权利均不受损害。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5 PROVISION OF TECHNICAL SERVICES AND RATE OF CHARGES1 ] Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airport and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and shall provide the latter with such communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第五条 技术服务提供与收费标准  

一、缔约各方应在本国领土内指定供对方缔约方指定航空公司经营规定航线所使用的定期航班机场和备降机场，并应在本国境内为协议航班运营提供所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司使用对方缔约方机场时，应按该缔约方主管部门制定的公平合理费率缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those paid by national airlines of the other Contracting Party engaged in international air services for the use of similar installations and services .
Translation: 该费率不得超过另一缔约方经营国际航空运输业务的航空公司使用类似设施和服务所支付的费率。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 EXEMPTIONS FROM CUSTOMS AND OTHER DUTIES AND CHARGES1 ] Aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of one Contracting party , as well as their regular equipment , spare parts , supplies of fuels and lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes on arriving in the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation:
第六条 关税及其他税费豁免  
一缔约方指定航空公司经营国际航班所使用的航空器及其正常设备、零备件、燃油与润滑油供应品，以及机上库存品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在飞抵另一缔约方领土时，应免除所有关税、检验费及其他税捐。但此类设备与供应品须留存航空器上直至复运出境。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] Supplies of fuels , lubricants , spare parts , regular equipment and aircraft stores introduced into the territory of each Contracting Party by or on behalf of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party or taken on board the aircraft operated by such designated airline and intended solely for use in the operation of international air services shall be exempt from all duties and charges , including customs duties and inspection fees imposed in the territory of the first Contracting Party even when those supplies are to be used on the parts of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board . The materials referred to above may be required to be kept under customs supervision or control .
Translation: 二、缔约一方指定航空公司或其代表运入缔约另一方领土的燃料、润滑油、零配件、常规设备及航空器专用物资，或装载于该指定航空公司运营航空器上且专供国际航空运输服务使用的上述物品，即使将在航空器飞越装载地缔约方领土的航段中使用，亦应免除缔约一方领土内征收的一切税费，包括关税及检验费。上述物资可受海关监管。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] The regular airborne equipment , spare parts , aircraft stores and supplies of fuels and lubricants retained on board the aircraft of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of that Contracting Parties , who may require that those materials be placed under their supervision up to such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations .
Translation: 三、缔约任何一方航空器上的正常机载设备、零备件、机上供应品及燃料和润滑油，只有在缔约另一方海关当局批准后方可卸下。该当局可要求将上述物资置于其监管之下，直至重新运出或根据海关规定另行处置。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] Airline tickets , airway bills as well as airline publicity materials and give-away items of the designated airline of either Contracting Party introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司运入缔约另一方领土的机票、航空运单以及宣传品和赠品，应免除一切关税、检验费及其他税捐。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 FINANCIAL PROVISIONSEither Contracting Party undertakes to grant the other Contracting Party free transfer , at the official rate of exchange , of the excess of receipt over expenditure achieved on its territory in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第七条 财务规定  
缔约一方应承诺，允许缔约另一方指定航空公司在境内经营旅客、行李、货物及邮件运输所获收支盈余，按官方汇率自由汇出。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 EXEMPTION FROM INCOME TAX AND OTHER TAXES1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be exempt from income tax or other similar taxes in the territory of the other Contracting Party in respect of the gains or profits accruing to it from the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第八条 所得税及其他税费的豁免  
一、缔约一方指定空运企业因经营协议航班在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入或利润，应豁免所得税及其他类似税费。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] The employees of the designated airline who are nationals of either Contracting Party , shall be exempt from income tax or other similar taxes in the territory of the other Contracting Party , in respect of their emoluments , allowances or other gains , accruing to them from their employment in the said territory by the said designated airline for the purposes of the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司的雇员，如为缔约另一方国民，因在该缔约另一方领土内受雇于该指定航空公司经营协议航班所获的薪酬、津贴或其他收入，应豁免缴纳该缔约另一方领土内的所得税或其他类似税项。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall take such action as may be necessary in terms of its laws to enable the provisions of this article to take effect .
Translation: 各缔约方应根据本国法律采取必要措施，以使本条之规定得以生效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9 ENTRY AND CLEARANCE REGULATIONS1 ] The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission into , stay in , departure from and flight over its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services , as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第九条 出入境规章  
一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的航空器进出其领土、在其领土内停留及飞越其领土的法律法规，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土、在其领土内停留的法律法规，在缔约另一方指定空运企业的航空器、该航空器所载机组人员及旅客、行李、货物和邮件处于该缔约一方领土内时，应同样适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] Passengers in direct transit across the territory of either Contracting Party shall be subject to no more than very simplified control .
Translation: 缔约任何一方领土内直接过境的旅客，仅须接受非常简化的检查。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10 CAPACITY PROVISIONS1 ] There shall be fair and equal opportunity for the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation:
第十条  运力规定

缔约各方指定航空公司在规定航线上经营协议航班时，应享有公平、平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] Matters relating to frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , ground handling and other matters pertaining to the operation of the agreed services shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties . Frequency and type of aircraft so agreed shall be subject to the approval of the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 二、有关班次、机型、班期时刻、地面服务及其他涉及协议航班运营的事项，应由缔约双方指定航空公司协商确定。商定的班次和机型须经缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] In the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the air services which the latter airline operates over the whole route or parts thereof .
Translation: 3 ] 在经营协议航线的约定航班业务时，缔约各方指定航空公司应充分考虑另一缔约方指定航空公司的利益，以避免对其在该航线全程或部分航段运营的航空服务造成不当影响。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] The agreed services provided by a designated airline shall retain as their primary objective the provision , at a reasonable load factor , of capacity adequate to current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , mail and cargo , originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline .
Translation: 缔约方指定航空公司提供的协议航班服务，应以合理载运率为基准，确保运力充分满足当前及合理预期的客货邮运输需求，且该等运输须始发或终至指定该航空公司的缔约方领土。

Query_Text_en: b ] traffic requirements of the areas through which the agreed services of the airline passes , after taking account of other transport services established by airlines of the States comprising the area , andc ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation:
b）在考虑该地区成员国航空公司已开通的其他运输服务后，经协商确定的航线所经区域的运输需求；  
c）直航运营的需求。

Query_Text_en: ARTILCE 11 INFORMATION AND STATISTICSThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , such periodic or other statistical data as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party on the specified route .
Translation:
第十一条  信息与统计数据  
任一缔约方的航空当局应另一缔约方航空当局要求，须向其提供定期或其他合理所需的统计数据，以便审查该缔约方指定航空公司在规定航线上提供的运力。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 12 APPROVAL OF FLIGHT SCHEDULES1 ] The designated airline of either Contracting Party shall communicate to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , not later than thirty days prior to the initiation of the agreed services on the specified routes , the type of service , the types of aircraft to be used and the flight schedules .
Translation:
第十二条 航班计划的批准  
任一缔约方指定航空公司应在商定航线开航前至少三十天，将拟提供的服务类型、所用机型及航班计划提交另一缔约方航空当局审批。

Query_Text_en: This shall likewise apply to changes as well as before the commencement of each summer and winter schedule .
Translation: 此规定同样适用于变更情况，以及每个夏冬航季开始前。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] The aeronautical authorities receiving such flight schedules shall normally approve the schedules or suggest modifications thereto .
Translation: 收到此类飞行计划的航空当局通常应予以批准或提出修改建议。

Query_Text_en: In any case the said designated airline shall not commence its services before the schedules are approved by the said aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 无论如何，该指定航空公司须在飞行计划经上述航空当局批准后，方可开始运营相关航班服务。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall likewise apply to later changes .
Translation: 本条款同样适用于后续变更。

Query_Text_en: ARTILE 13 ESTABLISHMENT OF TARIFFS1 ] The tariffs on any agreed service shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors including cost of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of service [ such as standards of speed and accommodation ] and the tariffs of other airlines for any part of the specified route .
Translation:
第十三条 运价的制定  
一、协议航班所采用的运价应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑所有相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润、服务特点（如速度与舱位标准）以及其他航空公司在规定航线任何区段所采用的运价。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] The tariffs referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , in consultation , when necessary and possible , with other airlines operating over the whole or part of that route .
Translation: 本条第一款所述运价应由缔约双方指定航空公司在必要时并可能时，经与经营该航线全部或部分航段的其他航空公司协商后议定。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] If the designated airlines can not agree on any of these tariffs , the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall try to determine the tariffs by agreement between themselves .
Translation: 3 ] 如指定航空公司未能就上述运价达成一致，缔约双方航空当局应通过协商予以确定。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] If the aeronautical authorities can not agree on the approval of any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 3 ] , the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article [ 7 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: 如航空当局未能就本条第二款提交的任何运价批准事宜或第三款规定的运价确定事宜达成一致，则该事项应提交缔约双方根据本协定第七条规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 5 ] Pending determination of a new tariff in accordance with the provisions of this Article , the tariffs already in force shall prevail .
Translation: 在根据本条规定确定新关税前，现行关税继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificates mentioned above of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方应承认缔约另一方签发的上述有效证书。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16 CONSULTATIONS1 ] Exchange of views shall take place as needed between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties in order to achieve close cooperation and agreement in all matters pertaining to the application of this Agreement .
Translation:
第十六条 协商  
缔约双方航空当局应视需要交换意见，以确保在涉及本协定实施的所有事项上保持密切合作与协调一致。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] Each Contracting Party may , at any time , request consultations with the other Contracting Party for the purpose of amending this Agreement or the Schedule .
Translation: 二、任一缔约方可随时要求与另一缔约方进行磋商，以修订本协定或附件。

Query_Text_en: Any amendments to this Agreement agreed to , as a result of such consultations , shall enter into force on the date of exchange of Diplomatic Notes stating that the legal procedures required have been fulfilled in accordance with their respective national laws .
Translation: 经协商对本协定所作的任何修改，应在外交换文确认双方已完成各自国内法律程序之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] If the amendment relates only to the Schedule , the consultations shall be between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 三、若修订仅涉及附件，应由缔约双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: ARTILCE 17 SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTESBoth Contracting Parties shall ensure correct implementation of the present Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support .
Translation:
第十七条 争议解决  
缔约双方应本着密切合作、相互支持的精神，确保本协议的正确实施。

Query_Text_en: If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement , the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding .
Translation: 如对本协定之解释或执行发生任何分歧，缔约双方主管部门应本着友好合作与相互理解之精神，通过直接协商予以解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18 TERMINATIONEither Contracting Parties may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第十八条  终止  
任何一方缔约方可随时通知另一方缔约方其决定终止本协议。

Query_Text_en: If such notice is given , this Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of receipt by the other Contracting Party of the notice to terminate , unless by agreement between the Contracting Parties the notice under reference is withdrawn before the expiry of that period .
Translation: 若一方发出终止通知，本协定应在另一方收到该通知十二个月后终止，除非缔约双方在该期限届满前协商撤销该终止通知。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 19 TITILESTitles are inserted in this Agreement at the head of each article for the purpose of reference and convenience and in no way to define , limit or describe the scope or intent of this Agreement .
Translation:
第十九条  标题  
本协议各条款标题仅为便于查阅而设，绝无界定、限制或阐释协议范围或意图之效力。

Query_Text_en: Done at Kuwait on the twentieth day of January 1980 , in two originals each in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协定于1980年1月20日在科威特签订，一式两份，每份均以中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。

Translation:

Query_Text_en: A point in China-any two intermediate points-Kuwait-any two points beyond .
Translation: 中国境内一点—任意两个中间点—科威特—任意两个以远点。

Query_Text_en: The intermediate points and the points beyond in the route specified can be served provided that traffic rights are not exercised between these points and Kuwait , and vice-versa .
Translation: 在指定航线的中间点及以远点可提供运输服务，前提是这些地点与科威特之间不行使第五航权，反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: Kuwait-any two intermediate points-Beijing-any two points beyond .
Translation: 科威特—任意两个中间点—北京—以远任意两点

Query_Text_en: The intermediate points and the points beyond in the route specified can be served provided that traffic rights are not exercised between these points and Beijing , and vice-versa .
Translation: 在指定航线上可经营中间点及以远点，但不得在北京与这些地点之间行使航权，反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: a ] Any point or points on the specified routes may be omitted on any orall flights provided that the operation starts and ends in the territoryof the Contracting Party designating the airline .
Translation: a ] 在指定航线的任何或全部航班中，可省略一个或多个经停点，但航班运营须在指定航空公司的缔约方领土内开始并结束。

Query_Text_en: b ] Each designated airline shall specify and submit to the aeronauticalauthorities of the other Contracting Party for their approval theintermediate points and the points beyond before the initiation of theagreed services and before any later changes in the schedule .
Translation: b ] 各指定航空公司在开始提供协议航班服务前及此后任何时刻调整航线时，均须将拟经停的中间点及以远点报另一方缔约国民航主管部门审批。

Query_Text_en: The points need not be the same in different flights .
Translation: 不同航班的积分规则未必相同。

Query_Text_en: Considerable attention has been focused in recent years on the need to remove barriers impeding the growth of foreign investment in developing countries .
Translation: 近年来，消除阻碍外资在发展中国家增长壁垒的必要性已引起广泛关注。

Query_Text_en: Many countries have enacted new laws to promote foreign investment and entered into bilateral investment treaties with capital-exporting countries for this purpose .
Translation: 多国已颁布新法以促进外商投资，并为此与资本输出国签订双边投资协定。

Query_Text_en: The concept of providing foreign investors with financial guarantees against non-commercial risks in developing countries has emerged as a means of improving the investment climate in these countries and , hence , of stimulating investment flows to them . Almost all developed countries and two developing countries have established official schemes to provide guarantees against non-commercial risks to their nationals for investments into developing countries .
Translation: 为发展中国家外国投资者提供非商业风险金融担保的理念应运而生，旨在改善这些国家的投资环境，从而促进外资流入。目前几乎所有发达国家和两个发展中国家均已建立官方机制，为本国国民在发展中国家投资提供非商业风险担保。

Query_Text_en: In addition , the Inter-Arab Investment Guarantee Corporation provides guarantees on a regional basis . A private political risk insurance market has also been operating internationally for over a decade . The activities of these entities are subject to several limitations and the perception of political risk remains a significant barrier to investment in developing countries . There is need for a multilateral investment guarantee agency to complement these schemes and improve the investment climate by issuing guarantees and engaging in other investment promotion activities .
Translation: 此外，阿拉伯国家间投资担保公司也提供区域性担保服务。私营政治风险保险市场在国际上运作已逾十年。这些机构的业务活动存在若干局限性，且政治风险认知仍是阻碍发展中国家投资的重要因素。亟需建立多边投资担保机构，通过提供担保及开展其他投资促进活动，对现有机制形成补充并改善投资环境。

Query_Text_en: The idea of establishing a multilateral investment guarantee agency emerged in the 1950s .
Translation: 建立多边投资担保机构的构想始于20世纪50年代。

Query_Text_en: It was discussed in the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development [ referred to in this Commentary as the Bank ] on several occasions during the 1962-1972 period , but no decision was taken about creating such an agency . President Clausen revived the concept in his first address to the Bank 's Annual Meeting in 1981 . After detailed studies by the Bank staff and informal discussions with the Bank 's Executive Directors , a paper entitled `` Main Features of a Proposed Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency '' was distributed to the Executive Directors in May 1984 . The paper presented a number of key features distinguishing the proposal from the schemes previously discussed in the Bank . This proposal , with modifications following discussions with the Executive Directors , was subsequently embodied in a `` Draft Outline of the Convention Establishing the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency '' , which was circulated in October 1984 .
Translation: 1962至1972年间，国际复兴开发银行（本评注中简称"世行"）曾多次讨论该议题，但始终未就设立此类机构作出决定。1981年，克劳森行长在其首次世行年会演讲中重提这一构想。经世行工作人员深入研究并与执行董事非正式磋商后，题为《拟议多边投资担保机构主要特征》的文件于1984年5月提交执行董事会审议。该文件阐述了当前提案与此前世行讨论方案的多项关键区别。经与执行董事讨论修订后，该提案最终形成《建立多边投资担保机构公约草案纲要》，并于1984年10月正式分发。

Query_Text_en: On the basis of that document , consultations were held with member governments of the Bank .
Translation: 根据该文件，世行与各成员国政府进行了磋商。

Query_Text_en: These consultations resulted in a revised draft of the Convention which was circulated to the member governments in march 1985 .
Translation: 经协商修订的公约草案于1985年3月分发给各成员国政府。

Query_Text_en: Between June and September 1985 , the Executive Directors , assisted by experts from member governments , convened in a Committee of the Whole to discuss the draft Convention .
Translation: 1985年6月至9月期间，执行董事会在成员国政府专家协助下，召集全体委员会会议对公约草案进行审议。

Query_Text_en: In September 1985 , the Executive Directors finalized the draft Convention and recommended to the Board of Governors that it adopt a resolution opening the Convention for signature .
Translation: 1985年9月，执行董事们最终敲定了公约草案，并建议理事会通过决议开放公约签署。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of the Convention are for the most part self-explanatory . This Commentary describes some of its principal features to aid interpretation of its provisions .
Translation: 公约条款大多无需赘述。本评注阐述其主要特点，以助于条款解释。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Convention establishes the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency [ referred to in this Commentary as the Agency ] as an autonomous international organization with `` full juridical personality '' under international law and the domestic laws of its members [ Article 1 ] with the main objective of encouraging the flow of investments for productive purposes among its member countries and in particular to its developing member countries [ Article 2 ] .
Translation: 1. 《公约》设立了多边投资担保机构[本评注中简称为“机构”]，作为一个具有国际法和其成员国国内法所规定的“完全法律人格”的自主国际组织[第一条]，其主要宗旨是鼓励成员国之间，特别是向发展中成员国进行生产性投资流动[第二条]。

Query_Text_en: The reference to `` investments for productive purposes '' emphasizes the Agency 's concentration on concrete projects and programs in all sectors of the economy .
Translation: "为生产性目的投资"这一表述强调了该机构对所有经济部门具体项目和计划的专注。

Query_Text_en: It does not imply a restriction of its operations to the manufacturing sector . In addition to guaranteeing investments in these member countries against non-commercial risks , the Agency is to carry out complementary activities to promote investment flows [ Article 2 [ b ] ] .
Translation: 这并不意味着将其业务范围局限于制造业。除为成员国投资提供非商业风险担保外，该机构还将开展促进投资流动的补充性活动【第二条第二款】。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Membership in the Agency is open to all members of the Bank and to Switzerland [ Article 4 [ a ] ] .
Translation: 二、机构成员资格向所有世行成员国及瑞士开放【第四条（a）项】。

Query_Text_en: There is , however , no obligation for Bank members to join the Agency .
Translation: 然而，银行成员国并无义务必须加入该机构。

Query_Text_en: The Convention recognizes the importance attached to participation by both capital-exporting and capital-importing members particularly in the provisions for its entry into force [ Article 61 [ b ] ] and for voting [ Article 39 ] .
Translation: 公约特别重视资本输出国与资本输入国成员方的共同参与，这一点尤其体现在公约生效条款（第六十一条第二款）及表决机制条款（第三十九条）中。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Earlier Bank proposals envisaged the Agency as having no share capital and conducting its operations on behalf of the member countries which would sponsor investments for guarantee by the agency .
Translation: 世界银行此前的提案设想，该机构将不设股本，其业务运作以成员国名义开展，由成员国为拟投保项目提供担保支持。

Query_Text_en: Under the Convention the Agency will have a share capital [ Article 5 ] and can issue guarantees in its own right which will be supplemented by guarantees issued for investments sponsored by members ; with respect to the latter , the Agency will act only as administrator [ Article 24 and Annex I to the Convention ] .
Translation: 根据公约规定，该机构将拥有法定股本（第五条），并有权自主签发担保；此类担保可与成员国赞助投资的担保并行使用。对于后者，该机构仅履行管理人职责（公约第二十四条及附件一）。

Query_Text_en: The subscribed capital can be leveraged , allowing for guarantee coverage several times its size [ see Article 22 ] .
Translation: 认缴资本可发挥杠杆作用，实现数倍于本金的担保覆盖规模[参见第二十二条]。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Convention provides for an authorized capital of one billion Special Drawing Rights , divided into 100 , 000 shares having a par value of SDR 10 , 000 each . Members ' payment obligations with respect to capital stock will , however , be settled on the basis of the average value of the SDR in terms of U. S. dollars for the period January 1 , 1981 to June 30 , 1985 , i. e. $ 1 . 082 , the former date being the date of the introduction of the current basket of currencies of the SDR [ Article 5 [ a ] ] . Once the initially authorized amount is fully subscribed , the authorized capital will be increased automatically to the extent necessary to provide for subscriptions by acceding members [ Article 5 [ b ] ] . The authorized capital may also be increased at any time by the Council of Governors [ referred to in this Commentary as the Council ] by the special majority of at least two-thirds of the voting power representing at least 55 percent of capital subscriptions [ Article 5 [ c ] and Article 3 [ d ] ] .
Translation: 4. 公约规定法定资本为10亿特别提款权，划分为10万股，每股面值1万特别提款权。但成员国认缴股本的支付义务应以1981年1月1日至1985年6月30日期间特别提款权兑美元的平均价值（即1特别提款权兑1.082美元）为结算基准，其中1981年1月1日为现行特别提款权货币篮子启用日[第五条(a)款]。当初始法定资本被全额认缴后，法定资本将自动增资以满足新加入成员的认缴需求[第五条(b)款]。理事会（本评注中简称"理事会"）亦可随时通过特别多数表决（即获得代表至少55%认缴资本的三分之二以上表决权）增加法定资本[第五条(c)款及第三条(d)款]。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The amout of subscribed capital will determine the Agency 's underwriting capacity [ see Article 22 ] . It is anticipated that the authorized capital will be subscribed within a reasonable time after the Agency commences operations and that it will be able to operate successfully on that basis .
Translation: 5. 认缴资本总额将决定本机构的承保能力[参见第二十二条]。预计在机构开始运作后的合理期限内，其法定资本将获得足额认缴，并以此为基础实现成功运营。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Every member shall subscribe to the capital stock of the Agency . Article 6 provides for a minimum subscription of 50 shares [ SDR 500 , 000 ] . This will give all members a stake in the Agency . Initial subscriptions of original members are set out in Schedule A to the Convention . The Subscriptions of acceding members will be determined by the Agency 's Council . While shares will be issued at par to original members , the Council is authorized to determine the terms and conditions of acceding members ' subscriptions provided that the issue price shall not be less than par . Issue prices above par might be appropriate if the Agency has accumulated reserves at the time of the accession [ Article 6 ] .
Translation: 六、各成员国均应认缴机构股本。第六条规定最低认缴额为50股（50万特别提款权），以确保所有成员国在机构中均持有股权。创始成员国首次认缴额详见公约附表A。加入成员国的认缴额将由机构理事会确定。原始成员国将按票面价值认购股份，理事会则有权在加入成员国认缴股份时规定其条款与条件，但发行价格不得低于票面价值。若机构在接纳新成员时已积累储备金，则可采用溢价发行方式（第六条）。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The Convention provides that ten percent of the price of the subscribed shares is to be paid in cash and that an additional ten percent is to be paid in the form of non-negotiable , non-interest-bearing promissory notes or similar obligations to be encashed pursuant to a decision of the Board . The cash payment is designed to cover start-up costs , administrative expenditures and possible claims arising out of the Agency 's guarantees . The arrangement for additional payment in the form of non-negotiable instruments allows the funds to remain within the members ' central banking systems and provides a cushion in the event that a large claim occurs during the Agency 's formative years . The purpose of this provision is to strengthen the Agency 's standing as a financially sound insurer from the outset . The remaining 80 percent of the subscribed shares is subject to call by the Agency to meet its obligations [ Article 7 ] . It should be emphasized that actual recourse to the non-negotiable instruments and the callable capital is not anticipated because the Agency is expected to conduct its activities on a sound business basis and maintain under all circumstances its ability to meet its financial obligations [ see Article 25 ] . Article 8 [ c ] provides that in case of default by a member on a call , the Agency is authorized to make successive calls on unpaid subscriptions .
Translation: 7. 《公约》规定，认缴股份价格的10%应以现金支付，另外10%以不可转让、无息期票或类似债券形式支付，并可根据董事会决议予以兑现。现金支付旨在覆盖启动成本、行政开支及可能因机构担保产生的索赔。以不可流通票据形式追加支付的安排，可使资金留存于成员国中央银行体系内，并为机构初创期可能发生的大额索赔提供缓冲。此条款旨在确保机构自成立之初即具备稳健财务保险人地位。剩余80%认缴股份可由机构催缴以履行债务【第七条】。需特别说明的是，由于机构将在稳健商业基础上运营并始终保持偿债能力【参见第二十五条】，预计不会实际动用不可流通票据及可催缴资本。第八条(c)款规定，若成员国拖欠催缴款，机构有权对未缴认缴款进行连续催缴。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Subject to the limited exception discussed below , payments on the paid-in and callable portions of subscriptions must be made in a freely usable currency as defined in the Convention [ Articles 3 [ e ] and 8 ] . This is essential to ensure the Agency 's financial viability and its recognition as a credible insurer . The Board of Directors [ referred to in this Commentary as the Board ] has the discretion , after consultation with the International Monetary Fund , to designate as `` freely usable '' currencies other than those so designated by the International Monetary Fund . The Board can make this decision if it is satisfied that the currency concerned can be readily used for the purposes of the Agency and if the country whose currency is involved agrees [ Article 3 [ e ] ] . In order to reduce the financial burden of developing member countries , the Convention allows developing countries to pay up to 25 percent of the paid-in cash portion of their subscription in their local currencies . In view of the small amounts likely to be involved , this is not expected to have adverse effects on the Agency 's finances .
Translation: （八）除下文所述的有限例外情形外，会员国必须以本公约第三条（戊）款和第八条界定的可自由使用货币缴付股本的实缴部分和待缴部分。这对确保机构的财务健全及其作为可靠保险人的信誉至关重要。董事会（本评注中简称"董事会"）经与国际货币基金组织磋商后，可自行决定将国际货币基金组织未确定为"可自由使用"的货币认定为可自由使用货币。董事会作出该决定的条件是：该货币在机构业务中可随时兑换使用，且货币发行国对此无异议[第三条（戊）款]。为减轻发展中国家会员国的财政负担，公约允许发展中国家以本国货币缴纳其认缴股本实缴现金部分的25%。鉴于所涉金额可能较小，预计不会对机构财务状况造成不利影响。

Query_Text_en: 9 . To reduce the financial burden on all members , the Convention provides that under certain circumstances the Agency will refund to members amounts paid on a call on subscribed capital . These refunds would be made in a freely usable currency in proportion to the payments made by members under calls made prior to such refund [ Article 10 [ b ] ] .
Translation: 为减轻全体成员国的财政负担，《公约》规定，在某些情况下，机构将以可自由使用货币按成员国在退款前缴纳的催缴资本份额比例，向成员国退还催缴款项[第十条(b)款]。

Query_Text_en: In the case of recovery of payments from a host country in a currency which is not freely usable , it is envisaged that the Agency would make the refund once it succeeds in converting such payments into usable currencies . To the extent amounts are refunded , members ' callable capital obligations would be re-established so that the situation existing before the respective call is restored [ Article 10 [ C ] ] .
Translation: 若东道国以非自由流通货币偿还付款，机构应在其成功将此类款项兑换为可自由使用货币后予以退还。退还金额到位后，各成员国认缴的待缴资本义务将相应恢复，使相关催缴前原有状态得以重建（第十条第三款）。

Query_Text_en: 10 . The Convention establishes the general framework for the Agency 's guarantee operations and enables the Board to define more precisely the scope of these operations by issuing policies , rules and regulations which can be amended from time to time .
Translation: 10. 《公约》为多边投资担保机构的担保业务确立了总体框架，并授权董事会通过颁布可适时修订的政策、规则和规章，更精确地界定这些业务的范围。

Query_Text_en: This provides the Agency with the necessary flexibility to adapt , within this general framework , to changing circumstances and maintain its financial viability . For example , the Agency could limit the scope of its coverage on commencing operations and expand it as it gained experience and built up financial reserves .
Translation: 这使机构能够在总体框架内灵活应对变化的环境，保持财务可持续性。例如，机构可在运营初期限定业务范围，随着经验积累和资金储备增加逐步扩大覆盖范围。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the details of each guarantee operation and the specific arrangements reached between the Agency and the investor would be incorporated into the contract of guarantee entered into between the agency and the investor . Article 16 provides that the Agency can not cover under a contract of guarantee the total loss sustained by an investor . This provision is designed to discourage possible irresponsible conduct by investors relying on total loss cover [ commonly referred to as `` moral hazard '' ] . In determining the appropriate percentage of possible indemnification , the Agency may find some guidance in the rules of national investment guarantee schemes which typically indemnify between 70 and 95 percent of a loss .
Translation: 此外，每项担保业务的具体细节以及机构与投资者之间达成的具体安排都将纳入双方签订的担保合同。第十六条规定，机构不得在担保合同中承保投资者遭受的全部损失。该条款旨在防止投资者因依赖全额赔付保障而可能出现的不负责任行为（通常被称为"道德风险"）。在确定适当的赔付比例时，机构可参考各国投资担保计划的规定，这些计划通常对损失的赔付比例介于70%至95%之间。
