Query_Text_en: 3 . 8 The two sides condemned terrorism in all its forms and manifestations .
Translation: 3.8 双方谴责一切形式的恐怖主义及其各种表现。

Query_Text_en: The international community should make every effort to combat terrorism in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations and other universally recognized international law and norms governing international relations .
Translation: 国际社会应严格遵循《联合国宪章》及其他公认的国际法和国际关系准则，全力打击恐怖主义。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will strengthen counter-terrorism cooperation in order to safeguard their own national security and promote new progress in international counter-terrorism cooperation .
Translation: 双方将加强反恐合作，以维护各自国家安全，并推动国际反恐合作取得新进展。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 1 . 1 The two sides commended Africa 's efforts in embracing a growth-oriented agricultural agenda through the Comprehensive African Agricultural Development Program [ CAADP ] aimed at increasing agricultural growth rates .
Translation: 4.1.1 双方赞赏非洲通过《非洲农业综合发展计划》推行以增长为导向的农业议程，该计划旨在提升农业增长率。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 1 . 2 The two sides noted that food security is a major challenge facing the international community and it is particularly serious for African countries . Agricultural development holds the key to food security in Africa , and is essential for Africa 's endeavor to eradicate poverty , ensure people 's livelihood and develop the economy .
Translation: 4.1.2 双方指出，粮食安全是国际社会面临的重大挑战，对非洲国家尤为严峻。农业发展是解决非洲粮食安全问题的关键所在，对非洲消除贫困、保障民生和发展经济至关重要。

Query_Text_en: The two sides decided to prioritize agriculture and food security in their cooperation .
Translation: 双方决定将农业和粮食安全作为合作优先领域。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 1 . 3 The two sides were pleased to see the deepened and orderly growth of agricultural cooperation between China and Africa .
Translation: 4.1.3 双方欣喜地看到，中非农业合作持续深化并有序拓展。

Query_Text_en: They pledged to maintain and strengthen such cooperation and expand , in particular , cooperation in agricultural infrastructure , grain production , breeding industry , exchanges and transfer of practical agricultural technologies , and in processing , storage and transportation of agricultural products .
Translation: 双方承诺保持并加强此类合作，重点拓展农业基础设施、粮食生产、育种产业、实用农业技术交流与转让，以及农产品加工、储运等领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: - In the course of the next three years , send 50 agricultural technology teams to Africa and help train 2,000 agricultural technicians for African countries .
Translation: 未来三年内，向非洲派遣50支农业技术专家组，为非洲国家培训2000名农业技术人员。

Query_Text_en: - In the course of the next three years , increase to 20 the total number of agricultural technology demonstration centers built for African countries .
Translation: 未来三年内，为非洲国家援建的农业技术示范中心总数增至20个。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to run well the agricultural technology demonstration centers already built . The centers will start to carry out experiments , demonstration projects , and training programs in crop seed selection , farming , fish breeding and animal raising .
Translation: 继续运营好已建成的农业技术示范中心。这些中心将着手开展农作物选种、耕作、水产养殖和畜牧饲养等领域的试验、示范项目及培训计划。

Query_Text_en: - Implement the decision to contribute US$ 30 million to the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization [ UNFAO ] to set up a trust fund , and actively use the trust fund to support South-South cooperation between China and African countries under the framework of the UNFAO Special Program for Food Security .
Translation: 决定向联合国粮农组织捐款3000万美元设立信托基金，并积极利用该信托基金支持中国与非洲国家在联合国粮农组织"粮食安全特别计划"框架下的南南合作。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 2 . 1 The two sides took note of the continued growth of two-way investment between China and Africa after the Beijing Summit in 2006 , especially the fast growth of Chinese investment in Africa .
Translation: 4.2.1 双方注意到，2006年中非合作论坛北京峰会以来，中非双向投资持续增长，特别是中国对非投资快速增长。

Query_Text_en: The African side welcomes investment from China , and acknowledges its important role in bolstering local economic growth and sustainable development .
Translation: 非洲方面欢迎中国投资，并认可其对促进当地经济增长和可持续发展的重要作用。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 2 . 2 The two sides will continue to promote the conclusion and implementation of bilateral agreements on investment promotion and protection , and create a sound environment with a view to scaling up mutual investment .
Translation: 4.2.2 双方将继续推动缔结并落实双边投资促进和保护协定，营造良好环境，以扩大相互投资规模。

Query_Text_en: Governments of China and African countries give encouragement and support to their competitive businesses in investing in each other 's country so as to raise the level and quality of cooperation for mutual benefit and win-win results .
Translation: 中国与非洲各国政府鼓励并支持本国优势企业赴对方国家投资兴业，以提升互利合作水平与质量，实现共赢发展。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 2 . 3 The Chinese side offered to increase the size of the China-Africa Development Fund to US$ 3 billion to support the expansion of investment from Chinese businesses to Africa .
Translation: 4.2.3 中方承诺将中非发展基金规模扩大至30亿美元，以支持中国企业加大对非投资力度。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 2 . 4 The two sides will continue to do a good job in establishing overseas business cooperation zones in Africa , intensify efforts to attract investment , actively encourage more Chinese companies to make investment in the cooperation zones , and provide facilitation to African small and medium-sized enterprises [ SMEs ] to develop their business in the zones .
Translation: 4.2.4 双方将继续推进在非洲建设经贸合作区工作，加大招商引资力度，积极鼓励更多中国企业赴合作区投资兴业，并为非洲中小企业入驻园区开展业务提供便利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 2 . 5 Noting the outcomes of the China-Africa Business Conference held during this Ministerial Conference , the two sides will further encourage their business communities to strengthen cooperation and deepen economic and trade links .
Translation: 4.2.5 双方注意到本届部长级会议期间中非经贸合作成果，将进一步鼓励两国工商界加强合作，深化经贸往来。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 3 . 1 The two sides were of the view that underdeveloped infrastructure is an obstacle to Africa 's development and integration .
Translation: 4.3.1 双方认为，基础设施发展不足是制约非洲发展与一体化进程的障碍。

Query_Text_en: China 's contribution to infrastructure development in Africa in recent years was appreciated .
Translation: 近年来中国对非洲基础设施建设作出的贡献受到各方赞赏。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 3 . 2 The two sides agreed that infrastructure will remain a priority in China-Africa cooperation .
Translation: 4.3.2 双方一致同意，基础设施将继续作为中非合作的重点领域。

Query_Text_en: In this context , the African side hopes that the Chinese side will support development projects that promote regional integration .
Translation: 在此背景下，非洲方希望中方支持促进区域一体化的发展项目。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing Africa 's urgent need for infrastructure development , the Chinese side will support the building of major infrastructure projects in Africa to promote Africa 's economic and social development .
Translation: 中方认识到非洲对基础设施建设的迫切需求，将支持非洲重大基础设施建设，助力非洲经济社会发展。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 3 . 3 The Chinese side will increase investment and play a larger role in infrastructure development in Africa through providing loans and free assistance to African countries and encouraging investment by Chinese companies .
Translation: 4.3.3 中方将通过向非洲国家提供贷款和无偿援助、鼓励中国企业投资等方式，加大对非基础设施建设的投入力度，发挥更大作用。

Query_Text_en: In the next three years , the Chinese side will provide US$ 10 billion of preferential loans to African countries , which will be used mainly to support infrastructure and social development projects .
Translation: 未来三年，中方将向非洲国家提供100亿美元优惠贷款，重点用于支持基础设施建设和民生发展项目。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 1 The two sides will continue to promote trade between China and Africa , and broaden their economic cooperation , which is currently dominated by trade in goods , so that it becomes multi-pronged to include trade in goods , investment , trade in services , technology and project contracting .
Translation: 4.4.1 双方将继续推动中非贸易发展，拓宽以货物贸易为主的经济合作领域，实现货物贸易、投资、服务贸易、技术与工程承包等多元化发展格局。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 2 The two sides were pleased to see the smooth implementation of the tariff exemption policy toward Africa , which has generated increasing benefits to the countries concerned .
Translation: 4.4.2 双方对非洲输华商品零关税政策顺利实施并持续释放积极成效表示满意。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will continue to improve China-Africa trade mix and promote trade balance .
Translation: 双方将继续优化中非贸易结构，促进贸易平衡发展。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 3 The Chinese side promised to further open its market to African countries .
Translation: 中方承诺将进一步向非洲国家开放市场。

Query_Text_en: It offered to , in a phased manner , grant tariff exemption treatment to 95 % of exports from the least developed countries [ LDCs ] in Africa having diplomatic relations with China . As the first step , the goal of zero tariff treatment for 60 % of products originating therefrom will be met in 2010 .
Translation: 中方承诺以分阶段方式，对与中国建交的非洲最不发达国家95%的出口产品给予免关税待遇。作为第一步，2010年将率先对上述国家60%的产品实现零关税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 4 The two sides agreed to further enhance cooperation in customs , taxation , inspection and quarantine , and to conclude and implement relevant cooperation agreements for the sound development of China-Africa trade .
Translation: 4.4.4 双方同意进一步加强海关、税务、检验检疫等领域合作，签署并落实相关合作协议，促进中非贸易健康发展。

Query_Text_en: China is ready to establish cooperation mechanisms with African countries on the supervision and administration of imports and exports and strengthen regulation of product quality and food safety in imports and exports to the benefit of consumers in China and Africa .
Translation: 中方愿同非洲国家建立进出口监管合作机制，加强进出口产品质量安全监管合作，更好保障中非消费者权益。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 5 An African commodities trade center will be established in China and preferential policies such as fees reduction and wavering will be adopted for participating African enterprises to promote export of African commodities to China .
Translation: 中国将设立非洲商品贸易中心，并对参与非洲企业实施费用减免等优惠政策，以促进非洲商品对华出口。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 6 The Chinese side will establish three to five logistic centers in Africa to help improve business facilities in African countries .
Translation: 4.4.6 中方将在非洲设立三至五个物流中心，助力改善非洲国家商业设施条件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 7 The two sides agreed to properly handle trade differences and frictions through friendly consultation under the principle of mutual understanding and mutual accommodation .
Translation: 4.4.7 双方同意秉持相互理解、相互包容的原则，通过友好协商妥善处理贸易分歧和摩擦。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 4 . 8 The two sides agreed to encourage the usage of national and regional arbitration organs in resolving contractual conflicts between Chinese and African enterprises .
Translation: 4.4.8 双方同意鼓励中非企业在合同纠纷中优先选用本国及地区仲裁机构进行解决。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 5 . 1 The two sides will continue to step up cooperation between relevant Chinese financial institutions and African financial institutions in support of African regional economic integration .
Translation: 4.5.1 双方将继续加强中国相关金融机构与非洲金融机构的合作，以支持非洲区域经济一体化进程。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 5 . 2 The two sides will encourage business exchanges between the commercial banks of the two sides and the opening of branches in each other 's country on mutually beneficial commercial terms so as to provide financing support to major China-Africa economic and trade cooperation projects and create a favorable financial environment for China-Africa economic and trade cooperation .
Translation: 4.5.2 双方将鼓励两国商业银行在互利共赢的商业原则下开展业务往来并互设分支机构，为中非重大经贸合作项目提供融资支持，为中非经贸合作营造良好金融环境。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 5 . 3 The Chinese side supported the establishment by Chinese financial institutions of a special loan of US$ 1 billion for African SMEs development to help the growth of African SMEs .
Translation: 中方支持中国金融机构设立10亿美元非洲中小企业发展专项贷款，助力非洲中小企业成长。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 6 Energy and Resources CooperationChina and Africa enjoy complementarity and cooperation potential in energy and resources .
Translation:
4.6 能源与资源合作  
中非在能源与资源领域优势互补，合作潜力巨大。

Query_Text_en: China will continue to cooperate with Africa , in keeping with the principles of mutual benefit and sustainable development , and try to raise the added value of the energy and resources products of African countries and enhance their capacity for intensive processing .
Translation: 中国将继续秉持互利共赢和可持续发展原则，同非洲深化合作，着力提升非洲国家能源资源产品附加值，增强其精深加工能力。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 7 Information and CommunicationsChina will further enhance cooperation with the information and communications authorities of African countries . It will step up training for African personnel in this field and give encouragement and support to competitive Chinese information and communications companies in getting involved in the building of communications infrastructure in Africa and engaging in mutually beneficial cooperation with African counterparts .
Translation:
4.7 信息通信领域  
中国将进一步加强与非洲国家信息通信主管部门的合作，加大对该领域非洲人才的培训力度，鼓励和支持有实力的中国信息通信企业参与非洲通信基础设施建设，与非洲企业开展互利合作。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 8 Services SectorThe two sides took note of the increasing role of the services sector in boosting the economy , and agreed to intensify exchanges and cooperation in this field with a view to improving the economic and industrial structures and transforming the growth pattern .
Translation:
4.8 服务业  
双方注意到服务业在推动经济增长中的作用日益增强，同意加强该领域的交流与合作，以优化经济和产业结构，转变增长方式。

Query_Text_en: 4 . 9 TransportationIn view of the deepening cooperation and exchanges between China and Africa , and their huge potential in transportation development , the two sides agreed to continue to encourage and support more flights and shipping links to be set up by their airlines and shipping companies .
Translation:
4.9 交通运输  
鉴于中非合作交流日益深化且交通运输发展潜力巨大，双方同意继续鼓励和支持各自航空及航运企业开通更多航线与班轮。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 1 . 1 Africa appreciated the development assistance China has provided to Africa in diverse forms over a long period of time and the reduction and canceling of debts for Africa .
Translation: 5.1.1 非洲赞赏中国长期以来以多种形式向非洲提供发展援助，并为非洲减免债务。

Query_Text_en: Africa took note of the remarkable strengthening of relevant measures following the Beijing Summit , which is conducive to the early realization of the MDGs in Africa .
Translation: 非洲注意到北京峰会后相关举措显著加强，这将有助于非洲早日实现千年发展目标。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 1 . 2 Despite its own difficulties caused by the impact of the global financial crisis on the Chinese economy , China expressed commitment to further scaling up assistance to Africa , and prioritizing cooperation areas concerning people 's well-being , such as agriculture , infrastructure , public health , education , human resources development , clean energy and environmental protection .
Translation: 5.1.2 尽管受全球金融危机冲击导致自身面临诸多困难，中国仍承诺进一步加大对非援助力度，并优先推进农业、基础设施、公共卫生、教育、人力资源开发、清洁能源和环境保护等民生领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 1 . 3 The Chinese Government offered to cancel due debts of interest-free government loans that will mature by the end of 2009 owed by all heavily-indebted poor countries and the LDCs in Africa having diplomatic relations with China .
Translation: 中国政府承诺免除截至2009年底所有同中国有外交关系的非洲重债穷国和最不发达国家对华到期无息贷款债务。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 2 . 1 The two sides noted with satisfaction that with the joint efforts of the two sides , the scholarships , seminars and training programs China had sponsored made an important contribution to the human resources development of Africa .
Translation: 5.2.1 双方满意地注意到，在中非双方共同努力下，中方提供的奖学金、研讨会和培训项目为非洲人力资源开发作出了重要贡献。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 2 . 2 The Chinese Government will continue to provide training for people from different sectors in Africa as the need arises , and pay special attention to raising the quality of such training .
Translation: 5.2.2 中国政府将根据非洲各界人士的实际需求，持续开展各类培训项目，并着重提升培训质量。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese Government undertakes to train a total of 20,000 people in various sectors for African countries in the next three years .
Translation: 中国政府承诺在未来三年内为非洲各国培训各领域人才共计两万人次。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 2 . 3 The Chinese side will make a US$ 1 . 5 million contribution to support NEPAD 's projects to train nurses and maternity assistants in Africa .
Translation: 5.2.3 中方将提供150万美元捐款，用于支持非洲发展新伙伴计划培训非洲护士和助产士的项目。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 2 . 4 The African side undertakes to provide necessary support in the selection of trainees and logistics .
Translation: 5.2.4 非洲方承诺在学员选拔及后勤保障方面提供必要支持。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 3 . 1 The two sides expressed satisfaction with the continued progress in China-Africa education cooperation in recent years . The two sides stressed that better education is the basis of and holds the key to social stability and economic development , and the two sides will build on the existing achievements to further enhance their cooperation .
Translation: 5.3.1 双方对近年来中非教育合作持续取得进展表示满意。双方强调，优质教育是社会稳定和经济发展的基础与关键，将立足已有成果进一步深化合作。

Query_Text_en: - Help African countries to build 50 China-Africa friendship schools in the next three years .
Translation: - 未来三年帮助非洲国家建设50所中非友好学校

Query_Text_en: - Propose implementation of the 20 +20 Cooperation Plan for Chinese and African Institutions of Higher Education to establish a new type of one-to-one inter-institutional cooperation model between 20 Chinese universities [ or vocational colleges ] and 20 African universities [ or vocational colleges ] .
Translation: 建议实施"中非高校20+20合作计划"，在中国20所高校（或职业院校）与非洲20所高校（或职业院校）之间建立新型一对一校际合作模式。

Query_Text_en: - Admit 200 middle and high level African administrative personnel to MPA programs in China in the next three years .
Translation: 未来三年内，为200名非洲中高级行政管理人员提供在华公共管理硕士（MPA）项目研修机会。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to raise the number of Chinese governmental scholarships and increase the number of scholarships offered to Africa to 5,500 by 2012 .
Translation: - 继续增加中国政府奖学金名额，到2012年将面向非洲的奖学金名额增至5500个。

Query_Text_en: - Intensify efforts to train teachers for primary , secondary and vocational schools in Africa , and help African countries train 1,500 school headmasters and teachers over the next three years .
Translation: 加大对非洲中小学及职业院校教师培训力度，未来3年为非洲培训1500名校长和教师。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to promote the development of Confucius institutes , increase the number of scholarships offered to Chinese language teachers to help them study in China , and double efforts to raise capacity of local African teachers to teach the Chinese language .
Translation: 继续推进孔子学院发展，增加汉语教师来华奖学金名额，着力提升非洲本土汉语教师教学能力。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 4 . 1 The two sides agreed to hold a FOCAC Science and Technology Forum in due course and proposed to launch the China-Africa Science and Technology Partnership Plan to help African countries develop their own science and technology capacity .
Translation: 5.4.1 双方同意适时举办中非合作论坛科技论坛，并提议启动中非科技伙伴计划，助力非洲国家提升自主科技创新能力。

Query_Text_en: - The Chinese side will carry out 100 joint research and demonstration projects in the next three years .
Translation: 中方将在未来三年内开展100个联合研究与示范项目。

Query_Text_en: - The Chinese side will invite 100 African postdoctors to conduct scientific researches in China .
Translation: 中方将邀请100名非洲博士后研究人员来华开展科研工作。

Query_Text_en: - The Chinese side will offer research instruments to all African scientific researchers who return to their home countries to work upon completion of their long-term joint research tasks in China .
Translation: 中方将为所有在华完成长期联合科研任务后回国工作的非洲科研人员提供研究仪器。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 4 . 2 To present African countries with China 's recent science and technology achievements in high , new and practical technologies , China will co-host with Egypt the China Exhibition on Innovative Technology and Products in Cairo in early December 2009 .
Translation: 五、4.2 为向非洲国家展示中国在高新技术及实用科技领域的最新成果，中国将于2009年12月初在开罗与埃及共同主办"中国创新技术与产品展览会"。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 4 . 3 Noting the important role of technology transfer in enhancing African countries ' capacity-building , China will encourage and promote technology transfer to Africa in various cooperation areas , in particular , the transfer of advanced applicable technologies with a major impact on Africa 's economic and social development , such as technologies for drinking water , agriculture , clean energy and health .
Translation: 五、4.3 中方注意到技术转让对增强非洲国家能力建设的重要作用，将在各合作领域鼓励并推动对非技术转让，特别是饮用水、农业、清洁能源和卫生等对非洲经济社会发展具有重大影响的先进适用技术转让。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 5 . 1 Recognizing that poverty eradication is an arduous task for both sides , and noting Africa 's pressing need to accelerate the poverty reduction process , the two sides will step up cooperation and exchanges in this field .
Translation: 5.5.1 双方认识到消除贫困是彼此面临的艰巨任务，注意到非洲加快减贫进程的迫切需求，将加强该领域合作交流。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 5 . 2 China will continue to share experience in poverty reduction with African countries through seminars and training sessions in order to jointly raise development capacity and make poverty alleviation efforts more effective .
Translation: 5.5.2 中国将继续通过举办研讨会和培训等方式，与非洲国家分享减贫经验，共同提升发展能力，提高减贫成效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 6 . 1 The two sides agreed on the importance of strengthening health systems in Africa and improving its abilities to tackle the major challenge of diseases .
Translation: 5.6.1 双方一致认为，加强非洲卫生体系建设、提升其应对重大疾病挑战的能力具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 6 . 2 The two sides noted with pleasure the deepening health cooperation between the two sides . In particular , the hospitals and anti-malaria centers that China has undertaken to build will play a positive role in improving the health care level and protecting people 's health in African countries .
Translation: 5.6.2 双方欣喜地注意到，中非卫生合作持续深化。特别是中方承建的医院和抗疟中心，将为提升非洲国家医疗水平、保障民众健康发挥积极作用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 6 . 3 The two sides will step up exchanges , particularly their joint efforts to prevent and treat major communicable diseases like HIV\/AIDS , malaria , tuberculosis , avian influenza and influenza A [ H1N1 ] .
Translation: 5.6.3 双方将加强交流，特别是在防控艾滋病、疟疾、结核病、禽流感和甲型H1N1流感等重大传染病方面的合作。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will continue to enhance cooperation in setting up mechanisms to handle public health emergencies .
Translation: 双方将继续加强公共卫生应急机制建设合作。

Query_Text_en: - Provide RMB500 million yuan worth of medical equipment and malaria-fighting materials to 30 hospitals and 30 malaria prevention and treatment centers built by China for Africa in the coming three years .
Translation: 未来三年向中国援建的30所非洲医院和30个疟疾防治中心提供价值5亿元人民币的医疗设备和抗疟物资。

Query_Text_en: China will invite African professionals working in malaria prevention and treatment centers to training programs in China in an effort to ensure sustainable development of the project .
Translation: 中国将邀请在疟疾防治中心工作的非洲专业人员来华参加培训项目，以确保该项目的可持续发展。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to help relevant African countries train a total of 3,000 doctors , nurses and administrative personnel over the next three years .
Translation: 未来三年继续为非洲国家培训总计3000名医生、护士及行政管理人员。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to do a good job in sending medical teams to Africa .
Translation: 继续做好向非洲派遣医疗队工作。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 7 . 1 The two sides noted the positive measures adopted by both sides to jointly tackle climate change . China had organized seminars and training programs on climate change , forest resources cultivation , the use of new energy , environmental management and pollution prevention and control for African countries .
Translation: 5.7.1 双方注意到为共同应对气候变化所采取的积极举措。中方已为非洲国家举办气候变化、森林资源培育、新能源利用、环境管理及污染防治等领域的研讨会与培训项目。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 7 . 2 To help African countries adapt to climate change and strengthen environmental protection , China will step up human resources training for African countries and expand bilateral exchanges and cooperation in the above-mentioned fields .
Translation: 5.7.2 为帮助非洲国家适应气候变化并加强环境保护，中国将加大对非人力资源培训力度，拓展双方在上述领域的交流合作。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 7 . 3 The two sides proposed the establishment of a China-Africa partnership in addressing climate change and the holding of senior officials consultations on a non-regular basis .
Translation: 5.7.3 双方提议建立中非气候变化伙伴关系，并不定期举行高级官员磋商。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese Government offered to assist African countries with 100 small-sized well digging projects for water supply and clean energy projects of biogas , solar energy and small hydro-power plants in the next three years .
Translation: 中国政府承诺在未来三年内，向非洲国家援建100个小型供水打井项目，并提供沼气、太阳能和小水电等清洁能源项目支持。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 7 . 4 China is ready to advance cooperation with African countries in environment surveillance , continue to share with African countries data from the China-Brazil Earth Resources Satellite and promote the application of the data in land use , weather monitoring and environmental protection in Africa .
Translation: 5.7.4 中方愿同非洲国家深化环境监测领域合作，继续向非洲国家共享中巴地球资源卫星数据，推动该数据在非洲土地利用、气象监测和环境保护等方面的应用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 7 . 5 China will help African countries better protect the ecosystem and biodiversity and improve the comprehensive treatment of desertified areas and the relevant surveillance capacity .
Translation: 5.7.5 中国将帮助非洲国家加强生态系统和生物多样性保护，提升荒漠化地区综合治理及相关监测能力。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 8 . 1 The two sides recognized that enhanced cooperation in disaster reduction and relief is an effective means for the two sides to build capacity for preventing natural disasters , eradicating poverty and maintaining sustainable social development . They expressed satisfaction with the sound cooperation between the two sides in the relevant areas .
Translation: 5.8.1 双方认识到，加强减灾救灾合作是提升自然灾害防范能力、消除贫困和保持社会可持续发展的有效途径。双方对相关领域业已开展的良好合作表示满意。

Query_Text_en: China expressed gratitude to African countries for their support and all forms of assistance in the wake of the devastating Wenchuan earthquake .
Translation: 中国对非洲国家在汶川特大地震后给予的支持和各种形式的援助表示感谢。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 8 . 2 China will be glad to share experience with African countries in reducing drought risks , and will send experts to Africa in due course to disseminate technologies and promote their application .
Translation: 5.8.2 中方愿与非洲国家分享抗旱减灾经验，适时派遣专家赴非开展技术推广与应用合作。

Query_Text_en: China plans to co-sponsor , together with the United Nations International Strategy for Disaster Reduction , a China-Africa international seminar on reducing drought risks in Africa in 2010 .
Translation: 中国计划于2010年与联合国国际减灾战略共同主办中非应对非洲旱灾风险国际研讨会。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 8 . 3 China will strengthen exchanges and cooperation with African countries in surveillance and prevention of earthquake and other disasters as well as technical training in those areas .
Translation: 5.8.3 中国将加强与非洲国家在地震等灾害监测防治领域的技术交流合作及人员培训。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 9 . 1 The two sides noted the recent good progress made in China-Africa tourism cooperation , the growing number of tourists and , in particular , the remarkable increase in Chinese tourists visiting Africa .
Translation: 5.9.1 双方注意到中非旅游合作近期取得的良好进展，游客数量持续增长，特别是中国赴非游客数量显著增加。

Query_Text_en: African countries welcome this increase and will encourage their citizens to travel to China .
Translation: 非洲国家对此表示欢迎，并将鼓励本国公民赴华旅行。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 9 . 2 The two sides noted that developing tourism is an effective way to promote national economic growth and cultural exchanges . They will take concrete steps to make travel both ways more convenient .
Translation: 5.9.2 双方指出，发展旅游业是促进国民经济增长和文化交流的有效途径，将采取切实措施为双向人员往来提供更多便利。

Query_Text_en: In response to Africa 's request , the Chinese Government will add more eligible African countries to the list of the Approved Destination Status [ ADS ] for Chinese tourists .
Translation: 中国政府应非洲方面要求，将把更多符合条件的非洲国家列入中国公民组团出境旅游目的地名单。

Query_Text_en: 5 . 9 . 3 The Chinese side reaffirmed its support to Chinese enterprises ' investment in the tourism sector in Africa , and to greater efforts to promote African tourist destinations .
Translation: 5.9.3 中方重申支持中国企业投资非洲旅游业，并加大力度推介非洲旅游目的地。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 1 . 1 The two sides noted with satisfaction that China-Africa cultural exchanges and cooperation have kept expanding with fruitful results in recent years .
Translation: 6.1.1 双方满意地注意到，近年来中非文化交流与合作持续拓展，成果丰硕。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing the splendid histories and cultures of both China and Africa , the two sides agreed to strengthen cultural exchanges and mutual learning to help advance dialogue and exchanges among different civilizations .
Translation: 中非双方高度认同彼此灿烂的历史文化，同意加强人文交流互鉴，促进不同文明对话交流。

Query_Text_en: - Hold the FOCAC Culture Forum in due course , and strengthen regular consultations between government cultural departments of the two sides .
Translation: 适时举办中非合作论坛文化论坛，加强双方政府文化主管部门的定期磋商。

Query_Text_en: - Continue to follow through on projects under the implementation plan of the China-Africa bilateral government cultural agreements , and conduct mid-term assessment on their implementation .
Translation: 继续落实中非双边政府文化协定执行计划项目，并对实施情况进行中期评估。

Query_Text_en: - Work together to promote `` Cultures in Focus '' events in China-Africa cultural exchanges . `` African Culture in Focus '' events will be held in even number years in China and `` Chinese Culture in Focus '' in odd number years in Africa .
Translation: 共同推动中非文化交流“文化聚焦”活动。逢双数年在中国举办“非洲文化聚焦”活动，逢单数年在非洲举办“中国文化聚焦”活动。

Query_Text_en: - Faithfully implement the China-Africa exchange of visits program in the cultural field , and strengthen exchanges and cooperation between cultural and art authorities and professionals of the two sides .
Translation: ——认真实施中非文化交流合作计划，加强双方文化艺术主管部门和专业机构间的交流合作。

Query_Text_en: - Strengthen cooperation and build more Chinese cultural centers in Africa to facilitate regular cultural exchanges , public understanding and research .
Translation: 加强合作，在非洲设立更多中国文化中心，以促进常态化的文化交流、公众认知与研究活动。

Query_Text_en: - Promote cultures of the two sides through new technologies such as the internet to increase mutual understanding .
Translation: - 运用互联网等新技术促进双方文化交流，增进相互理解。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 2 . 1 The two sides will continue to strengthen exchanges and cooperation between press departments of the Chinese and African governments , and support the annual press workshop for African officials .
Translation: 6.2.1 双方将继续加强中非政府新闻部门间的交流合作，支持非洲官员年度新闻研修班持续举办。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 2 . 2 The two sides will promote mutual visits between Chinese and African press department officials , editors and journalists , support the posting of journalists to each other 's country by news organizations of the two sides , and encourage news media of the two sides to step up objective and fair coverage on China and Africa .
Translation: 6.2.2 双方将推动中非新闻主管部门官员、编辑记者互访，支持两国新闻机构互派记者，鼓励双方新闻媒体加强对中非客观公正的报道。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 2 . 3 The two sides will increase cooperation in radio and television program production by conducting exchanges at various levels and in various forms .
Translation: 6.2.3 双方将通过多层次、多形式的交流，加强广播电视节目制作领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 3 . 1 The two sides noted that dynamic exchanges between academia and think tanks are instrumental in increasing mutual understanding between the peoples .
Translation: 6.3.1 双方注意到，学术界与智库间的活跃交流有助于增进两国人民相互理解。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 3 . 2 The two sides proposed to implement a China-Africa joint research and exchange plan to strengthen cooperation and exchanges between scholars and think tanks of the two sides through a variety of ways , such as seminars , mutual academic visits , and joint research projects .
Translation: 6.3.2 双方提议实施中非联合研究交流计划，通过研讨会、互派学者访问、联合研究项目等多种方式，加强两国学者与智库间的合作交流。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 1 The two sides noted that people-to-people exchanges are conducive to mutual understanding and important to the deepening of China-Africa friendship . The two sides remain committed to promoting people-to-people exchanges .
Translation: 6.4.1 双方指出，人文交流有助于增进相互理解，对深化中非友谊具有重要意义。双方将继续致力于促进人文交流。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 2 The two sides held that more China-Africa youth exchanges provided a new impetus to China-Africa traditional friendship and met the needs of both sides .
Translation: 6.4.2 双方认为，中非青年交流的深入开展为传统友谊注入了新动力，符合两国人民的共同期待。

Query_Text_en: The two sides expressed satisfaction with the active youth exchanges after the Beijing Summit .
Translation: 双方对北京峰会以来青年交流的活跃态势表示满意。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 3 The two sides resolved to continue to increase dialogue and exchanges between the younger generations , and advance practical cooperation between youth organizations and young people in youth affairs , social development , culture , sports , and volunteer service .
Translation: 6.4.3 双方决心持续加强青年一代对话交流，深化青年组织及青年群体在青年事务、社会发展、文化体育、志愿服务等领域的务实合作。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 4 The two sides support the Tunisian initiative , proposing the year 2010 as the `` International Year of the Youth '' as well as the organization of an international conference for the youth that will be convened under the auspices of the UN and other relevant international organizations .
Translation: 6.4.4 双方支持突尼斯提出的将2010年定为"国际青年年"的倡议，并支持在联合国及其他相关国际组织支持下召开一次国际青年会议。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 5 Noting the results of the FOCAC Women 's Forum held in Cairo and the release of the FOCAC Women 's Forum Declaration 2009 , the two sides held that the forum helped to enhance the role of women in promoting economic and social development and enriched China-Africa traditional friendship .
Translation: 6.4.5 双方注意到在开罗举行的中非合作论坛妇女论坛取得的成果以及《2009年中非合作论坛妇女论坛宣言》的发布，认为该论坛有助于增强妇女在促进经济社会发展中的作用，丰富了中非传统友谊。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 4 . 6 The two sides recognized the importance of promoting gender equality and the status of women , and resolved to strengthen exchanges and cooperation between Chinese and African women in multiple forms , such as seminars and technical training .
Translation: 6.4.6 双方认识到促进性别平等和提升妇女地位的重要性，决心通过研讨会、技术培训等多种形式，加强中非妇女交流合作。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 5 . 1 China appreciated African countries ' active support for and participation in the Beijing Olympic Games in 2008 .
Translation: 6.5.1 中国赞赏非洲国家对2008年北京奥运会的积极支持和参与。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed to further increase sports exchanges and cooperation .
Translation: 双方同意进一步加强体育交流与合作。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 5 . 2 China fully supports the Africa Cup of Nations , scheduled for January 2010 in Angola , as well as the 2010 FIFA World Cup , to be hosted by Africa for the first time , and wishes both events complete success .
Translation: 6.5.2 中方全力支持定于2010年1月在安哥拉举办的非洲国家杯足球赛，以及非洲大陆首次承办的2010年国际足联世界杯赛，预祝两项赛事取得圆满成功。

Query_Text_en: 6 . 6 World ExpoChina expressed appreciation to African countries ' active participation in World Expo 2010 Shanghai .
Translation: 6月6日世博会专题：中国对非洲国家积极参与2010年上海世博会表示赞赏。

Query_Text_en: China offered due support to African countries in their participation with a view to fully showcasing Africa 's economic development , progress , opportunities , culture and to promoting a better understanding of Africa in the world .
Translation: 中方为非洲国家参展提供了必要支持，旨在全面展示非洲经济发展成就、进步态势、投资机遇及多元文化，促进国际社会对非洲的深入了解。

Query_Text_en: African countries appreciated this and wished the Shanghai Expo a complete success .
Translation: 非洲国家对此表示赞赏，并祝愿上海世博会取得圆满成功。

Query_Text_en: 7 . 1 The two sides noted with satisfaction that since the establishment of FOCAC in 2000 , follow-up mechanisms and procedures have been introduced such as the Ministerial Conference , the regular political dialogue between Chinese and African foreign ministers , the Senior Officials Meeting [ SOM ] , and consultations between African diplomatic missions in China and the Secretariat of the Chinese Follow-up Committee .
Translation: 7.1 双方满意地注意到，自2000年中非合作论坛成立以来，已建立起包括部长级会议、中非外长定期政治对话、高官会议、非洲驻华使团与中方后续行动委员会秘书处磋商等后续机制与程序。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed that FOCAC has become an important platform for collective dialogue and an effective mechanism of practical cooperation between China and Africa .
Translation: 双方一致认为，中非合作论坛已成为中非开展集体对话的重要平台和务实合作的有效机制。

Query_Text_en: 7 . 2 The two sides recognized the need to further strengthen FOCAC as China-Africa relations continue to expand and deepen .
Translation: 7.2 双方认识到，随着中非关系持续拓展深化，有必要进一步加强中非合作论坛建设。

Query_Text_en: The two sides give encouragement and support to relevant departments in China and Africa in holding sub-forums within the FOCAC framework in order to boost cooperation between functional departments of the two sides .
Translation: 双方鼓励并支持中非相关部门在论坛框架下举办分论坛活动，以促进两国职能部门间的合作。

Query_Text_en: 7 . 3 Following the FOCAC follow-up mechanism procedures , the two sides decided to hold the Fifth Ministerial Conference in 2012 , and the 8th SOM in 2011 , both to be held in China .
Translation: 7.3 根据中非合作论坛后续机制程序，双方决定于2012年在中国举行第五届部长级会议，并于2011年在中国召开第八届高官会。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Establishment of a Free Trade AreaThe Parties to this Agreement , consistent with Article XXIV of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade 1994 , hereby establish a free trade area .
Translation:
第一条 自由贸易区的建立  
本协定缔约方根据《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第二十四条规定，特此建立自由贸易区。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] establish a framework for further bilateral economic cooperation to expand and enhance the benefits of this Agreement .
Translation: 建立进一步双边经济合作框架，以扩大并提升本协定带来的效益。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall interpret and apply the provisions of this Agreement in the light of its objectives set out in paragraph 1 and in accordance with customary rules of interpretation of public international law .
Translation: 双方应根据本协定第1款所述目标，并依照国际公法的惯常解释规则，对本协定条款进行解释和适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Relation to Other AgreementsThe Parties affirm their existing rights and obligations with respect to each other under the WTO Agreement and other agreements to which both Parties are parties .
Translation:
第三条 与其他协定的关系  
双方重申在世界贸易组织协定及双方均为缔约方的其他协定项下现有的权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Application of this AgreementThe free trade area to which this Agreement applies consists of the territory of the parties with the exception of any part thereof which constitute separate customs territories .
Translation:
第四条 本协定的适用  
本协定所适用的自由贸易区由缔约方领土构成，但构成单独关税区的部分除外。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] with respect to China , the territory of the People 's Republic of China , including land territory , internal waters , territorial sea and any maritime areas beyond the territorial sea that , in accordance with international law and its domestic law , China may exercise sovereign rights or jurisdiction with respect to the sea , seabed and subsoil and their natural resources .
Translation: 就中国而言，指中华人民共和国领土，包括陆地领土、内水、领海以及根据国际法和中国国内法，中国对海床、底土及其自然资源可行使主权权利或管辖权的领海以外海域。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] with respect to Pakistan , land territory , internal waters and territorial sea as well as and any maritime area situated beyond the territorial sea which has been or might in future be designated under its national law , in accordance with international law , as an area within which PAKISTAN may exercise defacto and de jure sovereign rights or jurisdiction with regard to the sea , sea-bed , the subsoil and the natural resources ;
Translation: 关于巴基斯坦，其陆地领土、内水及领海，以及根据国际法已通过或未来可能通过国内法划定的领海以外任何海域，凡巴基斯坦可对水体、海床、底土及自然资源实际行使或依法享有主权权利或管辖权的区域。

Query_Text_en: andCPFTA means the Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan .
Translation: 《中巴自贸协定》系指中华人民共和国政府与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府签订的自由贸易协定。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Scope and CoverageExcept as otherwise provided , this Chapter applies to trade in goods between the Parties .
Translation:
第六条 适用范围与涵盖领域  
除另有规定外，本章适用于缔约双方之间的货物贸易。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 National TreatmentEach Party shall accord national treatment to the goods of the other Party in accordance with Article III of the GATT 1994 , including its interpretative notes , and to this end Article III of GATT 1994 , and its interpretative notes , are incorporated into and made part of this Agreement , mutatis mutandis .
Translation:
第七条 国民待遇  
各方应依照《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第三条及其解释性说明的规定，给予另一方的货物国民待遇。为此，《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第三条及其解释性说明经必要修改后纳入本协定，构成本协定组成部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement , each Party shall progressively eliminate its import customs duties on goods originating in the territory of another Party in accordance with Annex 1 .
Translation: 除本协定另有规定外，各方应按照附件1逐步取消对原产于另一缔约方领土货物的进口关税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a Party reduces its applied most favored nation import customs duty rate after the entry into force of this Agreement and before the end of the tariff elimination period , the tariff elimination schedule [ Schedule ] of that Party shall apply to the reduced rate .
Translation: 二、如一缔约方在本协定生效后至关税取消期结束前降低其适用的最惠国进口关税税率，则该缔约方的关税减让表应适用于降低后的税率。

Query_Text_en: 3 . On the request of either Party , the Parties shall consult to consider acceleratingthe elimination of import customs duties set out in their Schedules .
Translation: 应一方要求，双方应协商考虑加快削减各自减让表所列进口关税。

Query_Text_en: An agreement between the Parties to accelerate the elimination of an import customs duty on a good shall supersede any duty rate or staging category determined pursuant to their Schedules for such good when approved by each Party in accordance with their respective applicable legal procedures .
Translation: 缔约双方达成的关于加速取消某货物进口关税的协议，一经各方依照本国适用法律程序批准，即应取代该货物减让表所确定的任何关税税率或分阶段实施类别。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Tariff Reduction Modality and the lists shall be reviewed and modified every five years by the Committee on Trade in Goods .
Translation: [ a ] 关税削减模式及清单应由货物贸易委员会每五年审议修订一次。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The review shall be undertaken on the basis of friendly consultation and accommodation of the concerns of the Parties .
Translation: 审查应在友好协商和兼顾各方关切的基础上进行。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The first review and modification shall be undertaken either at the end of the fourth year or at the beginning of the fifth year of entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 首次审议与修改应在本协定生效第四年年底或第五年年初进行。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Either party may request for an additional review at any time after coming into force of this Agreement .
Translation: [d]本协议生效后，任一方均可随时要求进行补充审议。

Query_Text_en: Such a request shall be favorably considered by the other Party .
Translation: 对方应积极考虑该请求。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall ensure , in accordance with Article VIII : 1 of the GATT 1994 and its interpretive notes , that all fees and charges of whatever character [ other than import customs duties , charges equivalent to an internal tax or other internal charge applied consistently with Article III : 2 of the GATT 1994 , and antidumping and countervailing duties ] imposed on or in connection with importation or exportation are limited in amount to the approximate cost of services rendered and do not represent an indirect protection to domestic goods or a taxation of imports or exports for fiscal purposes .
Translation: 1. 各方应依照《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第八条第1款及其解释性说明，确保对进口或出口征收的任何性质税费[进口关税、与《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第三条第2款相符的等效国内税费、反倾销税和反补贴税除外]，其金额不得超过所提供服务的近似成本，且不得构成对国内货物的间接保护，或为财政目的对进出口货物征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall make available through the Internet or a comparable computer-based telecommunications network a list of the fees and charges and changes thereto levied by the central\/federal Government , as the case may be , thereof in connection with importation or exportation .
Translation: 二、每一方应通过互联网或类似电脑电信网络公布其中央政府或联邦政府（视具体情况而定）征收的与进出口相关的费用、收费及其变更清单。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall provide that any right holder initiating procedures for suspension by the customs authorities of the release of suspected counterfeit trademark or pirated copyright goods into free circulation is required to provide adequate evidence to satisfy the competent authorities that , under the relevant laws of the Party of importation , there is prima facie an infringement of the right holder 's intellectual property right and to supply sufficient information to make the suspected goods reasonably recognizable to the customs authorities .
Translation: 一、各方应规定，权利持有人如申请海关中止放行涉嫌假冒商标或盗版货物进入自由流通，须向主管机关提供足以证明依照进口方相关法律已构成对其知识产权侵权的初步证据，并提供能使海关合理辨识涉嫌货物的充分信息。

Query_Text_en: The sufficient information required shall not unreasonably deter recourse to these procedures .
Translation: 所需充分信息不得对诉诸此类程序构成不合理阻碍。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall provide the competent authorities with the powers to require an applicant to provide a reasonable security or equivalent assurance sufficient to protect the defendant and the competent authorities and to prevent abuse .
Translation: 二、各方应赋予主管机关要求申请人提供合理担保或同等保证的权力，以确保被告及主管机关权益不受侵害，并防止权利滥用。

Query_Text_en: Such security or equivalent assurance shall not unreasonably deter recourse to these procedures .
Translation: 此类保证金或同等担保不得无理阻碍当事人诉诸这些程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where the competent authorities have made a determination that goods are counterfeit or pirated , a Party shall grant the competent authorities the right to inform the right holder , at the right holder 's request , of the names and addresses of the consignor , the importer , and the consignee , and of the quantity of the goods in question .
Translation: 3. 主管机关认定货物为假冒或盗版时，一缔约方应授权该主管机关根据权利持有人请求，向其提供发货人、进口商及收货人名称、地址以及涉案货物数量等信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Party shall provide that the competent authorities are permitted to initiate border measures ex officio , without the need for a formal complaint from a person or right holder .
Translation: 四、各方应规定主管机关有权依职权主动采取边境措施，无需权利人或其他个人提出正式投诉。

Query_Text_en: Such measures shall be used when there is reason to believe or suspect that goods being imported , or destined for export are counterfeit or pirated .
Translation: 当有合理理由怀疑进口或拟出口商品为假冒或盗版时，应采取此类措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties hereby establish a Committee on Trade in Goods , comprising representatives at the level of joint secretary , director general or deputy director general respectively .
Translation: 1. 双方特此设立货物贸易委员会，由各自联合秘书、司长或副司长级代表组成。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Committee shall meet on the request of either Party or the Commission established under Chapter XI of this Agreement to consider any matter arising under this Chapter , Chapter IV and Chapter V.
Translation: 2. 委员会应在本协定第十一章所设委员会或任一方提出请求时召开会议，审议本章及第四章、第五章项下产生的任何事项。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] any other issue related to trade in goods , referred to the Committee by either Party .
Translation: [d] 任何一方提交委员会处理的与货物贸易相关的其他事项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Committee may establish working groups to deliberate on any matter if required .
Translation: 4. 委员会可酌情设立工作组，审议相关事项。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] `` CIF value '' means the price actually paid or payable to the exporter for the good when the good is unloaded from the carrier , at the port of importation .
Translation: “到岸价格”指货物在进口港卸离运输工具时，进口商实际支付或应付给出口商的价格。

Query_Text_en: The value includes the cost of the good , insurance and freight necessary to deliver the good to the named port of destination .
Translation: 该价值包含货物成本、保险费及将货物运抵指定目的港所需的运费。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] `` Customs Valuation Agreement '' means the WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII of the = T and origin = 1348276 and provider = 1 and isEnglish = Y '' class = `` link '' re = `` T '' cate = `` en '' target = ''  blank '' ] General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade 1994 .
Translation: 《海关估价协定》指世界贸易组织《关于履行1994年关税与贸易总协定第七条的协定》。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] `` FOB value '' means the price actually paid or payable to the exporter for the good when the good is loaded into the carrier at the named port of exportation .
Translation: "FOB价值"指货物在指定出口港装运至承运工具时，实际支付或应付给出口商的货物价格。

Query_Text_en: The value includes the cost of the good and all costs necessary to bring the good into the carrier .
Translation: 该价值包括货物成本及将货物运至承运人所需的一切费用。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] `` Materials '' include ingredients , parts , components , subassembly and\/or goods that were physically incorporated into another good or were subject to a process in the production of another good .
Translation: “材料”包括用于构成另一物品或经加工程序生产另一物品所实际使用的成分、部件、零件、半成品及/或商品。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] `` Originating goods '' means products that qualify as originating in accordance with the provisions of Article 13 .
Translation: "原产货物"是指根据第十三条规定符合原产资格的产品。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] `` Product Specific Rules '' are rules that specify that the materials have undergone a change in tariff classification or a specific manufacturing or processing operation , or satisfy an ad valorem criterion or a combination of any of these criteria .
Translation: "产品特定规则"是指明确规定材料需经历税则归类变更、特定制造或加工工序，或满足从价标准，抑或上述任何标准组合的规则。

Query_Text_en: and any other goods that are not incorporated into the good but whose use in the production of the good can reasonably be demonstrated to be part of that production ;
Translation: 以及虽未构成货物组成部分，但能合理证明其用于该货物生产过程的任何其他货物；

Query_Text_en: [ h ] `` Non-originating material '' used in production means any material whose country of origin is other than that of the Parties and any material whose origin can not be determined ;
Translation: 生产过程中使用的"非原产材料"指原产地为非缔约方的任何材料，以及原产地无法确定的任何材料。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] `` Production '' includes methods of obtaining goods including manufacturing , producing , assembling , processing , raising , growing , breeding , mining , extracting , harvesting , fishing , trapping , gathering , collecting , hunting and capturing .
Translation: “生产”包括获取货物的各种方法，如制造、生产、组装、加工、饲养、种植、培育、采矿、提取、收获、捕捞、诱捕、采集、收集、狩猎和捕获。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] products not wholly obtained or produced provided that the said products are eligible under Article 15 , Article 16 or Article 17 .
Translation: [ b ] 非完全获得或生产的产品，只要该等产品符合第15条、第16条或第17条规定的资格要求。

Query_Text_en: [ l ] Goods obtained or produced in a Party solely from products referred to in paragraphs [ a ] to [ k ] above .
Translation: [ l ] 在一方境内完全使用上述[ a ]至[ k ]项所述产品获得或生产的货物。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] For the purposes of Article 13 [ b ] , a product shall be deemed to be originating if not less than 40 % of its content originates from a Party .
Translation: 就第十三条而言，若产品中至少40%的成分原产于缔约一方，则该产品应视为原产产品。

Query_Text_en: or [ ii ] the earliest ascertained price paid for the materials of undetermined origin in the territory of the Party where the working or processing takes place .
Translation: 或（ii）在加工或处理所在缔约方境内，对来源不明的材料所支付的最早可确定价格。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Cumulative Rule of OriginUnless otherwise provided for , products which comply with origin requirements provided for in Article 13 and which are used in the territory of a Party as materials for a finished product eligible for preferential treatment under the Agreement shall be considered as products originating in the territory of the Party where working or processing of the finished product has taken place provided that the aggregate China-Pakistan originating content on the final product is not less than 40 % .
Translation:
第十六条  原产地累计规则  
除非本协定另有规定，符合第十三条原产地要求的产品，在一方境内作为可享受本协定优惠待遇的制成品生产原料使用时，若该制成品最终的中国—巴基斯坦累计原产成分不低于40%，则应视为在其加工或制造的缔约方境内原产。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Product Specific RulesProducts which have undergone sufficient transformation in a Party shall be treated as originating goods of that Party .
Translation:
第十七条 产品特定规则  
一缔约方境内经充分加工的产品，应视为该缔约方的原产货物。

Query_Text_en: Products which satisfy the Product Specific Criteria as annexed to these Rules shall be considered as goods to which sufficient transformation has been carried out in a Party .
Translation: 符合本规则附件所列产品特定标准的产品，应视为在该缔约方境内经过充分加工的商品。

Query_Text_en: [ k ] A combination of two or more operations referred to in paragraphs [ a ] to [ j ] .
Translation: [ k ] 第[ a ]至[ j ]项所述两种或两种以上业务的组合。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] the products have not undergone any operation there other than unloading and reloading or any operation required to keep them in good condition .
Translation: [ iii ] 除卸货和重新装载或为保持产品良好状态所需操作外，该产品未在该地经历任何其他加工工序。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Where for purposes of assessing customs duties , a Party treats products separately from their packing ; it may also , in respect of its imports consigned from another Party , determine separately the origin of such packing .
Translation: [ a ] 为计征关税之目的，如一缔约方对产品及其包装分别处理，则该缔约方亦可针对自另一缔约方发运的进口货物，单独确定此类包装的原产地。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where paragraph [ a ] above is not applied , packing shall be considered as forming a whole with the products and no part of any packing required for their transport or storage shall be considered as having been imported from outside the CPFTA when determining the origin of the products as a whole .
Translation: 如上述第[a]款不适用，则包装应视为与产品构成整体。在确定产品整体原产地时，运输或存储所需的任何包装部件均不得视为来自《中巴自贸协定》外部区域。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Accessories , Spare Parts and ToolsThe origin of accessories , spare parts , tools and instructional or other information materials presented with the goods therewith shall be neglected in determining the origin of the goods , provided that such accessories , spare parts , tools and information materials are classified and collected customs duties with the goods by the importing member state .
Translation:
第二十一条 附件、备件及工具  
在确定货物原产地时，与货物一同报验的附件、备件、工具及说明书或其他信息材料的原产地可不予考虑，但上述附件、备件、工具及信息材料须与该货物一并归类并征收关税。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Treatment of Indirect MaterialsUnless otherwise provided , for the purpose of determining the origin of goods , the origin of indirect materials as defined in Article 12 [ h ] , or the materials used in its manufacture which do not remain in the goods or form part of the goods , shall not be taken into account .
Translation:
第二十二条 间接材料的处理  
除另有规定外，为确定货物原产地之目的，第十二条（h）项所定义的间接材料，或其制造过程中使用但未留存于货物中或不构成货物组成部分的材料，其原产地不予考虑。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 Certificate of OriginA claim that products shall be accepted as eligible for preferential concession shall be supported by a Certificate of Origin issued by a government authority designated by the exporting Party and notified to the other Party to the Agreement in accordance with the operational certification procedures , as set out in Annex II .
Translation:
第二十三条 原产地证书  
要求产品享受优惠关税待遇的主张，应由出口方政府指定并依据本协定附件二所列操作认证程序通知另一方的政府机构签发的原产地证书予以支持。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Review and ModificationThese rules may be reviewed and modified as and when necessary upon request of a Party and may be open to such reviews and modifications as may be agreed upon by both Parties .
Translation:
第二十四条 审查与修改  
经一方提出要求，本规则可随时进行必要审查与修改；双方亦可协商一致后开展此类审查与修改。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties maintain their rights and obligations under the Agreement on Implementation of Article VI of the GATT 1994 and the Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures , which are parts of the WTO Agreement .
Translation: 双方保留根据《关于实施1994年关税与贸易总协定第6条的协定》和《补贴与反补贴措施协定》所享有的权利及承担的义务，上述协定均为《WTO协定》的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Antidumping actions taken pursuant to Article VI of GATT l994 and the Agreement on Implementation of Article VI of the GATT 1994 or countervailing actions taken pursuant to Article VI of GATT l994 and the Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures shall not be subject to Chapter X [ Dispute Settlement ] of this Agreement .
Translation: 依据《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第六条及《关于实施1994年关税与贸易总协定第六条的协定》采取的反倾销措施，或依据《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第六条及《补贴与反补贴措施协定》采取的反补贴措施，均不适用本协定第十章[争端解决]之规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties maintain their rights and obligations under Article XIX of GATT l994 and the Safeguards Agreement .
Translation: 缔约方保留《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第十九条及《保障措施协定》项下的权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Actions taken pursuant to Article XIX of GATT 1994 and the Safeguards Agreement shall not be subject to Chapter X [ Dispute Settlement ] of this Agreement .
Translation: 根据《1994年关税与贸易总协定》第十九条及《保障措施协定》采取的行动，不受本协定第十章[争端解决]管辖。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in the case of Pakistan , National Tariff Commission , or its successor ;
Translation: [ ii ] 就巴基斯坦而言，指国家关税委员会或其继任机构；

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Transition period means `` five-year period in the first phase of customs duty reduction or elimination '' .
Translation: 过渡期指"关税削减或取消第一阶段内的五年期限"。

Query_Text_en: With regard to transition period in the second phase , the Parties shall meet to determine it in the review of this Article .
Translation: 关于第二阶段过渡期安排，双方将在本条审议期间会商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The MFN applied rate of customs duty on the good in effect on date of entry into force of this agreement ;
Translation: [ ii ] 本协定生效之日实施的最惠国适用关税税率；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the MFN applied rate of customs duty on the good in effect on the date of entry into force of this agreement .
Translation: [ ii ] 本协定生效之日实施的最惠国适用关税税率。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] taking a decision to apply a safeguard measure .
Translation: [ iii ] 作出实施保障措施的决定。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] a Party proposing to apply a measure shall provide adequate opportunity for prior consultations with the other Party as far in advance of taking any such measure as practicable , with a view to reviewing the information arising from the investigation , exchanging views on the measure and reaching an agreement on compensation set out in Paragraph 4 .
Translation: 一方若拟实施某项措施，应尽可能提前为另一方提供充分的事前磋商机会，以便审查调查所得信息、就相关措施交换意见，并就第四款所列补偿事宜达成协议。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] the appropriateness of the proposed measure , including consideration of alternative measures ;
Translation: [三] 拟议措施的适当性，包括对替代措施的考量；

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the investigation shall in all cases be completed within one year following its date of initiation ;
Translation: 调查应在立案之日起一年内全部结束。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] for a period exceeding two years , except that in exceptional circumstances , the period may be extended by up to an additional one year , to a total maximum of three years from the date of first imposition of the measure if the investigating authorities determine in conformity with procedures set out paragraphs [ a ] through [ g ] , that the safeguard measure continues to be necessary to prevent or remedy serious injury and to facilitate adjustment and that there is evidence that the industry is adjusting ;
Translation: [二] 保障措施的实施期限不得超过两年。但在特殊情况下，经调查机关根据第[a]至[g]项规定的程序认定，为防止或补救严重损害并便利调整确有必要继续实施保障措施，且有证据表明该产业正在进行调整的，可将实施期限延长不超过一年，自首次实施该措施之日起最长总计不得超过三年。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] beyond the expiration of the transition period , regardless of its duration or whether it has been subject to extension ;
Translation: [ iii ] 过渡期结束后，无论其期限长短或是否经过延长；

Query_Text_en: [ h ] no bilateral safeguard measure taken under this Article shall be applied again to the import of a product which has been subject to such a measure for a period of time equal to that during which such measure had been previously applied , provided that the period of non-application is at least two years ;
Translation: 根据本条采取的任何双边保障措施，对已实施该措施的进口产品，在其实施期限等于先前适用期限的情况下不得再次适用，但非适用期至少为两年者除外。

Query_Text_en: and [ k ] within 5 years after entry into force of this Agreement , the Parties shall meet to review this Article with a view to determining whether there is a need to maintain any bilateral safeguard mechanism .
Translation: 自本协定生效之日起5年内，缔约双方应召开会议审议本条，以确定是否有必要保留任何双边保障机制。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The party proposing to apply a measure described in Paragraph 2 shall provide to the other party mutually agreed adequate means of trade liberalizing compensation in the form of concessions having substantially equivalent trade effects or equivalent to the value of the additional duties expected to result from the measure .
Translation: 提议实施第二款所述措施的缔约方，应向另一缔约方提供双方商定的充分贸易自由化补偿，其形式为具有实质等效贸易效应的减让，或等同于该措施预期产生的额外关税等值的补偿。

Query_Text_en: If the Parties are unable to agree on compensation within 30 days in the consultations under Paragraph 3 [ c ] , the Party against whose originating goods the measure is applied may take action having trade effects substantially equivalent to the measure applied under this Article .
Translation: 若双方未能在第3款(c)项规定的磋商期内30日内就补偿达成一致，则被实施措施的缔约方可采取具有实质等效贸易效应的行动，以应对依据本条实施的措施。

Query_Text_en: This action shall be applied only for the minimum period necessary to achieve the substantially equivalent effects .
Translation: 此项措施仅应在实现实质等效效果所需的最短期限内实施。

Query_Text_en: The right of suspension described in this paragraph shall not be exercised for the first 18 months that a bilateral safeguard measure is in effect , provided that such a measure conforms to the provisions of this Article .
Translation: 本款所述中止权利在双边保障措施实施后的前18个月内不得行使，但该措施须符合本条相关规定。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] ensure the consistent , impartial and reasonable administration of its laws , regulations , decisions and rulings governing all safeguard investigation proceedings .
Translation: 确保所有保障措施调查程序所涉法律、法规、决定和裁决的行政管理始终一致、公正且合理。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] entrust determinations of serious injury or threat thereof in safeguard investigation proceedings to a competent investigating authority .
Translation: [ b ] 将保障措施调查程序中关于严重损害或其威胁的判定权授予主管调查机关。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] adopt or maintain equitable , timely , transparent and effective procedures for safeguard investigation proceedings .
Translation: [ c ] 制定或维持公平、及时、透明且有效的保障措施调查程序。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The definitions in Annex A of the SPS Agreement shall be applied in the implementation of this Chapter .
Translation: 《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》附件A中的定义适用于本章的实施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . SPS Agreement means the Agreement on the Application of Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures of the World Trade Organization .
Translation: 2. SPS协定指世界贸易组织《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》。

Query_Text_en: provide a forum to discuss SPS measures of each other , to solve the problems of trade in this field in a prompt and efficient manner to ensure trade expansion between the parties .
Translation: 为各方提供讨论卫生与植物检疫措施的论坛，及时高效解决该领域贸易问题，确保双方贸易持续扩大。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 ScopeThis Chapter applies to all sanitary and phytosanitary measures of the Parties which may , directly or indirectly , affect trade between the Parties .
Translation:
第三十条  范围  
本章适用于缔约方可能直接或间接影响双方贸易的所有卫生与植物卫生措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Parties are the authorities competent in the respective countries for the implementation of the measures referred to in this Chapter ,
Translation: 缔约双方的主管机关系指各自国家负责实施本章所述措施的相关部门。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall inform each other of any significant changes in the structure , organization and division of responsibility within its competent authorities .
Translation: 双方应相互通报各自主管部门在架构、组织及职责分工方面的重大变更。

Query_Text_en: 3 . For the suitable implementation of the Chapter , bilateral contact between the homologous sanitary and phytosanitary agencies will be promoted and strengthened .
Translation: 为切实落实本章内容，双方将推动并加强卫生与植物卫生主管机构的对口双边交流合作。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties shall undertake cooperation as per transparency requirements set out in WTO\/SPS Agreement .
Translation: 1. 双方应根据WTO/SPS协定规定的透明度要求开展合作。

Query_Text_en: The sanitary and phytosanitary enquiry points of the Parties established under the SPS Agreement shall set up a bilateral mechanism for further communication , including the sanitary and phytosanitary measures that needs to be undertaken as well as information regarding noncompliance with sanitary and phytosanitary requirements of importing Party without undue delay .
Translation: 根据《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》设立的双方卫生与植物检疫咨询点应建立双边沟通机制，就需采取的卫生与植物检疫措施、以及进口方卫生与植物检疫要求未获遵守的相关信息及时开展进一步交流。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties will , whenever a need arises , exchange information related to the sanitary and phytosanitary condition in their territories and will provide the necessary information to develop risk assessment and equivalence processes .
Translation: 二、缔约方应视需要交换各自境内的卫生与植物卫生状况信息，并提供必要资料以开展风险评估及等效性认定程序。

Query_Text_en: 1 . To achieve harmonization both Parties shall base their SPS measures on international standards , guidelines or recommendations , or base the measures on risk assessment , and shall cooperate in this regard .
Translation: 1. 为实现协调一致，双方应以国际标准、指南或建议为基础制定卫生与植物卫生措施，或依据风险评估结果制定相关措施，并就此开展合作。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Both Parties shall consider to accept the SPS measures of each other as equivalent even if it differs from their own or from those used by other members trading in the same product , if the exporting party objectively demonstrates to the importing party that its measures achieve the importing party 's appropriate level of sanitary and phytosanitary procedure .
Translation: 双方应考虑接受彼此的卫生与植物检疫措施为等效措施，即便这些措施与己方或其他贸易同类产品的成员方所采取的措施存在差异，只要出口方能够向进口方客观证明其措施达到了进口方适当的卫生与植物检疫保护水平。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , reasonable access shall be given , upon request , to the importing party for inspection , testing and other relevant procedures .
Translation: 为此目的，进口方提出请求时，应获得合理准入以便进行检验、测试及其他相关程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Both Parties shall cooperate for mutual recognition of SPS certificates .
Translation: 双方应开展合作，实现卫生与植物检疫证书互认。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties hereby agree to establish a Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Matters composed of each Party 's representatives who have responsibility for sanitary and phytosanitary matters .
Translation: 1. 双方特此同意设立卫生与植物卫生事务委员会，由各方负责卫生与植物卫生事务的代表组成。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in the case of Pakistan , Additional Secretary , Ministry of Food , Agriculture and Livestock or its designated person
Translation: 就巴基斯坦而言，由粮食、农业和畜牧部附加秘书或其指定人员

Query_Text_en: 2 . In order to facilitate the communication and ensure the proper functioning of the Committee , the Parties will designate a contact person no later than two months following the date of entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 为便于沟通并确保委员会正常运作，各方应在本协议生效后两个月内指定一名联络人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Parties shall establish the Committee in a period not longer than two months after the date of entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 3. 双方应在本协定生效后两个月内成立委员会。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The objectives of the Committee shall be to ensure the achievement of the objectives stated in this Chapter .
Translation: 委员会的目标是确保实现本章所述各项目标。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Committee shall seek to enhance any present or future relationship between the Parties ' agencies with responsibility for sanitary and phytosanitary matters .
Translation: 五、委员会应致力于加强双方负责卫生与植物卫生事务的现有及未来机构间合作关系。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] reviewing progress on addressing sanitary and phytosanitary matters that may arise between the competent authorities of both Parties .
Translation: 审议双方主管部门之间可能出现的卫生与植物卫生事务处理进展。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The Committee shall meet once a year unless the Parties otherwise agree .
Translation: 7. 除非缔约方另有约定，委员会应每年召开一次会议。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The Committee may agree to establish ad hoc technical working groups in accordance with the Committee 's terms of reference .
Translation: 8. 委员会可根据其职权范围，同意设立特设技术工作组。

Query_Text_en: 1 . `` WTO\/TBT Agreement '' means the Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade of the World Trade Organization .
Translation: 1. 《WTO/TBT协定》是指世界贸易组织《技术性贸易壁垒协定》。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The definitions of Annex I of the WTO\/TBT Agreement shall apply .
Translation: 2. 应适用WTO/TBT协定附件一中的定义。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Reduce , wherever possible , unnecessary transaction costs associated with trade between the Parties ;
Translation: 2. 在可能的情况下，降低双方贸易中不必要的交易成本。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 Scope and CoverageThis Chapter applies to all standards , technical regulations and conformity assessment procedures that may , directly or indirectly , affect the trade in goods between the Parties , except sanitary and phyto-sanitary measures which are covered by Chapter VI of this Agreement .
Translation:
第三十七条  范围与覆盖领域  
本章适用于可能直接或间接影响双方货物贸易的所有标准、技术法规和合格评定程序，但本协定第六章所涵盖的卫生与植物卫生措施除外。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 ReaffirmationThe rights and obligations of the Parties in respect of technical regulations , standards and conformity assessment procedures shall be governed by the WTO Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade [ TBT ] .
Translation:
第三十八条  重申  
双方在技术法规、标准及合格评定程序方面的权利与义务，应受世界贸易组织《技术性贸易壁垒协定》（TBT协定）管辖。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties shall intensify their joint work in the field of technical regulations , standards and conformity assessment procedures with a view to facilitating bilateral trade .
Translation: 1. 双方应加强在技术法规、标准及合格评定程序领域的合作，以促进双边贸易发展。

Query_Text_en: The Parties shall , through consultation , seek to identify specific preferential cooperation areas and products , and arrange for cooperative implementation initiatives that are appropriate for trade needs and practical capacity step by step .
Translation: 双方应通过协商确定具体的优惠合作领域和产品，并根据贸易需求和实际能力，逐步安排适当的合作实施举措。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall use international standards , or the relevant parts of international standards , as a basis for their technical regulations and related conformity assessment procedures where relevant international standards exist or their completion is imminent , except when such international standards or their relevant parts are ineffective or inappropriate to fulfill legitimate regulatory objectives .
Translation: 2. 对于已存在或即将完成的国际标准，缔约方应以国际标准或其相关部分作为技术法规及相关合格评定程序的制定基础，但此类国际标准或其相关部分无法有效实现正当监管目标或适用不当时除外。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Parties shall encourage appropriate institutions in their jurisdiction to strengthen their technical cooperation aimed at achieving full and effective compliance with the obligations set forth in the WTO Agreement and with a view to increase the mutual understanding of their respective systems and facilitating access to their respective markets .
Translation: 3. 双方应鼓励辖区内相关机构加强技术合作，旨在全面有效履行《WTO协定》所规定的各项义务，增进对彼此制度的相互理解，并为进入各自市场提供便利。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] promoting bilateral coordination by appropriate agencies in multilateral and international fora on standards .
Translation: [三]推动双方相关机构在多边及国际标准制定平台加强协调配合。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] give favourable consideration to any written request for cooperation .
Translation: [ ii ] 对任何书面合作请求给予积极考虑。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] transmit electronically the proposal to the other Party through the inquiry point established under Article 10 of the WTO\/TBT Agreement at the same time as it notifies WTO Members of the proposal pursuant to the TBT Agreement .
Translation: [ b ] 通过世贸组织《技术性贸易壁垒协定》第10条设立的咨询点，在规定向世贸组织成员通报该提案的同时，以电子方式将提案传送给对方；

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Party makes a notification under Article 2 . 10 or 5 . 7 of the WTO\/TBT Agreement , it shall at the same time transmit the notification to the other Party , electronically , through the inquiry point referred to in subparagraph [ b ] of paragraph1 .
Translation: 如一方根据《WTO/TBT协定》第2.10条或第5.7条发出通知，则该方应同时通过第1款第(b)项所述咨询点以电子方式将该通知转递另一方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Parties shall undertake cooperation as per transparency requirements set out in WTO\/TBT Agreement , and establish cooperation mechanism between enquiry points of the parties .
Translation: 3. 双方应按照《WTO/TBT协定》规定的透明度要求开展合作，并建立双方咨询点之间的合作机制。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Party shall provide and keep updated information about the competent authorities and will communicate any significant change in their structure , organization and division .
Translation: 4. 各方应提供并持续更新主管机关信息，并就其架构、组织及部门划分的任何重大变更进行通报。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Party shall notify each other upon request the conformity assessment procedure and related list of products stipulated by relevant technical regulations .
Translation: 五、各方应对方要求，通报相关技术法规规定的合格评定程序及所涉产品清单。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties hereby establish the Joint Committee on Technical Barriers to Trade , comprising representatives of each Party .
Translation: 双方特此设立技术性贸易壁垒联合委员会，由各方代表组成。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] in the case of China , the Director General of Department of International Cooperation of AQSIQ , or its designated person ;
Translation: 在中国，由国家质检总局国际合作司司长或其指定人员负责；

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] in the case of Pakistan , the Director General of Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority [ PSQCA ] , or its designated person .
Translation: 且[b]就巴基斯坦而言，巴基斯坦标准与质量控制总局（PSQCA）局长或其指定人员。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] consulting on any matter arising under this Chapter , upon either Party 's request ;
Translation: 应任何一方请求，就本章所涉任何事项提供咨询；

Query_Text_en: 4 . A Party shall , upon request , give favorable consideration to any sector-specific proposal the other Party makes to further cooperation under this Chapter .
Translation: 一方应对方要求，应对其就深化本章项下合作提出的具体领域建议给予积极考虑。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Committee shall meet once a year unless the Parties otherwise agree .
Translation: 5. 委员会应每年召开一次会议，除非缔约方另有约定。

Query_Text_en: These meetings may be held via teleconference , videoconference , or through any other means , as mutually determined by the Parties .
Translation: 双方可协商通过电话会议、视频会议或其他任何方式举行此类会议。

Query_Text_en: By mutual agreement , ad hoc working groups may be established if necessary .
Translation: 经双方协商同意，必要时可设立特别工作小组。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall designate a contact point to facilitate communications between the Parties on any matter covered by this Agreement .
Translation:
1. 双方应各自指定联络点，以便就本协定所涉任何事项进行沟通。  

2. 各方应指定一名联络人，负责协调本协议涵盖事项的双方沟通事宜。  

3. 缔约双方均应设立联络点，为协定范围内事务的沟通提供便利。  

（注：根据政经文本严谨性与中文表达习惯，提供三种不同风格的译法供选择，实际使用时只需采用其中一种即可。第一种译法最为简洁规范；第二种译法突出"协调"职能；第三种译法更侧重法律文本的正式性。）

Query_Text_en: 2 . Upon request of the other Party , the contact point shall identify the office or official responsible for the matter and assist , as necessary , in facilitating communication with the requesting Party .
Translation: 2. 应另一方要求，联络点应确定负责相关事务的机构或官员，并在必要时协助与请求方进行沟通。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 PublicationEach Party shall ensure that its measures respecting any matter covered by this Agreement are promptly published or otherwise made available to the other Party so as to enable the other Party to become familiarized with them .
Translation:
第四十三条  公布  
各方应确保本协定所涉相关措施迅速公布或以其他方式提供给另一方，以便另一方及时知悉。

Query_Text_en: 1 . To the extent possible , each Party shall notify the other Party of any actual measure that the Party considers might materially affect the operation of this Agreement or otherwise substantially affect the other Party 's legitimate interests under this Agreement .
Translation: 1. 在可能范围内，一方应将其认为可能实质影响本协定实施或实质损害另一方在本协定项下正当利益的任何实际措施通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Upon request of the other Party , to the extent possible , a Party shall promptly provide information and respond to questions pertaining to any actual or proposed measure , that the other Party considers might materially affect the operation of this Agreement or otherwise substantially affect its legitimate interests under this Agreement , whether or not the other Party has been previously notified of that measure .
Translation: 二、应另一缔约方请求，对于该方认为可能实质性影响本协定实施、或以其他方式实质影响其在本协定项下合法利益的任何已实施或拟议措施，无论该措施此前是否已通报，一缔约方应在可能范围内迅速提供相关信息并答复问题。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any notification or information provided under this Article shall be without prejudice as to whether the measure is consistent with this Agreement .
Translation: 根据本条所作的任何通知或提供的信息，均不影响对该措施是否符合本协定规定的判定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The information referred to under this Article shall be considered to have been provided when it has been made available by appropriate notification to the WTO or when it has been made available on the official , public and free of cost accessible website of the Party concerned .
Translation: 根据本条所述信息，在通过适当通知向世贸组织提供或已在相关缔约方官方、公开且免费可访问的网站上公布时，即视为已提供。

Query_Text_en: Article 45 Confidential InformationNothing in this Agreement shall be construed to require a Party to furnish or allow access to confidential information the disclosure of which would impede law enforcement or would be contrary to the public interests , the laws of the Party protecting the privacy or the financial affairs and accounts of individual customers or financial institutions or which prejudice legitimate commercial interests of particular enterprises , public or private .
Translation:
第四十五条  机密信息  
本协议任何条款不得解释为要求缔约方提供或允许获取下列机密信息：披露该信息将妨碍执法、违背公共利益、违反缔约方保护个人客户或金融机构隐私或财务事务及账目之法律，或有损特定企业（无论公有或私有）之合法商业利益。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] business concessions conferred by law or under contract permitted by law , including concessions to search for , cultivate , extract or exploit natural resources .
Translation: 法律授予或依法订立的合同所允许的商业特许权，包括勘探、培育、开采或开发自然资源的特许权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any change in the form in which assets are invested does not affect their character as investments provided that such a change is in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Party in whose territory the investment has been made .
Translation: 二、资产投资形式的任何变更，只要符合投资所在缔约方的法律法规，均不影响其作为投资的性质。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] legal entities , including companies , associations , partnerships and other organizations , incorporated or constituted under the laws and regulations of either Party and have their seats in that Party .
Translation: （二）法律实体，包括公司、协会、合伙组织及其他机构，依照任一方法律法规设立或组成，且在该方所在地设有住所。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` return '' means the amounts yielded from investments , including profits , dividends , interests , capital gains , royalties , fees and other legitimate income .
Translation: 4. "收益"指投资所产生的款项，包括利润、股息、利息、资本利得、特许权使用费、手续费及其他合法收入。

Query_Text_en: xxix instrument of ratification shall be construed as including instruments of acceptance or approval
Translation: 批准书应解释为包括接受书或核准书

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Laws of Contracting Parties and Certain International Treaties ] The provisions of this Act shall not affect the application of any greater protection which may be accorded by the law of a Contracting Party nor shall they affect in any way the protection accorded to works of art and works of applied art by international copyright treaties and conventions or the protection accorded to industrial designs under the Agreement on Trade Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights annexed to the Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization
Translation: ? 一 [缔约方法律及特定国际条约的适用] 本法规定不影响缔约方法律可能提供的更广泛保护之适用，亦不影响国际著作权条约与公约对艺术品及实用艺术品给予的保护，或《建立世界贸易组织协定》附件中《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》对工业设计所给予的任何保护。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Obligation to Comply with the Paris Convention ] Each Contracting Party shall comply with the provisions of the Paris Convention which concern industrial designs
Translation: 二 [遵守《巴黎公约》的义务] 各缔约方均应遵守《巴黎公约》中有关工业品外观设计的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Entitlement to File an International ApplicationAny person that is a national of a State that is a Contracting Party or of a State member of an intergovernmental organization that is a Contracting Party or that has a domicile a habitual residence or a real and effective industrial or commercial establishment in the territory of a Contracting Party shall be entitled to file an international application
Translation:
第三条 国际申请提交资格  
凡属缔约国之国民、或属缔约国政府间组织成员国之国民、或在缔约国领土内拥有住所、惯常居所或真实有效工商营业场所者，均有权提交国际申请。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Direct or Indirect Filing ] a The international application may he filed at the option of the applicant either directly with the International Bureau or through the Office of the applicant 's Contracting Party
Translation: [直接或间接提交] 申请人可选择直接向国际局提交国际申请，或通过申请人所在缔约国的专利局提交

Query_Text_en: ? b Notwithstanding subparagraph a any Contracting Party may in a declaration notify the Director General that international applications may not be filed through its Office
Translation: ? b 尽管有 a 项规定，任何缔约方仍可在声明中通知总干事，国际申请不得通过其局提交

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Transmittal Fee in Case of Indirect Filing ] The Office of any Contracting Party may require that the applicant pay a transmittal fee to it for its own benefit in respect of any international application filed through it
Translation: ? 二［通过非直接提交时的传送费］对于通过其提交的任何国际申请，任何缔约方的主管局可要求申请人向其支付传送费，供其自用。

Query_Text_en: vii any other prescribed particulars
Translation: vii 其他规定事项

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Additional Mandatory Contents of the International Application ] a Any Contracting Party whose Office is an Examining Office and whose law at the time it becomes party to this Act requires that an application for the grant of protection to an industrial design contain any of the elements specified in subparagraph b in order for that application to be accorded a filing date under that law may in a declaration notify the Director General of those elements
Translation: 二 [国际申请的附加必备内容] (a) 凡其主管局为审查局且在本协定对其生效时国内法要求工业品外观设计保护申请必须包含(b)项所列任何要素方能确定申请日的缔约方，可通过声明形式向总干事通报这些要素

Query_Text_en: iii a claim
Translation: iii 索赔

Query_Text_en: ? c Where the international application contains the designation of a Contracting Party that has made a notification under subparagraph a it shall also contain in the prescribed manner any element that was the subject of that notification
Translation: 如果国际申请中包含一个已根据a项规定作出通知的缔约方的指定，该申请还应按照规定的方式包含该通知中所提及的任何要素。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Other Possible Contents of the International Application ] The international application may contain or be accompanied by such other elements as are specified in the Regulations
Translation: 3 [ 国际申请的其他可能内容 ] 国际申请可以包含或附有细则中规定的其他要素

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Several Industrial Designs in the Same International Application ] Subject to such conditions as may be prescribed an international application may include two or more industrial designs
Translation: ? 4 [同一国际申请中包含多项工业设计] 在符合规定条件的前提下 一份国际申请可以包含两项或多项工业设计

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Request for Deferred Publication ] The international application may contain a request for deferment of publication
Translation: ? 5 [请求延迟公布] 国际申请可包含延迟公布的请求

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Claiming of Priority ] a The international application may contain a declaration claiming under Article 4 of the Paris Convention the priority of one or more earlier applications filed in or for any country party to that Convention or any Member of the World Trade Organization
Translation: ? 1 [优先权要求] a 国际申请可包含一项声明，根据《巴黎公约》第4条要求在《巴黎公约》任何缔约国或世界贸易组织任何成员境内提交的一件或多件在先申请的优先权。

Query_Text_en: ? b The Regulations may provide that the declaration referred to in subparagraph a may be made after the filing of the international application In such case the Regulations shall prescribe the latest time by which such declaration may be made
Translation: 细则可以规定，(a)项所述的声明可以在国际申请提交之后做出。在此种情况下，细则应规定做出该声明的最迟期限。
