Query_Text_en: 2 - Members undertake to accept as binding decisions of the Council under the provisions of this Agreement , and shall seek to refrain from implementing measures which would have the effect of limiting or running counter to them .
Translation: 2 - 各成员承诺接受理事会依据本协定条款所作决定之约束，并应避免实施可能产生限制或违背上述决定效果之措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Relief from obligations 1 - Where it is necessary on account of exceptional circumstances emergency or force majeure not expressly provided for in this Agreement , the Council may , by special vote , relieve a member of an obligation under this Agreement if it is satisfied by an explanation from that member regarding the reasons why the obligation can not be met .
Translation:
第三十五条 义务的免除
1. 若因本协定未明文规定的特殊情况、紧急事件或不可抗力确有必要，理事会可经特别表决免除某成员在本协定项下的某项义务，但须以该成员就其无法履行该义务的原因作出令理事会满意的解释为前提。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council , in granting relief to a member under paragraph 1 of this article , shall state explicitly the terms and conditions on which , and the period for which , the member is relieved of such obligation and the reasons for which the relief is granted .
Translation: 2 - 理事会在根据本条第一款给予成员国豁免时，应明确说明该成员国获准免除相关义务的具体条款与条件、豁免期限以及给予豁免的理由。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 Differential and remedial measures 1 - Developing importing members whose interests are adversely affected by measures taken under this Agreement may apply to the Council for appropriate differential and remedial measures .
Translation: 第三十六条 差别和补救措施 1 - 因本协定所采取措施而利益受到不利影响的发展中进口成员可向理事会申请适当的差别和补救措施。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall consider taking appropriate measures in accordance with section III , paragraphs 3 and 4 , of resolution 93 [ IV ] of the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development .
Translation: 理事会应考虑根据联合国贸易和发展会议第93(IV)号决议第三节第3段和第4段采取适当措施。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Without prejudice to the interests of other exporting members , the Council shall , in all its activities , give special consideration to the needs of a particular least developed exporting member .
Translation: 在不损害其他出口成员利益的前提下，理事会在开展所有活动时，应对特定最不发达出口成员的需求予以特别考虑。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 Signature , ratification , acceptance and approval 1 - This Agreement shall be open for signature at United Nations Headquarters from 3 January to 30 June 1983 inclusive by Governments invited to the United Nations Conference on Jute and Jute Products , 1981 .
Translation:
第三十七条 签署、批准、接受和核准  
1. 本协定自1983年1月3日至6月30日止（含首尾两日），在联合国总部开放供应邀参加1981年联合国黄麻及黄麻制品会议的各国政府签署。

Query_Text_en: b ] After signing this Agreement , ratify , accept or approve it by the deposit of an instrument to this effect with the depositary .
Translation: b] 签署本协定后，通过向保存人交存批准书、接受书或核准书完成批准、接受或核准程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 Depositary The Secretary-General of the United Nations is hereby designated as the depositary of this Agreement .
Translation: 第三十八条 保存人  兹指定联合国秘书长为本协定保存人。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Notification of provisional application 1 - A signatory Government which intends to ratify , accept or approve this Agreement , or a Government for which the Council has established conditions for accession but which has not yet been able to deposit its instrument , may , at any time , notify the depositary that it will apply this Agreement provisionally either when it enters into force in accordance with article 40 or , if it is already in force , at a specified date .
Translation:
第三十九条 临时适用的通知  
1. 凡签署国政府拟批准、接受或核准本协定者，或理事会已为其加入设定条件但尚未能交存加入书之政府，可随时通知保管机关，声明其将于本协定依第四十条生效时临时适用本协定；若协定已生效，则于其指定日期临时适用。

Query_Text_en: At the time of its notification of provisional application , each Government shall declare itself to be an exporting member or an importing member .
Translation: 各政府应在通知临时适用本协定时声明其为出口成员或进口成员。

Query_Text_en: 2 - A Government which has notified under paragraph 1 of this article that it will apply this Agreement either when this Agreement enters into force or , if this Agreement is already in force , at a specified date shall , from that time , be a provisional member of the Organization , until it deposits its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession and thus becomes a member .
Translation: 二、凡依照本条第一款规定声明在本协定生效时即适用本协定、或在本协定已生效后于某一特定日期适用本协定的政府，自该时起即为本组织临时成员，直至其交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书并正式成为成员为止。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Entry into force 1 - This Agreement shall enter into force definitively on 1 July 1983 or on any date thereafter , if by that date three Governments accounting for at least 85 per cent of net exports as set out in annex A to this Agreement , and 20 Governments accounting for at least 65 per cent of net imports as set out in annex B to this Agreement , have signed this Agreement pursuant to article 37 , paragraph 2 , a ] , or have deposited their instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation:
第四十条  生效  
1. 本协定应自1983年7月1日或其后任何日期起最终生效，但须在该日之前满足以下条件：  
   - 根据本协定第三十七条第2款(a)项规定，占附件A所列净出口总量至少85%的三个政府已签署本协定，或已交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书；  
   - 占附件B所列净进口总量至少65%的二十个政府已签署本协定，或已交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书。

Query_Text_en: 2 - This Agreement shall enter into force provisionally on 1 July 1983 or on any date thereafter , if by that date three Governments accounting for at least 85 per cent of net exports as set out in annex A to this Agreement , and 20 Governments accounting for at least 65 per cent of net imports as set out in annex B to this Agreement , have signed this Agreement pursuant to article 37 , paragraph 2 , a ] , or have deposited their instruments of ratification , acceptance or approval , or have notified the depositary under article 39 that they will apply this Agreement provisionally .
Translation: 本协定应自1983年7月1日或其后任何日期起临时生效，条件是在该日期前，占本协定附件A所列净出口总量至少85%的3个政府，以及占附件B所列净进口总量至少65%的20个政府，已根据第三十七条第2款(a)项签署本协定，或已交存其批准书、接受书或核准书，或已根据第三十九条通知保管机关将临时适用本协定。

Query_Text_en: 3 - If the requirements for entry into force under paragraph 1 or paragraph 2 of this article have not been met on 1 January 1984 , the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall invite those Governments which have signed this Agreement pursuant to article 37 , paragraph 2 , a ] , or have deposited instruments of ratification , acceptance or approval , or have notified the depositary that they will apply this Agreement provisionally , to meet at the earliest time practicable and to decide to put this Agreement into force provisionally or definitively among themselves in whole or in part .
Translation: 三、若本协定第一项或第二项规定的生效条件截至1984年1月1日仍未满足，联合国秘书长应邀请下列政府尽早召开会议，决定在彼此间全部或部分临时适用或最终实施本协定：根据第三十七条第二款第（一）项签署本协定的政府、已交存批准书/接受书/核准书的政府、或已通知保管机关将临时适用本协定的政府。

Query_Text_en: While this Agreement is in force provisionally under this paragraph , those Governments which have decided to put this Agreement into force provisionally among themselves in whole or in part shall be provisional members .
Translation: 本协定根据本款临时生效期间，决定全部或部分临时实施本协定的政府即成为临时成员。

Query_Text_en: Such Governments may meet to review the situation and decide whether this Agreement shall enter into force definitively among themselves , or continue in force provisionally , or terminate .
Translation: 相关政府可召开会议审议当前形势，并决定本协定在彼此间最终生效、继续临时适用或终止实施。

Query_Text_en: 4 - For any Government that deposits its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession after the entry into force of this Agreement , it shall enter into force for that Government on the date of such deposit .
Translation: 四、对于在本协定生效后交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的任何政府，本协定应自其交存之日起对该政府生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 - The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall convene the first session of the Council as soon as possible after the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 5 - 联合国秘书长应在本协定生效后尽快召开理事会第一届会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 Accession 1 - This Agreement shall be open for accession by the Governments of all States upon conditions established by the Council , which shall include a timelimit for the deposit of instruments of accession .
Translation:
第四十一条 加入
1. 本协定对各国政府开放加入，加入条件由理事会确定，其中应包括交存加入文书的期限。

Query_Text_en: The Council may , however , grant extensions of time to Governments which are unable to deposit their instruments of accession by the time-limit set in the conditions of accession .
Translation: 然而，对于未能在加入条件规定时限内提交加入书的国家政府，理事会可酌情批准延期。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument of accession with the depositary .
Translation: 2 - 加入应通过向保存机关交存加入书而生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Amendments 1 - The Council may , by special vote , recommend an amendment of this Agreement to the members .
Translation:
第四十二条 修正案  
1. 理事会可通过特别表决，向各成员建议对本协定进行修正。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall fix a date by which members shall notify the depositary of their acceptance of the amendment .
Translation: 2 - 理事会应确定各成员通知保管机关接受修正案的截止日期。

Query_Text_en: 3 - An amendment shall enter into force 90 days after the depositary has received notifications of acceptance from members constituting at least two thirds of the exporting members and accounting for at least 85 per cent of the votes of the exporting members , and from members constituting at least two thirds of the importing members and accounting for at least 85 per cent of the votes of the importing members .
Translation: 修正案应于保管人收到以下两类成员接受通知90天后生效：一类是占出口成员总数至少三分之二且其表决票数占出口成员总票数至少85%的成员；另一类是占进口成员总数至少三分之二且其表决票数占进口成员总票数至少85%的成员。

Query_Text_en: 4 - After the depositary informs the Council that the requirements for entry into force of the amendment have been met , and notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 of this article relating to the date fixed by the Council , a member may still notify the depositary of its acceptance of the amendment , provide that such notification is made before the entry into force of the amendment .
Translation: 四、在存管机构向理事会通报修正案生效条件已满足后，且即便本条第二款规定了理事会确定的日期，任何成员仍可在该修正案生效前向存管机构提交接受修正案的通知。

Query_Text_en: 5 - Any member which has not notified its acceptance of an amendment by the date on which such amendment enters into force shall cease to be a party to this Agreement as from that date , unless such member has satisfied the Council that its acceptance could not be obtained in time owing to difficulties in completing its constitutional or institutional procedures , and the Council decides to extend the period for acceptance of the amendment for that member . Such member shall not be bound by the amendment before it has notified its acceptance thereof .
Translation: 五、任何成员若在修正案生效之日尚未通知接受该修正案，则自该日起停止为本协定缔约方，除非该成员向理事会证明其因完成国内宪法或体制程序存在困难而未能及时提交接受书，且理事会决定延长该成员接受修正案的期限。该成员在通知接受修正案前不受其约束。

Query_Text_en: 6 - If the requirements for the entry into force of the amendment have not been met by the date fixed by the Council in accordance with paragraph 2 of this article , the amendment shall be considered withdrawn .
Translation: 六、若修正案未能于理事会依照本条第二款所定期限内满足生效要求，则该修正案应视为自动撤回。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 Withdrawal 1 - A member may withdraw from this Agreement at any time after the entry into force of this Agreement by giving written notice of withdrawal to the depositary .
Translation:
第四十三条 退出  
1. 任何成员可在本协定生效后随时退出，但需向保存人提交书面退出通知。

Query_Text_en: That member shall simultaneously inform the Council of the action it has taken .
Translation: 该成员应同时将其采取的行动通知理事会。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Withdrawal shall become effective 90 days after the notice is received by the depositary .
Translation: 二、退出应于保管人收到通知九十天后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 Exclusion If the Council decides that any member is in breach of its obligations under this Agreement and decides further that such breach significantly impairs the operation of this Agreement , it may , by special vote , exclude that member from this Agreement .
Translation:
第四十四条  除名  
若理事会认定某成员违反本协定项下义务，并进一步判定该违约行为严重损害本协定实施，理事会可通过特别表决将该成员除名。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall immediately so notify the depositary .
Translation: 理事会应立即将此事通知保存人。

Query_Text_en: One year after the date of the Council 's decision , that member shall cease to be a party to this Agreement .
Translation: 理事会作出决定之日起一年后，该成员即终止为本协定缔约方。

Query_Text_en: or c ] Exclusion from this Agreement under article 44 .
Translation: 或根据第44条排除在本协定之外。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall retain any contribution paid to the Administrative Account by a member which ceases to be a party to this Agreement .
Translation: 2 - 对于退出本协定的成员方向行政账户缴纳的任何摊款，理事会应予以保留。

Query_Text_en: 3 - A member which has received an appropriate refund under this article shall not be entitled to any share of the proceeds of liquidation or the other assets of the Organization .
Translation: 根据本条规定获得适当退款的成员，无权分享本组织清算所得或其他资产。

Query_Text_en: Nor shall such a member be liable for any deficit incurred by the Organization after such refund has been made .
Translation: 该成员在退还上述款项后，亦无须对组织此后产生的任何亏损承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 46 Duration , extension and termination 1 - This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of five years from the date of its entry into force unless the Council , by special vote , decides to extend or renegotiate this Agreement or to terminate it .
Translation:
第四十六条  期限、延长和终止  
1. 本协定自生效之日起有效期为五年，除非理事会以特别表决决定延长本协定、重新谈判本协定或终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Before the expiry of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this article , the Council may , by special vote , decide to extend this Agreement for a period not exceeding two years and\/or to renegotiate it .
Translation: 2 - 在本条第1款所述的五年期限届满之前，理事会可通过特别表决决定将本协定延长不超过两年和/或重新谈判。

Query_Text_en: 3 - If , before the expiry of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this article , negotiations for a new agreement to replace this Agreement have not yet been concluded , the Council may , by special vote , extend this Agreement for a period to be decided by the Council .
Translation: 三、若本协定第五条第一款所述五年期限届满前，新协定谈判尚未完成以取代本协定，理事会得以特别表决延长本协定，延长期限由理事会决定。

Query_Text_en: 4 - If , before the expiry of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this article , a new agreement to replace this Agreement has been negotiated but has not yet entered into force either definitively or provisionally , the Council may , by special vote , extend this Agreement until the provisional or definitive entry into force of the new agreement .
Translation: 四、若在本条第一款所述五年期限届满前，已就替代本协定的新协定完成谈判但尚未正式或临时生效，理事会可通过特别表决将本协定延期至新协定临时或正式生效之日。

Query_Text_en: Desirous of carrying further the development as regards the international regime of navigation on internal waterways , which began more than a century ago , and which has been solemnly affirmed in numerous treaties , Considering that General Conventions to which other Powers may accede at a later date constitute the best method of realizing the purpose of Article 23 [ e ] of the Covenant of the League of Nations , Recognising in particular that a fresh confirmation of the principle of Freedom of Navigation in a Statute elaborated by forty-one States belonging to the different portions of the world constitutes a new and significant stage towards the establishment of co-operation among States without in any way prejudicing their rights of sovereignty or authority , Having accepted the invitation of the League of Nations to take part in a Conference at Barcelona which met on March 10 , 1921 , and having taken note of the Final Act of such Conference , Anxious to bring into force forthwith the provisions of the Statute relating to the Regime of Navigable Waterways of International Concern which has there been adopted , Wishing to conclude a Convention for this purpose , the High Contracting Parties have appointed Plenipotentiarieswho , after communicating their full powers , found in good and due form , have agreed as follows :
Translation: 鉴于一个多世纪以来已开始形成、并经由诸多条约庄严确认的国际内河航行制度有待进一步发展；考虑到可供其他国家日后加入的普遍性公约，是实现《国际联盟盟约》第二十三条（辰）款宗旨的最佳途径；尤其认识到由全球四十一个国家共同拟定的规约对航行自由原则的再度确认，标志着国家间在不损害其主权与管辖权前提下建立合作的新里程碑；各缔约国接受国际联盟邀请，参加1921年3月10日召开的巴塞罗那会议，并已阅悉会议最终议定书；为促使会议通过的《国际性通航水道制度规约》条款立即生效，各缔约国决定缔结本公约，特委派全权代表相互校阅全权证书认为妥善后，议定如下：

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 1The High Contracting Parties declare that they accept the Statute on the Regime of Navigable Waterways of International Concern annexed hereto , adopted by the Barcelona Conference on April 19 , 1921 .
Translation:
第一条  
各缔约国声明，接受1921年4月19日巴塞罗那会议通过的《国际性通航水道制度规约》作为本公约附件。

Query_Text_en: This Statute will be deemed to constitute an integral part of the present Convention .
Translation: 本规约应视为本公约不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , they hereby declare that they accept the obligations and undertakings of the said Statute in conformity with the terms and in accordance with the conditions set out therein .
Translation: 因此，他们特此声明接受该规约所规定的义务和承诺，并依照其中列明的条款和条件予以履行。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2The present Convention does not in any way affect the rights and obligations arising out of the provisions of the Treaty of Peace signed at Versailles on June 28 , 1919 , or out of the provisions of the other corresponding Treaties , in so far as they concern the Powers which have signed , or which benefit by , such Treaties .
Translation:
第二条  
本公约概不影响1919年6月28日《凡尔赛和约》条款或其他相应条约条款所产生之权利与义务，但以该等条款涉及各签约国或享有该等条约权益之国家为限。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3The present Convention , of which the French and English texts are both authentic , shall bear this day 's date and shall be open for signature until December 1 , 1921 .
Translation:
第三条  
本公约以法文与英文文本同为作准，应署今日日期，并开放签署至1921年12月1日。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 4The present Convention is subject to ratification .
Translation: 第四条  本公约须经批准。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification shall be transmitted to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations , who will notify the receipt of them to the other Members of the League and to States admitted to sign the Convention .
Translation: 批准书应递交国际联盟秘书长保存，并由其将收到批准书一事通知国际联盟其他成员国及本公约签署国。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification shall be deposited in the archives of the Secretariat .
Translation: 批准书应交存秘书处档案库。

Query_Text_en: In order to comply with the provisions of Article 18 of the Covenant of the League of Nations , the Secretary-General will register the present Convention upon the deposit of the first ratification .
Translation: 为遵守《国际联盟盟约》第十八条规定，秘书长将在首份批准书交存时对本公约予以登记。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5Members of the League of Nations which have not signed the present Convention before December 1 , 1921 , may accede to it .
Translation:
第五条
凡国际联盟会员国未于1921年12月1日前签署本公约者，均得加入之。

Query_Text_en: The same applies to States not Members of the League to which the Council of the League may decide officially to communicate the present Convention .
Translation: 同样适用于非国联成员国——国联理事会可决定向其正式传达本公约之国家。

Query_Text_en: Accession will be notified to the Secretary-General of the League , who will inform all Powers concerned of the accession and of the date on which it was notified .
Translation: 加入书应通知国际联盟秘书长，由秘书长告知所有相关国家加入事宜及通知日期。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6The present Convention will not come into force until it has been ratified by five Powers .
Translation:
第六条
本公约须经五国批准后方可生效。

Query_Text_en: The date of its coming into force shall be the ninetieth day after the receipt of the Secretary-General of the League of Nations of the fifth ratification .
Translation: 本公约应自国际联盟秘书长收到第五份批准书之日起第九十日生效。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter the present Convention will take effect in the case of each Party ninety days after the receipt of its ratification or of the notification of its accession .
Translation: 此后，本公约将在每一缔约国交存批准书或加入通知书九十天后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: Upon the coming into force of the present Convention , the Secretary-General will address a certified copy of it to the Powers not Members of the League which are bound under the Treaties of Peace to accede to it .
Translation: 本公约生效后，秘书长应将核证无误的副本送交根据和平条约有义务加入本公约的非国际联盟成员国。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7A special record shall be kept by the Secretary-General of the League of Nations , showing which of the Parties have signed , ratified , acceded to or denounced the present Convention .
Translation:
第七条  
国际联盟秘书长应保存专门记录，载明各缔约国签署、批准、加入或退出本公约之情况。

Query_Text_en: This record shall be open to the Members of the League at all times ; it shall be published as often as possible in accordance with the directions of the Council .
Translation: 本记录应随时供联盟会员国查阅；并应根据行政院指示，尽可能经常予以公布。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8Subject to the provisions of Article 2 of the present Convention , the latter may be denounced by any Party thereto after the expiration of five years from the date when it came into force in respect of that Party .
Translation:
第八条  
在遵守本公约第二条规定的前提下，任何缔约方均可于本公约对其生效之日起满五年后退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: Denunciation shall be effected by notification in writing addressed to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations .
Translation: 退出应以书面形式通知国际联盟秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Copies of such notification shall be transmitted forthwith by him to all the other Parties , informing them of the date on which it was received .
Translation: 该通知之副本应由其立即转递所有其他缔约方，并告知收件日期。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall take effect one year after the date on which it was notified to the Secretary-General , and shall operate only in respect of the notifying Power .
Translation: 退约通知应于秘书长收到通知一年后生效，且仅对发出通知的缔约方具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: It shall not , in the absence of an agreement to the contrary , prejudice engagements entered into before the denunciation relating to a program of works .
Translation: 如无相反协议，退出行为不影响此前就工程项目所签订的各项合约效力。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9A request for the revision of the present Convention may be made at any time by one-third of the High Contracting Parties .
Translation:
第九条  
本公约之修正，得经三分之一以上缔约国随时提议修订之。

Query_Text_en: IN FAITH WHEREOF the above-named Plenipotentiaries have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 为此，双方全权代表在本公约上签字，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Barcelona the twentieth day of April one thousand nine hundred and twenty-one , in a single copy which shall remain deposited in the archives of the League of Nations .
Translation: 一九二一年四月二十日订于巴塞罗那，仅此一份，存于国际联盟档案库。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 1In the application of the Statute , the following are declared to be navigable waterways of international concern :
Translation:
第一条  
在适用本规约时，以下水道被宣布为具有国际意义的通航水道：

Query_Text_en: 1 . All parts which are naturally navigable to and from the sea of a waterway which in its course , naturally navigable to and from the sea , separates or traverses different States , and also any part of any other waterway naturally navigable to and from the sea , which connects with the sea a waterway naturally navigable which separates or traverses different States .
Translation: 1. 凡天然可通航且与海洋相连的水道，如其流程中自然分隔或流经不同国家，则该水道的所有天然可通航至海洋的区段；以及任何其他天然可通航至海洋的水道区段——此类水道连接着一条天然可通航且分隔或流经不同国家的水道与海洋。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] The different States separated or traversed by a navigable waterway of international concern , including its tributaries of international concern , are deemed to be `` riparian States .
Translation: [法语原文] 由国际性通航水道包括其国际性支流所分隔或经过的不同国家，被视为"沿岸国"。

Query_Text_en: `` 2 . Waterways , or parts of waterways , whether natural or artificial , expressly declared to be placed under the regime of the General Convention regarding navigable waterways of international concern either in unilateral Acts of the States under whose sovereignty or authority these waterways or parts of waterways are situated , or in agreements made with the consent , in particular , of such States .
Translation: 2. 航道或其部分区段（无论天然或人工开凿），凡经相关国家通过单边法令或经其特别同意缔结之协议明确宣布适用《国际通航水道一般公约》管辖制度者——该等航道或区段处于相关国家主权或管辖之下。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Navigable waterways which may hereafter be placed in this category , either in pursuance of unilaterial Acts of the States under whose sovereignty or authority they are situated , or in pursuance of agreements made with the consent , in particular , of such States .
Translation: [ b ] 今后可能被归入此类别的通航水道，无论是根据其所在主权或管辖国单方面法案，还是经相关国家特别同意后达成的协议所确立。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3Subject to the provisions contained in Articles 5 and 17 , each of the Contracting States shall accord free exercise of navigation to the vessels flying the flag of any one of the other Contracting States on those parts of navigable waterways specified above which may be situated under its sovereignty or authority .
Translation:
第三条  
在遵守第五条和第十七条规定的前提下，各缔约国应允许悬挂其他任一缔约国国旗的船舶，在其主权或管辖范围内的上述指定通航水道区段自由行使航行权。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 4In the exercise of navigation referred to above , the nationals , property and flags of all Contracting States shall be treated in all respects on a footing of perfect equality .
Translation:
第四条  
在行使上述航行权时，各缔约国的国民、财产及旗帜在所有方面均应享有完全平等的待遇。

Query_Text_en: similarly , no distinction shall be made between the nationals , the property and the flags of riparian and non-riparian States .
Translation: 同样，沿岸国与非沿岸国的国民、财产及旗帜不应区别对待。

Query_Text_en: It is understood , in consequence , that no exclusive right of navigation shall be accorded on such navigable waterways to companies or to private persons .
Translation: 据此，各方理解，此类通航水道不得授予公司或私人专属航行权。

Query_Text_en: No distinctions shall be made in the said exercise , by reason of the point of departure or of destination , or of the direction of the traffic .
Translation: 在上述运输过程中，不得因起运地、目的地或运输方向不同而区别对待。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A riparian State has the right of reserving for its own flag the transport of passengers and goods loaded at one port situated under its sovereignty or authority and unloaded at another port also situated under its sovereignty or authority .
Translation: 1. 沿岸国享有为本国船舶保留运输权之权利，即对在其主权或管辖范围内某一港口装载、并在其主权或管辖范围内另一港口卸载的旅客与货物实施专属运输。

Query_Text_en: A State which does not reserve the above-mentioned transport to its own flag may , nevertheless , refuse the benefit of equality of treatment with regard to such transport to a co-riparian which does reserve it .
Translation: 未保留上述运输权给本国船旗的国家，仍可拒绝将此类运输的平等待遇给予保留该权利的沿岸国。

Query_Text_en: On the navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 , the Act of Navigation shall only allow to riparian States the right of reserving the local transport of passengers or of goods which are of national origin or are nationalised .
Translation: 根据第二条规定，在可通航水域，《航行法》仅允许沿岸国保留本国原产或国有化货物及旅客的本地运输权。

Query_Text_en: In every case , however , in which greater freedom of navigation may have been already established , in a previous Act of Navigation , this freedom shall not be reduced .
Translation: 然而，在任何情况下，若先前航海法案已确立更自由的航行权，则此项自由不得削减。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When a natural system of navigable waterways of international concern which does not include waterways of the kind referred to in Article 2 separates or traverses two States only , the latter have the right to reserve to their flags by mutual agreement the transport of passengers and goods loaded at one port of this system and unloaded at another port of the same system , unless this transport takes place between two ports which are not situated under the sovereignty or authority of the same State in the course of a voyage , effected without transhipment on the territory of either of the said States , involving a sea-passage or passage over a navigable waterway of international concern which does not belong to the said system .
Translation: 二、如一条具有国际意义的天然通航水道仅分隔或流经两国，且不含第二条所述水道，则两国可经协议保留本国船舶在该水道系统内一个港口装载并运至同一系统另一港口的客货运输权。但若运输发生在不属于同一国家主权或管辖下的两个港口之间，且全程不经由两国领土中转，涉及海上航程或通过不属于该水道系统的其他国际通航水道，则不受此限。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6Each of the Contracting States maintains its existing right , on the navigable waterways or parts of navigable waterways referred to in Article 1 and situated under its sovereignty or authority , to enact the stipulations and to take the measures necessary for policing the territory and for applying the laws and regulations relating to customs , public health , precautions against the diseases of animals and plants , emigration or immigration , and to the import or export of prohibited goods , it being understood that such stipulations and measures must be reasonable , must be applied on a footing of absolute equality between the nationals , property and flags of any one of the Contracting States , including the State which is their author , and must not without good reason impede the freedom of navigation .
Translation:
第六条  
各缔约国对第一条所述、位于其主权或管辖范围内的通航水道或其区段，保留现行权利，可制定必要规定并采取必要措施，以维护领土治安及实施关于海关、公共卫生、动植物疫病防控、出入境以及违禁品进出口的法律法规；但须明确，此类规定与措施必须合理，且在实施时须对各缔约国（包括制定国）的国民、财产及旗帜保持绝对平等，无正当理由不得妨碍航行自由。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7No dues of any kind may be levied anywhere on the course or at the mouth of a navigable waterway of international concern , other than dues in the nature of payment for services rendered and intended solely to cover in an equitable manner the expenses of maintaining and improving the navigability of the waterway and its approaches , or to meet expenditure incurred in the interest of navigation .
Translation:
第七条  
在国际性通航水道或其出海口处，除为提供实际服务而征收的规费外，不得以任何名义征收任何税费。此类规费应仅用于公平合理地支付维护和改善水道及其进港航道通航条件所产生的费用，或用于偿付为航行利益而支出的款项。

Query_Text_en: These dues shall be fixed in accordance with such expenses , and the tariff of dues shall be posted in the ports .
Translation: 此项费用应根据开支情况合理确定，收费标准须在各港口公示。

Query_Text_en: These dues shall be levied in such a manner as to render unnecessary a detailed examination of the cargo , except in cases of suspected fraud or infringement of regulations , and so as to facilitate international traffic as much as possible , both as regards their rates and the method of their application .
Translation: 税费征收应尽可能简化手续，除涉嫌欺诈或违规情形外，避免对货物进行详细查验；其税率及征收方式均应以最大限度便利国际运输为原则。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8The transit of vessels and of passengers and goods on navigable waterways of international concern shall , so far as customs formalities are concerned , be governed by the conditions laid down in the Statute of Barcelona on Freedom of Transit .
Translation:
第八条  
关于国际性通航水道上的船舶、乘客及货物过境事宜，在海关手续方面应适用《巴塞罗那过境自由规约》所规定的条件。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] When a navigable waterway of international concern forms the frontier between two States , vessels , passengers and goods in transit shall while `` en route '' be exempt from any customs formality , except in cases in which there are valid reasons of a practical character for carrying out customs formalities at a place on the part of the river which forms the frontier , and this can be done without interfering with navigation facilities .
Translation: 当一条具有国际意义的可通航水道构成两国边界时，过境船舶、乘客及货物在"航行途中"应免除一切海关手续，除非在边界河道某处实施海关检查存在切实可行的正当理由，且该检查不会妨碍航行便利。

Query_Text_en: The transit of vessels and passengers , as well as the transit of goods without transhipment , on navigable waterways of international concern , must not give rise to the levying of any duties whatsoever , whether prohibited by the Statute of Barcelona on Freedom of Transit or authorised by Article 3 of that Statute .
Translation: 在国际通航水道上的船舶与旅客过境，以及货物不经转运的过境运输，均不得以任何名义课征税费——无论该税费是被《巴塞罗那过境自由规约》所禁止，还是被该规约第三条所允许。

Query_Text_en: It is nevertheless understood that vessels in transit may be made responsible for the board and lodging of any customs officers who are strictly required for supervision .
Translation: 但应理解，过境船舶可能需要为严格监管所需海关官员的食宿承担费用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9Subject to the provisions of Articles 5 and 17 , the nationals , property and flags of all the Contracting States shall , in all ports situated on a navigable waterway of international concern , enjoy , in all that concerns the use of the port , including port dues and charges , a treatment equal to that accorded to the nationals , property and flag of the riparian State under whose sovereignty or authority the port is situated .
Translation:
第九条  
在遵守第五条及第十七条规定的前提下，各缔约国的国民、财产及船旗，在国际性通航水道沿岸所有港口的使用事项上——包括港口税费及其他费用——均应享有与该港口所在沿岸国国民、财产及船旗同等的待遇。

Query_Text_en: It is understood that the property to which the present paragraph relates is property originating in , coming from or destined for , one or other of the Contracting States .
Translation: 据了解，本款所述财产系源自、来自或运往任一缔约国的财产。

Query_Text_en: The equipment of ports situated on a navigable waterway of international concern , and the facilities afforded in these ports to navigation , must not be withheld from public use to an extent beyond what is reasonable and fully compatible with the free exercise of navigation .
Translation: 位于国际通航水道上的港口设备，以及这些港口为航行提供的便利设施，其公共使用不得受到超出合理范围且与自由航行权相抵触的限制。

Query_Text_en: In the application of customs or other analogous duties , local octroi or consumption duties , or incidental charges , levied on the occasion of the importation or exportation of goods through the aforesaid ports , no difference shall be made by reason of the flag of the vessel on which the transport has been or is to be accomplished , whether this flag be the national flag or that of any of the Contracting States .
Translation: 在上述口岸进出口货物时征收的关税或其他类似税费、地方入市税或消费税以及附带费用，不得因运输船舶的国籍而有所区别，无论该船悬挂的是本国国旗还是任一缔约国的国旗。

Query_Text_en: The State under whose sovereignty or authority a port is situated may withdraw the benefits of the preceding paragraph from any vessel if it is proved that the owner of the vessel discriminates systematically against the nationals of that State , including companies controlled by such nationals .
Translation: 港口所在主权国或管辖国如证实某船舶所有者（包括受该国国民控制的公司）存在系统性歧视该国国民的行为，可撤销该船享受前款规定之权益。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of special circumstances justifying an exception on the ground of economic necessities , the customs duties must not be higher than those levied on the other customs frontiers of the State interested , on goods of the same kind , source and destination .
Translation: 除因经济需要等特殊情况确有必要实行差别待遇外，关税税率不得高于该国其他关境对同类货物、同种来源及相同目的地所征收的关税水平。

Query_Text_en: All facilities accorded by the Contracting States to the importation or exportation of goods by other land or water routes , or in other ports , shall be equally accorded to importation or exportation under the same conditions over the navigable waterway and through the ports referred to above .
Translation: 缔约各国通过其他水陆通道及口岸进出口货物所给予的一切便利，在同等条件下，亦应同样给予通过上述可航水道及口岸的进出口货物。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 101 . Each riparian State is bound , on the one hand , to refrain from all measures likely to prejudice the navigability of the waterway , or to reduce the facilities for navigation , and on the other hand , to take as rapidly as possible all necessary steps for removing any obstacles and dangers which may occur to navigation .
Translation: 第一百零一条 各沿岸国一方面须避免采取可能损害水道通航性或减少航行便利的一切措施，另一方面须尽快采取一切必要步骤清除可能出现的任何航行障碍与危险。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If such navigation necessitates regular upkeep of the waterway , each of the riparian States is bound as towards the others to take such steps and to execute such works on its territory as are necessary for the purpose as quickly as possible , taking account at all times of the conditions of navigation , as well as of the economic state of the regions served by the navigable waterway .
Translation: 2. 若此类航行需要对水道进行常规维护，各沿岸国均有义务尽快在本国境内采取必要措施并实施相关工程，同时须始终兼顾航行条件及通航水道所服务区域的经济状况。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of an agreement to the contrary , any riparian State will have the right , on valid reason being shown , to demand from the other riparians a reasonable contribution towards the cost of upkeep .
Translation: 若无相反协议，任何沿岸国在提出正当理由后，均有权要求其他沿岸国合理分摊维护费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the absence of legitimate grounds for opposition by one of the riparian States , including the State territorially interested , based either on the actual conditions of navigability in its territory , or on other interests such as , inter alia , the maintenance of the normal-water conditions , requirements for irrigation , the use of water-power , or the necessity for constructing other and more advantageous ways of communication , a riparian State may not refuse to carry out works necessary for the improvement of the navigability which are asked for by another riparian State , if the latter State offers to pay the cost of the works and a fair share of the additional cost of upkeep .
Translation: 3. 若无沿岸国（包括领土相关国）基于其境内实际通航条件或其他合法利益提出合理反对理由——例如维持正常水文状况、灌溉需求、水力利用或需建设其他更有利的交通线路等——当另一沿岸国承诺承担工程费用及合理比例的额外维护成本时，该沿岸国不得拒绝实施对方所要求的、旨在改善通航条件的必要工程。

Query_Text_en: It is understood , however , that such works can not be undertaken so long as the State on the territory of which they are to be carried out objects on the ground of vital interests .
Translation: 然而，据知悉，只要工程实施地所在国以重大利益为由提出反对，此类工程便不得开展。

Query_Text_en: as regards works for improvement , a State which is obliged to carry them out shall be freed from the obligation , if it authorises the State which made the request to carry them out instead of it .
Translation: 关于改善工程，若一国授权请求国代为实施，则该国可免除其应履行的义务。

Query_Text_en: The carrying out of works by States other than the State territorially interested , or the sharing by such States in the cost of works , shall be so arranged as not to prejudice the rights of the State territorially interested as regards the supervision and administrative control over the works , or its sovereignty and authority over the navigable waterway .
Translation: 非领土相关国家实施工程或分摊工程费用时，其安排不得损害领土相关国对工程的监督管理权，亦不得损害其对通航水道的主权与管辖权。

Query_Text_en: 5 . On the waterways referred to in Article 2 , the provisions of the present Article are to be applied subject to the terms of the Treaties , Conventions , or Navigation Acts which determine the powers and responsibilities of the International Commission in respect of works .
Translation: 第五条 对于第二条所述水道，本条规定之适用应遵循相关条约、公约及航行法规之条款，此类条款确定了国际委员会在工程事务方面的职权与责任。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The settlement , under the conditions laid down in Article 22 below , of any dispute which may arise as a result of these decisions , may always be demanded on the grounds that these decisions are ultra vires , or that they infringe international conventions governing navigable waterways . A request for a settlement under the aforesaid conditions based on any other grounds can only be put forward by the State which is territorially interested .
Translation: 根据下文第二十二条规定，对于因上述决定可能引发的任何争议，均可始终以相关决定超越权限或违反通航水道国际公约为由要求解决。唯有领土利益相关国方可基于其他任何理由，依前述条件提出争议解决请求。

Query_Text_en: The decisions of this Commission shall be in conformity with the provisions of the present Article .
Translation: 本委员会之决定应符合本条之规定。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article , a riparian State may , in the absence of any agreement to the contrary , close a waterway wholly or in part to navigation , with the consent of all the riparian States or of all the States represented on the International Commission in the case of navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 .
Translation: 六、虽有本条第一款之规定，但在无相反协议的情况下，沿岸国经所有沿岸国或第二条所述通航水道国际委员会全体成员国同意后，可全部或部分关闭该水道。

Query_Text_en: As an exceptional case one of the riparian States of a navigable waterway of international concern not referred to in Article 2 may close the waterway to navigation , if the navigation on it is of very small importance , and if the State in question can justify its action on the ground of an economic interest clearly greater than that of navigation .
Translation: 作为特例，若某条国际性通航水道未被第二条提及，且其航运价值微乎其微，沿岸国可基于明显高于航运利益的经济考量，在充分论证正当性的前提下，对该水道实施禁航。

Query_Text_en: In this case the closing to navigation may only take place after a year 's notice and subject to an appeal on the part of any other riparian State under the conditions laid down in Article 22 .
Translation: 在此情况下，仅可在提前一年通知且其他沿岸国依据第二十二条规定条件提出申诉后，方可实施航行关闭。

Query_Text_en: If necessary , the judgement shall prescribe the conditions under which the closing to navigation may be carried into effect .
Translation: 必要时，判决书应规定实施禁航的条件。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Should access to the sea be afforded by a navigable waterway of international interest through several branches , all of which are situated in the territory of one and the same State , the provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 of this Article shall apply only to the principal branches deemed necessary for providing free access to the sea .
Translation: 7. 若通往海洋的通道由多条具有国际利益的通航水道构成，且所有水道均位于同一国家领土内，则本条第一、二、三款之规定仅适用于为保障自由通海所必需的主要水道。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 11If on a waterway of international concern one or more of the riparian States are not parties to this Statute , the financial obligations undertaken by each of the Contracting States in pursuance of Article 10 shall not exceed those to which they would have been subject if all the riparian States had been Parties .
Translation: 第十一条 如国际性水道沿岸国中有一个或多个国家非本规约缔约国，则各缔约国依照第十条所承担的财政义务，不得超过假定全体沿岸国均为缔约方时该国应承担之额度。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 12In the absence of contrary stipulations contained in a special agreement or treaty , for example , existing Conventions concerning customs and police measures and sanitary precautions , the administration of navigable waterways of international concern is exercised by each of the riparian States under whose sovereignty or authority the navigable waterway is situated .
Translation:
第十二条
若无特别协定或条约（如现行关于海关与警务措施及卫生预防的公约）作出相反规定，国际性通航水道的管理权由各沿岸国行使。各沿岸国对位于其主权或管辖范围内的通航水道段行使管理权。

Query_Text_en: Each of such riparian States has , inter alia , the power and duty of publishing regulations for the navigation of such waterway and of seeing to their execution .
Translation: 各沿岸国尤其有权也有责任颁布此类水道的航行规章，并监督其实施。

Query_Text_en: These regulations must be framed and applied in such a way as to facilitate the free exercise of navigation under the conditions laid down in this Statute .
Translation: 这些规章的制定与实施，须以确保本规约所规定之航行自由条件得以实现为宗旨。

Query_Text_en: The rules of procedure dealing with such matters as ascertaining , prosecuting and punishing navigation offences must be such as to promote as speedy a settlement as possible .
Translation: 关于查明、起诉和惩处航行违规行为的程序规则，必须以确保案件尽快得到解决为宗旨。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless the Contracting States recognize that it is highly desirable that the riparian States should come to an understanding with regard to the administration of the navigable waterway and , in particular , with regard to the adoption of navigation regulations of as uniform a character throughout the whole course of such navigable waterway as the diversity of local circumstances permits .
Translation: 然而，各缔约国认识到，沿岸国就通航水道的管理达成谅解极为必要，尤其应尽可能根据当地不同情况，在整个通航水道全程采用统一性质的航行规则。

Query_Text_en: Public services of towage or other means of haulage may be established in the form of monopolies for the purpose of facilitating the exercise of navigation , subject to the unanimous agreement of the riparian States or the States represented on the International Commission in the case of navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 .
Translation: 为便利航行起见，可在第二条所述通航水道设立拖曳或其他牵引方式的公共服务机构，并实行垄断经营，但须经沿岸国或国际委员会成员国一致同意。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13Treaties , conventions or agreements in force relating to navigable waterways , concluded by the Contracting States before the coming into force of this Statute , are not , as a consequence of its coming into force , abrogated so far as concerns the States signatories to those treaties .
Translation:
第十三条  
本规约生效前，各缔约国已缔结且现行有效的关于通航水道的条约、公约或协定，不因本规约生效而废止，其效力仍适用于该等条约的签署国。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless the Contracting States undertake not to apply among themselves any provisions of such treaties , conventions or agreements which may conflict with the rules of the present Statute .
Translation: 然而，各缔约国承诺在彼此间不适用任何可能与本规约规则相冲突的条约、公约或协定条款。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 14If any of the special agreements or treaties referred to in Article 12 has entrusted or shall hereafter entrust certain functions to an international Commission which includes representatives of States other than the riparian States , it shall be the duty of such Commission subject to the provisions of Article 10 , to have exclusive regard to the interests of navigation , and it shall be deemed to be one of the organizations referred to in Article 24 of the Covenant of the League of Nations .
Translation:
第十四条
若第十二条所述之特别协定或条约已授权或今后将授权由非沿岸国代表参与之国际委员会行使特定职能，则该委员会应恪守第十条规定，专以航行利益为考量，并应视为《国际联盟盟约》第二十四条所指之组织之一。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , it will exchange all useful information directly with the League and its organizations , and will submit an annual report to the League .
Translation: 因此，本机构将与联盟及其下属组织直接交换所有有用信息，并向联盟提交年度报告。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] it shall be entitled , in cases in which the Act of Navigation does not include a special regulation with regard to the levying of dues , to approve of the levying of such dues and charges in accordance with the provisions of Article 7 of this Statute .
Translation: 如《航行法》未就税费征收作出专门规定，则有权根据本条例第七条规定批准征收此类税费。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15This Statute does not prescribe the rights and duties of belligerents and neutrals in time of war .
Translation:
第十五条  
本章程不规定交战国与中立国在战争期间的权利与义务。

Query_Text_en: The Statute shall , however , continue in force in time of war so far as such rights and duties permit .
Translation: 但在战争期间，只要上述权利与义务允许，本条例仍将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16This Statute does not impose upon a Contracting State any obligation conflicting with its rights and duties as a Member of the League of Nations .
Translation:
第十六条
本规约不使缔约国承担与其作为国际联盟会员国之权利和义务相冲突之任何义务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 17In the absence of any agreement to the contrary to which the State territorially interested is or may be a party , this Statute has no reference to the navigation of vessels of war or of vessels performing police or administrative functions , or , in general , exercising any kind of public authority .
Translation:
第十七条  
除领土相关国家为缔约方或可能成为缔约方的相反协议外，本规约不适用于军舰、执行警务或行政职能的船舶，以及一般而言行使任何形式公共权力的船舶之航行事宜。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18Each of the Contracting States undertakes not to grant either by agreement or in any other way , to a non-Contracting State , treatment with regard to navigation over a navigable waterway of international concern which , as between Contracting States , would be contrary to the provisions of this Statute .
Translation:
第十八条
各缔约国承诺，对于非缔约国在国际性通航水道上的航行权，不得通过协议或其他任何方式给予其优于本规约缔约国间所规定的待遇。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 19The measures of a general or particular character which a Contracting State is obliged to take in case of an emergency affecting the safety of the State or the vital interests of the country may , in exceptional cases and for a period as short as possible , involve a deviation from the provisions of the above Articles ; it being understood that the principle of the freedom of navigation and especially communication between the riparian States and the sea , must be maintained to the utmost possible extent .
Translation:
第十九条  
缔约国在国家安全或重大利益受到紧急威胁时，无论采取一般性或特殊性措施，均可在特殊情况下于尽可能短的期间内偏离上述条款之规定；但须明确，沿岸国与海洋间的航行自由原则，尤其是通航自由，必须尽最大可能予以维护。

Query_Text_en: nor does it entail the prohibition of such grant of greater facilities in the future .
Translation: 也不意味着今后禁止提供更优惠的便利条件。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 21In conformity with Article 23 [ e ] of the Covenant of the League of Nations , any Contracting State which can establish a good case against the application of any provision of this Statute in some or all of its territory on the ground of the grave economic situation arising out of the acts of devastation perpetrated on its soil during the war 1914-1918 , shall be deemed to be relieved temporarily of the obligations arising from the application of such provision , it being understood that the principle of freedom of navigation must be observed as far as possible .
Translation:
第二十一条  
依照《国际联盟盟约》第二十三条第五项之规定，任何缔约国若能基于1914至1918年战争期间其领土遭受破坏行为所引发的严峻经济状况，提出充分理由反对本规约某项条款在其全部或部分领土适用，则该国应被视为可暂免履行因适用该条款而产生之义务。但须明确，航行自由原则在可能范围内仍应予以遵守。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 22Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 5 of Article 10 , any dispute between States as to the interpretation of application of this Statute which is not settled directly between them shall be brought before the Permanent Court of International Justice , unless under a special agreement or a general arbitration provision steps are taken for the settlement of the dispute by arbitration or some other means .
Translation:
第二十二条
在不妨碍第十条第五款规定的前提下，缔约国间关于本规约解释或适用的任何争端，如未能通过直接谈判解决，应提交常设国际法院裁决，但当事国根据特别协定或一般仲裁条款约定通过仲裁或其他方式解决争端者除外。

Query_Text_en: Proceedings are opened in the manner laid down in Article 40 of the Statute of the Permanent Court of International Justice .
Translation: 诉讼程序应依照《常设国际法院规约》第四十条规定之方式启动。

Query_Text_en: In order to settle such disputes , however , in a friendly way as far as possible , the Contracting States undertake before resorting to any judicial proceedings and without prejudice to the powers and right of action of the Council and of the Assembly to submit such disputes for an opinion to any body established by the League of Nations as the advisory and technical organizations of the Member of the League in matters of communications and transit .
Translation: 然而，为尽可能友好解决此类争端，各缔约国承诺在诉诸任何司法程序之前，且不影响理事会和大会的职权及行动权的情况下，将此类争端提交由国际联盟设立的任何机构征询意见，该机构应作为国际联盟成员国在交通与过境事务方面的咨询及技术组织。

Query_Text_en: In urgent cases a preliminary opinion may recommend temporary measures intended in particular to restore the facilities for free navigation which existed before the act or occurrence which gave rise to the dispute .
Translation: 在紧急情况下，初步意见可建议采取临时措施，特别是旨在恢复引发争议的行为或事件发生前存在的自由航行设施。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 23A navigable waterway shall not be considered as of international concern on the sole ground that it traverses or delimits zones or enclaves , the extent and population of which are small as compared with those of the territories which it traverses , and which form detached portions or establishments belonging to a State other than that to which the said river belongs , with this exception , throughout its navigable course .
Translation: 第二十三条A 仅因某可航水道流经或分隔若干区域或飞地，而该等区域或飞地之面积与人口相较于水道流经之领土整体规模显著微小，且构成与水道所属国相异之国家所属的孤立领土或机构者，不得仅以此为由认定该水道具有国际利害关系；但该水道之整个可航段仍适用此项例外规定。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 24This Statute shall not be applicable to a navigable waterway of international concern which has only two riparian States and which separates , for a considerable distance , a Contracting State from a non-Contracting State whose Government is not recognized by the former at the time of the signing of this Statute , until an agreement has been concluded between them establishing , for the waterway in question , an administrative and customs regime which affords suitable safeguards to the Contracting State .
Translation:
第二十四条  
本规约不适用于仅有两个沿岸国的国际性通航水道，且该水道在相当长的距离内将一缔约国与另一非缔约国隔开，而该缔约国在本规约签署时未承认该非缔约国政府。在此情形下，须待两国就相关水道达成协议，确立能为缔约国提供适当保障的行政及海关制度后，本规约方得适用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 25It is understood that this Statute must not be interpreted as regulating in any way rights and obligations inter se of territories forming part , or placed under the protection , of the same sovereign State , whether or not these territories are individually Members of the League of Nations .
Translation:
第二十五条
兹经谅解：本规约无论如何不得解释为对构成同一主权国家组成部分或受其保护之各领土间相互权利与义务进行规范，无论该等领土是否为国联个别会员国。

Query_Text_en: PREAMBLE THE CONTRACTING PARTIES , RECOGNIZING the need to maintain a high level of safety of human life in the handling , stacking and transporting of containers , MINDFUL of the need to facilitate international container transport , RECOGNIZING , in this context , the advantages of formalizing common international safety requirements , CONSIDERING that this end may best be achieved by the conclusion of a Convention , HAVE DECIDED to formalize structural requirements to ensure safety in the handling , stacking and transporting of containers in the course of normal operations , and to this end HAVE AGREED as follows :
Translation:
序言  
各缔约方，  
认识到在集装箱装卸、堆存和运输过程中保障人身安全的高度必要性，  
考虑到促进国际集装箱运输的需要，  
在此背景下，认识到统一国际安全要求的规范化具有显著优势，  
认为达成一项公约是实现这一目标的最佳途径，  
兹决定通过规范结构要求，确保集装箱在正常作业中的装卸、堆存和运输安全，  
为此达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Article I General obligation under the present ConventionThe Contracting Parties undertake to give effect to the provisions of the present Convention and the Annexes hereto , which shall constitute an integral part of the present Convention .
Translation:
第一条 本公约项下的一般义务  
缔约各方承诺履行本公约及其附件的各项规定，该附件应构成本公约不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] of a size such that the area enclosed by the four outer bottom corners is either : [ i ] at least 14 sq. m. [ 150 sq. ft. ] or [ ii ] at least 7 sq. m. [ 75 sq. ft. ] if it is fitted with top corner fittings ; the term `` container '' includes neither vehicles nor packaging ; however , containers when carried on chassis are included .
Translation: 集装箱的尺寸应满足以下条件：由底部四个外角围合的区域面积需达到（i）至少14平方米（150平方英尺）；或（ii）若配备顶部角件，则至少为7平方米（75平方英尺）。"集装箱"一词不包括车辆或包装物，但装载在底盘车上运输的集装箱仍属于本定义范畴。

Query_Text_en: 2 . `` Corner fittings '' means an arrangement of apertures and faces at the top and\/or bottom of a container for the purposes of handling , stacking and\/or securing .
Translation: 2. 「角件」是指集装箱顶部和/或底部用于装卸、堆码和/或固定的一组开孔与表面结构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . `` Administration '' means the Government of a Contracting Party under whose authority containers are approved .
Translation: 3. "主管机关"系指缔约方政府授权批准集装箱的部门。

Query_Text_en: 4 . `` Approved '' means approved by the Administration .
Translation: 4. "批准"指经主管机关核准。

Query_Text_en: 5 . `` Approval '' means the decision by an Administration that a design type or a container is safe within the terms of the present Convention .
Translation: 5. "核准"系指主管机关认定某设计型号或集装箱符合本公约安全条款的决定。

Query_Text_en: 6 . `` International transport '' means transport between points of departure and destination situated in the territory of two countries to at least one of which the present Convention applies .
Translation: 6. "国际运输"系指根据本公约，其出发地和目的地位于两个国家境内，且至少其中一国适用本公约的运输。

Query_Text_en: The present Convention shall also apply when part of a transport operation between two countries takes place in the territory of a country to which the present Convention applies .
Translation: 本公约亦适用于两国间运输业务部分发生在公约适用国领土内之情形。

Query_Text_en: 7 . `` Cargo '' means any goods , wares , merchandise and articles of every kind whatsoever carried in the containers .
Translation: 7. "货物"指装载于集装箱内的各类商品、货品、商品及物品。

Query_Text_en: 8 . `` New container '' means a container the construction of which was commenced on or after the date of entry into force of the present Convention .
Translation: 8. "新集装箱"指本公约生效之日或其后开始建造的集装箱。

Query_Text_en: 9 . `` Existing container '' means a container which is not a new container .
Translation: 9. "现有集装箱"系指非新造集装箱。

Query_Text_en: 10 . `` Owner '' means the owner as provided for under the national law of the Contracting Party or the lessee or bailee , if an agreement between the parties provides for the exercise of the owner 's responsibility for maintenance and examination of the container by lessee or bailee .
Translation: 10. "所有人"系指缔约方国内法规定的所有人，或如各方协议约定由承租人或受托人行使所有人对集装箱的维护和检验责任，则指承租人或受托人。

Query_Text_en: 11 . `` Type of container '' means the design type approved by the Administration .
Translation: 11. "集装箱类型"系指经主管机关核准的设计型号。

Query_Text_en: 12 . `` Type-series container '' means any container manufactured in accordance with the approved design type .
Translation: 12. "定型系列集装箱"指按照经批准的设计型号制造的集装箱。

Query_Text_en: 13 . `` Prototype '' means a container representative of those manufactured or to be manufactured in a design type series .
Translation: 13. "原型容器"指代表某一设计类型系列中已制造或待制造容器的样品。

Query_Text_en: 14 . `` Maximum Operating Gross Weight or Rating '' or `` R '' means the maximum allowable combined weight of the container and its cargo .
Translation: 14. "最大运行总重量"或"额定重量"（简称"R"）系指集装箱及其货物允许的最大组合重量。

Query_Text_en: 15 . `` Tare Weight '' means the weight of the empty container including permanently affixed ancillary equipment .
Translation: 15. "皮重"指空容器的重量，包括永久固定附属设备的重量。

Query_Text_en: 16 . `` Maximum Permissible Payload '' or `` P '' means the difference between maximum operating gross weight or rating and tare weight .
Translation: 16. "最大允许载重"或"P"指最大运行总重量（或额定值）与空载重量之间的差值。

Query_Text_en: Article III Application 1 . The present Convention applies to new and existing containers used in international transport , excluding containers specially designed for air transport .
Translation:
第三条 适用范围  
一、本公约适用于国际运输中使用的现有及新造集装箱，但专为空运设计的集装箱除外。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each new container shall be approved either in accordance with the provisions for type-testing or for individual testing as contained in Annex I.
Translation: 2. 每个新集装箱均须按照附件一规定的定型试验或单个试验条款获得批准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Every existing container shall be approved in accordance with the relevant provisions for approval or existing containers set out in Annex I within 5 years from the date of entry into force of the present Convention .
Translation: 3. 现有各集装箱均须自本公约生效之日起五年内，按附件一关于新集装箱的批准规定或关于现有集装箱的批准规定获得批准。

Query_Text_en: Article IV Testing , inspection , approval and maintenance1 . For the enforcement of the provisions in Annex I every Administration shall establish an effective procedure for the testing , inspection and approval of containers in accordance with the criteria established in the present Convention , provided however that an Administration may entrust such testing , inspection and approval to organizations duly authorized by it .
Translation:
第四条 检验、检查、批准和维修  
1. 为实施附件一的规定，各主管机关须按照本公约制定的标准，建立有效的集装箱检验、检查和批准程序；但主管机关可将此类检验、检查和批准工作委托其正式授权的机构执行。

Query_Text_en: 2 . An Administration which entrusts such testing , inspecting and approval to an organization shall inform the Secretary-General of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization [ hereinafter referred to as `` the Organization '' ] for communication to Contracting Parties .
Translation: 2. 将此类检验、检查和核准工作委托给某一组织的缔约国政府，应通知政府间海事协商组织（以下简称"本组织"）秘书长，以便转告各缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Application for approval may be made to the Administration of any Contracting Party .
Translation: 三、申请批准可向任一缔约方主管部门提出。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Every container shall be maintained in a safe condition in accordance with the provisions of Annex I.
Translation: 4. 每个集装箱均须根据附件一的规定保持安全状态。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If an approved container does not in fact comply with the requirements of Annexes I and II the Administration concerned shall take such steps as it deems necessary to bring the container into compliance with such requirements or to withdraw the approval .
Translation: 五、若经批准的集装箱实际不符合本公约附件一和附件二的要求，相关主管机关应采取必要措施确保该集装箱符合要求或撤销其批准。

Query_Text_en: Article V Acceptance of approval1 . Approved under the authority of a Contracting Party , granted under the terms of the present Convention , shall be accepted by the other Contracting Parties for all purposes covered by the present Convention .
Translation:
第五条 批准书的接受  
1. 根据本公约条款，由一缔约方主管机关签发的批准书，其他缔约方应为本公约所涵盖的一切目的予以接受。

Query_Text_en: It shall be regarded by the other Contracting Parties as having the same force as an approval issued by them .
Translation: 其他缔约方应视其与本国签发的批准文件具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A Contracting Party shall not impose any other structural safety requirements or tests on containers covered by the present Convention , provided however that nothing in the present Convention shall preclude the application of provisions of national regulations or legislation or of international agreements , prescribing additional structural safety requirements or tests for containers specially designed for the transport of dangerous goods , or for those features unique to containers carrying bulk liquids or for containers when carried by air .
Translation: 二、本公约任何规定均不妨碍缔约国实施国家法规或国际协定中关于专门设计用于危险品运输的集装箱、散装液体集装箱特有装置或空运集装箱的附加结构安全要求或试验条款；除此之外，缔约国不得对适用本公约的集装箱施加其他结构安全要求或试验。

Query_Text_en: The term `` dangerous goods '' shall have that meaning assigned to it by international agreements .
Translation: "危险货物"一词的含义以国际协定所规定的为准。

Query_Text_en: Article VI Control1 . Every container which has been approved under Article III shall be subject to control in the territory of the Contracting Parties by officers duly authorized by such Contracting Parties .
Translation:
第六条 监管  
1. 根据第三条获得批准的每一集装箱，均应由缔约方正式授权的官员在其领土内实施监管。

Query_Text_en: This control shall be limited to verifying that the container carries a valid Safety Approval Plate as required by the present Convention , unless there is significant evidence for believing that the condition of the container is such as to create an obvious risk to safety . In that case the officer carrying out the control shall only exercise it in so far as it may be necessary to ensure that the container is restored to a safe condition before it continues in service .
Translation: 检查仅限于核实集装箱是否按本公约要求装有有效的安全合格牌照，除非有明显证据表明该集装箱状况可能对安全构成威胁。在此情况下，执行检查的官员仅应在必要范围内采取行动，以确保集装箱在继续投入运营前恢复安全状态。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where the container appears to have become unsafe as a result of a defect which may have existed when the container was approved , the Administration responsible for that approval shall be informed by the Contracting Party which detected the defect .
Translation: 2. 若集装箱因核准时可能存在的缺陷而出现安全隐患，发现该缺陷的缔约国应通知负责核准的主管机关。

Query_Text_en: Article VII Signature , ratification , acceptance , approval and accession1 .
Translation: 第七条 签署、批准、接受、核准和加入

Query_Text_en: The present Convention shall be open for signature until 15 January 1973 at the Office of the United Nations at Geneva and subsequently from 1 February 1973 until 31 December 1973 inclusive at the Headquarters of the Organization at London by all States Members of the United Nations or Members of any of the Specialized Agencies or of the International Atomic Energy Agency or Parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice , and by any other State invited by the General Assembly of the United Nations to become a Party to the present Convention .
Translation: 本公约自即日起至1973年1月15日止在日内瓦联合国办事处开放签署，其后自1973年2月1日起至1973年12月31日止在伦敦本组织总部开放签署，供联合国所有会员国、各专门机构或国际原子能机构成员国、《国际法院规约》缔约方，以及经联合国大会邀请成为本公约缔约方的任何其他国家签署。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII Entry into force1 . The present Convention shall enter into force twelve months from the date of the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation:
第八条  生效  
1. 本公约自第十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For each State ratifying , accepting , approving or acceding to the present Convention after the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , the present Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date of the deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 对于在第十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存后批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的每一国家，本公约应自该国交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any State which becomes a Party to the present Convention after the entry into force of an amendment shall , failing an expression of a different intention by that State , [ a ] be considered as a Party to the Convention as amended ;
Translation: 在本公约修正案生效后成为缔约国的任何国家，如未作出相反意思表示，[a]应视为修正后公约的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] be considered as a Party to the unamended Convention in relation to any Party to the Convention not bound by the amendment .
Translation: 且[b]应被视为未修正公约的缔约方，与不受该修正案约束的任何公约缔约方之间的关系适用原公约条款。

Query_Text_en: Article IX Procedure for amending any part or parts of the present Convention1 . The present Convention may be amended upon the proposal of a Contracting Party by any of the procedures specified in this Article .
Translation:
第九条 本公约任何部分的修改程序

一、任一缔约方均可提出对本公约的修改建议，并依照本条规定的任一程序进行修改。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Upon the request of a Contracting Party , any amendment proposed by it to the present Convention shall be considered in the Organization .
Translation: 应一缔约方请求，该缔约方对本公约提出的任何修正案均应由本组织审议。

Query_Text_en: If adopted by a majority of two-thirds of those present and voting in the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization , to which all Contracting Parties shall have been invited to participate and vote , such amendment shall be communicated to all Members of the Organization and all Contracting Parties at least six months prior to its consideration by the Assembly of the Organization .
Translation: 若修正案经本组织海上安全委员会出席并投票的三分之二多数通过——所有缔约国均应受邀参与该委员会的表决——则须在提交本组织大会审议前至少六个月，将该修正案通报本组织全体会员国及所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Any Contracting Party which is not a Member of the Organization shall be entitled to participate and vote when the amendment is considered by the Assembly .
Translation: 非本组织成员国的任何缔约国在大会审议修正案时均有权参与并投票。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] If adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting in the Assembly , and if such majority includes a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties present and voting , the amendment shall be communicated by the Secretary-General to all Contracting Parties for their acceptance .
Translation: [b]若修正案获大会出席并参加表决代表的三分之二多数通过，且该多数包含出席并参加表决缔约方的三分之二多数，秘书长应将修正案通报全体缔约方以供接受。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Such amendment shall come into force twelve months after the date on which it is accepted by two-thirds of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 该修正案应于三分之二缔约方接受之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: The amendment shall come into force with respect to all Contracting Parties except those which , before it comes into force , make a declaration that they do not accept the amendment .
Translation: 本修正案应对所有缔约方生效，但在其生效前已声明不接受该修正案的缔约方除外。

Query_Text_en: Upon the request of a Contracting Party , concurred in by at least one-third of the Contracting Parties , a Conference to which the States referred to in Article VII shall be invited will be convened by the Secretary-General .
Translation: 应任一缔约方请求并经至少三分之一缔约方同意，联合国秘书长应召开会议，并邀请第七条所述国家与会。

Query_Text_en: Article X Special procedure for amending the Annexes1 . Any amendment to the Annexes proposed by a Contracting Party shall be considered in the Organization at the request of that Party .
Translation:
第十条 附件修正特别程序  
一、任一缔约方提出的附件修正案，应经该缔约方请求，由本组织予以审议。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting in the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization to which all Contracting Parties shall have been invited to participate and to vote , and if such majority includes a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties present and voting , such amendment shall be communicated by the Secretary-General to all Contracting Parties for their acceptance .
Translation: 2. 若修正案经本组织海上安全委员会出席并投票成员的三分之二多数通过（所有缔约国均应受邀参与并投票），且该多数包括出席并投票缔约国的三分之二多数，则秘书长应将修正案通报所有缔约国以供接受。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Such an amendment shall enter into force on a date to be determined by the Maritime Safety Committee at the time of its adoption , unless by a prior date determined by the Maritime Safety Committee at the same time one-fifth or five of the Contracting Parties , whichever number is less , notify the Secretary-General of their objection to the amendment .
Translation: 3. 该修正案应于海上安全委员会通过时所确定的日期生效，除非在委员会同时确定的更早日期前，有五分之一的缔约国或五个缔约国（以数目较小者为准）向秘书长提出反对该修正案的通知。

Query_Text_en: Determination by the Maritime Safety Committee of the dates referred to in this paragraph shall be by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting , which majority shall include a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties present and voting .
Translation: 海事安全委员会对本款所述日期的确定，须经出席并投票成员的三分之二多数通过，且该多数应包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数。

Query_Text_en: an objection made by a Contracting Party shall not be binding on other Contracting Parties as to acceptance of containers to which the present Convention applies .
Translation: 一缔约方提出的异议，对于其他缔约方接受本公约所适用的集装箱，不具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Secretary-General shall inform all Contracting Parties and Members of the Organization of any request and communication under this Article and the date on which any amendment enters into force .
Translation: 5. 秘书长应将根据本条提出的任何请求和来文，以及修正案生效日期，通知所有缔约方及本组织成员国。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where a proposed amendment to the Annexes has been considered but not adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee , any Contracting Party may request the convening of a Conference to which the States referred to in Article VII shall be invited .
Translation: 6. 若海上安全委员会审议了附件修正提案但未予通过，则任何缔约国均可要求召开会议，并应邀请第七条所述国家参会。

Query_Text_en: Upon receipt of notification of concurrence by at least one-third of the other Contracting Parties such a Conference shall be convened by the Secretary-General to consider amendments to the Annexes .
Translation: 在收到至少三分之一其他缔约方同意召开会议的通知后，秘书长应召集会议审议附件修正事宜。

Query_Text_en: Article XI Denunciation1 . Any Contracting Party may denounce the present Convention by effecting the deposit of an instrument with the Secretary-General .
Translation:
第十一条  退出公约  
1. 任何缔约方均可向秘书长交存退出文书，退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall take effect one year from the date of such deposit with the Secretary-General .
Translation: 退约应自秘书长收到退约书之日起一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A Contracting Party which has communicated an objection to an amendment to the Annexes may denounce the present Convention and such denunciation shall take effect on the date of entry into force of such an amendment .
Translation: 二、已对附件修正案提出异议的缔约方可退出本公约，此项退出应于该修正案生效之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article XII TerminationThe present Convention shall cease to be in force if the number of Contracting Parties is less than five for any period of twelve consecutive months .
Translation:
第十二条 终止  
若本公约缔约方数量连续十二个月不足五个，则本公约即行失效。

Query_Text_en: Articles XIII Settlement of disputes1 . Any dispute between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of the present Convention which can not be settled by negotiation or other means of settlement shall , at the request of one of them , be referred to an arbitration tribunal composed as follows :
Translation:
第十三条 争端解决

一、若两个或两个以上缔约方就本公约之解释或适用发生争议，且无法通过谈判或其他解决方式予以处理，应任一缔约方请求，应将争端提交仲裁庭裁决。该仲裁庭按以下方式组成：

Query_Text_en: each party to the dispute shall appoint an arbitrator and these two arbitrators shall appoint a third arbitrator , who shall be the Chairman .
Translation: 争议各方应各自指定一名仲裁员，该两名仲裁员共同推选第三名仲裁员担任首席仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: If three months after receipt of a request one of the parties has failed to appoint an arbitrator if the arbitrators shall have failed to elect the Chairman , any of the parties may request the Secretary-General to appoint an arbitrator or the Chairman of the arbitration tribunal .
Translation: 如一方在收到请求后三个月内未指定仲裁员，或仲裁员未推选出首席仲裁员，则任何一方可请求秘书长指定仲裁员或仲裁庭首席仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Decisions of the arbitration tribunal both as to its procedure and its place of meeting and as to any controversy laid before it , shall be taken by majority vote .
Translation: 4. 仲裁庭关于其程序规则、开庭地点及所受理争议事项的一切裁决，均应以多数票作出。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any controversy which may arise between the parties to the dispute as regards the interpretation and execution of the award may be submitted by either party for judgment to the arbitration tribunal which made the award .
Translation: 五、争议各方对裁决的解释或执行发生任何争议时，任何一方均可将争议提交作出该裁决的仲裁庭裁决。

Query_Text_en: Article XIV Reservations1 . Reservations to the present Convention shall be permitted , excepting those relating to the provisions of Articles I-VI , XIII , and of the present Article and of those contained in the Annexes , on condition that such reservations are communicated in writing and , if communicated before the deposit of the instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , are confirmed in that instrument .
Translation:
第十四条 保留条款

1. 本公约允许提出保留，但涉及第一至第六条、第十三条、本条及附件所含条款者除外。所提保留须以书面形式通报，若在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之前通报，须在该文书中予以确认。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General shall communicate such reservations to all States referred to in Article VII .
Translation: 秘书长应将此类保留意见通知第七条所述所有国家。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any Contracting Party which has formulated a reservation under paragraph 1 may withdraw it at any time by notification to the Secretary-General .
Translation: 3. 根据第1款提出保留的任何缔约方可随时通知秘书长撤回该项保留。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] the termination of the present Convention under Article XII .
Translation: 现行公约依照第十二条规定终止。

Query_Text_en: Article XVI Authentic textsThe original of the present Convention , of which the Chinese , English , French , Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic , shall be deposited with the Secretary-General , who shall communicate certified true copies to all States referred to in Article VII .
Translation:
第十六条 作准文本  
本公约正本一份，以中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各文本同一作准，应交存联合国秘书长。秘书长应将核证无误的副本分送第七条所指所有国家。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 1 Safety Approval Plate1 . A Safety Approval Plate conforming to the specifications set out in the Appendix to this Annex shall be permanently affixed to every approved container at a readily visible place , adjacent to any other approval plate issued for official purposes , where it would not be easily damaged .
Translation:
规章1 安全合格牌照  
1. 每一经批准的集装箱均须在显眼且不易受损的位置永久性固定一块符合本附件附录所载规格的安全合格牌照，该牌照应邻近为官方用途颁发的其他批准牌照。

Query_Text_en: `` CSC SAFETY APPROVAL '' Country of approval and approval reference Date [ month and year ] of manufacture Manufacturer 's identification number of the container or , in the case of existing containers for which that number is unknown , the number allotted by the Administration Maximum operating gross weight [ kilogrammes and lbs ] Allowable stacking weight for 1 . 8 g [ kilogrammes and lbs ] Transverse racking test load value [ kilogrammes and lbs ] .
Translation:
《集装箱安全公约》安全合格牌照  
批准国及批准编号  
制造日期（年月）  
集装箱制造商编号（现有集装箱若编号不明，则为主管机关所分配号码）  
最大运营总重量（千克及磅）  
1.8g加速度下允许堆码重量（千克及磅）  
横向刚性试验负荷值（千克及磅）

Query_Text_en: [ b ] A blank space should be reserved on the Plate for insertion of end and\/or side-wall strength values [ factors ] in accordance with Regulation 1 , paragraph 3 and Annex II , texts 6 and 7 .
Translation: [ b ] 根据第1条第3款及附件Ⅱ第6、7段规定，应在标牌上预留空白处以标注端壁和/或侧壁强度值[系数]。

Query_Text_en: A blank space should also be reserved on the Plate for first and subsequent maintenance examination dates [ month and year ] when used .
Translation: 车牌上还应预留空白处，用于标注首次及后续维护检验日期（月份和年份）。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where the Administration considers that a new container satisfies the requirements of the present Convention in respect of safety and if , for such container , the end and\/or side-wall strength value [ factor ] are designed to be greater or less than that stipulated in Annex II such value shall be indicated on the Safety Approval Plate .
Translation: 3． 如主管机关认为新集装箱在安全方面已符合本公约的要求，而该集装箱的端壁和/或侧壁强度数值(系数)设计大于或小于附件二所规定的数值，则此种强度数值(系数)应在安全合格牌照上注明。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The presence of the Safety Approval Plate does not remove the necessity of displaying such labels or other information as may be required by other regulations which may be in force .
Translation: 安全合格牌照的存在并不免除根据其他现行法规要求展示此类标签或提供其他必要信息的义务。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 2 Maintenance1 . The owner of the container shall be responsible for maintaining it in safe condition .
Translation:
《规则二 维护保养》
1. 集装箱所有人须负责确保其处于安全状态。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The owner of an approved container shall examine the container or have it examined in accordance with the procedure either prescribed or approved by the Contracting Party concerned , at intervals appropriate to operation conditions .
Translation: 2. 经批准的集装箱所有人应按照相关缔约方规定或认可的程序，根据运营条件的实际情况，定期对集装箱进行检查或安排检查。

Query_Text_en: The date [ month and year ] before which a new container shall undergo its first examination shall be marked on the Safety Approval Plate .
Translation: 新集装箱的首次检验截止日期[年月]应标注于安全合格牌照上。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The date [ month and year ] before which the container shall be re-examined shall be clearly marked on the container on or as close as practicable to the Safety Approval Plate and in a manner acceptable to that Contracting Party which prescribed or approved the particular maintenance procedure involved .
Translation: 3. 集装箱下次检验截止日期[年月]应以该缔约方认可的方式，在安全合格牌照上或其附近醒目位置清晰标注。该缔约方系指规定或核准相关具体维修程序的当事国。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The interval from the date of manufacture to the date of the first examination shall not exceed five years .
Translation: 自制造日期至首次检验日期间隔不得超过五年。

Query_Text_en: Subsequent examination of new containers and re-examination of existing containers shall be at intervals of not more than 24 months .
Translation: 新集装箱的后续检验及现有集装箱的复验间隔期不得超过24个月。

Query_Text_en: All examinations shall determine whether the container has any defects which could place any person in danger .
Translation: 所有检验均应确认集装箱是否存在可能危及人身安全的缺陷。

Query_Text_en: 5 . For the purpose of this Regulation `` the Contracting Party concerned '' is the Contracting Party of the territory in which the owner is domiciled or has his head office .
Translation: 5. 本法规所称"相关缔约方"，系指商标权人住所地或总部所在地领土所属的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 3 Approval of new containersTo qualify for approval for safety purposes under the present Convention all new containers shall comply with the requirements set out in Annex II .
Translation:
第三条 新集装箱的批准  
根据本公约规定，为安全目的获得批准的所有新集装箱，均须符合附件二所列的各项要求。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 4 Design type approvalIn the case of containers for which an application for approval has been submitted , the Administration will examine designs and witness testing of a prototype container to ensure that the containers will conform with the requirements set out in Annex II .
Translation:
规则4 定型认可  
对于已提交认可申请的集装箱，主管机关应审查设计并见证原型箱试验，以确保该型集装箱符合附录II所载要求。

Query_Text_en: When satisfied , the Administration shall notify the applicant in writing that the container meets the requirements of the present Convention and this notification shall entitle the manufacturer to affix the Safety Approval Plate to every container of the design type series .
Translation: 经审查确认符合要求后，主管机关应以书面形式通知申请人，声明该型集装箱满足本公约要求。该通知书即授权制造商在此设计型号系列的所有集装箱上加贴安全合格牌照。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 5 Provisions for approval by design type1 . Where the containers are to be manufactured by design type series , application made to an Administration for approval by design type shall be accompanied by drawings , a design specification of the type of container to be approved , and such other data as may be required by the Administration .
Translation:
第五条 定型设计批准规定  
1. 若集装箱按定型系列制造，向主管机关申请定型批准时，应随附待批准箱型的图纸、设计说明书及主管机关可能要求的其他资料。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The applicant shall state the identification symbols which will be assigned by the manufacturer to the type of container to which the application for approval relates .
Translation: 申请人应说明制造商将为申请批准的集装箱类型分配的识别符号。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] affix the Safety Approval Plate to each container in the design type series and to no others ;
Translation: 将安全合格牌照固定在设计型号系列中的每个集装箱上，且不得用于其他集装箱；

Query_Text_en: [ d ] keep a record of containers manufactured to the approved design type . This record shall at least contain the manufacturer 's identification numbers , dates of delivery and names and addresses of customers to whom the containers are delivered .
Translation: [ d ] 保存按核准设计型号制造的容器记录。该记录至少应包含制造商识别编号、交付日期以及接收容器的客户名称与地址。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Approval may be granted by the Administration to containers manufactured as modifications of an approved design type if the Administration is satisfied that the modifications do not affect the validity of tests conducted in the course of design type approval .
Translation: 4. 若主管机关确认设计修改不影响已获批设计定型试验的有效性，可批准对获定型批准的设计进行修改制造的集装箱。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Administration shall not confer on a manufacturer authority to affix Safety Approval Plates on the basis of design type approval unless satisfied that the manufacturer has instituted internal production-control features to ensure that the containers produced will conform to the approved prototype .
Translation: 5. 行政管理部门不得仅凭设计型号批准就授予制造商加贴安全合格牌照的权限，除非确认该制造商已建立内部生产管控机制，确保所生产的集装箱符合获批原型标准。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 6 Examination during productionIn order to ensure that containers of the same design type series are manufactured to the approved design , the Administration shall examine or test as many units as it considers necessary , at any stage during production of the design type series concerned .
Translation:
第六条 生产过程中的检验  
为确保同一设计型号系列的集装箱均按批准的设计制造，主管机关应在该系列产品生产期间的任何阶段，对认为必要数量的集装箱进行检验或试验。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 7 Notification of AdministrationThe manufacturer shall notify the Administration prior to commencement of production of each new series of containers to be manufactured in accordance with an approved design type .
Translation:
第七条 行政主管机关报备  
制造商在开始生产依据核准设计类型制造的每一新系列集装箱前，应事先向行政主管机关报备。

Query_Text_en: Regulation 8 Approval of individual containersApproval of individual containers may be granted where the Administration , after examination and witnessing of tests , is satisfied that the container meets the requirements of the present Convention ;
Translation:
第八条 单个集装箱的认可  
经主管机关审查并见证试验后，若确认该集装箱符合本公约要求，可予以单个集装箱的认可。

Query_Text_en: the Administration , when so satisfied , shall notify the applicant in writing of approval and this notification shall entitle him to affix the Safety Approval Plate to such container .
Translation: 当行政当局确认符合要求后，应以书面形式通知申请人予以核准。该核准通知书即授权申请人在集装箱上加贴安全合格牌照。
