Query_Text_en: [ d ] [ i ] evidence that a container of this type has been safely operated in maritime and\/or inland transport for a period of at least two years , or [ ii ] evidence to the satisfaction of the Administration that the container was manufactured to a design type which had been tested and found to comply with the technical conditions set out in Annex II with the exception of those technical conditions relating to the end-wall and side-wall strength tests , or [ iii ] evidence that the container was constructed to standards which , in the opinion of the Administration , were equivalent to the technical conditions set out in Annex II , with the exception of those technical conditions relating to the end-wall and side-wall strength tests ;
Translation:
[1] 提供证明此类集装箱已在海上和/或内河运输中安全运行至少两年的证据；或  
[2] 提供令主管机关满意的证明，表明该集装箱是按照已通过测试的设计类型制造，且除端壁和侧壁强度测试外，符合附件二规定的技术条件；或  
[3] 提供证明表明集装箱的建造标准经主管机关认定，除端壁和侧壁强度测试外，等同于附件二规定的技术条件。

Query_Text_en: and if so , this notification shall entitle the owner to affix the Safety Approval Plate after an examination of the container concerned has been carried out in accordance with Regulation 2 .
Translation: 如属此类情况，经依据第2条规定对相关集装箱完成检验后，本通知应授权所有人加贴安全合格牌照。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Existing containers which do not qualify for approval under paragraph 1 of this Regulation may be presented for approval under the provisions of Chapter II or Chapter III of this Annex .
Translation: 2. 不符合本规则第1款核准要求的现有集装箱，可依照本附则第二章或第三章规定提交核准。

Query_Text_en: For such containers the requirements of Annex II relating to end and\/or side-wall strength tests shall not apply .
Translation: 对于此类集装箱，附件二中关于端壁和/或侧壁强度测试的要求不适用。

Query_Text_en: The Administration may , if it is satisfied that the containers in question have been in service , waive such of the requirements in respect of presentation of drawings and testing , other than the lifting and floor-strength tests , as it may deem appropriate .
Translation: 如经证实相关集装箱已投入使用，主管机关可酌情豁免其提交图纸和试验的要求（吊顶试验和箱底强度试验除外）。

Query_Text_en: The Safety Approval Plate , conforming to the model reproduced below , shall take the form of a permanent , non-corrosive , fire-proof rectangular plate measuring not less than 200 mm by 100 mm .
Translation: 安全合格牌照应采用永久性、防腐蚀、防火的矩形金属板制成，规格不小于200毫米×100毫米，其样式须与下方所示范本一致。

Query_Text_en: The words `` CSC Safety Approval '' of a minimum letter height of 8 mm and all other words and numbers of a minimum height of 5 mm shall be stamped into , embossed on or indicated on its surface in any other permanent and legible way .
Translation: "CSC安全认证"字样字母高度不得小于8毫米，其余文字及数字高度不得小于5毫米，须采用冲压、凸印或其他永久清晰方式标注于箱体表面。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Date [ month and year ] of manufacture .
Translation: 二、生产日期（年月）

Query_Text_en: 3 . Manufacturer 's identification number of the container or , in the case of existing containers for which that number is unknown , the number allotted by the Administration .
Translation: 3. 集装箱制造商的识别编号；若现有集装箱编号未知，则为主管机关所分配的编号。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Maximum Operating Gross Weight [ kilogrammes and lbs ] .
Translation: 4. 最大运行总重量【千克与磅】。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Allowable Stacking Weight for 1 . 8 g [ kilogrammes and lbs ] .
Translation: 1.8克允许堆叠重量【千克与磅】。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Transverse Racking Test Load Value [ kilogrammes and lbs ] .
Translation: 6. 横向货架测试载荷值 [千克与磅]。

Query_Text_en: 7 . End Wall Strength to be indicated on plate only if end walls are designed to withstand a load of less or greater than 0 . 4 times the maximum permissible payload , ie 0.4 P.
Translation: 7. 端壁强度仅在以下情况需于标牌注明：当端壁设计承载能力小于或大于最大允许有效载荷0.4倍时（即0.4P）。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Side Wall Strength to be indicated on plate only if the side walls are designed to withstand a load of less or greater than 0 . 6 times the maximum permissible payload , ie 0 . 6 P.
Translation: 8. 侧壁强度仅在侧壁设计承重能力低于或高于最大允许载重量0.6倍（即0.6P）时需在标牌上注明。

Query_Text_en: 9 . First maintenance examination date [ month and year ] for new containers and subsequent maintenance examination dates [ month and year ] if Plate used for this purpose .
Translation: 9. 新集装箱首次检验日期（年月）及后续检验日期（年月）（若使用铭牌标注）。

Query_Text_en: Introduction In setting the requirements of this Annex , it is implicit that in all phases of the operation of containers the forces as a result of motion , location , stacking and weight of the loaded container and external forces will not exceed the design strength of the container .
Translation:
引言  
在制定本附件的各项要求时，已默认集装箱在运输、装卸、堆存等所有作业环节中，其承受的由运动状态、摆放位置、堆码负荷及载重所产生的内外部作用力，均不得超过集装箱的设计强度。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the container will so be restrained that it is not subjected to forces in excess of those for which it has been designed ;
Translation: 集装箱应受到约束，确保其所受外力不超过设计承载极限。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the container will have its cargo stowed in accordance with the recommended practices of the trade so that the cargo does not impose upon the container forces in excess of those for which it has been designed .
Translation: 集装箱内货物装载应符合行业推荐规范，确保货物对箱体施加的力不超过其设计承载限度。

Query_Text_en: Construction 1 . A container made from any suitable material which satisfactorily performs the following tests without sustaining any permanent deformation or abnormality which would render it incapable of being used for its designed purpose , shall be considered safe .
Translation:
1. 构造要求  
凡采用适宜材料制成的容器，若能通过以下测试且未产生任何永久性变形或影响其设计功能的异常情况，则该容器应视为安全可靠。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The dimensions , positioning and associated tolerances of corner fittings shall be checked having regard to the lifting and securing systems in which they will function .
Translation: 2. 角件尺寸、定位及相关公差应根据其实际应用的吊装与固定系统进行校验。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When containers are provided with special fittings for use only when such containers are empty , this restriction shall be marked on the container .
Translation: 3. 若集装箱配备仅供空箱使用的特殊装置，须在箱体上标明该限制条件。

Query_Text_en: TEST LOADINGS AND APPLIED FORCES TEST PROCEDURES 1 . LIFTINGThe container , having the prescribed INTERNAL LOADING , shall be lifted in such a way that no significant acceleration forces are applied .
Translation:
试验载荷与施加力测试程序  
1. 吊装  
集装箱在装载规定内部载荷后，应以不产生明显加速度作用力的方式进行吊装。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Lifting from top corner fittingsA uniformly distributed load such that the combined weight of container and text load is equal to 2R . Containers greater than 3,000 mm [ 10 ft ] [ nominal ] in length shall have lifting forces applied vertically at all four top corner fittings . Containers of 3,000 mm [ 10 ft ] [ nominal ] in length or less shall have lifting forces applied at all four top corner fittings , in such a way that the angle between each lifting device and the vertical shall be 30 . Externally applied forces :
Translation:
[ i ] 顶角件吊升  
施加均布载荷，使集装箱与试验载荷的总重量等于2R。长度超过3,000毫米（标称10英尺）的集装箱，应在所有四个顶角件上垂直施加起吊力。长度等于或小于3,000毫米（标称10英尺）的集装箱，应在所有四个顶角件上施加起吊力，且每个起吊装置与垂直方向的夹角为30度。外部作用力：

Query_Text_en: Such as to lift the combined weight of 2R in the manner prescribed [ under the heading TEST PROCEDURES ] .
Translation: 按照[测试程序]标题下规定的方式，提升2R组合重量。

Query_Text_en: Containers shall have lifting forces applied in such a manner that the lifting devices bear on the bottom corner fittings only .
Translation: 集装箱的吊装受力方式应确保吊具仅作用于箱体底角件。

Query_Text_en: A uniformly distributed load such that the combined weight of container and test load is equal to 1 . 25 R. Externally applied forces : Such as to lift the combined weight of 1 . 25 R in the manner prescribed [ under the heading TEST PROCEDURES ] . The container shall be placed on bars which are in the same horizontal plane , one bar centred within each fork lift pocket which is used for lifting the loaded container . The bars shall be of the same width as the forks intended to be used in the handling , and shall project into the fork pocket 75 per cent of the length of the fork pocket .
Translation: 均布载荷应使集装箱与试验载荷总重量等于1.25倍额定值（R）。外部施加的作用力：按[试验程序]章节规定方式起吊1.25倍额定值（R）的总重量。集装箱应置于水平放置的横杠上，每根横杠居中置于用于吊载的叉槽内。横杠宽度须与实际作业叉臂同宽，且插入叉槽的深度应达叉槽长度的75%。

Query_Text_en: A uniformly distributed load such that the combined weight of containers and test load is equal to 1 . 25 R.
Translation: 集装箱与试验载荷总重量等于1.25倍额定载荷的均布荷载。

Query_Text_en: The container shall be placed on pads in the same horizontal plane , one under each grappler arm position . These pads shall be of the same sizes as the lifting area of the grappler arms intended to be used . Externally applied forces : Such as to lift the combined weight of 1 . 25 R , in the manner prescribed [ under the heading TEST PROCEDURES ] .
Translation: 集装箱应置于同一水平面的垫块上，每块垫块分别位于抓臂工位正下方。垫块尺寸须与拟用抓臂的承重区域规格一致。外部施加载荷：按照[测试程序]章节规定的方式，施加相当于1.25倍额定载荷（1.25R）总重量的提升力。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Other methodsWhere containers are designed to be lifted in the loaded condition by any method not mentioned in [ A ] or [ B ] [ i ] and [ ii ] they shall also be tested with the INTERNAL LOADING AND EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCES representative of the acceleration conditions appropriate to that method .
Translation:
[ iii ] 其他装载方式  
若集装箱设计采用[A]或[B]项中[i]和[ii]款未提及的任何方式进行满载吊运，则还须按照适用于该方式的加速度条件，施加具有代表性的内部载荷与外部作用力进行测试。

Query_Text_en: 2 . STACKING1 . For conditions of international transport where the maximum vertical acceleration forces vary significantly from 1 . 8 g and when the container is reliably and effectively limited to such conditions of transport , the stacking load may be varied by the appropriate ratio of acceleration forces .
Translation:
二、堆码要求  
1. 在国际运输过程中，若最大垂直加速度与1.8g存在显著差异，且集装箱运输条件被可靠有效地限制在此类工况下，则堆码载荷可按加速度力的相应比例进行调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 . On successful completion of this test the container may be rated for the allowable superimposed static stacking weight which should be indicated on the Safety Approval Plate against the heading `` Allowable stacking weight for 1 . 8 g [ kilogrammes and lbs ] '' .
Translation: 2. 试验通过后，可在安全合格标牌"允许堆码重量（1.8g工况）[千克及磅]"项下标明该集装箱允许叠加静载堆码重量额定值。

Query_Text_en: A uniformly distributed load such that the combined weight of container and test load is equal to 1 . 8 R. The container , having the prescribed INTERNAL LOADING , shall be placed on four level pads which are in turn supported on a rigid horizontal surface , one under each bottom corner fitting or equivalent corner structure .
Translation: 集装箱与试验载荷的总重量应等于1.8倍额定载荷（1.8R）。装有规定内载的集装箱须放置于四个水平垫块上，垫块需置于刚性水平台面，每个垫块对应支撑一个底角件或等效角部结构。

Query_Text_en: The pads shall be centralized under the fittings and shall be of approximately the same plan dimensions as the fittings .
Translation: 垫片应集中安装在配件下方，其平面尺寸应与配件大致相同。

Query_Text_en: Such as to subject each of the four top corner fittings to a vertical downward force equal to 1\/4 x 1 . 8 x the allowable superimposed static stacking weight .
Translation: 例如对四个顶部角件各施加一个垂直向下的力，其大小等于1/4×1.8倍的允许叠加静态堆码重量。

Query_Text_en: Each EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCE shall be applied to each of the corner fittings through corresponding test corner fitting or through a pad of the same plan dimensions . The test corner fitting or pad shall be offset with respect to the top corner fitting of the container by 25 mm [ 1 in . laterally and 38 mm [ 11\/2 in . longitudinally .
Translation: 每个外部施加的力应通过相应的测试角件或具有相同平面尺寸的垫块，传递至集装箱各角件。测试角件或垫块需相对于集装箱顶部角件横向偏移25毫米（1英寸），纵向偏移38毫米（1½英寸）。

Query_Text_en: Externally applied forces : A concentrated load of 300 kg [ 660 lb ] uniformly distributed over an area of 600 mm x 300 mm [ 24 in . x 12 in . The EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCES shall be applied vertically downwards to the outer surface of the weakest area of the roof of the container .
Translation: 外部施加力：在600毫米×300毫米（24英寸×12英寸）的面积上均匀分布的300千克（660磅）集中载荷。该外部施加力应垂直向下作用于集装箱顶部最薄弱区域的外表面。

Query_Text_en: Two concentrated loads each of 2,730 kg [ 6,000 lb ] and each applied to the container floor through a contact area of 142 cm2 [ 22 sq. in . The test should be made with the container resting on four levels supports under its four bottom corners in such a manner that the base structure of the container is free to deflect .
Translation: 两个集中载荷各为2,730公斤[6,000磅]，每个载荷通过142平方厘米[22平方英寸]的接触面施加于集装箱底板。试验时，集装箱应置于四个水平支撑上，支撑点位于箱体底部四角，确保集装箱底部结构能够自由变形。

Query_Text_en: A testing device loaded to a weight of 5,460 kilogrammes [ 12,000 lbs ] that is 2,730 kg [ 6,000 lbs ] on each of two surfaces having , when loaded , a total contact area of 284 cm2 [ 44 sq. in . that is 142 cm2 [ 22 sq. in . on each surface , the surface width being 180 mm [ 7 in . spaced 760 mm [ 30 in . apart , center to center , should be manoeuvred over the entire floor area of the container .
Translation: 测试装置总负载为5,460公斤[12,000磅]，即两个承载面各承受2,730公斤[6,000磅]荷载。加载状态下，装置总接触面积为284平方厘米[44平方英寸]，即每个承载面接触面积为142平方厘米[22平方英寸]。承载面宽度为180毫米[7英寸]，中心间距760毫米[30英寸]。该装置应在集装箱整个底板区域进行移动测试。

Query_Text_en: None .
Translation: 无。

Query_Text_en: The container in tare condition shall be placed on four level supports one under each bottom corner and shall be restrained against lateral and vertical movement by means of anchor devices so arranged that the lateral restraint is provided only at the bottom corners diagonally opposite to those at which the forces are applied .
Translation: 空载集装箱应置于四个水平支撑上，每个底角各设一个支撑点，并通过锚固装置限制其横向与垂直位移。锚固装置的布置须确保：仅在施加作用力的对角底角处提供横向约束。

Query_Text_en: Such as to rack the end structures of the container sideways . The forces shall be equal to those for which the container was designed .
Translation: 例如横向施加集装箱端部结构的载荷。所施加的力应等同于集装箱的设计承载值。

Query_Text_en: The EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCE shall be applied either separately or simultaneously to each of the top corner fittings on one side of the container in lines parallel both to the base and to the planes of the ends of the container .
Translation: 外部施加的作用力应单独或同时施加于集装箱一侧各顶角件上，施力方向须与箱底平行，且与箱端面平行。

Query_Text_en: The forces shall be applied first towards and then away from the top corner fittings .
Translation: 作用力应首先朝向顶部角件施加，随后反向远离。

Query_Text_en: In the case of containers in which each end is symmetrical about its own vertical centreline , one side only need be tested , but both sides of containers with asymmetric ends shall be tested .
Translation: 对于两端各自沿垂直中线对称的集装箱，仅需测试一侧；但若集装箱端部不对称，则需对两侧均进行测试。

Query_Text_en: 5 . LONGITUDINAL RESTRAINT [ STATIC TEST ] When designing and constructing containers , it must be borne in mind that containers , when carried by inland modes of transport may sustain accelerations of 2 g applied horizontally in a longitudinal direction .
Translation:
5. 纵向约束【静态试验】  
集装箱的设计与制造须考虑以下因素：通过内陆运输时，集装箱可能承受纵向水平方向2g的加速度作用。

Query_Text_en: A uniformly distributed load , such that the combined weight of a container and test load is equal to the maximum operating gross weight or rating , R. The container having the prescribed INTERNAL LOADING shall be restrained longitudinally by securing the two bottom corner fittings or equivalent corner structures at one end to suitable anchor points .
Translation: 均布载荷应使集装箱与试验载荷的总重量等于最大运行总重量或额定值R。装有规定内部载荷的集装箱，应通过将一端的两只底角件或等效角结构固定于适当锚固点的方式实现纵向约束。

Query_Text_en: Externally applied forces :
Translation: 外部作用力

Query_Text_en: Such as to subject each side of the container to longitudinal compressive and tensile forces of magnitude R , that is , a combined force of 2R on the base of the container as a whole .
Translation: 例如，对容器两侧分别施加大小为R的纵向压缩力和拉伸力，即相当于在整个容器底部施加2R的合力。

Query_Text_en: The EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCES shall be applied first towards and then away from the anchor points . Each side of the container shall be tested .
Translation: 外部作用力应先朝向锚定点施加，再反向施加。集装箱的每一侧均需进行测试。

Query_Text_en: 6 . END-WALLSThe end walls should be capable of withstanding a load of not less than 0 . 4 times the maximum permissible payload .
Translation:
6. 端墙
端墙应能承受不低于最大允许有效载荷0.4倍的荷载。

Query_Text_en: If , however , the end walls are designed to withstand a load of less or greater than 0 . 4 times the maximum permissible payload such a strength factor shall be indicated on the Safety Approval Plate in accordance with Annex I , Regulation 1 .
Translation: 然而，若端壁设计承载能力低于或高于最大允许载重量的0.4倍，则应根据附件一第1条规定，在安全合格牌照上注明该强度系数。

Query_Text_en: 4P or such other load for which the container may be designed .
Translation: 4P或集装箱设计适用的其他载荷。

Query_Text_en: The prescribed INTERNAL LOADING shall be applied as follows :
Translation: 规定内部荷载应按以下方式施加：

Query_Text_en: Both ends of container shall be tested except where the ends are identical only one end need be tested .
Translation: 除两端完全相同的集装箱仅需检测一端外，集装箱两端均须进行检测。

Query_Text_en: The end-walls of containers which do not have open sides or side doors may be tested separately or simultaneously .
Translation: 对于无侧开面或侧门的集装箱，其端壁可单独或同步进行测试。

Query_Text_en: The end-walls of containers which do have open sides or side doors should be tested separately .
Translation: 对于设有敞开侧面或侧门的集装箱，其端壁应单独进行测试。

Query_Text_en: When the ends are tested separately the reactions to the forces applied to the end-wall shall be confined to the base structure of the container .
Translation: 当对端部单独进行测试时，施加于端壁的作用力所产生的反作用力应仅限于集装箱的底部结构。

Query_Text_en: None . 7 . SIDE-WALLSThe side-walls should be capable of withstanding a load of not less than 0.6 times the maximum permissible payload . If , however , the side-walls are designed to withstand a load of less or greater than 0.6 times the maximum permissible payload , such a strength factor should be indicated on the Safety Approval Plate in accordance with Annex I , Regulation 1 .
Translation:
七、侧壁强度  
侧壁应能承受不低于最大允许载重量0.6倍的负荷。若侧壁设计承载能力低于或高于最大允许载重量的0.6倍，须根据附件一第1条规定，在安全合格牌照上注明该强度系数。

Query_Text_en: 6P or such other load for which the container may be designed .
Translation: 6P或其他集装箱设计承载的相应负荷。

Query_Text_en: Both sides of a container shall be tested except where the sides are identical only one side need be tested . Side-walls shall be tested separately and the reactions to the internal loading shall be confined to the corner fittings or equivalent corner structures .
Translation: 除两侧完全对称仅需测试单侧外，集装箱的左右两侧均应进行测试。侧壁须单独检测，其内部载荷反应应仅作用于角件或等效角部结构。

Query_Text_en: Open topped containers shall be tested in the condition in which they are designed to be operated , for example , with removable top members in position .
Translation: 敞顶集装箱应按照其设计使用状态进行测试，例如测试时应将可拆卸顶梁安装就位。

Query_Text_en: Article IThe area to which this Convention shall apply , hereinafter referred to as the `` Convention area '' , shall be all waters of the Atlantic Ocean , including the adjacent Seas .
Translation: 第一条 本公约适用区域（以下简称"公约区域"）为大西洋所有水域，包括附属海域。

Query_Text_en: Article IINothing in this Convention shall be considered as affecting the rights , claims or views of any Contracting Party in regard to the limits of territorial waters or the extent of jurisdiction over fisheries under international law .
Translation:
第二条  
本公约之任何规定均不得视为影响任何缔约国根据国际法对领海界限或渔业管辖范围所享有的权利、主张或观点。

Query_Text_en: Article III1 . The Contracting Parties hereby agree to establish and maintain a Commission to be known as the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas , hereinafter referred to as `` the Commission '' , which shall carry out the objectives set forth in this Convention .
Translation:
第三条  
1. 缔约各方特此同意设立并维持一个委员会，称为"国际大西洋金枪鱼养护委员会"（以下简称"委员会"），负责执行本公约所规定的各项宗旨。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each of the Contracting Parties shall be represented on the Commission by not more than three Delegates .
Translation: 2. 各缔约方在委员会中的代表人数不得超过三名。

Query_Text_en: Such Delegates may be assisted by experts and advisors .
Translation: 此类代表可由专家和顾问协助工作。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except as may otherwise be provided in this Convention , decisions of the Commission shall be taken by a majority of the Contracting Parties , each Contracting Party having one vote .
Translation: 除本公约另有规定外，委员会的决定应由缔约方多数表决通过，每一缔约方享有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: Two-thirds of the Contracting Parties shall constitute a quorum .
Translation: 缔约方三分之二出席即构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Commission shall hold a regular meeting once every two years .
Translation: 委员会应每两年举行一次例会。

Query_Text_en: A special meeting may be called at any time at the request of a majority of the Contracting Parties or by decision of the Council as constituted in Article V.
Translation: 经多数缔约方请求或根据第五条所设理事会的决定，可随时召开特别会议。

Query_Text_en: 5 . At its first meeting , and thereafter at each regular meeting , the Commission shall elect from among its Members a Chairman , a first Vice-Chairman and a second Vice-Chairman who shall not be re-elected for more than one term .
Translation: 5．委员会应在首次会议及此后每次常会上，从成员中选举主席一人、第一副主席一人及第二副主席一人，任期均不得超过两届。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The meetings of the Commission and its subsidiary bodies shall be public unless the Commission otherwise decides .
Translation: 六、委员会及其附属机构会议应公开举行，但委员会另有决定者除外。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The official languages of the Commission shall be English , French and Spanish .
Translation: 7. 本委员会正式语言为英语、法语和西班牙语。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The Commission shall have authority to adopt such rules of procedure and financial regulations as are necessary to carry out its functions .
Translation: 8. 委员会有权通过为履行其职能所需的议事规则和财务条例。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The Commission shall submit a report to the Contracting Parties every two years on its work and findings and shall also inform any Contracting Party , whenever requested , on any matter relating to the objectives of the Convention .
Translation: 9. 委员会应每两年向缔约方提交一份工作报告及研究成果，并应任一缔约方要求，随时通报与公约目标相关的任何事项。

Query_Text_en: Article IV1 . In order to carry out the objectives of this Convention the Commission shall be responsible for the study of the populations of tuna and tuna-like fishes [ the Scombriformes with the exception of the families Trichiuridae and Gempylidae and the genus Scomber ] and such other species of fishes exploited in tuna fishing in the Convention area as are not under investigation by another international fishery organization .
Translation: 第四条1．为实现本公约之宗旨，委员会应负责研究金枪鱼及类金枪鱼种群（鲭形目鱼类，但带鱼科和蛇鲭科以及鲭属除外），以及公约区域内其他未被国际渔业组织研究的、在金枪鱼捕捞过程中所开发的鱼类物种。

Query_Text_en: Such study shall include research on the abundance , biometry and ecology of the fishes ; the oceanography of their environment ; and the effects of natural and human factors upon their abundance .
Translation: 此类研究应包括以下内容：鱼类数量、生物统计及生态学研究；其生存环境的海洋学特征；以及自然与人为因素对鱼类数量的影响。

Query_Text_en: The Commission , in carrying out these responsibilities shall , insofar as feasible , utilise the technical and scientific services of , and information from , official agencies of the Contracting Parties and their political sub-divisions and may , when desirable , utilise the available services and information of any public or private institution , organization or individual , and may undertake within the limits of its budget independent research to supplement the research work being done by governments , national institutions or other international organizations .
Translation: 委员会在履行上述职责时，应尽可能利用缔约方及其行政区划官方机构提供的科技服务与信息；在必要时可动用任何公私机构、组织或个人提供的可用服务与信息；并可在预算范围内开展自主研究，以补充各国政府、国家机构或其他国际组织正在进行的研究工作。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] publishing and otherwise disseminating reports of its findings and statistical , biological and other scientific information relative to the tuna fisheries of the Convention area .
Translation: [四]发布并传播其调查结果报告，以及与公约区域金枪鱼渔业相关的统计、生物及其他科学信息。

Query_Text_en: Article V1 . There is established within the Commission a Council which shall consist of the Chairman and the Vice-Chairmen of the Commission together with the representatives of not less than four and not more than eight Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第五条 委员会内设理事会，由委员会主席、副主席及至少四个但不超过八个缔约方的代表组成。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties represented on the Council shall be elected at each regular meeting of the Commission .
Translation: 理事会缔约方代表应在委员会每届例会上选举产生。

Query_Text_en: However , if at any time the number of the Contracting Parties exceeds forty , the Commission may elect an additional two Contracting Parties to be represented on the Council .
Translation: 然而，若缔约方数量在任何时候超过四十个，委员会可增选两个缔约方加入理事会。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties of which the Chairman and Vice-Chairmen are nationals shall not be elected to the Council .
Translation: 理事会主席及副主席所属缔约方不得当选为理事会成员。

Query_Text_en: In elections to the Council the Commission shall give due consideration to the geographic , tuna fishing and tuna processing interests of the Contracting Parties , as well as to the equal right of the Contracting Parties to be represented on the Council .
Translation: 在理事会选举中，委员会应充分考虑各缔约国的地理分布、金枪鱼捕捞及加工利益，并确保各缔约国享有平等的理事会代表权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Council shall perform such functions as are assigned to it by this Convention or are designated by the Commission , and shall meet at least once in the interim between regular meetings of the Commission .
Translation: 2. 理事会应履行本公约所赋予或委员会所指定的职能，并在委员会常会闭会期间至少召开一次会议。

Query_Text_en: Between meetings of the Commission the Council shall make necessary decisions on the duties to be carried out by the staff and shall issue necessary instructions to the Executive Secretary .
Translation: 在委员会闭会期间，理事会应就工作人员须履行的职责作出必要决定，并向执行秘书下达必要指示。

Query_Text_en: Decisions of the Council shall be made in accordance with rules to be established by the Commission .
Translation: 理事会应依照委员会制定的规则作出决定。

Query_Text_en: Article VITo carry out the objectives of this Convention the Commission may establish Panels on the basis of species , group of species , or of geographic areas .
Translation:
第六条  
为实现本公约之宗旨，委员会可按鱼种、种群或地理区域设立专家小组。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] may recommend to the Commission studies and investigations necessary for obtaining information relating to its species , group of species , or geographic area , as well as the co-ordination of programs of investigation by the Contracting Parties .
Translation: [c]可向委员会建议开展必要的调研和调查，以获取与其物种、物种群或地理区域相关的信息，并协调缔约方的调查计划。

Query_Text_en: Article VIIThe Commission shall appoint an Executive Secretary who shall serve at the pleasure of the Commission .
Translation:
第七条  
委员会应任命一名执行秘书，该执行秘书的任期由委员会决定。

Query_Text_en: The Executive Secretary , subject to such rules and procedures as may be determined by the Commission , shall have authority with respect to the selection and administration of the staff of the Commission .
Translation: 执行秘书在遵循委员会所定规则和程序的前提下，有权负责委员会工作人员的遴选与管理工作。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] preparing for approval by the Commission scientific , administrative and other reports of the Commission and its subsidiary bodies .
Translation: [ g ] 为委员会及其附属机构准备待批准的科学、行政及其他报告。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII1 . [ a ] The Commission may , on the basis of scientific evidence , make recommendations designed to maintain the populations of tuna and tuna-like fishes that may be taken in the Convention area at levels which will permit the maximum sustainable catch .
Translation: 第八条1. [a] 委员会可依据科学证据提出建议，旨在将公约区域内可捕捞的金枪鱼及类金枪鱼种群数量维持在能够实现最大可持续捕捞量的水平。

Query_Text_en: These recommendations shall be applicable to the Contracting Parties under the conditions laid down in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article .
Translation: 本建议书应在符合本条第二款和第三款规定条件的情况下适用于各缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] on the proposal of the appropriate Panels if the recommendation in question relates to more than one geographic area , species or group of species .
Translation: [三]如建议涉及多个地理区域、鱼种或鱼类种群，则应根据相关专家小组的提议作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each recommendation made under paragraph 1 of this Article shall become effective for all Contracting Parties six months after the date of the notification from the Commission transmitting the recommendation to the Contracting Parties , except as provided in paragraph 3 of this Article .
Translation: 根据本条第一款提出的每项建议，自委员会向缔约方发出建议通知之日起六个月后对所有缔约方生效，但本条第三款规定的情形除外。

Query_Text_en: 3 . [ a ] If any contracting party in the case of a recommendation made under paragraph 1 [ b ] [ i ] above , or any Contracting Party member of a Panel concerned in the case of a recommendation made under paragraph 1 [ b ] [ ii ] or [ iii ] above , presents to the Commission an objection to such recommendation within the six months period provided for in paragraph 2 above , the recommendation shall not become effective for an additional sixty days .
Translation: 三、[甲]如任何缔约方对上述第一段[乙][一]项所作建议提出异议，或任何有关专家组成员缔约方对上述第一段[乙][二]或[三]项所作建议提出异议，并在上述第二段规定的六个月内向委员会提交异议书，则该建议应延迟六十日生效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Thereupon any other Contracting Party may present an objection prior to the expiration of the additional sixty days period , or within forty-five days of the date of the notification of an objection made by another Contracting Party within such additional sixty days , whichever date shall be the later .
Translation: [ b ] 此后，任何其他缔约方可在额外六十日期限届满前提出异议，或在另一缔约方于该额外六十日内提出异议的通知发出后四十五日内提出异议，以较晚的日期为准。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The recommendation shall become effective at the end of the extended period or periods for objection , except for those Contracting Parties that have presented an objection .
Translation: 除已提出异议的缔约方外，该建议应在延长的异议期结束时生效。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] However , if a recommendation has met with an objection presented by only one or less than one-fourth of the Contracting Parties , in accordance with sub-paragraphs [ a ] and [ b ] above , the Commission shall immediately notify the Contracting Party or Parties having presented such objection that it is to be considered as having no effect .
Translation: [ d ] 然而，若某项建议根据上述[ a ]项和[ b ]项规定仅遭到一个或不足四分之一缔约方反对，委员会应立即通知提出反对的缔约方，该反对意见应视为无效。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] In the case referred to in sub-paragraph [ d ] above the Contracting Party or Parties concerned shall have an additional period of sixty days from the date of said notification in which to reaffirm their objection .
Translation: 在上述[ d ]项所述情形下，相关缔约方自收到通知之日起可额外获得六十日期限以重申其反对立场。

Query_Text_en: On the expiry of this period the recommendation shall become effective , except with respect to any Contracting Party having presented an objection and reaffirmed it within the delay provided for .
Translation: 除已提出反对并在规定期限内重申反对意见的缔约方外，该建议书于上述期限届满时即行生效。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] If a recommendation has met with objection from more than one-fourth but less than the majority of the Contracting Parties , in accordance with sub-paragraphs [ a ] and [ b ] above , the recommendation shall become effective for the Contracting Parties that have not presented an objection thereto .
Translation: [ f ] 若某项建议根据上述[ a ]项和[ b ]项规定遭到四分之一以上但未达多数缔约方反对，则该建议对未提出反对的缔约方生效。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] If objections have been presented by a majority of the Contracting Parties the recommendation shall not become effective .
Translation: 如过半数缔约方提出异议，则该建议不得生效。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any Contracting Party objecting to a recommendation may at any time withdraw that objection , and the recommendation shall become effective with respect to such Contracting Party immediately if the recommendation is already in effect , or at such time as it may become effective under the terms of this Article .
Translation: 四、任何缔约方若对某项建议提出反对意见，可随时撤回该反对意见；若该建议已生效，则该建议应立即对该缔约方生效；若该建议尚未生效，则应根据本条条款规定在其生效时对该缔约方生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Commission shall notify each Contracting Party immediately upon receipt of each objection and of each withdrawal of an objection , and of the entry into force of any recommendation .
Translation: 5. 委员会应在收到每一项异议、每一项异议撤销通知以及任何建议生效后，立即通知各缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Article IX1 . The Contracting Parties agree to take all action necessary to ensure the enforcement of this Convention .
Translation: 第九条1. 缔约各方同意采取一切必要措施，确保本公约得以实施。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall transmit to the Commission , biennially or at such other time as may be required by the Commission , a statement of the action taken by it for these purposes .
Translation: 各缔约方应每两年或按委员会要求的其他时间，向委员会提交其为实现这些目标所采取措施的说明。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] when their official agencies are unable to obtain and furnish the said information , to allow the Commission , through the Contracting Parties , to obtain it on a voluntary basis direct from companies and individual fishermen .
Translation: [ b ] 若其官方机构无法获取并提供上述信息，则应允许委员会通过缔约方，以自愿方式直接从公司及个体渔民处获取该信息。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Contracting Parties undertake to collaborate with each other with a view to the adoption of suitable effective measures to ensure the application of the provisions of this Convention and in particular to set up a system of international enforcement to be applied to the Convention area except the territorial sea and other waters , if any , in which a state is entitled under international law to exercise jurisdiction over fisheries .
Translation: 缔约各方承诺相互协作，以期采取适当有效措施确保本公约条款之实施，尤其须建立一套适用于公约区域（领海及国家依据国际法对渔业行使管辖权的其他水域除外）的国际执行制度。

Query_Text_en: Article X1 . The Commission shall adopt a budget for the joint expenses of the Commission for the biennium following each regular meeting .
Translation: 第一条 委员会应于每次常会后通过下一两年期委员会共同支出预算。

Query_Text_en: The scheme of annual contributions in the Financial Regulations shall be established or modified only through the agreement of all the Contracting Parties present and voting .
Translation: 《财务条例》所规定的年度分摊费办法，须经所有出席并参加表决的缔约方一致同意方可制定或修改。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Council shall review the second half of the biennial budget at its regular meeting between Commission meetings and , on the basis of current and anticipated developments , may authorise reapportionment of amounts in the Commission budget for the second year within the total budget approved by the Commission .
Translation: 3. 理事会应在闭会期间例行会议上审议两年期预算的后半部分，并可根据当前及预期发展情况，在委员会核准的预算总额范围内，授权对第二年委员会预算资金进行重新分配。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Executive Secretary of the Commission shall notify each contracting Party of its yearly assessment .
Translation: 委员会执行秘书应将年度评估结果通知各缔约方。

Query_Text_en: The contributions shall be payable on January first of the year for which the assessment was levied .
Translation: 会费应于征收评估所涉年份的1月1日缴纳。

Query_Text_en: Contributions not received before January first of the succeeding year shall be considered as in arrears .
Translation: 次年1月1日前未收到的缴款将被视为欠缴。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Contributions to the biennial budget shall be payable in such currencies as the Commission may decide .
Translation: 5. 向两年期预算缴纳的会费应以委员会决定的货币支付。

Query_Text_en: 6 . At its first meeting the Commission shall approve a budget for the balance of the first year the Commission functions and for the following biennium . It shall immediately transmit to the Contracting Parties copies of these budgets together with notices of the respective assessments for the first annual contribution .
Translation: 6. 委员会首次会议应核准其运作首年剩余期间及随后两年期的预算。委员会须立即向缔约各方转交上述预算副本，并附首年度分摊会费缴付通知书。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Thereafter , within a period not less than sixty days before the regular meeting of the Commission which precedes the biennium , the Executive Secretary shall submit to each Contracting Party a draft biennial budget together with a schedule of proposed assessments .
Translation: 7. 此后，在委员会双年度例会召开前不少于六十日内，执行秘书应向各缔约方提交一份双年度预算草案及拟议分摊费用表。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The Commission may suspend the voting rights of any Contracting Party when its arrears of contributions equal or exceed the amount due from it for the two preceding years .
Translation: 8. 若任何缔约方拖欠会费达到或超过前两年应缴总额，委员会可暂停其表决权。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The Commission shall establish a Working Capital Fund to finance operations of the Commission prior to receiving annual contributions , and for such other purposes as the Commission may determine .
Translation: 9. 委员会应设立一项周转基金，用于在收到年度会费前资助委员会运作，以及用于委员会可能确定的其他用途。

Query_Text_en: The Commission shall determine the level of the Fund , assess advances necessary for its establishment , and adopt regulations governing the use of the Fund .
Translation: 委员会应确定该基金的规模，评估设立基金所需的预付款项，并通过规范基金使用的管理条例。

Query_Text_en: 10 . The Commission shall arrange an annual independent audit of the Commission 's accounts .
Translation: 10. 委员会应安排对委员会账目进行年度独立审计。

Query_Text_en: The reports of such audits shall be reviewed and approved by the Commission , or by the Council in years when there is no regular Commission meeting .
Translation: 此类审计报告须经委员会审核批准；若无定期委员会会议，则由理事会审议批准。

Query_Text_en: 11 . The Commission may accept contributions , other than provided for in paragraph 2 of this Article , for the prosecution of its work .
Translation: 11. 除本条第二款规定外，委员会可接受其他捐助以推进其工作。

Query_Text_en: Article XI1 . The Contracting Parties agree that there should be a working relationship between the Commission and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations .
Translation: 第十一条1. 缔约方同意，委员会与联合国粮食及农业组织之间应建立工作关系。

Query_Text_en: To this end the Commission shall enter into negotiations with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations with a view to concluding an agreement pursuant to Article XIII of the Organization 's Constitution .
Translation: 为此，委员会应与联合国粮食及农业组织展开谈判，以期根据该组织章程第十三条缔结协议。

Query_Text_en: Such agreement should provide , inter alia , for the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations to appoint a Representative who would participate in all meetings of the Commission and its subsidiary bodies , but without the right to vote .
Translation: 除其他外，此类协定应规定由联合国粮食及农业组织总干事委派一名代表，该代表可参加委员会及其附属机构的所有会议，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Contracting Parties agree that there should be co-operation between the Commission and other international fisheries commissions and scientific organizations which might contribute to the work of the Commission .
Translation: 缔约各方同意，委员会应与其他可能对其工作有所助益的国际渔业委员会及科学组织展开合作。

Query_Text_en: The Commission may enter into agreements with such commissions and organizations .
Translation: 委员会可与上述委员会及组织签订协议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Commission may invite any appropriate international organization and any Government which is a member of the United Nations or of any Specialized Agency of the United Nations and which is not a member of the Commission , to send observers to meetings of the Commission and its subsidiary bodies .
Translation: 3. 委员会可邀请任何相关国际组织及联合国会员国或联合国专门机构成员国（非委员会成员）派遣观察员列席委员会及其附属机构会议。

Query_Text_en: Article XII 1 . This Convention shall remain in force for ten years and thereafter until a majority of Contracting Parties agree to terminate it .
Translation: 第十二条 1. 本公约有效期为十年，此后继续有效，直至多数缔约方同意终止为止。

Query_Text_en: 2 . At any time after ten years from the date of entry into force of this Convention , any Contracting Party may withdraw from the Convention on December thirty-first of any year including the tenth year by written notification of withdrawal given on or before December thirty-first of the preceding year to the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations .
Translation: 在本公约生效之日起满十年后的任何时间，任何缔约方均可退出本公约。退出应以书面形式通知联合国粮食及农业组织总干事，且须于拟退出年份（含第十年）的前一年十二月三十一日或之前提交。退出将于该年份十二月三十一日生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any other Contracting Party may thereupon withdraw from this Convention with effect from the same December thirty-first by giving written notification of withdrawal to the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations not later than one month from the date of receipt of information from the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations concerning any withdrawal , but not later than April first of that year .
Translation: 三、其他任何缔约方均可随后退出本公约，自同年十二月三十一日起生效，但须在收到联合国粮食及农业组织总干事关于任何退约的通知后一个月内，且不迟于当年四月一日，向联合国粮食及农业组织总干事提交书面退约通知。

Query_Text_en: Article XIII1 . Any Contracting Party or the Commission may propose amendments to this Convention .
Translation: 第十三条1．任何缔约方或委员会均可对本公约提出修正案。

Query_Text_en: The Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations shall transmit a certified copy of the text of any proposed amendment to all the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 联合国粮食及农业组织总干事应将任何拟议修正案之认证文本副本分送全体缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Any amendment not involving new obligations shall take effect for all Contracting Parties on the thirtieth day after its acceptance by three-fourths of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 不涉及新增义务的修正案经四分之三缔约方接受后，将于第三十日起对所有缔约方生效。

Query_Text_en: Any amendment involving new obligations shall take effect for each Contracting Party accepting the amendment on the ninetieth day after its acceptance by three-fourths of the Contracting Parties and thereafter for each remaining Contracting Party upon acceptance by it .
Translation: 任何涉及新增义务的修正案，应自四分之三缔约方接受之日起九十天后对接受该修正案的缔约方生效，此后对剩余缔约方自其接受之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Any amendment considered by one or more Contracting Parties to involve new obligations shall be deemed to involve new obligations and shall take effect accordingly .
Translation: 若任一或多个缔约方认为某项修正案涉及新增义务，则该修正案应视为涉及新增义务并相应生效。

Query_Text_en: A government which becomes a Contracting Party after an amendment to this Convention has been opened for acceptance pursuant to the provisions of this Article shall be bound by the Convention as amended when the said amendment comes into force .
Translation: 在本公约修正案依照本条规定开放接受后成为缔约方的政府，应受修正案生效后的本公约约束。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Proposed amendments shall be deposited with the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations .
Translation: 拟议修正案应提交联合国粮食及农业组织总干事备案。

Query_Text_en: Notifications of acceptance of amendments shall be deposited with the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations .
Translation: 接受修正案之通知书应交存联合国粮食及农业组织总干事。

Query_Text_en: Article XIV1 . This Convention shall be open for signature by any Government of any State which is a Member of the United Nations or of any Specialized Agency of the United Nations .
Translation: 第十四条1. 本公约对联合国任何会员国或其专门机构成员国政府开放签署。

Query_Text_en: Any such Government which does not sign this Convention may adhere to it at any time .
Translation: 凡未签署本公约之政府,均得随时加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall be subject to ratification or approval by signatory countries in accordance with their constitutions .
Translation: 2. 本公约须由签署国依照其宪法程序予以批准或核准。

Query_Text_en: Instruments of ratification , approval , or adherence shall be deposited with the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations .
Translation: 批准书、接受书或加入书应交存联合国粮食及农业组织总干事。

Query_Text_en: 3 . This Convention shall enter into force upon the deposit of instruments of ratification , approval , or adherence by seven Governments and shall enter into force with respect to each Government which subsequently deposits an instrument of ratification , approval or adherence on the date of such deposit .
Translation: 3. 本公约自七国政府交存批准书、核准书或加入书之日起生效；此后对每一交存批准书、核准书或加入书的政府，自其交存之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article XVThe Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations shall inform all Governments referred to in paragraph 1 of Article XIV and all the organizations referred to in paragraph 4 of the same Article of deposits of instruments of ratification , approval , formal confirmation or adherence , the entry into force of this Convention , proposals for amendments , notifications of acceptance of amendments , entry into force of amendments , and notifications of withdrawal .
Translation:
第十五条  
联合国粮食及农业组织总干事应向第十四条第一款所述各国政府及同条第四款所述各组织通报下列事项：批准书、接受书、正式确认书或加入书的交存情况；本公约的生效；修正案提案；对修正案的接受通知；修正案的生效；以及退出通知。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIThe original of this Convention shall be deposited with the Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations who shall send certified copies of it to the Governments referred to in paragraph 1 of Article XIV and to the organizations referred to in paragraph 4 of the same Article .
Translation:
第十六条  
本公约正本应交存联合国粮食及农业组织总干事。总干事应将经核证无误的副本分送第十四条第一款所述各国政府及同条第四款所述各组织。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the representatives duly authorized by their respective Governments have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 兹由经各自政府正式授权的代表签署本公约，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: Done at Rio de Janeiro this fourteenth day of May 1966 in a single copy in the English , French and Spanish languages , each version being equally authoritative .
Translation: 一九六六年五月十四日订于里约热内卢，正本一份，用英文、法文和西班牙文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Protection granted under this Convention shall leave intact and shall in no way affect the protection of copyright in literary and artistic works .
Translation: 第一条 本公约所授予之保护，不改变且绝不影响对文学和艺术作品的版权保护。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , no provision of this Convention may be interpreted as prejudicing such protection .
Translation: 因此，本公约任何条款均不得解释为损害此种保护。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] to broadcasting organizations which have their headquarters on its territory , as regards broadcasts transmitted from transmitters situated on its territory .
Translation: 对于总部设在其境内的广播组织，就其通过境内发射台播出的节目。

Query_Text_en: 2 . National treatment shall be subject to the protection specifically guaranteed , and the limitations specifically provided for , in this Convention .
Translation: 2. 国民待遇应受本公约特别保障的保护及特别规定的限制。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] `` rebroadcasting '' means the simultaneous broadcasting by one broadcasting organization of the broadcast of another broadcasting organization .
Translation: [g] "转播"指一个广播组织同时广播另一广播组织的节目。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the performance , not being fixed on a phonogram , is carried by a broadcast which is protected by Article 6 of this Convention .
Translation: 该表演虽未固定于录音制品，但通过受本公约第六条保护的广播进行传播。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the phonogram was first published in another Contracting State [ criterion of publication ] .
Translation: 该录音制品首次出版于另一缔约国的（出版标准）。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a phonogram was first published in a non Ccontracting State but if it was also published , within thirty days of its first publication , in a Contracting State [ simultaneous publication ] , it shall be considered as first published in the Contracting State .
Translation: 二、若录音制品首先在非缔约国出版，但自首次出版之日起三十日内亦在某一缔约国内出版（同时出版），则该制品应视为在该缔约国首次出版。

Query_Text_en: 3 . By means of a notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , any Contracting State may declare that it will not apply the criterion of publication or , alternatively , the criterion of fixation .
Translation: 三、任何缔约国均可通过向联合国秘书长交存通知书的方式，声明其将不适用出版标准，或选择不适用固定标准。

Query_Text_en: Such notification may be deposited at the time of ratification , acceptance or accession , or at any time thereafter ;
Translation: 该通知可在批准、接受或加入时提交，亦可在此后任何时间提交；

Query_Text_en: in the last case , it shall become effective six months after it has been deposited .
Translation: 在最后一种情况下，该文件应于交存六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the broadcast was transmitted from a transmitter situated in another Contracting State .
Translation: 该广播节目系由位于另一缔约国的发射装置传送。

Query_Text_en: 2 . By means of a notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , any Contracting State may declare that it will protect broadcasts only if the headquarters of the broadcasting organization is situated in another Contracting State and the broadcast was transmitted from a transmitter situated in the same Contracting State .
Translation: 二、任何缔约国均可向联合国秘书长交存通知书，声明其仅对同时符合下列条件的广播予以保护：广播组织的总部设于另一缔约国境内，且广播节目系自该缔约国境内的发射台发射。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the broadcasting and the communication to the public , without their consent , of their performance , except where the performance used in the broadcasting or the public communication is itself already a broadcast performance or is made from a fixation ;
Translation: 未经表演者同意，广播或向公众传播其表演，但用于广播或公开传播的表演本身已属广播表演或出自录制件者除外。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] if the original fixation was made in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 , and the reproduction is made for purposes different from those referred to in those provisions .
Translation: [三]若原作品固定系依照第十五条规定所为，且复制目的与该条规定之用途不同。

Query_Text_en: 2 . [ 1 ] If broadcasting was consented to by the performers , it shall be a matter for the domestic law of the Contracting State where protection is claimed to regulate the protection against rebroadcasting , fixation for broadcasting purposes and the reproduction of such fixation for broadcasting purposes .
Translation: 二、[1]若表演者同意广播，则针对转播、为广播目的之录制及该录制品的广播用途复制等行为的保护，应由主张保护的缔约方国内法予以规范。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The terms and conditions governing the use by broadcasting organizations of fixations made for broadcasting purposes shall be determined in accordance with the domestic law of the Contracting State where protection is claimed .
Translation: 广播组织使用为广播目的而制作的录制品所适用的条款与条件，应依照主张保护之缔约国的国内法予以确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] However , the domestic law referred to in sub Cparagraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this paragraph shall not operate to deprive performers of the ability to control , by contract , their relations with broadcasting organizations .
Translation: 但本款第[1]项和第[2]项所指的国内法规，不得剥夺表演者通过合同约定其与广播组织之间关系的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Any Contracting State may , by its domestic laws and regulations , specify the manner in which performers will be represented in connection with the exercise of their rights if several of them participate in the same performance .
Translation: 第八条 任何缔约国均可通过国内法律和法规，对多名表演者共同参与同一表演时行使其权利的代表方式作出具体规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Any Contracting State may , by its domestic laws and regulations , extend the protection provided for in this Convention to artists who do not perform literary or artistic works .
Translation: 第九条 任何缔约国均可根据国内法律和规章，将本公约提供的保护范围扩展至不表演文学或艺术作品的艺人。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Producers of phonograms shall enjoy the right to authorize or prohibit the direct or indirect reproduction of their phonograms .
Translation: 第十条　录音制作者有权许可或禁止他人直接或间接复制其录音制品。

Query_Text_en: and , furthermore , if the copies or their containers do not identify the principal performers , the notice shall also include the name of the person who , in the country in which the fixation was effected , owns the rights of such performers .
Translation: 此外，若复制件或其外包装未标明主要表演者身份，则该公告还须载明在录制行为发生国享有相关表演者权利的主体名称。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 If a phonogram published for commercial purposes , or a reproduction of such phonogram , is used directly for broadcasting or for any communication to the public , a single equitable remuneration shall be paid by the user to the performers , or to the producers of the phonograms , or to both .
Translation: 第十二条　将已出版的商业性录音制品直接用于广播或向公众传播的，使用者应向表演者或录音制品制作者或同时向二者支付一笔合理报酬。

Query_Text_en: Domestic law may , in the absence of agreement between these parties , lay down the conditions as to the sharing of this remuneration .
Translation: 如双方未达成协议，国内法可规定报酬分配的条件。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] of fixations , made in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 , of their broadcasts , if the reproduction is made for purposes different from those referred to in those provisions ;
Translation: 根据第十五条规定对其广播节目进行固定录制时，若复制目的与该条款所述用途不符，则适用本项第二款规定。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the communication to the public of their television broadcasts if such communication is made in places accessible to the public against payment of an entrance fee ;
Translation: 向公众传播其电视广播，但该传播发生在向公众开放且收取入场费的场所时。

Query_Text_en: it shall be a matter for the domestic law of the State where protection of this right is claimed to determine the conditions under which it may be exercised .
Translation: 该权利的行使条件应由主张保护该权利的所在国国内法予以规定。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the broadcast took place Cfor broadcasts .
Translation: 该广播节目是为广播播出而制作的。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] use solely for the purposes of teaching or scientific research .
Translation: 仅限用于教学或科研目的。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Irrespective of paragraph 1 of this Article , any Contracting State may , in its domestic laws and regulations , provide for the same kinds of limitations with regard to the protection of performers , producers of phonograms and broadcasting organizations , as it provides for , in its domestic laws and regulations , in connection with the protection of copyright in literary and artistic works .
Translation: 二、无论本条第一款作何规定，任何缔约方均可在其国内法律法规中，对表演者、录音制品制作者及广播组织的保护，规定与其国内法律法规对文学艺术作品版权保护所设相同种类的限制。

Query_Text_en: However , compulsory licences may be provided for only to the extent to which they are compatible with this Convention .
Translation: 然而，强制许可的授予仅可在符合本公约规定的范围内实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 161 . Any State , upon becoming party to this Convention , shall be bound by all the obligations and shall enjoy all the benefits thereof .
Translation: 第一百六十一条 任何国家在成为本公约缔约国时，即应受本公约一切义务之约束，并享有本公约规定之一切权利。

Query_Text_en: however , the fact that the Contracting State of which the producer is a national does not grant the protection to the same beneficiary or beneficiaries as the State making the declaration shall not be considered as a difference in the extent of the protection ;
Translation: 然而，作为生产商所属缔约国的国家若未向与作出声明国家相同的受益人或受益人群体提供同等保护，此情形不应视为保护程度存在差异。

Query_Text_en: if a Contracting State makes such a declaration , the other Contracting States shall not be obliged to grant the right referred to in Article 13 , item [ d ] , to broadcasting organizations whose headquarters are in that State .
Translation: 如某一缔约国作出此项声明，其他缔约国无义务将第十三条第（四）款所述权利授予总部设在该缔约国的广播组织。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the notification referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is made after the date of the deposit of the instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession , the declaration will become effective six months after it has been deposited .
Translation: 如本条第1款所指通知系在批准、接受或加入文书交存之后作出，则该声明应自交存之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Any State which , on October 26 , 1961 , grants protection to producers of phonograms solely on the basis of the criterion of fixation may , by a notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations at the time of ratification , acceptance or accession , declare that it will apply , for the purposes of Article 5 , the criterion of fixation alone and , for the purposes of paragraph 1 [ a ] [ iii ] and [ iv ] of Article 16 , the criterion of fixation instead of the criterion of nationality .
Translation: 第十七条　凡于1961年10月26日仅依据录音制品固定地提供保护的任何国家，可在向联合国秘书长交存批准书、接受书或加入书时声明，为实施第五条之目的，其仅适用固定地标准；为实施第十六条第一款（甲）项第（三）目和第（四）目之目的，其将以固定地标准替代国籍标准。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Any State which has deposited a notification under paragraph 3 of Article 5 , paragraph 2 of Article 6 , paragraph 1 of Article 16 or Article 17 , may , by a further notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , reduce its scope or withdraw it .
Translation: 第十八条　凡根据第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款或第十七条提出保留的任何国家，均可随时向联合国秘书长提交另一份通知，缩小保留范围或撤销保留。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Notwithstanding anything in this Convention , once a performer has consented to the incorporation of his performance in a visual or audio Cvisual fixation , Article 7 shall have no further application .
Translation: 第十九条　虽有本公约之规定，一旦表演者同意将其表演纳入视觉或视听录制品中，第七条即不再适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 1 . This Convention shall not prejudice rights acquired in any Contracting State before the date of coming into force of this Convention for that State .
Translation: 第二十条 1. 本公约不影响任何缔约国在本公约对该国生效之日前已取得的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . No Contracting State shall be bound to apply the provisions of this Convention to performances or broadcasts which took place , or to phonograms which were fixed , before the date of coming into force of this Convention for that State .
Translation: 二、任何缔约国均无义务适用本公约于在该国生效前已经举行的表演、已经广播的节目或已经录制的录音制品。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 The protection provided for in this Convention shall not prejudice any protection otherwise secured to performers , producers of phonograms and broadcasting organizations .
Translation: 第二十一条 本公约所规定的保护不得妨碍表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织获得其他任何形式的保护。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Contracting States reserve the right to enter into special agreements among themselves in so far as such agreements grant to performers , producers of phonograms or broadcasting organizations more extensive rights than those granted by this Convention or contain other provisions not contrary to this Convention .
Translation: 第二十二条　缔约各国保留相互间签订专门协定的权利，只要此类协定给予表演者、录音制品制作者或广播组织的权利比本公约所规定的更为广泛，或包含其他不与本公约相抵触的条款。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations . It shall be open until June 30 , 1962 , for signature by any State invited to the Diplomatic Conference on the International Protection of Performers , Producers of Phonograms and Broadcasting Organisations which is a party to the Universal Copyright Convention or a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works .
Translation: 第二十三条  本公约应交存联合国秘书长。凡受邀参加保护表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织外交会议之国家，且系《世界版权公约》成员国或国际文学艺术产权联盟成员者，均可签署本公约，签署截止日期为1962年6月30日。

Query_Text_en: Article 241 . This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory States .
Translation: 第二百四十一条 本公约须经签署国批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall be open for accession by any State invited to the Conference referred to in Article 23 , and by any State Member of the United Nations , provided that in either case such State is a party to the Universal Copyright Convention or a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works .
Translation: 二、本公约对受邀参加第二十三条所述会议的任何国家及联合国任何成员国开放加入，但加入国须为《世界版权公约》缔约国或《保护文学艺术作品国际联盟》成员。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Ratification , acceptance or accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument to that effect with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations .
Translation: 三、批准、接受或加入应以向联合国秘书长交存相应文书的方式完成。

Query_Text_en: Article 251 . This Convention shall come into force three months after the date of deposit of the sixth instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession .
Translation: 第二百五十一条 本公约应自第六份批准书、接受书或加入书交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subsequently , this Convention shall come into force in respect of each State three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession .
Translation: 二、本公约随后对每一国家自其交存批准书、接受书或加入书三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 261 . Each Contracting State undertakes to adopt , in accordance with its Constitution , the measures necessary to ensure the application of this Convention .
Translation: 第二百六十一条  每一缔约国应按照本国宪法采取必要措施，以确保本公约之适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . At the time of deposit of its instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession , each State must be in a position under its domestic law to give effect to the terms of this Convention .
Translation: 二、各国在交存批准书、接受书或加入书时，须确保其国内法能够履行本公约各项条款之规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 271 . Any State may , at the time of ratification , acceptance or accession , or at any time thereafter , declare by notification addressed to the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations that this Convention shall extend to all or any of the territories for whose international relations it is responsible , provided that the Universal Copyright Convention or the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works applies to the territory or territories concerned .
Translation: 第二百七十一条 任何国家均可在批准、接受或加入时，或在此后任何时间，向联合国秘书长提交通知，声明本公约适用于其国际关系所涉全部或任一领土，但须《世界版权公约》或《保护文学艺术作品国际公约》已适用于该有关领土。

Query_Text_en: This notification shall take effect three months after the date of its receipt .
Translation: 本通知自收到之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The notifications referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 5 , paragraph 2 of Article 6 , paragraph 1 of Article 16 and Articles 17 and 18 , may be extended to cover all or any of the territories referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款以及第十七条和第十八条所述通知，可扩展适用于本条款第一款所述全部或任一领土。

Query_Text_en: Article 281 . Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention , on its own behalf or on behalf of all or any of the territories referred to in Article 27 .
Translation: 第二百八十一条 任何缔约国均可代表本国，或代表第二十七条所述全部或部分领土，声明退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The denunciation shall be effected by a notification addressed to the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations and shall take effect twelve months after the date of receipt of the notification .
Translation: 2. 退出应以书面通知联合国秘书长方为有效，自秘书长收到通知之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The right of denunciation shall not be exercised by a Contracting State before the expiry of a period of five years from the date on which the Convention came into force with respect to that State .
Translation: 缔约国的退出权，自本公约对该国生效之日起五年期满后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: 4 . A Contracting State shall cease to be a party to this Convention from that time when it is neither a party to the Universal Copyright Convention nor a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works .
Translation: 4. 缔约国之退出本公约，以该国同时退出《世界版权公约》且不再为保护文学艺术作品国际联盟成员之时为生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . This Convention shall cease to apply to any territory referred to in Article 27 from that time when neither the Universal Copyright Convention nor the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works applies to that territory .
Translation: 五、自《世界版权公约》或《保护文学艺术作品国际公约》对第二十七条所指领土不再适用之日起，本公约亦不再适用于该领土。

Query_Text_en: Article 291 . After this Convention has been in force for five years , any Contracting State may , by notification addressed to the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , request that a conference be convened for the purpose of revising the Convention .
Translation: 第二百九十一条 本公约生效满五年后，任何缔约国均可向联合国秘书长提交通知，要求召开会议修订本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary CGeneral shall notify all Contracting States of this request .
Translation: 秘书长应将此项请求通知所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: If , within a period of six months following the date of notification by the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , not less than one half of the Contracting States notify him of their concurrence with the request , the Secretary CGeneral shall inform the Director CGeneral of the International Labor Office , the Director CGeneral of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works , who shall convene a revision conference in co Coperation with the Intergovernmental Committee provided for in Article 32 .
Translation: 若联合国秘书长发出通知之日起六个月内，不少于半数缔约国向其表示同意该请求，秘书长应通知国际劳工局局长、联合国教科文组织总干事及保护文学艺术作品国际联盟局局长。上述机构须与第三十二条所设政府间委员会协作，共同召开修订会议。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The adoption of any revision of this Convention shall require an affirmative vote by two Cthirds of the States attending the revision conference , provided that this majority includes two Cthirds of the States which , at the time of the revision conference , are parties to the Convention .
Translation: 2. 本公约任何修订案的通过，须经出席修订会议的国家三分之二多数票赞成，且该多数须包括修订会议召开时公约缔约国的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] this Convention shall remain in force as regards relations between or with Contracting States which have not become parties to the revising Convention .
Translation: [b] 对于尚未加入修订公约的缔约国之间或其相互关系，本公约仍继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 Any dispute which may arise between two or more Contracting States concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention and which is not settled by negotiation shall , at the request of any one of the parties to the dispute , be referred to the International Court of Justice for decision , unless they agree to another mode of settlement .
Translation: 第三十条 两个或两个以上缔约国之间就本公约解释或适用发生的任何争端，如未能通过谈判解决，经争端任何一方请求，应提交国际法院裁决，除非当事国同意采取其他解决方式。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 3 of Article 5 , paragraph 2 of Article 6 , paragraph 1 of Article 16 and Article 17 , no reservation may be made to this Convention .
Translation: 第三十一条  在不违背第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款及第十七条的规定下，对本公约不得作出保留。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] to collect proposals and to prepare documentation for possible revision of this Convention .
Translation: 以及[b]收集相关提案并准备文件，以便对本公约进行可能的修订。

Query_Text_en: The number of members shall be six if there are twelve Contracting States or less , nine if there are thirteen to eighteen Contracting States and twelve if there are more than eighteen Contracting States .
Translation: 缔约方数量为12个或以下时，委员会成员人数为6名；缔约方达13至18个时，成员人数为9名；缔约方超过18个时，成员人数为12名。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Committee shall be constituted twelve months after the Convention comes into force by an election organized among the Contracting States , each of which shall have one vote , by the Director CGeneral of the International Labor Office , the Director CGeneral of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works , in accordance with rules previously approved by a majority of all Contracting States .
Translation: 3. 委员会应于本公约生效十二个月后，由国际劳工局局长、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事及世界知识产权组织总干事根据全体缔约国过半数事先核准的规则，在各缔约国间通过选举组成，每个缔约国享有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Committee shall elect its Chairman and officers . It shall establish its own rules of procedure .
Translation: 4. 委员会应选举主席及官员，并制定其议事规则。

Query_Text_en: These rules shall in particular provide for the future operation of the Committee and for a method of selecting its members for the future in such a way as to ensure rotation among the various Contracting States .
Translation: 该规则尤其应规定委员会今后的运作方式，并制定未来委员的遴选办法，以确保各缔约国之间的轮换。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Officials of the International Labor Office , the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works , designated by the Directors CGeneral and the Director thereof , shall constitute the Secretariat of the Committee .
Translation: 5. 由国际劳工局总干事、联合国教科文组织总干事及世界知识产权组织总干事分别指定官员，共同组成该委员会秘书处。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Meetings of the Committee , which shall be convened whenever a majority of its members deems it necessary , shall be held successively at the headquarters of the International Labor Office , the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works .
Translation: 6．委员会会议须经多数成员认为必要时方可召开，会议应轮流在国际劳工组织总部、联合国教科文组织总部以及世界知识产权组织国际局所在地相继举行。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Expenses of members of the Committee shall be borne by their respective Governments .
Translation: 7. 委员会成员的开支应由其各自政府承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 331 . The present Convention is drawn up in English , French and Spanish , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 第三百三十一条 本公约以英文、法文和西班牙文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In addition , official texts of the present Convention shall be drawn up in German , Italian and Portuguese .
Translation: 此外，本公约的正式文本应以德文、意大利文和葡萄牙文拟定。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] if any of the situations referred to in paragraphs 4 and 5 of Article 28 arise .
Translation: 如出现第二十八条第4款和第5款所述任何情形。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations shall also notify the Director CGeneral of the International Labor Office , the Director CGeneral of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works of the requests communicated to him in accordance with Article 29 , as well as of any communication received from the Contracting States concerning the revision of the Convention .
Translation: 联合国秘书长还应将根据第二十九条规定向其通报的修订请求，以及各缔约国就本公约修订事宜提交的任何来函，同时通知国际劳工局局长、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和国际保护文学艺术作品联盟局局长。

Query_Text_en: IN FAITH WHEREOF , the undersigned , being duly authorised thereto , have signed this Convention .
Translation: 下列签署人经正式授权，谨签署本公约，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Rome , this twenty Csixth day of October 1961 , in a single copy in the English , French and Spanish languages .
Translation: 一九六一年十月二十六日订于罗马，以英文、法文及西班牙文各制成一份。

Query_Text_en: Certified true copies shall be delivered by the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations to all the States invited to the Conference referred to in Article 23 and to every State Member of the United Nations , as well as to the Director CGeneral of the International Labor Office , the Director CGeneral of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将本公约经核证无误的副本分送第二十三条所指会议的所有受邀国及联合国全体会员国，并分送国际劳工局局长、联合国教育科学及文化组织总干事以及保护文学艺术作品国际联盟局局长。

Query_Text_en: Article I General obligations under the Convention [ a ] The Contracting Governments undertake to give effect to the provisions of the present Convention and the Annex thereto , which shall constitute an integral part of the present Convention . Every reference to the present Convention constitutes at the same time a reference to the Annex .
Translation:
第一条 公约的一般义务  
[a] 各缔约国政府承诺实施本公约及其附则的各项规定，该附则构成本公约不可分割的组成部分。凡提及本公约时，即同时构成对附则的引用。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Contracting Governments undertake to promulgate all laws , decrees , orders and regulations and to take all other steps which may be necessary to give the present Convention full and complete effect , so as to ensure that , from the point of view of safety of life , a ship is fit for the service for which it is intended .
Translation: 各缔约国政府承诺颁布一切必要的法律、法令、命令和规章，并采取其他一切措施，使本公约充分和完全生效，以确保从人命安全角度而言，船舶适于其预定用途。

Query_Text_en: Article II ApplicationThe present Convention shall apply to ships entitled to fly the flag of States the Governments of which are Contracting Governments .
Translation:
第二条 适用范围  
本公约适用于悬挂缔约国政府旗帜的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] a sufficient number of specimens of their Certificates issued under the provisions of the present Convention for circulation to the Contracting Governments for the information of their officers .
Translation: 根据本公约条款签发的证书样本应制备足够份数，分送各缔约国政府，供其官员参考。

Query_Text_en: Article IV Cases of force majeure [ a ] A ship , which is not subject to the provisions of the present Convention at the time of its departure on any voyage , shall not become subject to the provisions of the present Convention on account of any deviation from its intended voyage due to stress of weather or any other cause of force majeure .
Translation:
第四条 不可抗力情形  
[a] 船舶在启航时不受本公约规定约束者，若因恶劣天气或其他不可抗力原因偏离预定航线，不得仅因该偏离行为而适用本公约规定。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Persons who are on board a ship by reason of force majeure or in consequence of the obligation laid upon the master to carry shipwrecked or other persons shall not be taken into account for the purpose of ascertaining the application to a ship of any provisions of the present Convention .
Translation: 因不可抗力或船长履行救助遇险人员义务而登船者，在确定本公约条款是否适用于该船舶时，不应计入载客人数。

Query_Text_en: Article V Carriage of persons in emergency [ a ] For the purpose of evacuating persons in order to avoid a threat to the security of their lives a Contracting Government may permit the carriage of a larger number of persons in its ships than is otherwise permissible under the present Convention .
Translation:
第五条 紧急情况下的人员运输  
[a] 为撤离人员以避免其生命安全受到威胁，缔约国政府可允许其船舶载运超过本公约规定限额的人员。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Such permission shall not deprive other Contracting Governments of any right of control under the present Convention over such ships which come within their ports .
Translation: [b] 此项许可不得剥夺其他缔约国政府根据本公约对进入其港口的此类船舶行使的任何监管权。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Notice of any such permission , together with a statement of the circumstances , shall be sent to the Secretary-General of the Organization by the Contracting Government granting such permission .
Translation: 准予此类许可的缔约国政府应将许可通知连同相关情况说明一并送交本组织秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article VI Prior Treaties and Conventions [ a ] As between the Contracting Governments , the present Convention replaces and abrogates the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea which was signed in London on 17 June 1960 .
Translation: 第六条 先前条约与公约 [ a ] 就各缔约国政府之间而言，本公约取代并废止1960年6月17日在伦敦签署的《国际海上人命安全公约》。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] ships to which the present Convention applies , in respect of matters for which it has not expressly provided .
Translation: [二]本公约适用于其未作明文规定事项的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] To the extent , however , that such treaties , conventions or arrangements conflict with the provisions of the present Convention , the provisions of the present Convention shall prevail .
Translation: 但若此类条约、公约或安排与本公约条款相抵触，应以本公约规定为准。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] All matters which are not expressly provided for in the present Convention remain subject to the legislation of the Contracting Governments .
Translation: 本公约未作明确规定之事项，仍应适用缔约国政府之立法规定。

Query_Text_en: Article VII Special rules drawn up by AgreementWhen in accordance with the present Convention special rules are drawn up by agreement between all or some of the Contracting Governments , such rules shall be communicated to the Secretary-General of the Organization for circulation to all Contracting Governments .
Translation:
第七条 协议制定的特殊规则  
当各缔约国政府或部分缔约国政府依据本公约通过协议制定特殊规则时，应将此类规则提交本组织秘书长，由其分发给所有缔约国政府。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII Amendments [ a ] The present Convention may be amended by either of the procedures specified in the following paragraphs .
Translation: 第八条 修正案 [ a ] 本公约可按下列任一程序予以修正。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Any amendment proposed by a Contracting Government shall be submitted to the Secretary-General of the Organization , who shall then circulate it to all Members of the Organization and all Contracting Governments at least six months prior to its consideration .
Translation: [i] 任何缔约国政府提出的修正案应提交本组织秘书长，秘书长应至少在审议该修正案前六个月将其分发给本组织所有成员国及所有缔约国政府。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Any amendment proposed and circulated as above shall be referred to the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization for consideration .
Translation: [ ii ] 按上述程序提出并分发的任何修正案均应提交本组织海上安全委员会审议。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Contracting Governments of States , whether or not Members of the Organization , shall be entitled to participate in the proceedings of the Maritime Safety Committee for the consideration and adoption of amendments .
Translation: [ iii ] 无论是否为国际海事组织成员国，各缔约国政府均有权参与海上安全委员会的议事程序，审议并通过修正案。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] Amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the Maritime Safety Committee expanded as provided for in sub-paragraph [ iii ] of this paragraph [ hereinafter referred to as `` the expanded Maritime Safety Committee '' ] on condition that at least one-third of the Contracting Governments shall be present at the time of voting .
Translation: 修正案应由本款第[三]项所规定的扩大后的海上安全委员会（以下称"扩大海上安全委员会"）中出席并参加表决的缔约政府三分之二多数通过，但投票时至少应有三分之一的缔约政府出席。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] Amendments adopted in accordance with sub-paragraph [ iv ] of this paragraph shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Governments for acceptance .
Translation: 本款第[iv]项通过的修正案应由本组织秘书长通报各缔约国政府以供接受。

Query_Text_en: or [ bb ] at the end of a different period , which shall not be less than one year , if so determined at the time of its adoption by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the expanded Maritime Safety Committee .
Translation: 或[bb]项所载另一期限届满时终止，该期限自通过之日起不得少于一年，且须经出席扩大海上安全委员会并参与表决的缔约国政府以三分之二多数同意确定。

Query_Text_en: However , if within the specified period either more than one-third of Contracting Governments , or Contracting Governments the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant fleet , notify the Secretary-General of the Organization that they object to the amendment , it shall be deemed not to have been accepted .
Translation: 然而，若在指定期限内，超过三分之一的缔约国政府，或其商船总吨位合计不低于世界商船总吨位百分之五十的缔约国政府，向本组织秘书长提出反对该修正案，则该修正案应视为未获接受。

Query_Text_en: [ vii ] [ 1 ] An amendment to an Article of the Convention or to Chapter I of the Annex shall enter into force with respect to those Contracting Governments which have accepted it , six months after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted , and with respect to each Contracting Government which accepts it after that date , six months after the date of that Contracting Government 's acceptance .
Translation: [ vii ] [ 1 ] 本公约某一条款或附件第一章的修正案，应自视为接受之日起六个月后对已接受该修正案的缔约国政府生效；此后接受该修正案的各缔约国政府，应自其接受之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] An amendment to the Annex other than Chapter I shall enter into force with respect to all Contracting Governments , except those which have objected to the amendment under sub-paragraph [ vi ] [ 2 ] of this paragraph and which have not withdrawn such objections , six months after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted . However , before the date set for entry into force , any Contracting Government may give notice to the Secretary-General of the Organization that it exempts itself from giving effect to that amendment for a period not longer than one year from the date of its entry into force , or for such longer period as may be determined by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the expanded Maritime Safety Committee at the time of the adoption of the amendment .
Translation: 除第一章外，本附则修正案在视为接受之日起六个月后对所有缔约国政府生效，但根据本款第[六]项第[2]目提出反对且未撤回反对意见的缔约国政府除外。但在修正案生效之日前，任何缔约国政府均可向本组织秘书长声明，自修正案生效之日起不超过一年的期限内暂不实施该修正案；或在修正案通过时，经扩大海上安全委员会出席并投票的缔约国政府三分之二多数同意，可延长暂不实施期限。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Amendment by a Conference : [ i ] Upon the request of a Contracting Government concurred in by at least one-third of the Contracting Governments , the Organization shall convene a Conference of Contracting Governments to consider amendments to the present Convention .
Translation: [c] 会议修正案：[i] 经至少三分之一缔约国政府同意某一缔约国政府之请求，本组织应召开缔约国政府会议，审议对本公约之修正。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Every amendment adopted by such a Conference by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Governments for acceptance .
Translation: [ ii ] 经该会议出席并投票的缔约国政府三分之二多数通过的各项修正案，应由本组织秘书长送交所有缔约国政府接受。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Unless the Conference decides otherwise , the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted and shall enter into force in accordance with the procedures specified in sub-paragraphs [ b ] [ vi ] and [ b ] [ vii ] respectively of this Article , provided that references in these paragraphs to the expanded Maritime Safety Committee shall be taken to mean references to the Conference .
Translation: 除大会另作决定外，修正案应视为已被接受，并应分别按本条（b）款（vi）项和（b）款（vii）项所述程序生效；但上述条款中提及的海上安全委员会扩大会议应理解为指大会。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] [ i ] A Contracting Government which has accepted an amendment to the Annex which has entered into force shall not be obliged to extend the benefit of the present Convention in respect of the certificates issued to a ship entitled to fly the flag of a State the Government of which , pursuant to the provisions of sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vi ] [ 2 ] of this Article , has objected to the amendment and has not withdrawn such an objection , but only to the extent that such certificates relate to matters covered by the amendment in question .
Translation: 已接受本附则某项生效修正案的缔约国政府，无义务将本公约的利益授予悬挂如下国家旗帜的船舶所持证书：该国政府根据本条（b）（vi）（2）款之规定已对该修正案提出反对且未撤销反对意见；但此种豁免仅限于证书内容涉及该修正案所规范事项的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] A Contracting Government which has accepted an amendment to the Annex which has entered into force shall extend the benefit of the present Convention in respect of the certificates issued to a ship entitled to fly the flag of a State the Government of which , pursuant to the provisions of sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vii ] [ 2 ] of this Article , has notified the Secretary-General of the Organization that it exempts itself from giving effect to the amendment .
Translation: [ ii ] 已接受本附则某项修正案且该修正案已生效的缔约国政府，对于悬挂根据本条第[ b ][ vii ][ 2 ]款规定已向本组织秘书长声明免除实施该修正案义务的国家旗帜的船舶所签发的证书，仍应给予本公约的利益。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Unless expressly provided otherwise , any amendment to the present Convention made under this Article , which relates to the structure of a ship , shall apply only to ships the keels of which are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction , on or after the date on which the amendment enters into force .
Translation: 除另有明文规定外，根据本条对本公约涉及船舶结构的任何修正案，应仅适用于在修正案生效之日或之后安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Any declaration of acceptance of , or objection to , an amendment or any notice given under sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vii ] [ 2 ] of this Article shall be submitted in writing to the Secretary-General of the Organization , who shall inform all Contracting Governments of any such submission and the date of its receipt .
Translation: 本条款第[b]项第[vii]目第[2]分目所述关于修正案的接受或反对声明及相关通知，均应以书面形式提交本组织秘书长。秘书长须将此类文件及其收文日期通报全体缔约国政府。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] The Secretary-General of the Organization shall inform all Contracting Governments of any amendments which enter into force under this Article , together with the date on which each such amendment enters into force .
Translation: 本组织秘书长应将根据本条生效的任何修正案及其生效日期通知所有缔约国政府。
