第112条 3. 除第111条所列缴款级别外，任何成员国均可选择超过40单位的多个缴款单位数。

Query_Text_en: 113 4 . Members shall be free to choose their class of contribution for defraying Union expenses .
Translation: 113.4 各成员国有权自行选择会费类别以支付联盟开支。

Query_Text_en: 114 5 . No reduction in a unit classification chosen in accordance with the Convention can take effect during the life of this Convention .
Translation: 114 5. 根据本公约选定的单位分类等级，在本公约有效期内不得降低。

Query_Text_en: However , under exceptional circumstances such as natural disasters necessitating international aid programs , the Administrative Council may authorize a reduction in a unit classification when so requested by a Member which has established that it can no longer maintain its contribution at the class originally chosen .
Translation: 然而，在自然灾害等特殊情况下需要实施国际援助计划时，若某成员国证明其无法继续维持最初选定的分摊等级缴款，行政理事会可应其请求批准降低该国的分摊等级。

Query_Text_en: 115 6 . Expenses incurred by the regional administrative conferences referred to in No. 50 shall be borne in accordance with their unit classification by all the Members of the region concerned and , where appropriate , on the same basis by any Members of other regions which have participated in such conferences .
Translation: 第115条第6款 第50款所述区域性行政大会所需费用，应由该区域所有会员根据其会籍等级共同承担；若其他区域会员参与此类大会，亦应按照相同标准分摊相应费用。

Query_Text_en: 116 7 . Members shall pay in advance their annual contributory shares , calculated on the basis of the budget approved by the Administrative Council .
Translation: 第一百一十六条第七款 成员国应依据行政理事会批准的预算，预先缴纳其年度认缴份额。

Query_Text_en: 117 8 . A Member which is in arrear in its payments to the Union shall lose its right to vote as defined in Nos. 10 and 11 for so long as the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of the contribution due from it for the preceding two years .
Translation: 8. 凡拖欠本联盟会费的成员国，当其拖欠金额达到或超过其前两年应缴会费总额时，即丧失第10款和第11款规定的表决权。

Query_Text_en: 118 9 . The provisions which apply to the financial contributions by recognized private operating agencies , scientific or industrial organizations and international organizations are in the General Regulations .
Translation: 118 9. 关于经认可的私营运营机构、科学或工业组织及国际组织提供财政资助的条款，详见《总则》部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Languages119 1 . [ 1 ] The official languages of the Union shall be Arabic , Chinese , English , French , Russian and Spanish .
Translation:
第十六条 语言  
第一百一十九条  
一、[1] 联盟的官方语言为阿拉伯语、汉语、英语、法语、俄语和西班牙语。

Query_Text_en: 120 [ 2 ] The working languages of the Union shall be English , French and Spanish .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本联盟的工作语言为英语、法语和西班牙语。

Query_Text_en: 121 [ 3 ] In case of dispute , the French text shall prevail .
Translation: 如遇争议，以法文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: 122 2 . [ 1 ] The final documents of the Plenipotentiary and administrative conferences , their final acts , protocols , resolutions , recommendations and opinions , shall be drawn up in the official languages of the Union , in versions equivalent in form and content .
Translation: 122 2. [ 1 ] 全权代表大会和行政大会的最终文件，包括最后议定书、议定书、决议、建议及意见，应以联盟各正式语文制定，其各文本在形式和内容上应具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: 123 [ 2 ] All other documents of these conferences shall be issued in the working languages of the Union .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本联盟各次会议的所有其他文件均应以本联盟工作语言发布。

Query_Text_en: 124 3 . [ 1 ] The official service documents of the Union as prescribed by the Administrative Regulations shall be published in the six official languages .
Translation: 124 3. [ 1 ] 根据《行政条例》规定，联盟正式公务文件应以六种官方语言公布。

Query_Text_en: 125 [ 2 ] The proposals and contributions submitted to conferences and meetings of the International Consultative Committees in any of the official languages shall be communicated to the Members in the working languages of the Union .
Translation: 提交至国际咨询委员会各类会议、以任何一种正式语言撰写的提案与文件，均应以国际电信联盟工作语言向各成员国传达。

Query_Text_en: 126 [ 3 ] All other documents for general distribution prepared by the Secretary-General in the course of his duties shall be drawn up in the three working languages .
Translation: [三] 秘书长在执行职务过程中拟订供普遍分发的所有其他文件，均应以三种工作语文编制。

Query_Text_en: 127 4 . [ 1 ] At conferences of the Union and at Plenary Assemblies of the International Consultative Committees , at the meetings of study groups included in the program of work approved by a Plenary Assembly and at the meetings of the Administrative Council , an efficient system of reciprocal interpretation between the six official languages shall be used .
Translation: 127 4. [ 1 ] 在国际电联全权代表大会、国际咨询委员会全体会议、经全体会议批准的工作计划所含研究组会议以及行政理事会会议上，应使用六种正式语文间高效互译系统。

Query_Text_en: 128 [ 2 ] At other meetings of International Consultative Committees , discussions shall be conducted in the working languages provided that Members requiring interpretation for a particular working language give at least 90 day 's notice of their participation in these meetings .
Translation: [ 2 ] 在国际咨询委员会的其他会议上，若需对某一工作语言提供口译服务的会员国提前至少90天通知其参会意向，则会议讨论应使用工作语言进行。

Query_Text_en: 129 [ 3 ] When all participants in a conference or in a meeting so agree , discussions may be conducted in fewer languages than those mentioned above .
Translation: 129 [ 3 ] 若会议或集会全体与会者一致同意，可使用少于上述规定的语言进行讨论。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Legal capacity of the Union130 The Union shall enjoy in the territory of each of its Members such legal capacity as may be necessary for the exercise of its functions and the fulfillment of its purposes .
Translation:
第十七条 本联盟的法律行为能力

130 本联盟在各成员国领土内享有行使职能及实现宗旨所必需的法律行为能力。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 The right of the public to use the international telecommunication service131 Members recognize the right of the public to correspond by means of the international service of public correspondence .
Translation:
第十八条 公众使用国际电信业务的权利  
各会员国承认公众有权通过国际公众通信业务进行通信。

Query_Text_en: The services . the charges and the safeguards shall be the same for all users in each category of correspondence without any priority or preference .
Translation: 各类信函业务的服务、资费及保障措施对所有用户一视同仁，不得有任何优先或优待。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Stoppage of telecommunications132 1 . Members reserve the right to stop the transmission of any private telegram which may appear dangerous to the security of the State or contrary to their laws , to public order or to decency , provided that they immediately notify the office of origin of the stoppage of any such telegram or any part thereof , except when such notification may appear dangerous to the security of the State .
Translation:
第十九条 电信业务的中止  
各成员国保留中止传输任何可能危害国家安全、违反本国法律、公共秩序或公序良俗的私人电报的权利，但须立即将中止该电报或其部分内容的决定通知原发报机构；若此类通知可能危害国家安全，则无需履行通知义务。

Query_Text_en: 133 2 . Members also reserve the right to cut off any other private telecommunications which may appear dangerous to the security of the State or contrary to its laws , to public order or to decency .
Translation: 各成员国亦有权切断任何可能危害国家安全、违反本国法律、破坏公共秩序或有伤风化的其他私人电信通讯。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Suspension of services134 Each Member reserves the right to suspend the international telecommunication service for an indefinite time , either generally or only for certain relations and\/or for certain kinds of correspondence , outgoing , incoming or in transit , provided that it immediately notifies such action to each of the other Members through the medium of the Secretary-General .
Translation:
第二十条  业务的中断  

每一会员保留其中断国际电信业务的权利，或则一般中断，或则仅中断某些通信关系及/或某几类通信、发出、收到或经转的，但须立即将此种行动通过秘书长通知每一其他会员。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Responsibility135 Members accept no responsibility towards users of the international telecommunication services . particularly as regards claims for damages .
Translation:
第二十一条 责任  
各成员国对国际电信业务用户不承担任何责任，特别是关于损害赔偿的索赔。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Secrecy of telecommunications136 1 . Members agree to take all possible measures , compatible with the system of telecommunication used , with a view to ensuring the secrecy of international correspondence .
Translation:
第二十二条 电信保密

1. 各成员国同意采取一切可行措施，在符合所用电信系统的前提下，确保国际通信的保密性。

Query_Text_en: 137 2 . Nevertheless , they reserve the right to communicate such correspondence to the competent authorities in order to ensure the application of their internal laws or the execution of international conventions to which they are parties .
Translation: 尽管如此，他们仍保留向主管机关通报此类信函的权利，以确保其国内法或所参加国际公约的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 Establishment , operation and protection of telecommunication channels and installations138 1 . Members shall take such steps as may be necessary to ensure the establishment , under the best technical conditions , of the channels and installations necessary to carry on the rapid and uninterrupted exchange of international telecommunications .
Translation:
第二十三条 电信信道与设施的建立、运营及保护  
第一百三十八款 一、各成员国应采取必要措施，确保在最佳技术条件下建立用于开展快速且不间断国际电信交流所需的信道与设施。

Query_Text_en: 139 2 . So far as possible , these channels and installations must be operated by the methods and procedures which practical operating experience has shown to be the best . They must be maintained in proper operating condition and kept abreast of scientific and technical progress .
Translation: 2. 这些渠道和设施应尽可能采用实践操作经验证明的最佳方法与程序进行运营。必须确保其处于良好的运行状态，并紧跟科学技术进步的步伐。

Query_Text_en: 140 3 . Members shall safeguard these channels and installations within their jurisdiction .
Translation: 各成员国应保护其管辖范围内的这些通道和设施。

Query_Text_en: 141 4 . Unless other conditions are laid down by special arrangements , each Member shall take such steps as may be necessary to ensure maintenance of those sections of international telecommunication circuits within its control .
Translation: 4．除特殊协定另有规定外，各成员国应采取必要措施，确保其管辖范围内的国际电信电路段落保持正常运行。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Notification of infringements142 In order to facilitate the application of the provisions of Article 44 , Members undertake to inform one another of infringements of the provisions of this Convention and of the Administrative Regulations annexed thereto .
Translation:
第二十四条  违反公约的通知  
为便于执行第四十四条规定，各成员国承诺相互通报违反本公约及其附则《行政规则》条款的行为。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Priority of telecommunications concerning safety of life143 The international telecommunication services must give absolute priority to all telecommunications concerning safety of life at sea , on land , in the air or in outer space , as well as to epidemiological telecommunications of exceptional urgency of the World Health Organization .
Translation:
第二十五条 人命安全通信的优先权  
国际电信业务必须绝对优先传递涉及海上、陆地、空中或外层空间人命安全的一切通信，以及世界卫生组织极其紧急的疫情通信。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Priority of government telegrams and telephone calls144 Subject to the provisions of Articles 25 and 36 government telegrams shall enjoy priority over other telegrams when priority is requested for them by the sender .
Translation:
第二十六条 政务电报电话之优先权  
第一百四十四款 在第二十五条及第三十六条规定之限制下，发报人申请优先传递时，政务电报应优先于其他电报发送。

Query_Text_en: Government telephone calls may also be given priority , upon specific request and to the extent practicable , over other telephone calls .
Translation: 在特定要求下且实际可行范围内，政府电话可优先于其他电话接转。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 Secret language145 1 . Government telegrams and service telegrams may be expressed in secret language in all relations .
Translation:
第二十七条 密语电文  
145.1 政府电报及公务电报在所有往来中均可使用密语表述。

Query_Text_en: 146 2 . Private telegrams in secret language may be admitted between all countries with the exception of those which have previously notified , through the medium of the Secretary-General , that they do not admit this language for that category of correspondence .
Translation: 146 2. 除已事先通过秘书长通知不接受该类别通信使用密语的国家外，各国之间可允许使用密语的私人电报往来。

Query_Text_en: 147 3 . Members which do not admit private telegrams in secret language originating in or destined for their own territory must let them pass in transit , except in the case of suspension of service provided for in Article 20 .
Translation: 147.3 各成员国如不允许以密语书写的私务电报在其本国境内始发或终接，则必须准许此类电报过境传输，但依照第20条规定暂停业务的情况除外。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Charges and free services148 The provisions regarding charges for telecommunications and the various cases in which free services are accorded are set forth in the Administrative Regulations annexed to this Convention .
Translation:
第二十八条  资费和免费业务  
148  本公约所附《行政规则》对电信资费以及各类免费业务作出了具体规定。

Query_Text_en: Where no such arrangements have been concluded , and in the absence of special agreements made under Article 31 , these settlements shall be effected in accordance with the Administrative Regulations .
Translation: 如未订立此类协议，且未按第三十一条达成特别协议，则应按行政规则进行结算。

Query_Text_en: - either the monetary unit of the International Monetary Fund - or the gold franc , both as defined in the Administrative Regulations . The provisions for application are contained in Appendix 1 to the Telegraph and Telephone Regulations .
Translation: - 采用国际货币基金组织的货币单位或行政规则所定义的金法郎。具体适用条款载于《电报电话规则》附录1。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Special arrangements151 Members reserve for themselves , for the private operating agencies recognized by them and for other agencies duly authorized to do so , the right to make special arrangements on telecommunication matters which do not concern Members in general .
Translation:
第三十一条  特别协议  
各会员国为其认可的私营电信机构及其他经正式核准的机构保留权利，就一般不涉及其他会员国的电信事项订立特别协议。

Query_Text_en: Such arrangements , however , shall not be in conflict with the terms of this Convention or of the Administrative Regulations annexed thereto , so far as concerns the harmful interference which their operation might be likely to cause to the radio services of other countries .
Translation: 然而，此类安排不得与本公约或其附则《行政规则》的条款相抵触，尤其不得对其他国家的无线电业务可能造成有害干扰。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Regional conferences , arrangements and organizations152 Members reserve the right to convene regional conferences , to make regional arrangements and to form regional organizations , for the purpose of settling telecommunication questions which are susceptible of being treated on a regional basis .
Translation:
第三十二条 区域性大会、区域性协定和区域性组织  
各会员国保留召开区域性大会、缔结区域性协定和成立区域性组织的权利，旨在处理可于区域内协调解决的电信问题。

Query_Text_en: Such arrangements shall not be in conflict with this Convention .
Translation: 此类安排不得与本公约相抵触。

Query_Text_en: To that end they shall endeavor to apply the latest technical advances as soon as possible .
Translation: 为此，各方应致力于尽快应用最新技术成果。

Query_Text_en: 154 2 . In using frequency bands for space radio services Members shall bear in mind that radio frequencies and the geostationary satellite orbit are limited natural resources and that they must be used efficiently and economically , in conformity with the provisions of the Radio Regulations , so that countries or groups of countries may have equitable access to both , taking into account the special needs of the developing countries and the geographical situation of particular countries .
Translation: 各成员国在使用空间无线电业务频段时，应谨记无线电频率和对地静止卫星轨道均属有限自然资源，必须根据《无线电规则》的规定高效节约使用，以使各国或国家集团能够公平使用这两种资源，同时兼顾发展中国家的特殊需求和特定国家的地理状况。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 Intercommunication155 1 . Stations performing radiocommunication in the mobile service shall be bound , within the limits of their normal employment , to exchange radiocommunications reciprocally without distinction as to the radio system adopted by them .
Translation:
第三十四条 移动业务电台互通义务  
1. 在正常使用范围内，从事移动业务的电台应相互交换无线电通信，不得因所采用的无线电系统不同而有所区别。

Query_Text_en: 156 2 . Nevertheless , in order not to impede scientific progress , the provisions of No. 155 shall not prevent the use of a radio system incapable of communicating with other systems , provided that such incapacity is due to the specific nature of such system and is not the result of devices adopted solely with the object of preventing intercommunication .
Translation: 然而，为避免阻碍科学进步，第155条规定不适用于无法与其他系统通信的无线电系统，只要该无法通信是由于该系统的特殊性质所致，而非仅为阻止互联而采取装置的结果。

Query_Text_en: 157 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of No. 155 , a station may be assigned to a restricted international service of telecommunication , determined by the purpose of such service , or by other circumstances independent of the system used .
Translation: 157 3．虽有第155款规定，电台仍可被指定用于受限的国际电信业务，其限制条件取决于该业务的服务目的或与所用制式无关的其他情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Harmful interference158 1 . All stations , whatever their purpose , must be established and operated in such a manner as not to cause harmful interference to the radio services or communications of other Members or of recognized private operating agencies , or of other duly authorized operating agencies which carry on radio service , and which operate in accordance with the provisions of the Radio Regulations .
Translation:
第三十五条 有害干扰  
158 1．所有电台，无论其用途为何，在设立和操作时均不得对其他会员国、经认可的私营运营机构或其他经正式授权并依照《无线电规则》开展无线电业务的运营机构的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。

Query_Text_en: 159 2 . Each Member undertakes to require the private operating agencies which it recognizes and the other operating agencies duly authorized for this purpose , to observe the provisions of No. 158 .
Translation: 各成员国承诺要求其认可的私营运营机构及其他经正式授权运营的机构，遵守第158号条款之规定。

Query_Text_en: 160 3 . Further , the Members recognize the desirability of taking all practicable steps to prevent the operation of electrical apparatus and installations of all kinds from causing harmful interference to the radio services or communications mentioned in No. 158 .
Translation: 此外，各成员国认识到宜采取一切可行措施，防止各类电气设备和装置对第158号条款所述无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 Distress calls and messages161 Radio stations shall be obliged to accept , with absolute priority , distress calls and messages regardless of their origin , to reply in the same manner to such messages , and immediately to take such action in regard thereto as may be required .
Translation:
第三十六条 遇险呼叫与遇险通信  
161 无线电台必须绝对优先接收任何来源的遇险呼叫与遇险通信，以同样方式回复此类通信，并立即采取所需行动。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 False or deceptive distress , urgency , safety or identification signals162 Members agree to take the steps required to prevent the transmission or circulation of false or deceptive distress , urgency , safety or identification signals , and to collaborate in locating and identifying stations transmitting such signals , from their own country .
Translation:
第三十七条 虚假或欺骗性遇险、紧急、安全或识别信号  
各成员国同意采取必要措施，防止本国境内传输或传播虚假或欺骗性的遇险、紧急、安全或识别信号，并协作定位和识别发送此类信号的电台。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 Installations for national defense services163 1 . Members retain their entire freedom with regard to military radio installations of their army , naval and air forces .
Translation:
第三十八条 国防用无线电设备

一、各成员国对于其陆海空军军事无线电设备保有完全的自由权。

Query_Text_en: 164 2 . Nevertheless , these installations must , so far as possible , observe statutory provisions relative to giving assistance in case of distress and to the measures to be taken to prevent harmful interference , and the provisions of the Administrative Regulations concerning the types of emission and the frequencies to be used , according to the nature of the service performed by such installations .
Translation: 尽管如此，此类装置仍须尽可能遵守以下规定：关于遇险时提供援助的法定条款、防止有害干扰的应对措施，以及《行政条例》中根据装置所执行业务性质对发射类型和使用频率的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: 165 3 . Moreover , when these installations take part in the service of public correspondence or other services governed by the Administrative Regulations annexed to this Convention , they must , in general , comply with the regulatory provisions for the conduct of such services .
Translation: 此外，当这些设施参与公共通信业务或本公约所附《行政规则》管辖的其他业务时，原则上必须遵守开展此类业务的相关监管规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Relations with the United Nations166 1 . The relationship between the United Nations and the International Telecommunication Union is defined in the Agreement concluded between these two organizations , the text of which appears in Annex 3 to this Convention .
Translation:
第三十九条 同联合国关系  
一、国际电信联盟与联合国之间的关系，由两组织间缔结的协定确定。该协定文本载于本公约附件三。

Query_Text_en: 167 2 . In accordance with the provision of Article XVI of the abovementioned Agreement , the telecommunication operating services of the United Nations shall be entitled to the rights and bound by the obligations of this Convention and of the Administrative Regulations annexed thereto .
Translation: 根据上述协定第十六条规定，联合国电信运营服务享有本公约及其附则《行政规则》所规定的权利，并承担相应义务。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly , they shall be entitled to attend all conferences of the Union , including meetings of the International Consultative Committees , in a consultative capacity .
Translation: 因此，它们有权以咨询身份参加国际电联的所有会议，包括国际咨询委员会的各类会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Relations with international organizations168 In furtherance of complete international coordination on matters affecting telecommunication , the Union shall cooperate with international organizations having related interests and activities .
Translation:
第四十条 与国际组织的关系
为在国际电信事务领域实现全面协调，本联盟应与具有相关利益和业务活动的国际组织开展合作。

Query_Text_en: Article : 41 Basic provisions and general regulations169 In the case of an inconsistency between a provision in the first part of the Convention [ Basic Provisions , Nos. 1 to 194 ] and a provision in the second part of the Convention [ General Regulations , Nos. 201 to 643 ] the former shall prevail .
Translation:
第四十一条 基本条款与总章规定  
若本公约第一部分【基本条款，第1至194条】与第二部分【总章，第201至643条】之规定存在冲突，应以第一部分条款为准。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Administrative regulations170 1 . The provisions of the Convention are supplemented by the Administrative Regulations which regulate the use of telecommunication and shall be binding on all Members .
Translation:
第四十二条 行政规则  
1. 《公约》条款由《行政规则》予以补充，该规则对电信业务的使用作出规定，对所有成员国均具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: 171 2 . Ratification of this Convention in accordance with Article 45 or accession in accordance with Article 46 involves acceptance of the Administrative Regulations in force at the time of ratification or accession .
Translation: 171.2 根据第四十五条批准本公约或根据第四十六条加入本公约，即意味着接受批准或加入时现行有效的《行政规则》。

Query_Text_en: 172 3 . Members shall inform the Secretary-General of their approval of any revision of these Regulations by competent administrative conferences . The Secretary-General shall inform Members promptly regarding receipt of such notifications of approval .
Translation: 172.3 各成员国应将其经行政主管会议批准的本条例修订情况通知秘书长。秘书长收到此类批准通知后，应立即通报各成员国。

Query_Text_en: 173 4 . In case of inconsistency between a provision of the Convention and a provision of the Administrative Regulations , the Convention shall prevail .
Translation: 第一百七十三条第四款 若《公约》条款与《行政规则》条款存在不一致，应以《公约》为准。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 Validity of Administrative Regulations in force174 The Administrative Regulations referred to in No. 170 are those in force at the time of signature of this Convention .
Translation:
第四十三条  现行行政条例的效力  
第一百七十条所指的行政条例，为本公约签署时现行有效的行政条例。

Query_Text_en: They shall be regarded as annexed to this Convention and shall remain valid , subject to such partial revisions as may be adopted in consequence of the provisions of No. 53 until the time of entry into force of new Regulations drawn up by the competent world administrative conferences to replace them as annexes to this Convention .
Translation: 此类文件应视为本公约附件，除根据第五十三条规定条款进行部分修订外持续有效，直至主管世界行政大会制定新法规取代其作为公约附件并生效为止。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 Execution of the Convention and Regulations175 1 . The Members are bound to abide by the provisions of this Convention and the Administrative Regulations in all telecommunication offices and stations established or operated by them which engage in international services or which are capable of causing harmful interference to radio services of other countries , except in regard to services exempted from these obligations in accordance with the provisions of Article 38 .
Translation:
第四十四条 公约及规则的实施  

1. 各成员国须确保在其设立或运营的所有参与国际业务或可能对其他国家的无线电业务造成有害干扰的电信局及电台中，遵守本公约及《行政规则》之规定；但依据第三十八条条款豁免相关义务的业务除外。

Query_Text_en: 176 2 . They are also bound to take the necessary steps to impose the observance of the provisions of this Convention and of the Administrative Regulations upon private operating agencies authorized by them to establish and operate telecommunications and which engage in international services or which operate stations capable of causing harmful interference to the radio services of other countries .
Translation: 此外，各成员国必须采取必要措施，确保经其授权建立和运营电信业务并从事国际服务、或运营可能对其他国家的无线电业务造成有害干扰的电台的私营运营机构，遵守本公约及《行政规则》的各项条款。

Query_Text_en: Article 45 Ratification of the Convention177 1 . This Convention shall be ratified by the signatory governments in accordance with the constitutional rules in force in their respective countries .
Translation:
第四十五条 公约的批准  
1. 本公约应由各签署国政府依照本国现行宪法规定予以批准。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification shall be deposited , in as short a time as possible , with the Secretary-General by diplomatic channel through the intermediary of the government of the country of the seat of the Union .
Translation: 批准书应尽速通过外交途径，经由本联盟总部所在国政府转交秘书长存放。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The Secretary-General shall notify the Members of each deposit of ratification .
Translation: 秘书长应将每一份批准书的交存通知各会员国。

Query_Text_en: 178 2 . [ 1 ] During a period of two years from the date of entry into force of this Convention , a signatory government , even though it may not have deposited an instrument of ratification in accordance with No. 177 , shall enjoy the rights conferred on Members of the Union in Nos. 8 to 11 .
Translation: 自本公约生效之日起两年内，任何签署国政府即使尚未按第177条规定交存批准书，仍可享有第8至11条赋予本同盟成员国的各项权利。

Query_Text_en: Its rights , other than voting rights , shall not be affected .
Translation: 除表决权外，其他权利不受影响。

Query_Text_en: 180 3 . After the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with Article 52 , each instrument of ratification shall become effective on the date of its deposit with the Secretary-General [ 2 ] .
Translation: 180 3. 本公约依照第五十二条生效后，各批准书应于交存联合国秘书长[2]之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 181 4 . If one or more of the signatory governments do not ratify the Convention it shall not thereby be less valid for the governments which have ratified it .
Translation: 181 4. 若一个或多个签署国政府未批准本公约，该公约对已批准国政府仍具同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 46 Accession to the Convention182 1 . The government of a country , not a signatory of this Convention , may accede thereto at any time subject to the provisions of Article 1 .
Translation:
第四十六条 加入本公约
1. 凡未签署本公约之国家政府，得随时依第一条之规定加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 183 2 . The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General by diplomatic channel through the intermediary of the government of the country of the seat of the Union .
Translation: 加入书应通过外交途径，经由本联盟总部所在国政府转交秘书长保存。

Query_Text_en: Unless otherwise specified therein , it shall become effective upon the date of its deposit .
Translation: 除另有规定外，自交存之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General shall notify the Members of each accession when it is received and shall forward to each of them a certified copy of the act of accession .
Translation: 秘书长收到加入书后，应通知各成员方，并向其转递经核证的加入书副本。

Query_Text_en: Article 47 Denunciation of the Convention184 1 . Each Member which has ratified , or acceded to , this Convention shall have the right to denounce it by a notification addressed to the Secretary-General by diplomatic channel through the intermediary of the government of the country of the seat of the Union .
Translation:
第四十七条 公约的退出  
1. 凡批准或加入本公约的成员国，有权通过外交渠道经由国际劳工组织总部所在国政府向秘书长提交通知，退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General shall advise the other Members thereof .
Translation: 秘书长应就此通知其他会员国。

Query_Text_en: 185 2 . This denunciation shall take effect at the expiration of a period of one year from the day of the receipt of notification of it by the Secretary-General .
Translation: 185 2. 此项退出声明应自秘书长收到通知之日起一年期满后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 48 Abrogation of the International Telecommunication Convention [ Malaga-Torremolinos , 1973 ] 186 This Convention shall abrogate and replace , in relations between the Contracting Governments , the International Telecommunication Convention [ Malaga-Torremolinos , 1973 ] . [ 3 ]
Translation:
第四十八条　废止1973年《国际电信公约》[马拉加-托雷莫里诺斯]  

本公约在各缔约国政府之间的关系上废止并取代1973年《国际电信公约》[马拉加-托雷莫里诺斯]。

Query_Text_en: Article 49 Relations with non-contracting States187 Each Member reserves to itself and to the recognized private operating agencies the right to fix the conditions on which it admits telecommunications exchanged with a State which is not a party to this Convention .
Translation:
第四十九条 与非缔约国关系  
各会员国保留为其本身及经认可的私营运营机构确定与非本公约缔约国进行电信交换之条件的权利。

Query_Text_en: If a telecommunication originating in the territory of such a non-contracting State is accepted by a Member , it must be transmitted and , in so far as it follows the telecommunication channels of a Member , the obligatory provisions of the Convention and Administrative Regulations and the usual charges shall apply to it .
Translation: 若源自非缔约国境内的电信业务被某一成员国所接受，则该业务必须予以传输；且在其经由成员国电信信道传输的范围内，应适用《国际电信公约》及《行政规则》的强制性条款，并按常规费率计费。

Query_Text_en: Article 50 Settlement of disputes188 1 . Members may settle their disputes on questions relating to the interpretation or application of this Convention or of the Regulations contemplated in Article 42 , through diplomatic channels , or according to procedures established by bilateral or multilateral treaties concluded between them for the settlement of international disputes , or by any other method mutually agreed upon .
Translation:
第五十条 争端的解决

一、各成员国关于本公约或第四十二条所述条例的解释或适用问题的争端，可通过外交途径解决，亦可采用各成员国间为解决国际争端而缔结的双边或多边条约规定的程序，或经各方共同商定的其他方式予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 189 2 . If none of these methods of settlement is adopted , any Member party to a dispute may submit the dispute to arbitration in accordance with the procedure defined in the General Regulations or in the Optional Additional Protocol , as the case may be .
Translation: 189 2. 如上述解决方式均未被采用，则争议的任何成员方可依照《总则》或《任择附加议定书》（视情况而定）规定的程序将争议提交仲裁。

Query_Text_en: 192 [ b ] other terms which are defined in the Regulations referred to in Article 42 shall have the meanings therein assigned to them .
Translation: 192 [ b ] 本协议第四十二条所指条例中定义的其他术语应具有该条例所赋予的含义。

Query_Text_en: The General Conference of the International Labor Organization , Having been convened at Geneva by the Governing Body of the International Labor Office , and having met in its 87th Session on 1 June 1999 , andConsidering the need to adopt new instruments for the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labor , as the main priority for national and international action , including international cooperation and assistance , to complement the Convention and the Recommendation concerning Minimum Age for Admission to Employment , 1973 , which remain fundamental instruments on child labor , andConsidering that the effective elimination of the worst forms of child labor requires immediate and comprehensive action , taking into account the importance of free basic education and the need to remove the children concerned from all such work and to provide for their rehabilitation and social integration while addressing the needs of their families , andRecalling the resolution concerning the elimination of child labor adopted by the International Labor Conference at its 83rd Session in 1996 , andRecognizing that child labor is to a great extent caused by poverty and that the long-term solution lies in sustained economic growth leading to social progress , in particular poverty alleviation and universal education , andRecalling the Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 20 November 1989 , andRecalling the ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work and its Follow-up , adopted by the International Labor Conference at its 86th Session in 1998 , andRecalling that some of the worst forms of child labor are covered by other international instruments , in particular the Forced Labor Convention , 1930 , and the United Nations Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery , the Slave Trade , and Institutions and Practices Similar to Slavery , 1956 , andHaving decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to child labor , which is the fourth item on the agenda of the session , andHaving determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention ; Adopts this seventeenth day of June of the year one thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine the following Convention , which may be cited as the Worst Forms of Child Labor Convention , 1999 .
Translation: 国际劳工组织大会，经国际劳工局理事会召集，于1999年6月1日在日内瓦举行其第87届会议，考虑到有必要通过新的文书，把禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动作为主要优先目标，以便在国家层面和国际层面采取包括国际合作与援助在内的行动，作为对1973年《准予就业最低年龄公约》和《建议书》的补充，这两项文书依然是有关童工劳动的基本文书，考虑到有效消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动要求采取立即和全面的行动，同时要考虑到免费基础教育的重要性，以及需要使有关儿童脱离所有此类工作以及为其提供康复和社会融合，还要同时解决其家庭需要问题，回顾1996年第83届国际劳工大会通过的关于消除童工劳动的决议，并认识到童工劳动在很大程度上是由贫困造成的，长期解决办法在于实现可持续的经济增长，从而促进社会进步，特别是消除贫困和普及教育，回顾联合国大会1989年11月20日通过的《儿童权利公约》，回顾1998年第86届国际劳工大会通过的《国际劳工组织关于工作中的基本原则和权利宣言及其后续措施》，并回顾某些最恶劣形式的童工劳动已涵盖在其他国际文书中，特别是1930年《强迫劳动公约》和联合国1956年《废止奴隶制、奴隶贩卖及类似奴隶制的制度与习俗补充公约》，决定就本届会议议程第四项关于童工劳动的若干提议通过新文书，并确定这些提议应采取一项国际公约的形式；于1999年6月17日通过以下公约，引用时可称之为1999年《最恶劣形式的童工劳动公约》。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall take immediate and effective measures to secure the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labor as a matter of urgency .
Translation: 第一条 凡批准本公约的会员国须立即采取有效措施，以确保作为紧迫事项禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 For the purposes of this Convention , the term child shall apply to all persons under the age of 18 .
Translation: 第二条 为本公约之目的，凡未满十八周岁者均视为儿童。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] work which , by its nature or the circumstances in which it is carried out , is likely to harm the health , safety or morals of children .
Translation: 按其性质或实施环境可能危害儿童健康、安全或道德的工作。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The types of work referred to under Article 3 [ d ] shall be determined by national laws or regulations or by the competent authority , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , taking into consideration relevant international standards , in particular Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Worst Forms of Child Labor Recommendation , 1999 .
Translation: 根据第三条(d)款所述工作类型，应由国家法律法规或主管当局在征询相关雇主组织和工人组织意见后，参照相关国际标准予以确定，尤其应考量《1999年最恶劣形式童工劳动建议书》第3段和第4段的规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The competent authority , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , shall identify where the types of work so determined exist .
Translation: 2. 主管机关在咨询相关雇主组织和工人组织后，应确定存在此类工作类型的领域。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The list of the types of work determined under paragraph 1 of this Article shall be periodically examined and revised as necessary , in consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned .
Translation: 根据本条第一款确定的工作类型清单，应定期与相关雇主组织和工人组织协商，必要时进行审查和修订。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Each Member shall , after consultation with employers ' and workers ' organizations , establish or designate appropriate mechanisms to monitor the implementation of the provisions giving effect to this Convention .
Translation: 第五条 各成员国应在与雇主组织和工人组织协商后，建立或指定适当机制，监督实施本公约各项条款的情况。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Member shall design and implement programs of action to eliminate as a priority the worst forms of child labor .
Translation: 各成员国须制定并实施行动计划，作为优先事项消除最恶劣形式的童工现象。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such programs of action shall be designed and implemented in consultation with relevant government institutions and employers ' and workers ' organizations , taking into consideration the views of other concerned groups as appropriate .
Translation: 2. 此类行动计划应在与相关政府机构及雇主和工人组织协商的基础上制定并实施，同时酌情考虑其他相关群体的意见。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Member shall take all necessary measures to ensure the effective implementation and enforcement of the provisions giving effect to this Convention including the provision and application of penal sanctions or , as appropriate , other sanctions .
Translation: 1. 各成员国应采取一切必要措施，确保有效实施和执行本公约各项条款，包括规定并适用刑事处罚或酌情采取其他制裁措施。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] take account of the special situation of girls .
Translation: 考虑到女孩的特殊情况。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Member shall designate the competent authority responsible for the implementation of the provisions giving effect to this Convention .
Translation: 3. 各成员国应指定负责实施本公约条款的主管机关。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Members shall take appropriate steps to assist one another in giving effect to the provisions of this Convention through enhanced international cooperation and\/or assistance including support for social and economic development , poverty eradication programs and universal education .
Translation: 第八条　各成员国应采取适当措施，通过加强国际合作和/或援助（包括支持社会经济发展、消除贫困计划和普及教育）协助彼此落实本公约规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 The formal ratifications of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第九条 本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局局长登记。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention shall be binding only upon those Members of the International Labor Organization whose ratifications have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labor Office .
Translation: 1. 本公约仅对国际劳工组织成员国生效，且其批准书已由国际劳工局局长登记在案。

Query_Text_en: 2 . It shall come into force 12 months after the date on which the ratifications of two Members have been registered with the Director-General .
Translation: 2. 本公约应于两个成员国批准书经总干事登记之日起12个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Thereafter , this Convention shall come into force for any Member 12 months after the date on which its ratification has been registered .
Translation: 此后，本公约对任何成员国应自其批准书登记之日起12个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force , by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 1. 已批准本公约的成员国，自公约首次生效之日起满十年后，可通过向国际劳工局局长提交登记文书的方式退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall notify all Members of the International Labor Organization of the registration of all ratifications and acts of denunciation communicated by the Members of the Organization .
Translation: 国际劳工局局长应将本组织各成员国通报的所有批准书和退出文书登记情况，通知国际劳工组织全体成员国。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When notifying the Members of the Organization of the registration of the second ratification , the Director-General shall draw the attention of the Members of the Organization to the date upon which the Convention shall come into force .
Translation: 二、总干事在向本组织成员国通报第二次批准书的登记时，应提请各成员国注意本公约生效的具体日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall communicate to the Secretary-General of the United Nations , for registration in accordance with article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations , full particulars of all ratifications and acts of denunciation registered by the Director-General in accordance with the provisions of the preceding Articles .
Translation: 第十三条 国际劳工局局长应将按照前述各条规定所登记的一切批准书和解约书的详细情况，依照《联合国宪章》第一百零二条的规定，送请联合国秘书长登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 At such times as it may consider necessary , the Governing Body of the International Labor Office shall present to the General Conference a report on the working of this Convention and shall examine the desirability of placing on the agenda of the Conference the question of its revision in whole or in part .
Translation: 第十四条 国际劳工局理事会应在其认为必要时，向大会提交关于本公约实施情况的报告，并审议是否将本公约全部或部分修订问题列入大会议程。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] as from the date when the new revising Convention comes into force , this Convention shall cease to be open to ratification by the Members .
Translation: [b]自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约即不再接受会员国批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 The English and French versions of the text of this Convention are equally authoritative .
Translation: 第十六条 本公约的英文和法文文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: China and Australia attach great importance to the issues of climate change and they wish to strengthen the cooperation to jointly tackle the challenge of climate change .
Translation: 中澳两国高度重视气候变化问题，愿加强合作，共同应对气候变化挑战。

Query_Text_en: Both parties reiterate their commitment made regarding the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change [ abbreviated to UNFCCC ] and the Kyoto Protocol . Both emphasize again that developed countries should continue to take the lead in reducing greenhouse gas emissions beyond 2012 in accordance with the principle of Common and Differential Liabilities , their respective capacities as well as the Bali Roadmap , and should also help developing countries to enhance the capacity of tackling climate change .
Translation: 双方重申对《联合国气候变化框架公约》（简称《公约》）和《京都议定书》的承诺，并再次强调发达国家应按照"共同但有区别的责任"原则、各自能力及"巴厘路线图"的规定，在2012年后继续率先减少温室气体排放，同时帮助发展中国家增强应对气候变化的能力。

Query_Text_en: Both China and Australia realize that negotiations should be enhanced in order to accomplish the time-table set out by the Bali Roadmap . Both parties will work closely together in the upcoming relevant bi-lateral and multi-lateral forums , and support the negotiations under the UNFCCC .
Translation: 中澳双方均认识到应加强谈判，以实现巴厘路线图确定的时间表。双方将在即将举行的相关双边及多边论坛上密切合作，并支持《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的谈判进程。

Query_Text_en: Both China and Australia have a lot in common regarding climate change .
Translation: 中澳两国在气候变化问题上存在诸多共识。

Query_Text_en: The partnership and cooperation between the two parties will focus on that with comparative advantages and common interests , so as to make contribution to global effort to tackle on climate change .
Translation: 双方将聚焦具有比较优势和共同利益的领域开展伙伴合作，为全球应对气候变化努力作出贡献。

Query_Text_en: Both parties agree to strengthen practically-oriented cooperation through enhancing ministerial-level dialogues on policies , and development and execution of mutually beneficial and substantive projects which help both parties to tackle climate change in order to promote closer cooperation in respect of climate change .
Translation: 双方同意通过加强政策层面的部长级对话，以及开发和执行互利共赢的实质性项目，来强化以实践为导向的合作，以应对气候变化，从而推动双方在气候变化领域开展更紧密的合作。

Query_Text_en: On the basis of developing closer cooperation between the two countries in respect of climate change , both parties reiterate their support to the work of the Sino-Australian Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology .
Translation: 在深化两国气候变化领域合作的基础上，双方重申支持中澳洁净煤技术联合协调工作组开展工作。

Query_Text_en: Both countries deem that reducing forests destruction and emissions should be regarded as one of the aspects in the future actions for tackling climate change . The support to the Asia Pacific Network for Sustainable Forest Management and Rehabilitation which was advocated and initiated by China in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation [ APEC ] Forum held in Sidney in September 2007 was reiterated .
Translation: 两国认为，减少毁林和排放应作为未来应对气候变化行动的内容之一。双方重申支持2007年9月在悉尼举行的亚太经合组织会议上中方倡议并提出的亚太森林恢复与可持续管理网络。

Query_Text_en: Both countries and other parties demonstrated concerted efforts at the 13th Conference of Parties to the UNFCCC culminated in the Bali Roadmap which is an international framework for the future to tackle climate change .
Translation: 在《联合国气候变化框架公约》第十三次缔约方大会上，各国及其他与会方展现出协同努力，最终达成《巴厘路线图》。该路线图确立了未来应对气候变化的国际框架。

Query_Text_en: Under the guidance of the UNFCCC and the Kyoto Protocol , both countries will continue to joint efforts for promoting negotiations as well as relevant international cooperations in respect of climate change .
Translation: 在《联合国气候变化框架公约》和《京都议定书》指导下，双方将继续共同推动气候变化谈判及相关国际合作。

Query_Text_en: To this end , both parties agree , on the basis of the existing climate change mechanisms , to hold annual ministerial-level meetings for strengthening regular dialogues on policies , cooperation and coordination between both parties .
Translation: 为此，双方同意在现有气候变化机制基础上，每年举行部长级会议，以加强政策对话、合作与协调。

Query_Text_en: The first ministerial-level meeting will be hosted by Australia in the second half of 2008 .
Translation: 首次部长级会议将于2008年下半年在澳大利亚举行。

Query_Text_en: China and Australia enjoy a successful bi-lateral partnership in respect of climate change . This partnership draws together resources and experts of both countries from the industrial and science sectors as well as relevant government departmens .
Translation: 中澳两国在气候变化领域建立了卓有成效的双边伙伴关系。这一合作机制整合了两国工业界、科学界及相关政府部门的资源和专家力量。

Query_Text_en: Both parties reiterate the commitment to the agreed joint projects , and agree to further expand the practically-oriented project activities , particularly in the areas of capacity building , renewable energy technology , energy efficiency , the recycling and use of methane , climate change and agriculture , land use , the change of land use and forestry , adaptation to climate change and the science of climage change , etc.
Translation: 双方重申致力于推进已商定的合作项目，并同意进一步拓展务实合作项目活动，重点包括能力建设、可再生能源技术、能效提升、甲烷回收利用、气候变化与农业、土地利用及林业转型、适应气候变化以及气候变化科学等领域。

Query_Text_en: China and Australia will cooperate in developing low emissions technology , so as to help the two countries to reduce greenhouse gas emissions as far as possible in the course of economic development , and also meet both countries ever growing needs for clean technology for generating electricity .
Translation: 中国与澳大利亚将合作开发低碳排放技术，以助力两国在经济发展进程中尽可能减少温室气体排放，同时满足双方日益增长的清洁发电技术需求。

Query_Text_en: The two countries welcome their existing cooperations in the areas relating to the Asia-Pacific Partnership on Clean Development and Climate , the Sino-Australian Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology and the bi-lateral partnership on the issues of climate change .
Translation: 两国对双方在亚太清洁发展与气候伙伴关系、中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组以及气候变化双边伙伴关系等领域的现有合作表示欢迎。

Query_Text_en: China welcomes the Australia s reiteration of the commitment to allocate AUD 200 million to the Sino-Australian Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology .
Translation: 中方欢迎澳方重申承诺向中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组提供2亿澳元资金。

Query_Text_en: At the invitation of H. E. Wen Jiabao , Premier of the State Council of the People 's Republic of China , H. E. Anders Fogh Rasmussen , Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Denmark , came to China to attend the 7th Asia-Europe Meeting and to pay an official visit on 20th C 25th October 2008 .
Translation: 应中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝阁下邀请，丹麦王国首相安诺斯·福格·拉斯穆森阁下于2008年10月20日至25日来华出席第七届亚欧首脑会议并进行正式访问。

Query_Text_en: During the official visit President Hu Jintao and Premier Wen Jiabao held talks with Prime Minister Rasmussen .
Translation: 国家主席胡锦涛和国务院总理温家宝在访问期间与拉斯穆森首相举行了会谈。

Query_Text_en: The leaders reviewed the considerable progress of the bilateral relations and the fruitful cooperation in the political , economic , cultural , educational , scientific and technological fields since the establishment of diplomatic relations in 1950 . Bilateral relations have been steadily enhanced with greater political mutual trust and respect and expanded economic cooperation and trade .
Translation: 两国领导人回顾了自1950年建交以来双边关系取得的重大进展，以及在政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等领域开展的富有成效的合作。双方政治互信与尊重不断增强，经贸合作持续扩大，推动双边关系稳步提升。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed that they shared a common interest in working together on bilateral , multilateral and global issues .
Translation: 双方一致认为，在双边、多边及全球性事务中开展合作符合共同利益。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The two sides agreed to strengthen the political and economic dialogue by maintaining the momentum of regular high-level exchanges and enhancing friendly exchanges between the governments and legislative bodies as well as local authorities in various forms and at various levels to increase mutual understanding and establish concrete cooperation .
Translation: 1. 双方同意通过保持定期高层交往势头，加强政府、立法机构及地方政府间形式多样、层级丰富的友好交流，深化政治经济对话，增进相互理解，开展务实合作。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will strengthen the political dialogue and promote closer consultation and co-operation between the two foreign ministries .
Translation: 双方将加强政治对话，推动两国外交部门开展更紧密的磋商与合作。

Query_Text_en: They will maintain the political consultation mechanism at vice foreign ministerial level and strive for annual meetings alternately in Beijing and Copenhagen .
Translation: 双方将保持副外长级政治磋商机制，并努力实现每年在北京和哥本哈根轮流举行会晤。

Query_Text_en: During these exchanges and also other bilateral consultations and meetings , the two sides can discuss ways to strengthen cooperation including meetings at the level of leaders of government or foreign ministers at bilateral or multilateral occasions .
Translation: 在以上交流及其他双边磋商和会晤中，双方可探讨加强合作的途径，包括在双边或多边场合举行政府首脑或外长级会议。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will also work in common to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations in 2010 through suitable mutual high-level visits and in other ways .
Translation: 双方还将共同努力，通过适当的高层互访及其他方式，庆祝2010年两国建交60周年。

Query_Text_en: Denmark reiterated its firm adherence to the one China policy , not supporting Taiwan 's membership of international organizations which require statehood , and not having official contacts with Taiwan .
Translation: 丹麦重申坚定奉行一个中国政策，不支持台湾加入任何以国家为资格的国际组织，不与台湾进行官方往来。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side appreciated the above principled position of the Danish side .
Translation: 中方赞赏丹方上述原则立场。

Query_Text_en: Denmark expressed its hope for a peaceful resolution of the Taiwan question through constructive dialogue .
Translation: 丹麦表示希望通过建设性对话和平解决台湾问题。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side reiterated its principled position on Taiwan .
Translation: 中方重申了在台湾问题上的原则立场。

Query_Text_en: The two sides were pleased about the good progress made in EU-China relations and were ready to make continued contribution to the deepening of China-EU comprehensive strategic partnership .
Translation: 双方对中欧关系取得的良好进展感到满意，愿继续为深化中欧全面战略伙伴关系作出贡献。

Query_Text_en: Denmark confirmed its willingness to carry forward work towards lifting the EU arms embargo against China on the basis of the Joint Statement of the 2004 EU-China Summit and subsequent European Council Conclusions .
Translation: 丹麦确认愿基于2004年中欧峰会联合声明及此后欧洲理事会结论，继续推进解除欧盟对华武器禁运的相关工作。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Denmark and China both fully support a fair , just and rules-based multilateral international system , with the United Nations playing the central role in addressing global issues and bringing political solutions to international disputes through consultations and negotiations .
Translation: 2. 丹麦和中国都坚定支持公平、公正、以规则为基础的多边国际体系，主张联合国在应对全球性问题和通过协商谈判政治解决国际争端中发挥核心作用。

Query_Text_en: The two sides support reasonable and necessary reforms of the UN .
Translation: 双方支持对联合国进行合理且必要的改革。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , the two sides will strengthen cooperation in the United Nations , ASEM , EU-China relations and other multilateral and regional mechanisms .
Translation: 为此，双方将加强在联合国、亚欧会议、中欧关系及其他多边和区域机制中的合作。

Query_Text_en: In connection with the United Nations and its peace-keeping missions , the two sides affirmed their willingness to engage in sharing experiences in this regard .
Translation: 双方就联合国及其维和行动交换意见，愿就此开展经验分享。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The two sides condemned terrorism in all its forms without qualifications , committed by whomever , whenever and for whatever purposes .
Translation: 双方谴责一切形式的恐怖主义，不论由何人在何时出于何种目的实施，均不加区别地予以反对。

Query_Text_en: The two sides decided to strengthen consultation and exchanges on counter-terrorism , reiterated that the UN should play a leading role in the fight against terrorism and expressed opposition to associating terrorism with any specific ethnic group or religion .
Translation: 双方决定加强反恐领域磋商与交流，重申联合国应在国际反恐合作中发挥核心作用，反对将恐怖主义同特定民族或宗教挂钩。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Leaders stated their willingness to strengthen exchanges and cooperation in the field of non-proliferation .
Translation: 四、领导人表示愿加强防扩散领域的交流与合作。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The two sides reaffirmed their commitment to the promotion and protection of human rights and continued to place value on the exchanges and cooperation on human rights based on equality and mutual respect .
Translation: 5. 双方重申致力于促进和保护人权，将继续重视在平等和相互尊重基础上开展人权领域交流合作。

Query_Text_en: They underlined the importance of concrete steps in the field of human rights .
Translation: 他们强调在人权领域采取具体措施的重要性。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Both sides affirmed their commitment to the continued development of Africa .
Translation: 6. 双方重申致力于非洲的持续发展。

Query_Text_en: Denmark and China will enhance mutual exchanges in support of African development in order to explore more effective ways of cooperating with the continent .
Translation: 丹麦和中国将加强支持非洲发展的相互交流，以探索与该地区合作更有效的途径。

Query_Text_en: The two sides expressed their full commitment to the Millennium Development Goals [ MDGs ] and global sustainable development .
Translation: 双方表示将全力致力于实现千年发展目标和全球可持续发展。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The two sides agreed to continue to strengthen cooperation in the fields of climate change , energy and the environment , research and innovation , and education .
Translation: 7. 双方同意继续加强在气候变化、能源与环境、科研创新及教育等领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: China appreciated Denmark 's initiative for enhancing cooperation .
Translation: 中方赞赏丹方为推动合作所作努力。

Query_Text_en: The two sides stressed the importance they attach to tackling climate change .
Translation: 双方强调高度重视应对气候变化问题。

Query_Text_en: They support the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change as the main channel for global efforts on climate change and reiterated their commitment to the principle of `` common but differentiated responsibilities '' . They will work together with a view to reaching an agreed outcome and adopt a decision at the Conference of Parties [ COP 15 ] in Copenhagen in 2009 .
Translation: 双方支持联合国气候变化框架公约作为全球应对气候变化努力的主渠道，重申坚持"共同但有区别的责任"原则，致力于在2009年哥本哈根联合国气候变化大会上就最终结果达成一致并作出决定。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed to maintain close contact at all levels with a view to attaining this goal .
Translation: 双方同意保持各级密切接触，以期实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Denmark supports the development of the Chinese wind energy sector . A new program beginning in 2009 will support China 's national plans for renewable energy including the establishment of a center for renewable energy and the transfer and development of new and innovative renewable energy technologies in close cooperation between Danish and Chinese R and D institutions and the private sector .
Translation: 丹麦支持中国风电产业发展。自2009年起实施的新计划将助力中国可再生能源国家战略，包括共建可再生能源中心，并通过中丹两国研发机构与私营部门的紧密合作，推动创新可再生能源技术的转移与开发。

Query_Text_en: Leaders of the two sides witnessed the signing of a letter of intent concerning a new Danish-Chinese program for renewable energy worth 100 million DKK .
Translation: 两国领导人共同见证了价值1亿丹麦克朗的中丹新能源合作计划意向书的签署。

Query_Text_en: In the field of environment , the two sides will strengthen cooperation in such environmental protection fields as water and air pollution prevention and treatment , and waste management .
Translation: 在环境领域，双方将加强水污染防治、大气污染防治及废弃物管理等环保领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: Both sides agreed to strengthen cooperation in higher education , research and innovation in order to jointly develop competences and knowledge in areas closely linked to the social and economic development in both countries .
Translation: 双方同意加强高等教育、科研创新领域合作，共同提升两国经济社会发展密切关联领域的专业能力与知识水平。

Query_Text_en: This will , inter alia , be achieved through support for research partnerships and increased mobility of research talents as it follows from the September 2007 Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Cooperation in Science and Technology between the People 's Republic of China and Denmark .
Translation: 为此，双方将特别通过支持研究合作、促进科研人才流动等举措予以落实，具体遵循2007年9月签署的《中华人民共和国与丹麦王国科学技术合作谅解备忘录》相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Leaders of the two sides witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding Concerning the Establishment of a Sino-Danish Center [ SDC ] for Education and Research .
Translation: 两国领导人共同见证了《关于共建中丹科教中心谅解备忘录》的签署。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The two sides will further deepen and expand mutually beneficial economic and trade co-operation , make full use of and improve the Sino-Danish Joint Committee of Trade and Economic Cooperation and other existing consultation and co-operation mechanisms to increase the dialogue on trade , investment and technology and encourage exchanges and cooperation between business communities , especially small - and medium-sized enterprises of the two sides .
Translation: 8. 双方将进一步深化和拓展互利经贸合作，充分利用并完善中丹经贸联委会等现有磋商合作机制，加强贸易、投资与技术对话，鼓励两国工商界特别是中小企业开展交流与合作。

Query_Text_en: Both parties will support enterprises in making increased efforts to fulfill social responsibility while advancing commercial relations .
Translation: 双方将支持企业在推进商业关系的同时，加大履行社会责任的力度。

Query_Text_en: Denmark supports China 's wish for early recognition of market economy status by the EU and actively works for this to happen as soon as an appropriate framework for such a decision can be found .
Translation: 丹麦支持中国希望欧盟尽早承认其市场经济地位的愿望，并将积极推动此事，一旦找到作出这一决定的适当框架便尽快落实。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side appreciates the abiding commitment of Denmark to free trade and its opposition to trade protectionism .
Translation: 中方赞赏丹麦一贯坚持自由贸易、反对贸易保护主义的立场。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The two sides will expand co-operation in culture and tourism and facilitate people-to-people contacts and exchanges .
Translation: 9. 双方将扩大文化和旅游领域合作，便利人员往来与人文交流。

Query_Text_en: 1 . At the invitation of President Hu Jintao of the People 's Republic of China , President Pervez Musharraf of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan paid a state visit to the People 's Republic of China from 19 to 23 February 2006 .
Translation: 应中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛邀请，巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国总统佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫于2006年2月19日至23日对中华人民共和国进行国事访问。

Query_Text_en: 2 . President Hu Jintao held official talks with President Musharraf .
Translation: 胡锦涛主席与穆沙拉夫总统举行正式会谈。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Wu Bangguo , Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People 's Congress , Mr. Wen Jiabao , Premier of the State Council , and Mr. Jia Qinglin , Chairman of the Chinese People 's Political Consultative Conference , met President Musharraf respectively .
Translation: 全国人大常委会委员长吴邦国、国务院总理温家宝、全国政协主席贾庆林分别会见了穆沙拉夫总统。

Query_Text_en: In a cordial and friendly atmosphere , leaders of the two countries had in-depth exchange of views and reached broad common ground on strengthening China-Pakistan strategic partnership of cooperation and on international and regional issues of mutual interest .
Translation: 在亲切友好的气氛中，两国领导人就加强中巴战略合作伙伴关系及共同关心的国际和地区问题深入交换意见，达成广泛共识。

Query_Text_en: 3 . During his visit , President Musharraf addressed leading Chinese scholars at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences , met members of the Chinese business community and attended a special commemorative event marking the 55th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Pakistan .
Translation: 访问期间，穆沙拉夫总统在中国社会科学院向中国知名学者发表演讲，会见了中国工商界人士，并出席了中巴建交55周年特别纪念活动。

Query_Text_en: President Musharraf and his delegation also visited Chengdu , Sichuan Province .
Translation: 穆沙拉夫总统及代表团一行还访问了四川省成都市。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The leaders of the two countries reviewed with satisfaction the growth of China-Pakistan relations over the past 55 years . They were glad to see that China-Pakistan friendship featuring sincerity , cooperation , mutual trust and support has struck deep root in the hearts of the two peoples .
Translation: 两国领导人满意地回顾了55年来中巴关系的长足发展，高兴地看到以真诚合作、互信互助为特征的中巴友好已深深扎根于两国人民心中。

Query_Text_en: The all-weather friendship between China and Pakistan has withstood the test of time and prospered notwithstanding changes in the international , regional and domestic environment .
Translation: 中巴全天候友谊经受住了国际风云变幻和各自国内局势变化的考验，历久弥坚。

Query_Text_en: Both sides agreed that at a time when major and profound changes are taking place both internationally and regionally , to strengthen good-neighborliness and friendship , develop cooperation and deepen strategic relations between China and Pakistan serves the fundamental interests of the two countries and peoples and will promote peace and development in the region .
Translation: 双方一致认为，在当前国际和地区形势发生重大深刻变化的背景下，加强中巴睦邻友好、深化双边合作、提升战略关系，不仅符合两国和两国人民的根本利益，也有利于促进本地区的和平与发展。

Query_Text_en: Both sides emphasized that the two countries are committed to enhancing China-Pakistan strategic partnership of cooperation featuring good-neighborliness , friendship and mutual cooperation . The two countries will continue to take steps to deepen and enrich China-Pakistan relations .
Translation: 双方强调，两国致力于构建以睦邻友好、相互合作为特征的中巴战略合作伙伴关系，并将继续采取举措深化和丰富双边关系内涵。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Both sides expressed satisfaction with the successful implementation of the Joint Declaration between the People 's Republic of China and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan on the Direction of Bilateral Cooperation issued by the two Heads of State in November 2003 and the signing and coming into effect of the Treaty of Friendship , Cooperation and Good-neighborly Relations .
Translation: 五、双方对2003年11月两国元首签署的《中华人民共和国和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国关于双边合作发展方向的联合宣言》得到顺利落实表示满意，并对《中巴睦邻友好合作条约》的签署和生效表示欢迎。

Query_Text_en: They agreed to maintain exchange of high-level visits and contacts and conduct regular consultation and coordination on major international and regional issues and bilateral relations and to make unremitting efforts to promote stability and prosperity both in China and Pakistan and in the region .
Translation: 双方同意保持高层互访与接触，就重大国际和地区问题及双边关系定期开展磋商协调，为促进中巴两国及本地区的稳定与繁荣作出不懈努力。

Query_Text_en: 6 . On behalf of the Pakistani Government and people , President Musharraf expressed appreciation to the Chinese Government and people for the provision of emergency relief material and humanitarian assistance in the wake of the earthquake in Pakistan .
Translation: 6. 巴基斯坦总统穆沙拉夫代表巴政府和人民，对中国政府和人民在巴基斯坦地震后提供紧急救援物资和人道主义援助表示感谢。

Query_Text_en: He stated that the selfless assistance of the Chinese side reflected the true friendship between China and Pakistan tested by adversity .
Translation: 他表示，中方的无私援助体现了中巴两国历经考验的患难真情。

Query_Text_en: President Hu Jintao said that the Chinese side will take an active part in the reconstruction of disaster-hit areas in Pakistan and help the affected people rebuild their homeland .
Translation: 胡锦涛主席表示，中方将积极参与巴基斯坦灾后重建工作，帮助受灾民众重建家园。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The two sides decided to use the occasion of the 55th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties to lift China-Pakistan relations to a new height . The two sides agreed to hold this year the `` Cultural Week '' and `` Film Week '' , and to exchange media and academic visits .
Translation: 七、双方决定以建交55周年为契机，将中巴关系推向新高度。双方同意今年互办"文化周"和"电影周"，开展媒体和学术交流互访。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Both sides expressed their firm resolve to strengthen cooperation in all spheres . They held that to maintain trade and economic links is not only an important part of China-Pakistan cooperation and good-neighborly relations but also a bond of common interests between the two countries .
Translation: 八、双方坚定致力于深化各领域合作，一致认为保持经贸联系不仅是中巴合作与睦邻友好关系的重要组成部分，更是两国共同利益的重要纽带。

Query_Text_en: Both sides agreed to explore new ways to expand economic cooperation and trade to promote common development for the two countries and peoples .
Translation: 双方同意探索拓展经贸合作新途径，促进两国及两国人民共同发展。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The two sides expressed satisfaction with the implementation of the Early Harvest Programme , and agreed to expedite negotiations on the Free Trade Agreement .
Translation: 9. 双方对早期收获计划的实施表示满意，并同意加快自由贸易协定谈判进程。

Query_Text_en: They emphasized that overland trade through the Karakoram Highway should be promoted and were ready to adopt measures to facilitate such trade .
Translation: 他们强调应促进通过喀喇昆仑公路的陆路贸易，并愿意采取便利化措施推动此类贸易发展。

Query_Text_en: 10 . Both sides also expressed deep satisfaction with the progress being made on various Chinese-assisted economic projects in Pakistan , including Gwadar Port , Sandhak Gold and Copper and Dudar Zinc and Lead .
Translation: 10. 双方对中方援建的瓜达尔港、山达克金铜矿、杜达铅锌矿等巴基斯坦经济项目取得的进展表示高度满意。

Query_Text_en: They agreed to encourage cooperation between Chinese and Pakistani companies , including setting up joint ventures , and supported the early launching of a joint study on expanding economic cooperation and trade .
Translation: 双方同意鼓励两国企业开展合作，包括建立合资企业，并支持早日启动拓展经贸合作的联合研究。

Query_Text_en: Both sides agreed to set up a China-Pakistan Joint Investment Company between the financial institutions of the two countries .
Translation: 双方同意在两国的金融机构间设立中巴联合投资公司。

Query_Text_en: Both sides also reached agreement in principle to upgrade the Karakoram Highway .
Translation: 双方还原则同意升级喀喇昆仑公路。

Query_Text_en: Special emphasis was placed on cooperation in agriculture , especially agro-based industry , pesticides , drip irrigation and fisheries .
Translation: 重点推进农业领域合作，特别是农基产业、农药、滴灌及渔业等方面。

Query_Text_en: A framework agreement on expanding and deepening economic cooperation was signed .
Translation: 双方签署了关于拓展和深化经济合作的框架协议。

Query_Text_en: 11 . Both sides agreed to enhance their cooperation in the energy sector and signed the Framework Agreement on Energy Cooperation , a wide-ranging document .
Translation: 11. 双方同意加强能源领域合作，并签署了涵盖广泛的《能源合作框架协议》。

Query_Text_en: Pakistan expressed its interest in construction of oil refineries , gas terminals , oil and gas storage and transit facilities .
Translation: 巴基斯坦表示有意建设炼油厂、天然气终端、油气储存设施及中转设施。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side welcomed these proposals and agreed to assist in the development of oil and gas sector in Pakistan .
Translation: 中方对这些提议表示欢迎，并同意协助巴基斯坦发展油气产业。

Query_Text_en: 12 . Both sides expressed satisfaction with the performance of Chashma Nuclear Power Plant-I and the start of the construction of the Chashma Power Plant Unit-II . They agreed to enhance cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy .
Translation: 12. 双方对恰希玛核电站一期的运行表现及二期工程开工建设表示满意，同意加强和平利用核能领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: 13 . Both sides attached considerable importance to broadening cooperation in social sectors , including health , human resources development , education and vocational training .
Translation: 13. 双方高度重视拓展卫生、人力资源开发、教育和职业培训等社会领域合作。

Query_Text_en: 14 . Both sides agreed to enhance cooperation in high technology , including space technology for peaceful purposes .
Translation: 14. 双方同意加强高新技术领域合作，包括和平利用太空技术。

Query_Text_en: They agreed to enhance close cooperation between relevant institutions in the earth , marine and space sciences and promote the application of relevant technologies in industry and agriculture .
Translation: 双方同意加强地球科学、海洋科学和空间科学领域相关机构的紧密合作，推动相关技术在工农业领域的应用。

Query_Text_en: They also agreed to cooperate in seismology , geology and Antarctic sciences .
Translation: 双方还同意在地震学、地质学和南极科学领域开展合作。

Query_Text_en: 15 . China reaffirmed its respect for Pakistan 's independence , sovereignty and territorial integrity . It appreciated and supported Pakistan 's efforts to promote peace and stability in South Asia and supported all efforts by Pakistan to safeguard its sovereignty , territorial integrity and independence .
Translation: 15. 中国重申尊重巴基斯坦的独立、主权和领土完整，赞赏并支持巴基斯坦为促进南亚和平稳定所作努力，支持巴基斯坦为维护国家主权、领土完整和独立所作的一切努力。

Query_Text_en: Pakistan reaffirmed its long-standing commitment to the one China policy and recognized that the Government of the People 's Republic of China is the sole legal government representing the whole of China and that Taiwan is an inalienable part of China 's territory .
Translation: 巴基斯坦重申长期奉行一个中国政策，承认中华人民共和国政府是代表全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Pakistan opposed `` Taiwan independence '' and fully supported China 's peaceful reunification .
Translation: 巴基斯坦反对"台独"，完全支持中国和平统一。

Query_Text_en: 16 . The two sides discussed in depth the international and regional developments . They reaffirmed their firm opposition to terrorism in all its forms and manifestations as well as the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and their means of delivery .
Translation: 16. 双方深入探讨了国际和地区形势发展，重申坚决反对一切形式的恐怖主义以及大规模杀伤性武器及其运载工具的扩散。

Query_Text_en: They expressed their commitment to maintaining international peace and stability . Both sides agreed that the United Nations reform should aim at strengthening its authority and unity and give priority to the issue of development .
Translation: 双方承诺共同维护国际和平与稳定，一致认为联合国改革应增强其权威性和团结性，并将发展议题置于优先位置。

Query_Text_en: The reform of the Security Council should take into full consideration the interests of all its members , and a formula acceptable to all should be sought through extensive and thorough consultations .
Translation: 安理会改革应充分考虑全体成员国的利益，通过广泛深入协商寻求各方均能接受的方案。

Query_Text_en: 17 . Pakistan welcomed China becoming an observer of South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation [ SAARC ] .
Translation: 17. 巴基斯坦欢迎中国成为南亚区域合作联盟（SAARC）观察员国。

Query_Text_en: China welcomed Pakistan becoming an observer of Shanghai Cooperation Organization [ SCO ] and invited it to participate in the SCO Shanghai Summit in June 2006 .
Translation: 中方欢迎巴基斯坦成为上海合作组织观察员，并邀请其参加2006年6月举行的上海合作组织上海峰会。

Query_Text_en: Both sides expressed their support for the process of regional cooperation in Asia and the need to promote inter-regional cooperation .
Translation: 双方表示支持亚洲区域合作进程，并认为有必要推动区域间合作。

Translation: 18. 双方签署了《中华人民共和国政府与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府关于扩大和深化双边经贸合作的框架协议》、《中华人民共和国国防部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国国防部合作框架协议》、《中华人民共和国国家发展和改革委员会与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府石油和自然资源部能源领域合作框架协议》、《中华人民共和国劳动和社会保障部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国劳动、人力资源和海外巴侨部职业培训合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国交通运输部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国交通部关于喀喇昆仑公路升级改造合作的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国农业部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国食品、农业和畜牧部渔业领域合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国农业部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国食品、农业和畜牧部农药管理合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国商务部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国商务部关于启动双边经贸合作五年规划联合研究的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国卫生部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国卫生部卫生领域合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国国家人口和计划生育委员会与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国人口福利部合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国中国地震局与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国气象局地震研究领域合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国中国气象局与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国气象局气象科技合作谅解备忘录》，以及《中国进出口银行与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国经济事务和统计部关于使用中华人民共和国政府优惠买方信贷的总贷款协议》。

Query_Text_en: 19 . President Musharraf invited President Hu Jintao to visit Pakistan this year and to participate in commemorative events celebrating the 55th Anniversary of diplomatic ties between the two countries .
Translation: 19. 穆沙拉夫总统邀请胡锦涛主席今年访问巴基斯坦并出席两国建交55周年纪念活动。

Query_Text_en: President Hu thanked President Musharraf for the invitation .
Translation: 胡主席感谢穆沙拉夫总统的邀请。

Query_Text_en: Joint Statement between the People 's Republic of China and the People 's Republic of BangladeshAt the invitation of Premier Wen Jiabao of the State Council of the People 's Republic of China , Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina of the People 's Republic of Bangladesh paid an official visit to China from 17 to 21 March , 2010 .
Translation:
中华人民共和国与孟加拉人民共和国联合声明

应中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝邀请，孟加拉人民共和国总理谢赫·哈西娜于2010年3月17日至21日对中国进行正式访问。

Query_Text_en: During the visit , President Hu Jintao and Chairman Wu Bangguo of the National People 's Congress Standing Committee received the Bangladesh Prime Minister . Premier Wen Jiabao and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina held official talks .
Translation: 访问期间，国家主席胡锦涛和全国人大常委会委员长吴邦国分别会见了孟加拉国总理，国务院总理温家宝与谢赫·哈西娜总理举行了正式会谈。

Query_Text_en: The leaders of the two countries had an in-depth exchange of views and reached agreement on newer directions for taking China-Bangladesh relations forward . They also exchanged views on international and regional issues of mutual interest and indentified areas for collective initiatives to face contemporary global challenges .
Translation: 两国领导人深入交换意见，就推动中孟关系迈上新台阶达成共识，并就共同关心的国际地区问题交换看法，明确了携手应对全球性挑战的合作领域。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The two sides reviewed the course of bilateral relations since the establishment of diplomatic relations 35 years ago , and extolled active cooperation and partnership that has sustained between the two countries in the political , economic , social , and cultural fields .
Translation: 双方回顾了建交35年来双边关系发展历程，高度评价两国在政治、经济、社会、文化等领域开展的积极合作与伙伴关系。

Query_Text_en: The two sides recalled that the relations between the peoples of the two countries date back many centuries . They also recalled that the successive leaders of the two countries made important contributions to the development of China-Bangladesh relations .
Translation: 双方忆及两国人民之间的友好交往源远流长，两国历代领导人为中孟关系发展作出了重要贡献。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed that consolidation and enhancement of China-Bangladesh friendship and cooperation serve the fundamental interests of both countries , meet the common aspirations of the two peoples and are conducive to peace and development in the region and the world at large .
Translation: 双方一致认为，巩固和深化中孟友好合作关系符合两国根本利益，顺应两国人民共同期待，有利于地区乃至世界的和平与发展。

Query_Text_en: The two sides decided to establish a `` Closer Comprehensive Partnership of Cooperation '' between China and Bangladesh from the strategic perspective and on the basis of the principles of longstanding friendship , equality , and mutual benefit .
Translation: 双方决定从战略高度出发，在长期友好、平等互利原则基础上，将中孟关系提升为"更加紧密的全面合作伙伴关系"。

Query_Text_en: The two sides noted that 4 October 2010 marks the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and Bangladesh . They agreed to hold various commemorative activities in Beijing and Dhaka , and take this opportunity to promote and further develop the existing friendly relations between the two countries .
Translation: 双方注意到，2010年10月4日是中孟建交35周年纪念日，同意在北京和达卡举行系列庆祝活动，并以此为契机推动和深化两国间业已存在的友好关系。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The two sides agreed to continue to exchange high-level visits and contacts between the two countries , intensify friendly exchanges between government agencies , parliaments , political parties , armed forces , and non-governmental groups of the two countries ;
Translation: 双方同意继续保持两国高层交往和接触，加强两国政府机构、立法机关、政党、军队及民间团体之间的友好交流；

Query_Text_en: promote communication and cooperation at the local government level , and enhance the cooperation mechanisms , including diplomatic consultations , the Joint Economic and Trade Committee and Joint Agriculture Committee .
Translation: 推动地方政府间交流合作，完善外交磋商、经贸联委会和农业联委会等合作机制。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Both sides reiterated their conviction that economic cooperation and trade constitute an important part of the comprehensive partnership between China and Bangladesh .
Translation: 双方重申，经贸合作是中孟全面合作伙伴关系的重要组成部分。

Query_Text_en: In this regard , the two sides agreed to intensify cooperation in trade , investment , agriculture , transportation and infrastructure development on the basis of equality and mutual benefit .
Translation: 双方同意在此基础上加强贸易、投资、农业、交通和基础设施发展等领域的平等互利合作。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The two sides will take active measures to expand bilateral trade and ease trade imbalance .
Translation: 双方将积极采取措施扩大双边贸易，缓解贸易不平衡问题。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side will provide preferential tariff treatment to more Bangladeshi products and continue to boost the bilateral investment and trade activities .
Translation: 中方将对更多孟加拉国产品给予关税优惠待遇，并持续推动双边投资贸易活动。

Query_Text_en: The Bangladesh side will encourage Bangladeshi enterprises to actively participate in the Shanghai World Expo 2010 and other commodity fairs in China to boost Bangladesh 's exports to China .
Translation: 孟方将鼓励本国企业积极参加2010年上海世博会及中国其他商品交易会，以扩大对华出口规模。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Chinese side expressed its commitment to continue to offer assistance to Bangladesh to the best of its ability in support of the economic and social development of Bangladesh .
Translation: 中方表示，愿继续尽己所能向孟方提供援助，支持孟加拉国经济社会发展。

Query_Text_en: The Bangladesh side expressed its heartfelt appreciation in this regard .
Translation: 孟方对此表示衷心感谢。

Query_Text_en: The two sides signed the Agreement on Economic and Technical Cooperation between the Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the People 's Republic of Bangladesh , the Framework Agreement between the Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the People 's Republic of Bangladesh on a Concessional Loan Provided by China to Bangladesh , and the Exchange of Letters on the Construction of the 7th Bangladesh-China Friendship Bridge at Kajirtek .
Translation: 双方签署了《中华人民共和国政府和孟加拉人民共和国政府经济技术合作协定》《中华人民共和国政府和孟加拉人民共和国政府关于中国向孟加拉国提供优惠贷款的框架协议》以及《关于建设卡兹尔特克第七座中孟友谊大桥的换文》。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed to intensify efforts to resolve technical matters of such further projects as the construction of the Bangladesh-China Friendship Exhibition Centre .
Translation: 双方同意加大力度推进孟中友谊展览中心等后续项目技术问题的解决工作。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The two sides encourage and support their own enterprises to carry out two-way investment and mutually beneficial cooperation , and provide facilitation for enterprises of both sides in project contracting and labor service cooperation .
Translation: 双方鼓励并支持本国企业开展双向投资与互利合作，为两国企业在项目承包和劳务合作方面提供便利。

Query_Text_en: The Bangladesh side welcomes the active involvement of Chinese enterprises in the energy , communication , transportation , industry and infrastructure sectors in Bangladesh .
Translation: 孟方欢迎中国企业积极参与孟加拉国能源、通信、交通、工业和基础设施领域建设。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side would encourage and support capable and reputable Chinese enterprises to explore and carry out investment cooperation in the above-mentioned fields in Bangladesh , and to provide possible facilitation and financing support for the mutually agreed cooperation projects .
Translation: 中方将鼓励并支持有实力、信誉好的中国企业在上述领域探索并开展对孟投资合作，并为双方商定的合作项目提供可能的便利化措施和融资支持。

Query_Text_en: During this visit , China National Petroleum Corporation signed a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in Oil and Gas Sector with Bangladesh Oil , Gas and Mineral Corporation and Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation .
Translation: 此次访问期间，中国石油天然气集团公司与孟加拉国油气矿产公司、孟加拉国石油公司签署了油气领域合作谅解备忘录。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The two sides agreed to enhance transport links and , in this connection , to continue to discuss the possibility of building road and rail links between the two countries .
Translation: 双方同意加强交通互联互通，并就此继续探讨两国间建设公路和铁路连接的可能性。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will enhance exchanges between technical and managerial personnel of agriculture , and further explore the specific ways and means of expanding agricultural cooperation .
Translation: 双方将加强农业技术和管理人员交流，进一步探索拓展农业合作的具体途径和方式。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The two sides agreed to carry out sustainable cooperation on hydrological data sharing and flood control of river Yarluzangbu\/Brahmaputra , in view of its necessity to the disaster reduction in Bangladesh .
Translation: 鉴于对孟加拉国减灾的必要性，双方同意在雅鲁藏布江/布拉马普特拉河的水文数据共享和防洪方面开展可持续合作。

Query_Text_en: The two sides agreed to strengthen cooperation on water resources management , hydrological data sharing , flood control and disaster reduction , based on the exchange of letters between the Ministries of Water Resources of the two countries in 2005 .
Translation: 双方同意在2005年两国水利部门换函基础上，加强水资源管理、水文数据共享、防洪减灾等领域合作。

Query_Text_en: At the request of the Bangladesh side , the Chinese side agreed to provide assistance for dredging of riverbeds and for capacity building through training of personnel .
Translation: 应孟方请求，中方同意为河道疏浚项目提供援助，并通过人员培训开展能力建设。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] The Bangladesh side hopes that China could launch a communication satellite in orbit for Bangladesh in the near future .
Translation: 孟加拉国方面希望中国能在不久的将来为其发射一颗在轨通信卫星。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side expressed interest to carry out cooperation with Bangladesh in this field .
Translation: 中方表示愿与孟加拉国在该领域开展合作。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In commemorating the 35th anniversary of our relations , the two sides agreed to further widen people-to-people and cultural exchanges and cooperation with a view to promoting mutual understanding and friendship between the peoples of the two friendly countries .
Translation: 在庆祝两国建交35周年之际，双方同意进一步扩大人文交流与合作，以增进两国人民之间的相互理解与友好情谊。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The Chinese People 's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries [ CPAFFC ] and the Bangladesh-China People 's Friendship Association will jointly host the China-Bangladesh Friendship and Brightness [ Ophthalmic ] Trip , meaning , a team of Chinese medical experts will visit Bangladesh to offer free medical treatment to Bangladeshi cataract patients .
Translation: 中国人民对外友好协会与孟中人民友好协会将共同主办"中孟友好光明行"活动，届时中国医疗专家组将赴孟加拉国为当地白内障患者实施免费诊疗。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Chinese side will continue to provide government scholarships to Bangladesh and in the meanwhile welcome Bangladeshi students to China for study under other programs and through other channels .
Translation: 中方将继续向孟方提供政府奖学金，同时欢迎孟加拉国学生通过其他项目和渠道来华留学。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side agreed to provide Chinese government scholarships annually for young Bangladeshi diplomats to study in China .
Translation: 中方同意每年向孟加拉国青年外交官提供中国政府奖学金赴华进修。

Query_Text_en: At the request of the Bangladesh side , the Chinese side agreed to gradually increase the number of scholarships provided to Bangladeshi students depending upon circumstances .
Translation: 应孟方请求，中方同意视情逐步增加向孟加拉国学生提供的奖学金名额。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will strengthen exchanges and cooperation for capacity building in Chinese language and human resources .
Translation: 双方将加强汉语教学与人力资源能力建设交流合作。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The two sides will actively expand exchanges and cooperation in culture , press , health , sports and tourism and promote contacts between the media organizations , think tanks , scholars , friendship groups , women 's groups , cultural troupes , athletes and youths .
Translation: 双方将积极拓展文化、新闻、卫生、体育、旅游等领域交流合作，推动媒体机构、智库、学者、友好团体、妇女组织、文艺团体、运动员及青年群体间的交往。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The two sides agreed to consider negotiating and signing a bilateral consular agreement and will conduct consultations in this regard through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 5. 双方同意考虑商签双边领事协定，并将通过外交渠道就此进行磋商。
